title: Flow Yoga by Aomam
address: 228 Kaeonawarat Rd, Tambon Wat Ket, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai 50000, Thailand
plusCode: R228+H3 Chiang Mai, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

reviews.name: maya Gitolendia
reviews.text: If you're looking for an amazing yoga experience in Chiang Mai, Thailand, Flow Yoga by Aomam is an absolute gem. The lovely teacher brings a unique approach to every session, making each practice  deeply fulfilling and fun. What really stands out is the warmth and friendliness of the entire team—they truly make you feel like part of a family. The atmosphere is very welcoming, creating the perfect environment for relaxation and growth. My time here left me with unforgettable memories, and I can't recommend this studio enough! Kob Khun Kha !

reviews.name: Aashna Sandhu
reviews.text: Teacher Aomam is simply amazing. She transformed what yoga means to me. Class size is small, max 9 mats, and most students are Thai. She is kind and flexible, and does her best to teach in both English and Thai. She also offers a class pack deal, which I really appreciated. If you’re looking for a spiritual, intimate and welcoming practice, this is the studio for you. It is challenging but in all the best ways. All levels of practitioners are welcomed here. Thanks to Teacher Aomam, I am pursuing my 100 YTT and hopefully my 200 YTT in the future.

reviews.name: Suchada Pankor
reviews.text:
Kru Aom is a great yoga instructor. She is kind and gives such great advices. She always reminds you to listen to your body and being thankful to yourself to be able to find time to do yoga.

The location is by the Arcade bus station. You can easily find parkings there.

Small studio but full of great energies and supports. 🙏

Everyone can join, yoga is not a competition. ❤️

reviews.name: duangtean chantana
reviews.text: Good energy and good class . If you want to plactice yoga you can come. Easier for transportation and nearest chiangmai bus terminal.

reviews.name: Angela Huber
reviews.text: Great yoga studio! Aomam, the teacher, has a great knowledge and she supports you exactly where you need it. Since it is a small studio, the classes are very personal and you can improve a lot, also the atmosphere between the students is very friendly and easy-going. I can only recommend it!

reviews.name: Ella Buhbinder
reviews.text: Lovely yoga studio, professional, attentive and super nice teacher. Very calm and good atmosphere, suitable for all levels.

reviews.name: Genevieve Laurent
reviews.text: One of the best yoga studio in chiangmai!!

reviews.text:
ครูอ้อมสอนดี เป็นกันเอง คนไม่มีพื้นฐานก็เรียนได้ค่ะ
พื้นที่สะอาดและเรียบง่าย ถ่ายรูปสวย

reviews.textTranslated:
Teacher Aom teaches well and is friendly. Even those with no prior experience can learn.
The space is clean and simple, and the photos are beautiful.
This is a warm, welcoming yoga studio. The teaching is gradual, focusing on muscle development. It's perfect for those looking to build strength and flexibility throughout their entire body.
If you're looking for a yoga studio in Chiang Mai, don't miss this one! :)

reviews.text: เป็นสตูโยคะที่อบอุ่น กันเอง คุณครูใจดี เพื่อนในคลาสก็น่ารักทุกคนค่ะ ครูช่วยฝึกดูแลตามร่างกายของเรา ฝึกเท่าที่ได้ ทำเท่าที่ไหว ไม่กดดัน แฮปปี้ทุกครั้งที่มาเรียนค่ะ 🥰

reviews.textTranslated: The instructor is lovely and kind. Classes are suitable for beginners, those with no prior experience, and experienced practitioners. There are various time slots to choose from. Highly recommended.

reviews.text:
มาเทรนที่นี่ได้ 3 เดือนคอบ่าไหล่ แข็งแรง ยืดหยุ่นขึ้น ผ่านไป 6 เดือนอาการปวดตึงลดลง ยกเครดิตให้ครูแพร ที่รับฟังความต้องการของนักเรียน ออกแบบโปรแกรมการเทรนแบบมีเป้าหมาย ยืด นวด คลายกล้ามเนื้อตอนจบทุกครั้ง

สตูดิโอ สวย สะอาด โปร่ง มีความเป็นไพรเวทที่แท้ทรู แอร์เย็นชื่นใจ ที่จอดรถสะดวกสบาย

reviews.textTranslated:
I've been training here for 3 months, and my neck, shoulders, and upper back have become stronger and more flexible. After 6 months, the pain and stiffness have decreased. I give credit to Teacher Prae for listening to her students' needs and designing goal-oriented training programs, including stretching, massage, and muscle relaxation at the end of every session.

The studio is beautiful, clean, spacious, and truly private. The air conditioning is refreshingly cool, and parking is convenient.

If you have office syndrome, body stiffness, or neck and shoulder tension, I highly recommend trying it.

reviews.name: Arunee Sukchit
reviews.text: บรรยากาศดี สะอาด สวยแกรมมากค่ะ ครูสอนใจดี พูดคุยเป็นกันเองน่ารักมากค่ะ เล่นแล้วรู้สึกฟิน เดินทางไปสะดวกหาเจอง่ายแนะนำเลยค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: The atmosphere is great, clean, and very beautiful. The instructor is kind, friendly, and lovely. Playing here felt amazing. It's easy to get to and easy to find. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Meaws Pml
reviews.text: สตูโอเค เครื่องไม่เยอะและไม่อึดอัด ไปถึงก้คือครูถามเลยว่ามีปัญหาตรงไหนมั้ยที่อยากแก้ คือช่วยได้เยอะ โดนจุดที่ปวด แต่เราไปtrialที่แบบเป็นproมีการวัดร่างกาย และนวดเมื่อเล่นเสร็จ วันที่ไปถึงคือเลท เพราะไปครั้งแรก และค่อนข้างไกลขนาดเผื่อเวลาเดินทางเป็นชม. พอพิลาทิสเสร็จก้มียืดเส้น แต่ไม่ได้นวดเลยถามว่าไม่มีนวดหรอคะ instructorเลยบอกว่าตัดออก พอดีมีสอนต่อ แต่จริงๆควรจะแจ้งแต่แรกว่าอาจจะต้องตัดออกเพราะเวลาไม่ทัน อีกอย่างเราเดินทางมาไกลมากกกกกจากสุขุมวิท หลังจากนั้นฝนตกเลยกะจะรอฝนซาแล้วออกไป ครูถามอีกว่าเรียกรถอยู่มั้ย เพราะมีนักเรียนcancel classเลยจะปิดสตู (เหมือนไล่) เอาจริงตอนสอนเล่นคือโอเคนะ ปล.เราไม่ได้เล่นทุกอย่างในสตู อย่างบางที่ไปtrialคือให้เล่นหมด serviceดีมากกกกๆ ความรุ้สึกหลังได้รับอะไรดีๆก้คือจองคลาสไปซ้ำ ระหว่างรอgrabคืออึดอัดมาก เลยถือว่าการtriaคือดีอย่าง ถ้าไม่โอเคก้คือเลือกได้ว่าควรจะเสียเงินให้มั้ย
reviews.textTranslated: The studio was okay; not too many machines and not cramped. When I arrived, the instructor immediately asked if I had any problems I wanted to address, which was very helpful and hit the right spots. However, I went for a trial session with a more professional approach, which included body measurements and a massage after the session. I arrived late because it was my first time, and it's quite far – I even factored in an hour for travel time. After Pilates, there was stretching, but no massage. I asked if there was a massage, and the instructor said it was cut out because they had another class to teach. But they should have informed me beforehand that it might be cut out due to time constraints. Also, I traveled a very long way from Sukhumvit. After that, it started raining, so I planned to wait for the rain to stop before leaving. The instructor asked if I wanted to call a taxi because a student had cancelled a class and they were going to close the studio (it felt like they were trying to get me to leave). Honestly, the workout itself was okay. P.S. I didn't try everything in the studio. Some places let you use everything during a trial session with excellent service. After receiving such good service, I booked another class. Waiting for a Grab taxi was very uncomfortable, so I think the trial session is great because if it's not okay, you can choose whether or not you should pay for it.

reviews.name: Puy
reviews.text:

Teacher Prae took very good care of us.🫶🏻
The studio was clean, spacious, and not cramped at all.

reviews.name: Beaut Nisawara
reviews.text:

reviews.textTranslated:
The Pilates studio is beautiful, clean, spacious, and not cramped 🎀🤍
Plenty of parking 🚗

The instructor is lovely, teaches well, and hits all the right spots 💗

reviews.name: ืีnun mee
reviews.text: ไปทดลองเรียน มาหลายที่ เกือบจะถอดใจเลิกเรียนพิลาทิสแล้วแต่พอมาลองเรียนที่นี้ ทำให้รู้สึกมีจุดมุ่งหมายที่จะมาเรียนพิลาทิสต่อ ประทับใจครูที่นี้ค่ะ ครูสอนดีมาก ตั้งแต่การหายใจ ครูใจเย็น ขอบคุณมากนะคะ
reviews.textTranslated: I've tried out classes at several places and almost gave up on Pilates, but after trying it here, I feel like I have a purpose to continue learning. I'm very impressed with the instructors here. They teach very well, starting from breathing exercises. They are very patient. Thank you so much!

reviews.name: PuNcH SuThIdA
reviews.text: ครูมายด์สอนละเอียดเข้าใจ่งาย ใส่ใจและใจดีมาก ไม่กดดันเลยถึงไม่เคยเล่นมาก่อน สถานที่สะอาด บรรยากาศดี  หาง่าย เดินทางสะดวกไม่ต้องเข้าซอยไปไกล
reviews.textTranslated: Teacher Mind teaches in detail, making it easy to understand. She's very attentive and kind, and doesn't put any pressure on anyone, even if they've never played before. The place is clean, the atmosphere is good, it's easy to find, and convenient to get to—no need to go far down a side street.

reviews.textTranslated: The teaching was excellent and the instructor was very attentive. The place was clean. It was fantastic!

address: 2 nd floor, Onnut plaza, 486 On Nut Rd, Suan Luang, Bangkok 10250, Thailand

reviews.name: Supattra Wattananond
reviews.text: I discovered MeeDee Studio four months ago and have been practicing Pilates ever since. Great atmosphere(quiet and friendly) with good instructor. It has really helped both my body and mind. I've noticed improved focus while working on each pose and my core strength has increased. Feel more confident with my body and posture:-) Thank to MeeDee Studio for helping me get back on track with my exercise routine🙏🏼❤️
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for choosing Mee Dee Pilates Studio 🤍
We’re glad you enjoyed our service and caring instructors. Looking forward to seeing you in the next class 🫶🏻

reviews.name: Veronika Butckovskaia
reviews.text: Very aesthetically pleasing studio. They were very friendly and helpful when i just started, all the instructors are great at what they do. Highly recommend
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your wonderful review.
We're delighted to hear that you enjoyed the atmosphere of our studio and had a great experience with our friendly team and instructors. Your recommendation means a lot to us.
MEE DEE Pilates Studio is always happy to welcome you, and we look forward to seeing you again soon! 🧘✨

reviews.name: Gwendolyn Perfort
reviews.text: The instructor is very nice. She fixed my muscle problems with absolute expertise. The other students are kind and fun! I have happy time here and I’m definitely continue coming here😊
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your wonderful review.💙✨
We're delighted to hear that our instructor was able to help with your muscle concerns and that you've been enjoying the friendly and fun atmosphere at the studio. Your kind words mean a lot to us. Everyone at MEE DEE Pilates Studio is always happy to welcome you, and we look forward to seeing you again for many more happy sessions!

reviews.name: Pattra Wanichwasin
reviews.text:
I have been practicing Pilates at Meedee Studio since last year, and it has been an impressive experience. I have some issues with my shoulder muscles, and the instructor, Kru Da, always keeps a close eye on me and helps me maintain the correct posture, especially when I can’t perform certain movements like others.

Practicing here makes me feel relaxed, stronger, and more focused.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your lovely review 💖
Mee Dee Pilates Studio is happy to know you enjoyed our classes, instructors, and warm atmosphere. Hope to see you again soon ✨

reviews.name: Viroj Thoraninpanich
reviews.text:
1 year Pilates here, good location.
And Instructor Da is nice and detail to all player, smalland quality group class here, recommended. ✨
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much ka💕

reviews.name: Nice Thidaporn Intaraparn
reviews.text: คุณครูดา รวมถึงครู parttime ใจดีและน่ารักมากๆค่ะ สอนแบบค่อยเป็นค่อยไป มีการปรับท่าหากไม่สามารถเล่นท่าที่ advance ได้ ปรับให้เหมาะกับความสามารถค่ะ ซึ่งเราเล่นพีลาทิสแบบ Group class ที่ Mee dee Pilates มาประมาณเกือบ 1 ปีแล้วค่ะ ส่วนตัวแล้วเป็นโรคกระดูกสันหลังคด หลังเรียนได้ประมาณ 3-4 เดือนหายปวดหลังล่างเลยค่ะ เป็นเพราะได้ฝึก core & back muscle รวมถึงฝึกความแข็งแรง/ทนทานในกล้ามเนื้ออื่นๆ และคิดว่าออกกำลังกายนี้ค่อนข้างเหมาะกับ lifestyle ค่ะ เอาไปเยยย 10-10-10💖🙏🏻✨
reviews.textTranslated: Teacher Da, along with the part-time teachers, are incredibly kind and lovely. They teach at a gradual pace, adjusting poses if advanced poses are too difficult, adapting them to suit my ability. I've been doing group Pilates classes at Mee dee Pilates for almost a year now. Personally, I have scoliosis, and after about 3-4 months of classes, my lower back pain disappeared! This is because I've been training my core and back muscles, as well as building strength and endurance in other muscles. I think this exercise suits my lifestyle perfectly. 10/10/10! 💖🙏🏻✨
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you ka 💕

reviews.name: Thanathorn Ngamchai
reviews.text:
Pilates Studio เล็กๆบนถนนอ่อนนุช
เป็นสตูที่ไม่เน้นจำนวนผู้ฝึกเยอะ
แต่ให้ความใส่ใจกับผู้ฝึกอย่างใกล้ชิด🫶

คลาสเรียนไม่ได้แบ่งแยก Level อย่างชัดเจน
แต่ผู้ฝึกทุกระดับสามารถฝึกร่วมกันได้ แบบไม่กดดัน
และยังสนุกด้วย 👍😻

ครูผู้สอนมี Option สำหรับทุกคน เพื่อให้ผู้ฝึกสามารถทำได้ตามความสามารถของร่างกายตัวเอง ณ เวลานั้น และยังมีท่าให้เราลอง Challenge ร่างกายอีกด้วย💪

บรรยากาศในคลาสเรียนเป็นกันเอง เพื่อนๆร่วมคลาสน่ารัก ส่งพลังบวกให้กันเสมอๆ🧡

คลาสที่นี้มีตลอดทั้งวัน และทุกวัน สามารถเลือกฝึกได้ตามสะดวก แต่เนื่องจากจำนวนที่มีจำกัด
แนะนำให้วางแผนจองล่วงหน้ากันด้วยนะคะ😊
reviews.textTranslated:
A small Pilates studio on On Nut Road.
It doesn't focus on large groups,
but rather on providing close, personalized attention to each student 🫶

Classes aren't strictly divided by level,
but students of all levels can train together without pressure,
and it's fun too 👍😻

The instructors offer options for everyone, allowing students to perform exercises according to their current physical capabilities, and there are also challenging poses to try 💪

The class atmosphere is friendly, and the classmates are lovely, always spreading positive energy 🧡

Classes are available throughout the day, every day, so you can choose one that suits you. However, due to limited space,
we recommend planning to book in advance 😊
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
ขอบคุณสำหรับรีวิว และ เลือกมาใช้บริการที่ MEE DEE Pilates Studio นะคะ
โอกาสหน้ามาออกกำลังกายที่นี่อีกนะคะ MEE DEE Pilates ยินดีต้อนรับค่ะ

reviews.name: Nannaphas S
reviews.text:
Studio บรรยากาศดี สะอาด และเป็นส่วนตัวมากค่ะ
ครูสอนใส่ใจ แนะนำท่าถูกต้อง เข้าใจง่าย
เหมาะทั้งมือใหม่และคนที่มีพื้นฐาน
เล่นแล้วรู้สึกได้เลยว่า core body ทำงานจริง 😄
อุปกรณ์ครบ และจัดคลาสไม่แออัด
แนะนำเลยค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated:
The studio has a great atmosphere, is clean, and very private.
The instructor is attentive, explains the techniques correctly, and makes it easy to understand.
Suitable for both beginners and those with some experience.
I could really feel my core body working after the workout 😄
The equipment is complete, and the classes aren't crowded.
Highly recommend!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
ขอบคุณมากนะคะที่ไว้วางใจมาออกกำลังกายกับ Mee Dee Pilates Studio ✨
ดีใจมากที่ได้เป็นส่วนหนึ่งในการดูแลสุขภาพและการฟื้นฟูร่างกายของคุณนะคะ 🤍
หวังว่าทุกคลาสจะช่วยให้รู้สึกแข็งแรง ผ่อนคลาย และมีความสุขมากขึ้นค่ะ แล้วพบกันในคลาสถัดไปนะคะ 🫶🏻

reviews.name: Possawee K
reviews.text: เป็นสตูที่ดีมากๆค่ะ เดินทางสะดวก มีที่จอดรถ คุณครูสอนดีมากๆ ใจดี คอยจัดท่าให้ถูกต้องตลอด ใส่ใจนักเรียนดีมากๆค่ะ แนะนำ😘
reviews.textTranslated: This is a really great studio! It's easy to get to and there's parking. The instructors are excellent, very kind, and always make sure you have correct posture. They are very attentive to their students. Highly recommend! 😘
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
ขอบคุณมากๆ สำหรับรีวิวน่ารักๆ นะคะ 🥹💖
Mee Dee Pilates Studio ดีใจมากที่คุณลูกค้าประทับใจทั้งบรรยากาศ การเดินทาง และการดูแลของคุณครูค่ะ ✨
พวกเราตั้งใจดูแลและใส่ใจทุกรายละเอียด เพื่อให้นักเรียนได้ออกกำลังกายอย่างถูกต้องและปลอดภัยที่สุด 🤍
ขอบคุณที่แนะนำสตูดิโอของเรานะคะ แล้วพบกันในคลาสต่อไปค่า 🫶🏻😘

reviews.name: Pimrampa Kititarakul
reviews.text: สตูดิโอพิลาทิสอยู่ในอ่อนนุชพลาซ่า สถานที่สะอาด คุณครูน่ารักใจดีค่ะ ดูแลทั่วถึง แนะนำให้มาลองค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: The Pilates studio is located in On Nut Plaza. The place is clean, and the instructor is lovely and kind, providing attentive care. I recommend giving it a try.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
ขอบคุณสำหรับรีวิวน่ารักๆ ค่ะ 🤍

reviews.name: Nicky nick
reviews.text: I have attended yoga classes at many places in Bangkok before, but this is my first time joining a class at North Shala Chiang Mai. I’m truly impressed with my experience here. The place is spacious, easy to access, and offers classes at various times throughout the day. The yoga instructors are highly experienced and guide each step with great understanding, which I believe is very important when choosing a yoga studio. This is definitely one of the best yoga studios in Chiang Mai — highly recommended.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for sharing your experience! We’re truly happy to hear that your first class at North Shala Chiang Mai left such a great impression. We’re glad you enjoyed the space, the convenient location, and the variety of class times. Our instructors always aim to guide with care and understanding, so it means a lot to know you felt well supported.
Thank you for recommending us — we’re excited to welcome you back to the mat again soon!

reviews.name: Hwang관중
reviews.text:
One of the best decisions I made during my 6 months in Chiang Mai was joining this studio.
This isn’t just your average yoga class — it genuinely builds both strength and flexibility in a way I hadn’t experienced before. I can say with confidence it’s the best class I’ve been to.
Both Kru Tai and Neur are exceptional teachers who really know how to guide you. If you’re in Chiang Mai and wondering where to start your fitness journey, don’t overthink it — just sign up here. You won’t regret it!”
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your wonderful review and for choosing North Shala Yoga!🙏 We're so happy to hear that you're enjoying your practice and seeing the benefits. It's a pleasure having you with us. We truly appreciate your support and hope to see you again ! 🧘‍♀️

reviews.name: Jaycow Millinery / Block Common
reviews.text:
I am so happy that I have found North Shaka Yoga Studio through the recommendation of a friend! The first day of class I saw so many familiar faces from my neighbourhood, I knew I am in the right place.
Kru Tai is a great teacher! She encourage and guides you with what you need to push for more strength to grow in your practice.
Her fine tuning and adjustment to my poses helped so much!
I love her humour too! So much laughter in her classes!Great mix of students, encouraging each other to come to the mat to practice.
I have grown so much in my practice since coming to this studio!
I am encouraging my son to practice with me.
Come and experience for yourself!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your beautiful words! I’m so happy you found your way to North Shala and that the studio feels like the right place for you. It’s always a joy having you in class — your energy and smile bring such a great vibe! Can’t wait to see you (and maybe your son soon!) on the mat again. 💛🙏

reviews.name: Sarah Denny
reviews.text: I’ve loved coming to Tai’s classes! She is so supportive and has a lot of great knowledge about stretching, yoga and health. She is very kind to speak English for my friends and I. I will miss her very much when I have to go back home to America! ❤️❤️❤️ I highly recommend her classes!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ขอบคุณมากนะคะ แน่นอน ฉันจะคิดถึงคุณและนึกถึงเวลาที่เราได้ฝึกโยคะด้วยกัน ขอบคุณที่เปิดใจฝึกโยคะ ขอให้คุณฝึกอย่างต่อเนื่องนะคะ  Hug with love🤗❤️

reviews.name: Sompor Wannapat Suranant
reviews.text: I have been practicing yoga with Kru Tai for 4 years. The studio is spacious with a proper bathroom and shower (better than many studios I have been to). Kru Tai truly listens to her students and understands the our bodies. I have been practicing yoga for more than 10 years. Sometimes i would push myself and get hurt from my practice, Kru tai is the one who always adjust and correct my posture for me so I can heal faster. If anyone is looking for a yoga teacher around Hang Dong area, I highly recommend Kru Tai.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much for your wonderful feedback. I truly appreciate your trust and commitment to your practice over the years. I’m grateful to be part of your yoga journey.

I’ve joined Hatha Yoga🙏, Body Weight🏃‍♀️, Fit Ball, and Yoga Flow classes🧘‍♀️ — and I enjoy every one of them. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a supportive and positive place to practice yoga!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your kind words and for being part of North Shala Studio. I’m so glad you feel safe and encouraged in your practice. You bring such positive energy to every class — keep shining on your yoga journey! 🌸

reviews.name: กายรัตน์ อาดํา
reviews.text:
เรียนทำขนมที่นี่
ครูสอนเข้าใจง่าย ไม่มีพื้นฐานก็ทำได้
สะอาด อุปกรณ์และวัตถุดิบที่ใช้ดีมากๆค่ะ ที่สำคัญสูตรขนมอร่อยมากๆๆค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated:
Learn to bake here!
The instructor is easy to understand; even without prior experience, you can do it.
It's clean, and the equipment and ingredients are of very high quality. Most importantly, the recipes are delicious!

reviews.name: กาญจนา รอดรักษ์
reviews.text:
เรียนทำเค้กกับครูกวาง 2 วัน 10 เมนู
จากที่ไม่มีประสบการณ์เลย และไม่คิดว่าตัวเองจะทำได้ พอได้ลองทำ รู้สึกมั่นใจขึ้นเยอะเลยและเชื่อว่าเราจะทำได้

ขอบคุณครูกวางมากๆ นะคะ ครูสอนเข้าใจง่าย ใจดี ไม่ดุด้วย Studio สวยมากค่ะ หอมกลิ่นขนมอบอวลไปทั้งสตูเลย ที่สำคัญขนมอร่อยมากค่ะ หวานกำลังดี เป็นรสชาติที่กำลังตามหาเลยค่ะ

จะมา update เมนูใหม่ๆ กับครูเรื่อยๆ นะคะ❤️
reviews.textTranslated:
I took a cake-making class with Teacher Kwang for two days, learning 10 different recipes.
I had no experience at all and didn't think I could do it. After trying, I felt so much more confident and believed I could do it!

Thank you so much, Teacher Kwang. Your teaching was easy to understand, you were kind, and not strict at all. Your studio is beautiful, and the aroma of baked goods filled the whole place. Most importantly, the cakes were delicious! They were perfectly sweet, exactly the flavor I was looking for.

I'll be back to get updates on new recipes from you regularly! ❤️

reviews.name: Rattiya Phuangsap
reviews.text:
เรียนทำขนมกับครูกวางบอกเลยว่าคุ้มค่ามาก
ครูสอนเก่ง ไม่มีพื้นฐานเลยก็ทำได้
สถานที่เรียนเดินทางไปง่าย สะอาด อุปกรณ์และวัตถุดิบที่ใช้ดีมากๆค่ะ ที่สำคัญสูตรขนมของครูอร่อยมากๆๆค่ะ
ให้ใครชิม ทุกคนชมหมดเลยค่ะว่าอร่อย นำไปพัฒนาเป็นอาชีพได้สบายๆเลย
reviews.textTranslated:
Learning to bake with Teacher Kwang was totally worth it!
The teacher is excellent; even someone with no prior experience can do it.
The learning location is easy to get to, clean, and the equipment and ingredients used are of very high quality. Most importantly, the teacher's recipes are incredibly delicious!
Everyone I've shared with them has praised how delicious they are. I can easily develop these skills into a career.

reviews.name: มนต์ภัสสร
reviews.text: ขอบคุณครูเคน ครูกวางมากๆนะคะ ไม่มีพื้นฐาน ไม่มีประสบการณ์ ก็ทำได้  ไม่ผิดหวังที่มาเรียนจริงๆค่ะ *สูตรขนมอร่อยมาก
reviews.textTranslated: Thank you so much, Teacher Ken and Teacher Kwang! Even without any prior knowledge or experience, I was able to do it. I'm so glad I came to learn! *The dessert recipes were delicious!*

reviews.name: น.ส.จุฬารัตน์ วงษ์แก้ว
reviews.text:
ได้เรียนทำเค้กกับครูกวาง สนุกมากค่ะ คุณครูใจดี สอนเข้าใจง่าย ให้เราทำเองทุกขั้นตอนเลยค่ะ
ได้ความรู้จริงๆ คนไม่มีพื้นฐานก็สามารถมาเรียนได้น๊าห้องเรียนน่ารักมาก เดินทางสะดวก เรียนเสร็จเอาเค้กกลับบ้านได้ทั้งหมดเลยค่ะ เค้กที่ครูสอนทำอร่อยมากฟินสุด ลองเปิดใจมาเรียนกันนะคะ🧁🍰🤤✨
reviews.textTranslated:
I had so much fun learning how to make cakes with Teacher Kwang! She's kind, teaches in an easy-to-understand way, and lets us do everything ourselves.
I really learned something new. Even people with no prior experience can come and learn. The classroom is adorable, and it's easy to get there. After the class, you can take all the cakes home with you! The cakes she taught us to make were incredibly delicious. Give it a try and come learn with us! 🧁🍰🤤✨

reviews.name: Jasita Puechthonglang
reviews.text: ครูกวางสอนสนุก เข้าใจง่าย มีแนะนำเทคนิคเยอะแยะมากมายค่ะ เรียน4 เมนู หอม อร่อยทุกอย่างเลยค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: Teacher Kwang's lessons were fun and easy to understand. She shared lots of techniques. We learned four recipes, and they were all fragrant and delicious!

reviews.name: CHATHAMON A.
reviews.text: เรียนคลาสprivate กับหลาน ครูกวางกับครูเคน สอนใจเย็นและสนุก มากค่ะ  ได้เทคนิคต่างๆเพิ่มมากขึ่น หลานก็ชอบมากด้วยค่ะ จะมาเรียนคลาสต่อไปอีกค่า
reviews.textTranslated: I took a private class with my nephew, Teacher Kwang and Teacher Ken. They taught patiently and it was very fun. I learned many more techniques and my nephew really enjoyed it. I will definitely come back for another class.

reviews.name: นภา ไชยภา
reviews.text: ไปเรียนมาทั้งหมด 3 เมนูค่ะ คุณครูสอนสนุกและใจดีมากค่ะ สำหรับคนไม่มีพื้นฐานคุณครูก็แนะนำ และสอนทุกขั้นตอนเลยค่ะ มีแนะนำทริคหลายๆทริคด้วย สูตรขนมอร่อยค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: I took three baking classes in total. The teacher was fun and very kind. Even for those with no prior experience, the teacher guided and taught every step. They also shared many tips and tricks. The desserts were delicious!

reviews.name: 밀크
reviews.text: ครูสอนเข้าใจง่าย บรรยากาศในห้องเรียนดีมาก เรียนสนุก สูตรขนมอร่อยมากด้วยค่ะ💖💖💖💖
reviews.textTranslated: The teacher explained things clearly, the classroom atmosphere was great, learning was fun, and the dessert recipes were delicious! 💖💖💖💖

reviews.name: Vcan Go
reviews.text: คุณครูใจดี สอนสนุกเข้าใจง่าย สูตรเค้กอร่อยสามารถทำขายได้เลย ประทับใจมากคะ
reviews.textTranslated: The teacher was kind, the lessons were fun and easy to understand, and the cake recipe was delicious enough to sell. I was very impressed!

reviews.name: somwang meow meow
reviews.text: เรียนมา 2รอบแล้วค๊าา สอนสนุกมากๆ ครูกวางน่ารัก เป็นกันเอง บอกเคล็ดลับ แล้ววัตถุดิบ อุปกรณ์ที่ต้องใช้ ให้นักเรียนลงมือทำทุกขั้นตอนช่วยแก้ไขปัญหาตอนเรียน ต้องมีเรียนรอบ3 แน่นอน❤
reviews.textTranslated: I've taken the class twice already! The teaching is so much fun. Teacher Kwang is lovely and friendly. She shares tips, and shows us exactly what ingredients and equipment are needed. She lets students do everything themselves and helps solve problems during the class. I'll definitely be taking a third class! ❤

reviews.name: Vicky
reviews.text: เป็นคลาสที่ได้ลงมือปฏิบัติเองทุกขั้นตอนจริงๆ ตั้งแต่ตวงวัตถุดิบ ครูจับมือทำจริงๆสำหรับมือใหม่ รายละเอียดและเทคนิคเยอะมากๆ
reviews.textTranslated: This is a truly hands-on class, where you get to do everything yourself, from measuring ingredients to the instructor guiding you step-by-step, especially for beginners. There are tons of details and techniques covered.

reviews.name: Ging Ueapamon
reviews.text: ครูน่ารักทั้ง2คนเลยค่ะ สอนแบบเป็นกันเอง ทำทุกอย่างเสร็จภายในเวลาที่กำหนด บริหารเวลาในการสอนดีมากค่ะ ที่สำคัญสูตรขนมครูเขาอร่อยจริงๆค่ะ🩷
reviews.textTranslated: Both teachers are lovely! They teach in a friendly manner, complete everything within the allotted time, and manage their time very well. Most importantly, their dessert recipes are truly delicious! 🩷

reviews.name: Thararath Shansungnoen
reviews.text: มาเรียนหลายรอบแล้ว ได้เทคนิคดี ๆ เยอะแยะมากมายค่ะ ครุกวาง ครูเคนสอนดีมาก 😍😍😍 แนะนำวิธีการต่าง ๆ ที่ไม่รู้มาก่อน /
reviews.textTranslated: I've attended several classes already and learned so many great techniques. Teacher Krung and Teacher Ken are excellent instructors 😍😍😍 They introduced many methods I didn't know before.

reviews.name: Sirikarn Jatuponepairoe
reviews.text: ครูสอนเป็นกันเอง เข้าใจง่าย ได้ลองทำทุกอย่างเองด้วย ไม่มีพื้นฐานเลยก็เรียนได้ เรียนสนุกมากกก
reviews.textTranslated: The teacher is friendly and the content is easy to understand. We got to try everything ourselves. Even someone with no prior knowledge can learn. It was so much fun!

reviews.name: อรอนงค์ แก้วมณี
reviews.text: ได้ลงเรียนคอส 4 เมนู สนุกประทับใจมากๆเลยค่ะ ได้ความรู้เพิ่มขึ้นเยอะมาก
reviews.textTranslated: I took a course on 4 menus and it was so much fun and memorable! I learned a lot.

reviews.name: Kningkn
reviews.text: คุณครูสอนสนุกให้คำแนะนำดี สูตรเค้กอร่อยไม่เลี่ยน สามารถทำตามได้จริง❤️
reviews.textTranslated: The teacher was fun and gave great advice. The cake recipe was delicious, not too sweet, and actually easy to follow. ❤️

reviews.name: Saowanit Sutapak
reviews.text: เรียนที่นี่ 2 คอร์สแล้วค่ะ ที่เรียนสะอาด อุปกรณ์ไฮโซโก้เก๋มาก เป็น smeg lover ด้วยค่ะ แล้วครูน่ารักทุกคน ไม่มีกั๊กสูตรเลย เอาไปทำขายได้สบายเลยค่ะ คอร์สต่อไปไม่พลาดแน่ๆค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: I've taken two courses here already. The place is clean, and the equipment is high-end and stylish. I'm a Smeg lover too! All the instructors are lovely and don't hold back any recipes. I can easily sell my products using what I've learned. I definitely won't miss the next course!

reviews.name: สุภาพร มะลิทอง
reviews.text: คุณครูน่ารักทั้งสองคนเลยค่ะ สอนเข้าใจง่าย
reviews.textTranslated: Both teachers are lovely and their lessons are easy to understand.

title: Enjoy Thai Cooking - Krabi School
address: 585 4, Khwaeng Lak Song, Khet Bang Khae, Chang Wat Krabi 81000, Thailand
plusCode: P95W+VP Bangkok, Thailand

reviews.name: Ravit Shem-Tov
reviews.text:
Had a lovely morning learning about Thai cooking and making some delicious dishes with Tu, the chef and teacher.
She showed and shared some useful information about the Thai kitchen and it’s ingredients, and I had the change to choose 5 dishes that we prepared together.
It was deliciously fun, and not too much work, perfect for a vacation cooking school.
The class also included transports, and all the recipes for what we made. Tu has good English, so communication is easy.
Very fun addition to your Krabi vacation

reviews.name: Amir Ariely
reviews.text:
We had the best time learning from Tony and Tu.
The instructions were clear, the atmosphere was amazingly friendly (we were the only ones so we had a private lesson!), and the food was delicious.

We were picked up at the pier by Tony (we were staying at Railay beach) straight to the cooking class at their lovely back yard. Each one of us chose 5 dishes, and all ingredients (most vegetables are home grown!) were pre washed and waiting for us at the table. Tony explained what is each ingredient, let us taste the ones we weren’t familiar with, and then explained their cutting technique. Then we cooked each dish and ate our masterpieces :)

We learnt a lot from this class and will definitely try many of the dishes at home!
Don’t hesitate and go there for a wonderful day of cooking.

reviews.name: Alexandra Pavičić
reviews.text: Absolutely amazing experience. We have learnt a lot about Thai cuisine, the dishes were delicious. At the end you also get a cook book. Really nive atmosphere. Highly recommended.

reviews.name: Lorene Maucher
reviews.text: I had a great afternoon with very good food and friendly people.  I was picked up from my hostel on time and brought back again.  It was all very authentic and would recommend it to everyone!  Thank you for this experience.

reviews.name: Antonio Pavičić
reviews.text:
Amazing, it was so obvious how they enjoyed showing and teaching us how to make Thai dishes.
We could choose 6 dishes, then we got an explanation of each ingredient and them quite and easy: make your dish with our teacher.

Guys come there with an empty stomach because after all, you will enjoy your Thai food. If you will not have space, like we, you will be able to take it with you. 🤩🤩

reviews.name: Simona Domnisoru
reviews.text: We had an amazing time. The teacher was fun and had 14 experience teaching the class. It takes place in the chef's home and patio. I recommend this course to anyone who wants to learn more about Thai culture while having fun and eating delicious freshly prepared meals.

reviews.name: Jason L.
reviews.text: Tu and Ton were both great. This class taught me a lot about Thai cooking. And Tu was very helpful and knowledgeable with any questions that I had. They were also kind enough to let me take a class despite being the only student. And, at the end I received a cookbook with all the recipes and information about Thai ingredients. I definitely recommend this class.

reviews.name: Chris
reviews.text: My wife and I took a dinner cooking class and we had a great time! It felt like authentic Thai food and not just tourist food. We learned about the ingredients and how to use them in the dishes we cooked and others. We came hungry and left almost to full to walk. A great experience.

reviews.name: Yayoi Yoshihara
reviews.text: We were 4 people and cooked four dishes. Each dish had choices and we independently chose different dishes. After we cooked, we taste them each other and chat. Staff was very very friendly and well organized. I totally recommend Lanna Thai Cookery school!

reviews.name: Rohan Hemani
reviews.text: We had an amazing experience with Tu, the chef and instructor. It was a perfectly authentic experience in every way, from the dishes we made, to Tu’s instruction/humor, to her children bringing back flowers in real time for us to use in our cooking (for coloring only). Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Maia Diamant
reviews.text: We had an amazing time here! All ingredients were fresh and vegetables are grown in the backyard, we cooked every dish from scratch (a total of 10 dishes), and got to taste all of the dishes once we were done. Most importantly, our hosts were amazing, very welcoming and cooked like pros! Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Khruawan Param
reviews.text: Tony and Tuu are a wonderful couple which made our cooking experience fun and unique. As per the class program we went to the morning market where Tony explained about vegetables, spieces and meats for our cooking class. Tuu speaks great English which helped getting the recipe through while Tony directed the meal preparation and processes, We've also got a mini true karaoke time experience with Ton after class! . A lot of fun and have been  extremely happy our experience.

reviews.name: Greg Hustead
reviews.text: Had an amazingly amusing time learning how to cook some delicious classic Thai dishes to the Tu. She is hilarious and engaging. Will visit aging on our next trip to Thailand.

reviews.name: alex murphy
reviews.text: A brilliant experience. The instructors are very knowledgeable. Great equipment and set up. Must do if in Krabi. Thank you

reviews.name: Lawrence
reviews.text: Highly recommended cooking school for people who loves thai food. The class is very organized. You'll be amaze with the dish you've created!

reviews.name: Hattie Wood
reviews.text: Amazing day, thank you so much! So full and so yummy!

reviews.name: Pekka Varri
reviews.text: Nice and friendly place. Tony was an excellent teacher. It was wery homely place, not a tourist factory.

reviews.name: Adrian Rose
reviews.text: What a great morning. We learned so much and loved the fact we did every step, nothing was done for us 😀

reviews.name: J
reviews.text: Great experience, also for vegetarians :)

reviews.name: Catfish
reviews.text: Wonderful cookery school！！！

title: Thai Garden farm cooking classes
address: 259 หมู่ 7 หนองหาร San Sai District, Chiang Mai 50290, Thailand
plusCode: WXXX+26 เทศบาลเมืองแม่โจ้ San Sai District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

reviews.name: Gus van Oppen
reviews.text:
We joined Sorn and Thien for a Thai cooking class with our three young children. We started off by making a visit to the local market to buy fresh produce. We then l proceeded to their amazing place where we prepared a series of typical Thai meals.

The class was very well prepared. Sorn is a former chef so he is very knowledgeable about all the little details. The tour around the vegetable garden was the capstone to a rich Thai food culture experience.

We can definitely recommend a visit to the amazing little paradise Sorn and Thien created.

reviews.name: Chaz Lever
reviews.text: This was the coolest experience. We got to walk through a local fresh market to gather some ingredients, tour the garden where  herbs were grown, and cook a delicious multi-course meal using the ingredients we just sourced! Neither my wife nor I had ever made Thai food (let alone from scratch), but Tien was a wonderful teacher and host. She explained everything and helped us to prepare all the ingredients. Then she made us feel like master chefs as we cooked each dish—each of which were incredible! I couldn’t recommend this cooking experience enough, and we’d love to do it again the next time we’re in Chiang Mai!

reviews.name: Dr. Ost
reviews.text: We had an amazing time at the Thai Garden Farm! Son and his wife Tien are beautiful, warm and  welcoming people. We started with a little market tour at the outskirt of Chiangmai. After that we drove to the farm, which is around 20 minutes outside the city. Son took us on a little tour through his farm and we harvested fresh herbs and vegetables for our picked meals. The cooking took place in a big kitchen-dining area with an open floor plan, which offered a  perfect authentic setting. The food we made was delicious! Especially the sticky rice with mango was the best I have ever eaten!  We are very thankful for everything we learned that day - not just about cooking but about Thai life. We will never forget this day and this beautiful family. Thanks so much to Son and Tien. We definitely want to come back!

reviews.name: Thom Schrama
reviews.text:
We are still a bit amazed by this experience. These must be one of the warmest and friendliest people I’ve ever met.

We booked our cooking class via our hotel, we choose this cooking class because it seems to be one which takes place in a green and natural environment. Some classes also happen in the city, and that didn’t feel like the right fit for us.

At 8:30 we were picked up from our hotel by Son in a very comfortable mini van. He drove us to a very nice market just outside of the busy city. We got a tour from Son, he showed us around to see what everything on the market was, which ingredients are what and how people prepare. Some very helpful insights when visiting a local market and you have no clue what all these beautiful products are that you’re looking at. We got some time to stroll the market while Son did some groceries for the class.

After a short drive, not more than 30 min from the old centre, we drove into a lush green garden. The driveway was too small for this minivan, it was overwhelmed by nature. This turned out to be the garden farm of Son and his wife Tien. The one acre piece of land is filled with all different kinds of green, from citrus fruits to fresh pepper trees and the best range of basil I’ve ever smelled. We started with a tour of the grounds and Son shows you all the different vegetables, herbs, fruits and spices that he grows. You could really see that this man loves these products and he loves telling you about it.

Okay, let’s get to the cooking. I mean the place is amazing! It is a very professional set up, big counters with double sinks, everyone gets their own apron, towel, cutting board an knife. Everything you might need is there. And then you start prepping all the ingredients, and you get to see these lovely products from the market again and the crazy good basil from the garden.

We booked a half day course which means we cook 4 dishes. The steps are all very easy to follow and Son is there to help you out wherever you need. You cook with locally sourced products some even from their own backyard. The class is fun and educational. You use a variety of tools and equipment to prepare the ingredients. Basically you’re doing the mise en place. When everything is prepped you start cooking, which is really fast! Working with professional equipment makes you feel confident about the dish you’re cooking. And all of this under the guiding eyes of Son.

Hmmm, eating this Thai food which is some of the best Thai food I’ve ever eaten, and then I realised I made it myself! How awesome!

To round it up, the cooking class is a 10/10. For the chefs under us, the knifes are sharp and the equipment is there.
But what really makes this experience unforgettable are Son and Tien. The place they created, the kindness the show and the incredible welcome feeling you have when walking around and cooking in their home is one of a kind.

Tien and Son, thank you so much for this experience. 🙏

reviews.name: Farhad Rahnamoon
reviews.text: What an amazing experience. ‘Son’ was such a great teacher. We made 6 dishes and it was so much food we had to take our pad thai home for dinner. The class is at his personal two acre farm and it’s a beautiful environment to learn in. He’s very thorough and I really feel like I took a lot away from it. Plus they are just such sweet people and we had such a great day, can’t recommend them enough! We called directly and booked.

reviews.name: reema hamad
reviews.text: Fantastic cooking class from start to finish. Run by wonderful people who have excellent knowledge and speak english very well. The meals were so good we were so stuffed by the end. Lovely location i highly recommend

reviews.name: Leah Schullerer
reviews.text:
We had an amazing day here. Son picked us up from our accommodation and we drove together to the local market. This was a very cool experience, because the selling people were so friendly and Son explained us vegetables, we never heard before. A lot of this vegetables are also growing in the huge garden around the house of our cooking teacher. So you will cook with the fresh herbals from the garden. We did the full day class and we will do it again the next time we will be here in Chiang Mai.
If you want a cooking class with friendly people as Son, you have to book to become a Thaicook. 100% recommended!

reviews.name: Linus Frahm
reviews.text: Thank you for this cooking class which was the highlight of our Thailand trip! We spent a wonderful day at the farm. Son and his wife are really kindhearted and friendly people. After making our own curry paste we were able to cook 5 delicious dishes which you can choose from different categories. We ate an amazing soup and two main dishes at the farm, our Pad Thai and Mango sticky rice were prepared to take them home for dinner – in ecofriendly packages! Highly recommended when you visit Chiang Mai and want to experience a private cooking class! ขอบคุณครับ!

reviews.name: Taylor York
reviews.text: This cooking class was amazing!! We made four different dishes for a half day class and it was so yummy! They were also so accommodating as we needed the class to end quicker and we were still able to do everything we wanted to do. The space to cook was beautiful and the guided instructions to cook were super clear. Overall it was a really fun experience for our group and we would love to come back again!!

reviews.name: Laura
reviews.text:
We had a very nice day at Thai Garden Farm. Lovely people and great food. Son and Tien have a wonderful garden where you can have a look and smell all the different spices. The pick up from Chiang Mai was very convenient and we went to a local market to get the ingredients.

If you like good Thai food, you want to make it by yourself under professional guidance and you want to meet wonderful people, you should definitely visit Thai Garden Farm for a cooking class.

reviews.name: Sander Cox
reviews.text:

Would definitely recommend!

reviews.name: Tammy Cole
reviews.text:
A MUST DO!!! TOP RATED
This was one of the highlights of our trip!
We had the wonderful experience of meeting up with local farmer Sonthichai “Son” and his wife Sangtien “Tien”.
Soon picked us up from our vacation house, then gave us a tour through a local market explaining about the different kinds of rice, vegetables, a and herbs. Next into his farm which is also their home. Together they taught us to cook 4 traditional Thai dishes. Their farm had almost everything needed to cook our meal. All the fresh herbs and spices to make curry paste, the limes, eggs, fruits, sweeteners, chilis, and etc were all home grown.
We had terrific conversations and felt like we were welcomed as family. My daughter went with us and had a terrific time as well.
This experience was intimate and personalized. We definitely recommend everyone spend the time on a local farm experiencing first hand what this farmer grows, taste a variety of herbs and spices right out in the farm, make food, and fill your heart with joy! #travelingtothailandtogether🇹🇭 #ChiangMaiSummer2022 #localcommunityfarmer

reviews.name: Christoph Altmeppen
reviews.text: Very good experience. We prepared six different dishes (where we could choose between three different varieties each). Son (and his wife!) was very fun and relaxed to work with and explained us everything in great detail. Recommended!

reviews.name: Rhiannon Hiscocks
reviews.text:
This was so great, so much fun! Snow White was our teacher (great name right?), she was very funny. We learnt 3 dishes, Pad Thai, chicken & coconut soup and sticky rice. We booked direct just by emailing them (so they didn’t have to pay commission to a booking site) You need to pay cash then if you do this I think, bring it with you, I didn’t see an ATM.
We ended up being the only two on the course so it only took one hour and felt like a private lesson.
We were staying on Khaosan Road and walked from there, it would have been easy if we weren’t distracted chatting and took a wrong turn up some ally but bumped into some super friendly locals who put us on the right path; if you do walk just follow the canal and you’ll up can’t miss it, the school is right on the water.
It’s an outdoor kitchen but you should still remove your shoes before you step in, treat it like her home.
Anyway, 10 out of 10, would recommend.

reviews.text:
We arrived today, a family of 6 for a cooking class. At first we were worried because the place was in the local neighborhoods, but when we arrived we were met by the stunning Snow White, with her kind smile,
She was tolerant of all the questions and noise we made, explained to us step by step what to do and was charming and welcoming to us along with her cute son. Everything was organized and arranged in advance. It was a lovely experience and everything was so delicious. My kids said it was the most delicious Pad Thai they had ever eaten. Thanks to the stunning Shilgaya!!!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We are truly thankful for your support. It’s customers like you who make us better.

reviews.name: Jam BA
reviews.text:
I was really disappointed with this cooking class. The instructor was not kind or welcoming at all. She didn’t greet us when we arrived and immediately asked to see our booking, acting as if she was forced to run the class.

When I added an ingredient earlier than I should have, she got upset and told me to remove it, then repeatedly asked, (Did you get me?) which made me feel uncomfortable.

Although we mentioned we were fine with seafood, she assumed we were vegetarian and didn’t provide any seafood sauces or tofu until later. She was also extremely stingy with ingredient portions, cutting everything into tiny pieces, and we left the class still hungry.

They mentioned that coffee and tea were included, but we didn’t receive any, nor did we get the pdf recipe book.

The class felt rushed and lasted less than the stated 2 hours and 30 minutes. The instructor also took numerous photos, asking us to hold dishes and dmile, but later said they could only be downloaded from facebook.

Overall, the instructor’s attitude and poor communication completely ruined what could have been a fun and authentic Thai cooking experience.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your patience. There will be a formal warning and improvements made to ensure better service.

reviews.text: Clean environment with home atmosphere. The instructor, Snow White speaks 100%English and knowledgeable. More than you think, you’re gonna be a pro Thai food chef! Highly recommend
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your positive feedback.

reviews.name: Valeria Hidalgo
reviews.text:
I was wondering around and found out this cooking school. I booked a class immediately for the next day. Snow White was the chef, i was the only one doing the class and ABSOLUTELY LOVED IT, not only because i made delicious dishes and tried so many new things (didn’t have any idea of what Thai food is) but also because i felt like i was cooking with my friend, she is so funny and lovely, book with her if you have the chance. I picked up the papaya salad, tom yum soup, pad thai, and massaman curry, I can’t believed i made those dishes, they were so tasty, but the massaman curry was the cherry on the top, so YUMMY, one of the best dishes i’ve had in WEEKS, and i made it💓💓
I also loved the logistics of the class, cooking a dish, eating it, chatting with Snow White and cooking again. I highly recommend to go for the massaman curry, and add that extra chilli that Snow white says, trust me, it makes it so tasty. Had a great experience, the place is nice and clean and Snow White really does a great job, she is an amazing cooker.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your trust in our service. We are honored to serve you.

reviews.text: I had a wonderful afternoon learning to cook multiple dishes. Snow White was so generous with her time and information and answered all my questions. reviews.name: Seth
reviews.text: Fantastic Muay Thai gym! The training is top-notch, and the environment is super welcoming. The staff and trainers are always friendly, helpful, and attentive. Absolutely love training here, highly recommended for anyone at any skill level

reviews.name: Howie Owyang
reviews.text:
I was introduced to this gym by my Thai friend, and it truly is an authentic local Muay Thai gym. The coaches were friendly, patient, and eager to teach, which made the experience very enjoyable. For easier access, I recommend getting dropped off at Wat Khon Non temple and walking to the gym from there.

I brought my boxing shoes after learning that one of the coaches is Rattanachai Sor Vorapin, former WBO Bantamweight Champion. He was kind enough to hold pads for me in a western boxing style, and I even had a few technical rounds with their boxers. Overall, it was a fantastic experience—I’ll definitely be back!

reviews.text: Highly recommended place for those who wanna try Thai Boxing!! Really good for the new beginner. No need to bring any equipment. The instructor is really kind and professional. However, the location is quite deserted so recommend not to go alone.

reviews.name: Kaayladee K.
reviews.text:
I’m honestly pissed. I called this morning to ask first, and whoever answered told me to come in this evening and said a 5-year-old was fine to train.
Then I drive all the way out here, just for y’all to say 5-year-olds can’t train and gotta wait till they’re 8?
Like nah, if kids ain’t allowed, say that clearly from the jump. Don’t have people wasting gas and time driving all the way here for nothing. That’s foul.

reviews.name: Lee
reviews.text: WOW!! This AUTHENTIC Muay Thai gym was such a lovely experience!!! I had such a great time and amazing training. The coaches teach you exactly at the level you need. Do not be afraid and think you are training like you are fighting tomorrow. The coaches gauge you and help you with your technique. The warm ups also go along with your level of fitness so you do not need to worry about doing the most extreme from day one. I stayed here at their airbnb rooms that are inside the gym. The A/C is new and entire setup is new. The mattress felt amazing as it is firm and felt so good to lay on after a great training session. The coaches explained very well and clearly how i can improve my technique and as a martial art enthusiast I enjoyed the explanations and analogies to help me understand the meaning and reasoning behind the moves. Everyone is genuinely friendly and they make sure to be fair with everyone when it comes to training pads or giving one on one help. I have trained here a few times not just one session. I truly enjoyed the atmosphere and the quiet neighborhood. Everyone in the neighborhood is friendly and it feels like you are in the heart of Thailand. No loud city noises or crazy city style businesses. It is all local Thai people and business. Food is extremely cheap here and there is a 711 not too far from the gym. I would recommend this gym to beginners, amateurs and pros! Come try a class you won’t regret it!!

reviews.name: Hannah Moreau
reviews.text: If you want to come to thailand and learn real muay thai than this is the place. From the minute i came to the minute i left, the trainers pushed me as hard as they could. The people are also amazing and make it feel like family. The trainers have extensive training and they really want to see you improve. Really such a great gym and i’m so thankful for them 🫶🏼

reviews.name: Adrien Soulié
reviews.text: Amazing gym to learn strong fundamentals and the real values of Muay Thai. The vision comes from Kru Jaroonsak and is proudly carried on by his former student Yung. Training is now handled by the legendary Ratanachai Sor Vorapin. A friendly, family-style gym that stays true to traditional roots. Perfect for anyone serious about authentic Muay Thai

Highly Recommend!

The environment is welcoming, safe, and focused on learning, making it a great place for both beginners and experienced practitioners.

reviews.name: Jeremy Martinez
reviews.text: I've come to Arete Minburi on-and-off for a few months and it is my favorite BJJ gym. I travel a lot in the USA and in Asia and go to different BJJ/grappling gyms often (not trial classes, but for at least a month each). The instructor, Mitz, is very knowledgeable, demonstrates effectively, and each lesson is a continuation from the lesson from the day prior. It insures continued progress from a certain position. Beyond the instruction, the other students are very nice, fun, and I feel absolutely no ego from them like you might at other gyms. At the end of the day, this is a sport and the sport should be fun. It's a great environment to learn.

reviews.textTranslated: The sensei (teacher) has extensive knowledge and techniques in teaching, and the learning atmosphere is fun. reviews.textTranslated:
The place is spacious enough for training large groups. It's an open area with excellent ventilation. Equipment is readily available; you can borrow equipment or purchase your own. The staff, from the administrators to the instructors, are all friendly. The instructors are professional Muay Thai fighters with extensive experience and techniques ready to share.

It's ideal for training to become a Muay Thai fighter, for self-defense, and for a fitness experience using Muay Thai. It's like a gym class but more practical and fun than body combat.

Highly recommended! 👍

The two months I spent training here were not only intense and challenging, but also incredibly rewarding. Whether you're a complete beginner or an experienced fighter, this place has something for everyone. Every session pushed me, taught me something new, and made me fall even more in love with the sport. On top of that, the atmosphere is always positive, supportive, and full of laughs. I looked forward to training every single day.

Huge thanks to all the coaches and staff for your energy, your guidance, and your constant smiles.

reviews.name: DJ Fuzz
reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 5/5 stars

Sor Dechapant is an exceptional gym for serious Muay Thai practitioners looking to take their skills to the next level. This is a true fighter's camp with an impressive track record - they've produced so many champions over the years, and you can feel that winning mentality the moment you walk in.

I had an incredible opportunity to train with Aliff Rakib, the Malaysian One Championship fighter, which was an amazing experience and really showed the caliber of athletes who choose this gym.

The training here is definitely geared toward upgrading your Muay Thai skills, but I should mention that it's quite advanced. While the gym welcomes everyone at all levels, beginners should be prepared for intense, high-level training that might be challenging if you're just starting out. The coaches and atmosphere are supportive, but the pace and intensity reflect the serious nature of this fighter's camp.

If you're an intermediate to advanced practitioner looking to push your limits and train in an authentic, championship-producing environment, Sor Dechapant is absolutely the place to be. The quality of instruction and training partners here is top-notch.

Will train here again!

reviews.name: SDK STONES
reviews.text: I don't know where to start with this gym. It is the best fighters gym I have trained at in Thailand. It's a fighters gym where they push you to your limits so it's not for the faint hearted. But if you're a fighter that wants to train with some of the most elite muay thai fighters in the world this is the place. All the boys here are the most humble killers that I have ever trained with an it was an honor to train alongside them! I cannot wait to come back to this place ❤️

reviews.text: Fantastic Gym with great trainers, fighters and mangement! This is not a entry level gym, here you will find experienced fighters that are in a non stop ritme of hard and focussed training. Very inspirational and we learned a lot, not only from the Muay Thai technical  aspect but also on how to be dedicated to your craft! We will be back... Redouan&Samir

reviews.name: Jake
reviews.text:
This is a fighter’s gym. Not beginner friendly but if you are looking for a fight camp to prepare for your upcoming fights, there’s no better place. There are top level guys daily for you to train with. But this is hardcore training that’s gonna make or break you. Each training session can go up to 4 hours.

Morning routine: 1 hour of running, 15-30 minutes of skipping, 15 minutes of shadow, 45-60 minutes of bagwork/padwork, 30 minutes of sparring and clinching, 30 minutes of finishers.

Afternoon routine: 30 minutes of running, 15-30 minutes of skipping, 15 minutes of shadow, 45-60 minutes of bagwork/padwork, 30 minutes of light sparring, 60 minutes of clinching, 30 minutes of finishers.

ถ้าใครกำลังหาค่ายมวยที่ฝึกแล้ว เห็นผลจริง ไม่จกตา ทั้งเรื่องหุ่น สุขภาพ แล้วก็ได้สังคมใหม่ ๆ บอกเลยว่า ค่ายมวย ส.เดชะพันธ์ คือของจริงค่ะะะ

ตอนนี้คือร่างกายแข็งแรงขึ้นชัดเจน ไขมันลด หุ่นกระชับขึ้น ใส่เสื้อผ้าแล้วมั่นใจขึ้นแบบรู้สึกได้เลย
เรื่องการสอนคือไม่ไก่กาเลยนะ
ครูมวยสอนละเอียดมาก ตั้งแต่ท่ายืน การ์ด หมัด เตะ เข่า ศอก คือไม่ได้ให้มาต่อยกระสอบมั่ว ๆ แต่สอนเทคนิคจริง ๆ ว่าต้องลงน้ำหนักยังไง หมุนสะโพกยังไง ป้องกันตัวยังไง

มือใหม่แบบศูนย์มาก่อนก็เรียนได้ ไม่ต้องกลัวเลย เพราะเขาปรับให้ตามระดับเราเลย

อีกอย่างที่ชอบมากคือบรรยากาศ 🫶

ที่นี่มีทั้งคนไทยและต่างชาติ ได้เพื่อนใหม่เพียบ แบบบางวันซ้อมเสร็จนั่งคุยกันต่อ ฝึกภาษาไปในตัว แลกเปลี่ยนวัฒนธรรม สนุกมากกก

มันไม่ใช่แค่ค่ายมวยอะ แต่มันเหมือนคอมมูนิตี้เล็ก ๆ ที่ทุกคนซัพพอร์ตกันจริง ๆ ไม่มีใครมองว่าใครเก่งกว่าใคร มือใหม่ก็ไม่โดนกดดัน ทุกคนให้กำลังใจกันหมด ฟีลดีมาก มาลองกันนะๆ
reviews.textTranslated:
If you're looking for a Muay Thai gym that delivers real results, not just hype – in terms of physique, health, and making new friends – then S. Dechapan Muay Thai Gym is the real deal!
I initially came just to lose weight, thinking, "Okay, let's give it a try." But the results exceeded my expectations!
Now, my body is noticeably stronger, I've lost fat, my physique is more toned, and I feel much more confident in my clothes.
The teaching is top-notch.
The instructors are incredibly detailed, teaching everything from stance, guard, punches, kicks, knees, and elbows. They don't just have you punch the bag haphazardly; they teach real techniques like how to control weight, how to rotate your hips, and how to defend yourself.

Even complete beginners can learn; don't worry, they tailor the training to your level.

Another thing I love is the atmosphere 🫶

There are both Thai and international students, and I've made tons of new friends. Some days, after training, we'd just chat, practice our language skills, and exchange cultures – it was so much fun!

It's not just a Muay Thai gym; it's like a small community where everyone truly supports each other. No one thinks anyone is better than anyone else, and beginners aren't pressured. Everyone was encouraging each other, it felt great. You should try it!

reviews.name: chai bk
reviews.text:
This Muay Thai boxing camp has been successful in turning many fighters into national, as well as international level famous. Almost of them are from upcountry at their very young age by devoting themselves in Muay Thai.

Boarding and meals are provided, plus schooling with to and from the camp transportation. They are even given pocket money for their lunch!

What's nice is that boxers who win the fight will be awarded with pay in full. However, those who lost, will get 50% deduction towards the camp. That sum would turn into fund supporting the camp.

Regardless of the owner being a businessman, his involvement in Muay Thai is a non profit sideline as he is a great fan of Muay Thai.

reviews.name: Samia D
reviews.text:
The padholders and the trainers are amazing, so kind and devoted in their work. You can do the exact same training as the champions in the camp : the afternoon session start with a 20min run followed by 20min of skipping rope, then 4 or 5 padwork 6min rounds !! You can then do some bag work + clinching, to finish up with physical conditioning. All in a superb atmosphere and a great mood brought by the trainers and the fighters their (Panpayak, Kiewpayak, Neuglanlek, Phetnarin etc...)
I highly recommend JitMuengNon gym if you are looking for a unique experience in BKK.
Special thanks to the gym mom who was absolutely nice and caring.

reviews.name: Honest Reviews Only
reviews.text:
I stopped by MBK Center specifically to find Muay Thai shorts for my daughter and this store likely has the widest selection of kids' sizes and customization options in the mall. They provide a huge variety of patches and embroidery styles. I ended up getting a pair with my daughter's name which cost THB 300 for the shorts and THB 200 for the six letters. The service was quite good because the staff managed to rush our order to accommodate an appointment we had later that afternoon. The embroidered name turned out really nicely and I am excited to show it to her.

It is worth noting that the shop only carries their own house brand and does not offer other major names. I would not recommend this spot for adult gear since the pricing of their shorts is roughly the same as popular brands like Top King or Boon, which you can find elsewhere. However for anyone looking for high quality and customizable kids' gear this is a perfect choice.

reviews.name: Siraaj Karim
reviews.text: While I did not buy anything in here I still feel a review is required. The reason they lost two stars is the same reason I didn't shop in the store. There was no staff who spoke to us or gave us any attention, this is a big shopping turnoff. However the shop was very beautifully decorated and the products did seem really good, fancy and unique. I also feel like the prices were extra high since its a famous place, and that's okay.

reviews.name: Laurie Ho
reviews.text: A very busy and successful shop. Great selection of shorts with customisation for a reasonable price. Turnaround time for customisation was about 3 days for us and the staff were clear about communicating this. Would recommend!

reviews.text: amazing place for customs shorts, awesome service and overall had a good time here as i got 2 pants
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for the review! We’re thrilled to hear you had a great time and love your 2 custom pairs. Each one is a unique piece of Thai craftsmanship. Enjoy your new shorts, and we hope to see you again soon.

reviews.name: KC & Mar
reviews.text:
Picked up a pair of shorts and got my logo Custom embroidered on them.

Had to dig through the piles a bit to find a color\size combo that I liked, so make sure to check everything when looking for the shorts that are perfect for you.

Staff was very helpful with getting my logo perfect - the image I had wasn't exact, and they were able to modify it a little bit to make it look perfect.

I also picked up some hand wraps and they are very comfortable and feel very durable.

Looking forward to wearing these shorts for training both in Thailand and when I get back to my home gym.

Thank you!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your kind review! We’re happy to hear you’re satisfied with the custom embroidery and our team’s support. Glad you liked the hand wraps as well. Wishing you great training in Thailand and back home. Thank you! 🙏

reviews.name: Nicolai Philip Stengaard
reviews.text: If you want bad service, high prices and logos that is not even straight (look at the picture) then this is the right place. The women I talked to was very rude and acted like I didn’t even exist and it took 2 hours! for some shorts that now just look like some 4 year old put together… Don’t come to this place it is a TURIST TRAP! 0/10
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi Nicolai,
Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We’re truly sorry to hear that your experience did not meet your expectations, and we appreciate the opportunity to respond.

Our store provides custom, in-store embroidery services, and we always aim to confirm design details and review the finished product with customers before completion. We regret that this experience did not reflect the level of service and quality we strive to provide.

As we offer real-time custom services, production time may vary depending on order volume and design complexity. For added convenience, we also offer hotel delivery for customers who prefer not to wait in store.

We take customer service very seriously and would appreciate the opportunity to better understand what happened. If you are willing, please feel free to contact us directly with the date and time of your visit so we can review this matter internally and improve our service.

Please accept our sincere apologies for any discomfort or disappointment this experience may have caused. Your feedback is valuable to us, and we remain committed to improving our service for every customer.

Sincerely,
Thai Battle Boxing Team

reviews.name: Ashleigh Das
reviews.text:
I had a mixed experience at this store.
When I first visited in the morning (around 10:00am), the lady who served me seemed disinterested and had an attitude, which made communication difficult. After placing my order (with requested customization of my shorts), I was told that the earliest collection time would be 9:30pm that night or the next day. When I returned in the afternoon to politely ask if an earlier collection was possible, I was met with the same attitude and no attempt to explore any alternative options.

It was only after I later read through online reviews that I discovered the store offers a hotel drop-off service — an option that was never mentioned to me despite my situation. I had to return for a third time, where I was assisted by a gentleman who was kind, patient, and helpful. He immediately understood my request, offered the hotel drop-off option, and arranged same-day delivery.

I’d like to sincerely thank the staff member who helped me the third time — he was the saving grace of this whole experience. Unfortunately, the initial service left a poor impression and made what should have been a straightforward purchase unnecessarily unpleasant. I hope the store can work on more consistent customer service, as it really makes a difference.

reviews.text: My husband and kid attend Muay thai classes here weekly.  They have a lot of fun and like it very much.  The instructors are professionals, helpful and patient.   The local just got some renovations and looks nice and big.  It is in a building in the same sukhumvit with easy access.  They also offer from time to time good promotions for packages of classes.  You can book a class the same day.

reviews.name: Shiran Sela dan-gur
reviews.text: A real show! Full value for money. We sat in the chairs closest to the ring and it was perfect! Amazing atmosphere! Spend a whole evening 4 hours of fights of all ages and types! We really loved it! The host is perfect, funny and gets the audience moving! All the scenery and lighting and everything is perfect! A must go watch!!

reviews.name: Olena Williams
reviews.text:
One of the brightest memories from Thailand - visit to Rajadamnern Stadium - Muay Thai Boxing Academy.  It is operated by Thai military and has fights almost every night of the week.

For those who don”t know: Thai boxing allows kicks, elbows and knees.  Hits to groin area and suffocation are not allowed. Adrenaline on the ring and in the crowd were amazing. It was a celebration of masculinity, agility and dedication.

When kids fought I originally felt uneasy.  Then I thought they boys fight anyway. And it is better to do it with a trainer  and on the ring then on the streets in group fight.

reviews.name: Swee Chye Loh
reviews.text:
Went for a 1.5 hour basic class which costed about 680B and rented the handwraps which costed 20B.

Started with 30 minutes warmup with stretching, jogging, skipping, static exercises. Followed by basic shadow drills, bag works and 3 rounds of pad work. Lastly ended off with some kicks and cool down. The whole experience was pleasant. If you are looking to get a good workout so a sweat out session, you can consider this place.

However, if you already had some experience in Muay Thai, I would advise to go for the advance class. Do note advance class comes at a higher price.

Also, if you are looking for old school Muay Thai gym, this might not be the place as it seems to be rather commercialised.

Place is located at a very convenient place (Jasmine city shopping centre) which is near to the BTS station. Area is air-condition.

reviews.name: Rachel Lee
reviews.text: My friend and I came for an impromptu 1.5h class on 10th Jan and it was such an amazing experience!!!! The instructors were so patient and bubbly:) The session was easy to follow along despite our language barrier. The session was very structured and we did some conditioning too which was nice😆

reviews.name: J K
reviews.text:
Some mixed reviews about the instructors on google. Day I went 3 out of 3 were top notch. Expect to be pushed and hit the limits of your fitness. Hard work is recognised by some motivational grunts. Early morning session was pretty empty so you get your money's worth of pad sparring. Bring an extra 50 Baht for wraps if you don't have your own. Gloves are on the side of the ring (by the windows).

Stretch, run, skip, hiit stuff, shadow box, pad spar, heavy bags, stretch.

Instructors instruct, receptionists reception. Turn up early and bring a towel if you want a shower afterwards.

reviews.name: m8055
reviews.text: A clean and comfortable gym. I took the beginner 1.5 hour class. It was a hard workout but fun. The class did finish 15 mins earlier than I thought though.

reviews.name: Gregory DiCioccio
reviews.text: Trained here for a couple of days while visiting Bangkok.  Did a private lesson and advanced group class.  Very challenging and enjoyable experience.

reviews.name: Stephan Leroy
reviews.text: We had a class with the whole family. The team was very nice and gave the girls a fantastic introduction to the sport.

reviews.name: Daehee Kim
reviews.text:
Friends of mine and I joined the beginning class on 29th July and we had lots of fun.
The class was structured as 30 mins of warm-up, 10-20 mins of shadow boxing + kicks and rest of time, paring with coaches for punching + kicking on pads.
It could be challenging if you haven’t exercised for a long time but, it’s so much fun!

reviews.name: Brandon Jones
reviews.text: Very good facilities but wouldn’t recommend if you wanted to really train Muay Thai or get a workout. Neither the receptionist or trainers were welcoming or seemed one bit interested. I’ve trained in a dozen gyms across Thailand and I have to say value for money it was the worst experience overall.

reviews.name: Octavio
reviews.text:
If you want to watch the muai thaï fights , it is not here!

The stadium is somewhere else near the river

Hopefully you don’t make the same mistake as us lol

reviews.name: Jii Koo
reviews.text: Really cool gym with aircon. Bags are new and it's perfect for beginners to advanced, great trainers. Sessions starts every 1.5hours.

reviews.name: Stephanie Braganza
reviews.text: STAY AWAY FROM THIS PLACE!!! As you will see from the other low reviews this place is a complete mess and ripoff. My friends had pre-paid for two personal trainers and upon arrival (without being told in advance in any way) they were informed that now there was only one trainer instead of two they paid for. My friends said they should get a refund for 1 trainer then (since they paid for 2 trainers) and the establishment said NO. They said they will NOT give a refund but that instead if you wait 90minutes (so they can waste your time) you can join the next class to have two instructors. Since we all have plans my friends took the first class. Most of it was workouts you can do as a beginner by yourself at any gym and with so little actual boxing. Not to mention the price was double what we found at other places. Nonsense policies, scamming foreigners and ridiculously bad customer service. There are many better and more worth it places in the area, as someone who has lived all over the world (INCLUDING southeast Asia - where I grew up) I can tell you this is well below the average respect and service you can expect from most places, specially in a city. And an incredibly bad way to do business. It's disgusting that they think it's okay to penalize customers for their own mistakes. 0% recommendations and I'm telling everyone I know in Bangkok NOT to go here. Save your money literally go anywhere else.

reviews.name: Lily G
reviews.text: Thank you for introducing me to Thailand's national sport!  I took the beginner class as a way to experience just a little bit of this part of Thai culture.  I quickly realized that I was not prepared for how physically intense even the beginner class is.  Expect 5 minutes running, 5 minutes jump rope, planks, mountain climbers, v sit ups, etc.  Then put on the gloves!  Thank you to the instructor for being so good natured about me being there, even though it's obvious there are people who seriously train here 🙏🏻

reviews.name: Kyle Hooker
reviews.text: My wife and I had a blast! We have never practiced Muay Thai and this was a great opportunity to learn. We enjoyed how the class was structured.

reviews.name: Kit W
reviews.text: Had a private class just now and the experience was rather bad. I showed up on time and all the trainers seemed surprised. I guess there’s no communication between the one taking care of bookings and the trainers. The trainer I got wasn’t professional at all, my posture was bad,  and I know it.  He didn’t even bother to instruct me on that. The whole attitude was just ‘whatever’. I think I had bad luck because other trainers seemed very passionate and willing to help! Two stars for the clean and nice environment.

reviews.name: Domcor
reviews.text:
After reading the reviews I wasn’t expecting too much. I’ve trained at many of the well known known Muay Thai gyms in Bangkok: PK Saenchai, Elite Fight Club, Superbon’s camp and Yokkao and I was happy with the 1 on 1 session I did at RSM.
I trained with Tee and he was great. Good technique and paced the session well. I’d definitely train with him again.
1700 baht for a private is more expensive than most of the gyms in Bangkok but it’s clean, in a convenient location and training in aircon at the start of April is most welcome for Farangs not used to the heat.

reviews.name: Joann Yun
reviews.text: I had a great workout training with coach Phat doing a personal training Muay Thai session. He took extra time for a warm up, stretch and post work out stretch. He definitely pushed me to land my hits directly and with as much power as I could really great motivation to keep going and corrected my stance and hand positions. Really great training I high recommend coach Phat!

reviews.name: Amie Prasongsukarn
reviews.text: Amazing place for anyone who wants to learn Muay Thai. You don’t need experience at all to learn. The price is reasonable and location is amazing. Only a few minutes from Asoke bts and Mrt station. The place has shower rooms and you can rent a towel in case you need to go somewhere else afterwards, just don’t forget shampoo (you can buy it from boots downstairs if you forgot it). I took 1 star off because the parking lot is quite difficult to drive up.

reviews.name: Amit Chahal
reviews.text:
An Exceptional Couples Massage Experience at Anantara Mai Khao – Pure Bliss!

My partner and I recently enjoyed a couples massage at the Anantara Spa in Mai Khao, Phuket, and it was, without exaggeration, one of the best spa experiences we’ve ever had. From the moment we arrived, we were enveloped in a sense of peace and luxury that truly set the tone for what was to come.

Our treatments were performed by Eve and Rose, who were both absolutely phenomenal. They were warm, professional, and incredibly attentive to our individual needs and preferences. Before the massage began, they took time to discuss any areas we wanted them to focus on, and they adjusted the pressure perfectly throughout – firm and therapeutic where it was needed, yet gentle and relaxing in more sensitive areas.

The spa room itself was a sanctuary – beautifully appointed, immaculately clean, and wonderfully serene. Soft lighting, calming aromas, and the tranquil sounds of nature made it feel like we had stepped into a private oasis. The room was spacious enough to allow us to feel completely comfortable, yet intimate enough to enhance the shared experience.

What really stood out was the attention to detail. From the welcome tea to the post-treatment refreshments, everything was thoughtful and perfectly timed. The transitions between each phase of the treatment were seamless, and we never felt rushed – just completely cared for from start to finish.

The massage left us both feeling deeply relaxed, rejuvenated, and connected. Eve and Rose have a true gift, and we can’t thank them enough for making the experience so special. We genuinely floated out of the spa and continued to feel the benefits of the treatment for days afterwards.

If you’re considering a couples treatment while in Phuket, we cannot recommend Anantara Mai Khao highly enough. It’s not just a massage – it’s a full sensory journey that nurtures body, mind, and soul. Ask for Eve and Rose – they are exceptional.

We’ll definitely be returning next time we’re in Phuket. Thank you again for an unforgettable experience!

reviews.name: Nongchichi Chichi
reviews.text: ✨ A serene sanctuary with impeccable service and warm hospitality. The deep muscle massage was exceptional — a true journey of renewal. 🌿 Follow the white lotus. #Liza #AnantaraMaiKhaoSpa

Their policy around allowing outside guests for day use may change / have changed, as we were during the Sandbox programme when there were fewer visitors.

Would be better if they gave a choice of oils for the massage but otherwise it was a really indulgent holiday treat in natural surroundings.
