reviews.name: Öz-G Bayraktar Vural
reviews.text:
Puket tatiline gelip de masaj yaptirmamak olur mu hic deyip, ana kız otelin spa merkezinin yolunu tuttuk.
1 saat boyunca meshur Thai masajini denedik ama oncesinde guzel ve rahat bir cay yudumlarken kisa bir ayak masaji ile bizleri karsiladilar.Masaj sonrasinda da yine ayni nezaket ve guleryuzlulukle bu kez kucuk kurabiyelerle farkli bir cay ikrami daha gerceklestirdiler.
Biz cok memnun kaldik.
Bu arada eger spada masaj yaptirmak istemezseniz, kumsalda  12-15 kisinin yan yana ayni anda yatarak masaj hizmeti alabilecegi saati spanin dortte bir fiyatina da masaj cesitleri de mevcut. Biz onu da denedik ancak masaj benzer olsa da kisiye ozel, sessiz ve gurultusuz bir ahsap klimali kutuk evde masajin keyfi paha bicilemez👍🏼
reviews.textTranslated:
"It's impossible to come to Phuket for a holiday and not get a massage," my daughter and I said, heading to the hotel's spa center.
We spent an hour trying the famous Thai massage, but before that, they greeted us with a short foot massage while we sipped a nice, relaxing cup of tea. After the massage, with the same kindness and friendliness, they offered us another cup of tea with small cookies.
We were very pleased.
By the way, if you don't want a massage at the spa, there are also massage options available on the beach where 12-15 people can lie side-by-side and receive massage services at a quarter of the spa price per hour. We tried that too, but although the massage was similar, the pleasure of a private, quiet, air-conditioned wooden log cabin was priceless 👍🏼

reviews.text: I had a wonderful facial massage experience here. The therapist was highly professional, and the treatment was both relaxing and effective. My skin feels refreshed and glowing. Highly recommended.

reviews.name: Jutharat Songkun
reviews.text:
สำหรับมุกที่ตั้งใจเข้ามาเรียนนวดหน้าเพื่อไปต่อยอดอาชีพ รู้สึกว่าเรียนที่นี่แล้วได้อะไรมากกว่าที่อื่นมากเลยค่ะ หลังจากที่ได้สัมผัสด้วยตัวเอง บอกเลยว่าความประทับใจไม่ได้อยู่ที่แค่เทคนิคการนวด แต่ที่นี่มีมาตรฐานในทุกมิติเลย ครูใหม่และครูกนกสอนดีมากค่ะสิ่งแรกที่สัมผัสได้คือ อาจารย์ที่นี่ไม่ได้สอนตามตำราเพียงอย่างเดียว แต่สอนจาก "ความเข้าใจ" อาจารย์มีความเชี่ยวชาญมาก ทั้งสรีระใบหน้า แรงกดหรือทิศทางการนวด การใช้ผลิตภัณฑ์ รวมถึงท่าทางการนวด อาจารย์ใส่ใจรายละเอียดมากจริงๆค่ะ ที่สำคัญอาจาร์ยเน้นเรื่องขั้นตอนการทำงานและความสะอาด บรรยากาศในสถานที่เรียนสะอาดสะอ้าน มีกลิ่นหอมทำให้เราซึมซับนิสัยความสะอาดนี้ไปใช้กับลูกค้าของเราในอนาคตอีกด้วย และได้มีโอกาศสัมผัสและเห็นขั้นตอนการทำงานจริงของอาจารย์โดยตรง

ความรู้สึกหลังเรียนจบ
รู้สึกมั่นใจในการนำความรู้การนวดหน้าไปใช้สำหรับทำงานจริง ถ้าคุณกำลังสนใจเรียนนวดหน้าและต้องการความรู้แน่นๆ จากคนรู้จริง แนะนำที่ Setaiเลยค่ะ ลองมาสัมผัสรับการนวดดูก่อน แล้วค่อยตัดสินใจเรียนก็ดีค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated:
For Mook, who came to learn facial massage to advance her career, she feels that studying here has given her so much more than other places. After experiencing it firsthand, she can say that her impression isn't just about massage techniques, but that the place maintains high standards in every aspect. Teachers Mai and Kanok are excellent instructors. The first thing she noticed was that the instructors didn't just teach from textbooks, but from "understanding." They are highly skilled in facial anatomy, pressure and massage direction, product use, and massage techniques. They pay close attention to detail. Importantly, the instructors emphasize work procedures and cleanliness. The learning environment is spotlessly clean and smells nice, which helps us instill a habit of cleanliness to apply to our future clients. She also had the opportunity to witness the instructors' actual work processes firsthand.

Her feelings after graduation:
She feels confident in applying her facial massage knowledge to her work. If you are interested in learning facial massage and want solid knowledge from true experts, she highly recommends Setai. Try a massage session firsthand before deciding to enroll.

reviews.name: Nayika Hinon
reviews.text:
เปิดร้านนวดเพื่อสุขภาพอยู่แล้วแต่อยากมีความรู้เพิ่มเติมเรื่องนวดหน้า

I already own a health massage shop, but I wanted to learn more about facial massage.
I decided to try a facial massage here and loved it so much that I enrolled in a course. I wasn't disappointed; the instructor was kind and taught in an easy-to-understand way, with hands-on practice.

reviews.name: Thilini
reviews.text:
This was the best massage I had in my entire Phuket+krabi Thailand trip. Not only me, my husband also had a lovely experience.

Decided to walk into this place as this was right infront of my hotel ( Gorgeous Boutique Hotel ). By this time, I had done quite a few massages. This place looks very simple. Nothing fancy. You would not think that you would get this much of a good service from the looks of it.

Im very pleased to say that I had a wonderful thai foot massage here. Absolutely amazing. The ladies there were very polite, professional, friendly. They know what they are doing. No funny business. They do what they have to do exceptionally well, I must say.

We got a foot massage for one hour for only 300 baht. This included a lower limb massage upto mid thighs ( so very comprehensive I would say ). And also at the end they do a mini head, neck, shoulder and back massage in Thai style.

Me and my husband both were very pleased and  walked out of there very happily.

Totally recommend this place to you all visiting Patong, Phuket.

reviews.text: I have walked past this place many times while shopping in this mall. One day after a  20 hour long travel I decided to stop for a massage. I had THE WORST experience ever here. Youd think that when you go for a massage the atmosphere should be calm and professional. The receptionist is a Nightmare! No smile, no warmth, no professionalism. She was so rude and condescending, she didnt want to answer mt questions and kept rolling her eyes, giving me dirty looks and speaking aggressively with me. She literally raised her voice at me.I cannot believe the level of attitude I received from her. Im not one to write a review but I feel so terrible and robbed of my experience i couldn't even enjoy the massage. I will NEVER return as long as I see her working the front desk. I promise you it took alot of effort for me to not argue and walk out. I was genuinely in shock and im proud of myself for not escalating as there were other people trying to enjoy the quiet and the older lady who didnt speak english seemed a bit scared. I really needed the massage and absolutely wasnt able to go anywhere else. Simply  couldn't enjoy my experience after that interaction. Im so ashamed of her customer service because everyone else seemed to really want to make up for her attitude. I left feeling more drained than when i walked in. Its a shame the buisness is so empty but now i understand why. I dont understand how as a business the customer service was so terrible. Absolutely unacceptable. Will not return.

You won’t have your feet cleaned/wiped like other massage places. The therapist didn‘t bother asking you if you are fine with her hands pressure. Her massage was way too light for my liking but I guess some people might enjoy it. The worst part is their massage room design. They separate each bed with some poorly designed curtains. Whenever someone walks into another room, the curtains moves and your body is exposed. They don‘t even try to cover it up properly for the sake of your privacy. I kept hearing other clients talking both left and right. I know it‘s not their fault that the clients talk but with better room design, you can minimize those sound. The place is also very small.

這次跟著旅行社的行程，有機會體驗我人生中的第一次精油按摩，感覺相當新鮮也很放鬆。

一開始可以自由選擇自己喜歡的精油香氣，從玫瑰、苿莉香到薰衣草都有，每一種都有不同的放鬆效果。按摩師手法溫和、專業，整個過程讓人感到身心都被釋放，尤其對我這個初次體驗的人來說，真的非常舒服。

reviews.textTranslated:
This trip with the tour group gave me the opportunity to experience my first aromatherapy massage, which was quite novel and relaxing.

At the beginning, I could freely choose my favorite aromatherapy scent, from rose and jasmine to lavender, each with a different relaxing effect. The masseuse's technique was gentle and professional, and the whole process made me feel completely relaxed, especially for someone like me who was experiencing it for the first time—it was truly comfortable.

After the massage, they thoughtfully provided mung bean soup and hot herbal tea, which not only relaxed my body but also warmed my heart. This short massage became an unexpected little surprise during my trip.

reviews.text:
十分糟的體驗，連一顆星都不想給
專業宰中國客的店
買了草藥+桑拿+精油按摩，B2000/2hr
0.我們約了5:00，提早4:30到，明明有很多空間可以讓我們提早進去，卻讓我們在外面白坐30分鐘
1.說是有男女分流，一開始卻讓我們走男賓的走道
2.中間經過的設施都是停止運作+毫無維護
3.浴室的門關不起來，且無放衣服的平台
4.在桑拿房待了10分鐘都不會熱，桑拿房無清潔且十分破舊，且桑拿房的門也關不起來，我和朋友直接放棄坐在裡面浪費時間，放棄桑拿這個項目
5.外門都大敞，我們洗完澡圍著浴巾出來都會被經過的遊客看光，十分沒有隱私性
6.我們在按摩的時候都是近全裸，工作人員在進出門的時候都不會將門關實，外面如果有人經過可以從縫隙中看到按摩的現場
7.空間非常髒，放包包的小櫃子已經粉化，且無門可以鎖住貴重物品
8.按摩有些穴位抓不準，且按壓力道過大讓人喘不過氣
9.默認要給小費B100，服務不到位卻還是要硬收小費？？？我以為小費是覺得有滿意的服務才需要付的？？？

不會再去第二次了，氣死
reviews.textTranslated:
A terrible experience, I wouldn't even give it one star.

A shop that professionally rips off Chinese tourists. Bought herbal medicine + sauna + aromatherapy massage, B2000/2hr

0. We had an appointment for 5:00, arrived at 4:30 early, and although there was plenty of space for us to get in early, we were made to sit outside for 30 minutes.

1. They said there was separate male and female areas, but initially they made us walk through the men's aisle.

2. All the facilities we passed were out of service and completely unmaintained.

3. The bathroom door wouldn't close, and there was no platform for putting clothes down.

4. We stayed in the sauna for 10 minutes and it wasn't hot at all. The sauna was unclean and very dilapidated, and the door wouldn't close either. My friend and I decided to skip the sauna altogether, as it was a waste of time.

5. The outer doors were wide open; even when we came out wrapped in towels after showering, we were completely exposed to passing tourists, offering absolutely no privacy.

6. We were practically naked during our massages, and the staff didn't close the doors properly when entering or leaving, so anyone passing by could see into the massage area through the gaps.

7. The space was extremely dirty; the small lockers for bags were crumbling and had no doors to lock valuables.

8. The massage techniques were inaccurate, targeting some acupoints, and the pressure was too strong, making it difficult to breathe.

9. They expect a 100 Baht tip by default, even though the service was subpar? I thought tips were only for satisfied customers?

I will never go there again. I'm furious.

In the end, I only got to use the reformer and practice on the mat. 😂 So confusing!

reviews.text: Staffs and instructors are very nice and helpful. The studio is also easy to access, clean and well prepared👍🏻😊

reviews.name: NongPoii LittleDevil
reviews.text: เล่นพิลาทิสที่นี่มาหลายเดือนแล้วค่ะ ทั้ง grop class ทั้ง private คุณครูและเจ้าหน้าที่น่ารักมาก ดูแลทุกอย่าง ช่วยจัดท่าให้ตลอด group class ขนาดเล็กทำให้คุณครูดูแลทั่วถึง อาการปวดบ่าจาก office syndrome ดีขึ้นจริงๆ สถานที่สะอาด เดินทางสะดวก ติด mrt เลย แนะนำเลยค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: I've been doing Pilates here for several months now, both group classes and private lessons. The instructors and staff are lovely and attentive, always helping me with my posture. The small group classes allow for personalized attention from the instructors, and my shoulder pain from office syndrome has really improved. The place is clean, conveniently located right next to the MRT, and easily accessible. I highly recommend it!

reviews.name: chunya Th
reviews.text:
สตูดิโอสะอาด น้องๆinstuctorน่ารักทุกคนค่ะ group classes ราคาไม่แรง น้องๆใส่ใจปรับท่าทางให้ตลอด จากที่แค่ตั้งใจจะมาฝึกcoreเพื่อเอาไปต่อยอดการฝึกโยคะ กลายเป็นหยุดฝึกโยคะแล้วมาฝึกพิลาทิสแทน คลาสสนุกมาก ได้เหงื่อทุกคลาส ที่สำคัญคือความปลอดภัย น้องๆผู้สอนจะพยายามย้ำถึงความปลอดภัยในการใช้งานเครื่องตลอดเวลา
น้องreceptionก้น่ารักค่ะถามอะไรตอบด้วยรอยยิ้มตลอดเวลา
reviews.textTranslated:
The studio is clean, and all the instructors are lovely. The group classes are reasonably priced, and the instructors are attentive, constantly adjusting your posture. I initially intended to train my core to improve my yoga practice, but I ended up stopping yoga and switching to Pilates instead. The classes are so much fun, and I sweat every time. Most importantly, safety is paramount; the instructors constantly emphasize safety precautions when using the equipment.
The receptionist is also lovely, always answering questions with a smile.

I tried a private trial course twice.
The teacher was lovely and friendly. It's conveniently located; you can get off the MRT and walk straight into Seacon Square.

reviews.name: veeranant chanboonyawat
reviews.text: จากที่ไม่รู้จัก pilates มาก่อน เริ่มหัดเล่นครั้งแรก ที่ three studio pilates ประทับใจ ครูผู้สอน ที่อัธยาศัยดี ใส่ใจนักเรียน เป็นกันเอง บรรยากาศ ความสะอาด  ยอดเยี่ยม สวยงาม  ผ่านมา 3 ปี จาก three studio อยู่ เมโทรปาร์ค กัลปพฤกษ์ ย้ายมา ซีคอนบางแค ก็ยังติดตามมาเล่น ปัจจุบัน วัยเลข 5 นำหน้าแล้ว ยิ่งรู้สึกเลยว่า pilates เป็นการออกกำลังกายที่เหมาะกับวัยเราอย่างยิ่ง ใครที่มาลองเล่นครั้งแรก แล้วถอดใจ คิดว่าเล่นไม่ได้ หรือ ไม่เข้าใจวิธีเล่น อยากให้ลองเปิดใจ เล่นต่อเนื่อง แล้วจะเข้าใจวิธีการ เทคนิค แล้วทีนี้จะสนุกและอยาก advance มากขึ้น
reviews.textTranslated: Having known nothing about Pilates before, I started learning at Three Studio Pilates. I was impressed by the instructors – friendly, attentive, and welcoming – and the atmosphere, cleanliness, and overall beauty of the studio. Three years later, after Three Studio moved from Metro Park Kanlapaphruek to Seacon Bangkae, I still follow them. Now in my 50s, I realize even more that Pilates is the perfect exercise for my age. For anyone trying it for the first time and feeling discouraged, thinking they can't do it or don't understand, I encourage you to be open-minded and consistent. You'll understand the techniques and methods, and then you'll find it fun and want to advance further.

reviews.text: ก่อนหน้านี้มีปัญหาปวดคอบ่าไหล่ พอได้มาเล่นพิลาทิสที่นี่อาการดีขึ้นมากเลยค่ะ ครูทุกคนน่ารัก ใส่ใจรายละเอียด มีความสุขทุกครั้งที่ได้มาเล่นค่ะ

reviews.textTranslated: I was very impressed with Teacher Dao's teaching. 🤍 She's a great teacher, patient, attentive to detail, and constantly guides and corrects postures to ensure they're correct according to yoga principles. If you're looking for a skilled, attentive, and understanding yoga teacher, you absolutely must try her classes!

title: Abbysan Yoga & Wellness
ownerDescription:
Abbysan is a private movement and longevity practice in Phuket, led by Dr. Abhishek Agrawal and physiotherapist Denny Jumpaon. Every journey begins with a Foundation Assessment. Before any exercise, we read how you stand, how you move, and what your body has been quietly compensating for. Only then do we recommend a path built around you.

We work with people managing back, neck and joint pain, posture and alignment, pregnancy and postnatal recovery, strength, and healthy ageing. This is not a drop-in class. It is an unhurried, one-to-one approach for people who want to understand their body and stay capable for life.

Two Phuket locations: Boat Lagoon, Ko Kaeo, and Alanna Wellness, Choeng Thale. By appointment.

September 2026 intake now open — Clinical Pilates Instructor Course. 100 hours, AAA-accredited, Phuket Thailand. Maximum 4 students. 
Details:

Living in Phuket and dealing with back or neck pain? A postural assessment might be your next step.

If you're living or spending extended time in Phuket, you're probably not short of wellness options — massages, yoga studios, and gyms.

But if you're dealing with persistent back pain, neck tension, shoulder stiffness, or that general feeling that your body is just not moving right, a massage or a yoga class is unlikely to get to the root of it.

At Abbysan in Ko Kaew, and  we specialise in exactly this. We work with expats and long-term residents who want real answers about why their body feels the way it does, and a structured plan to actually fix it.

Our process starts with a full postural and movement assessment. We look at how your body is aligned, where the restrictions are, and why they're there. 

Then we build a corrective programme tailored to you.

No generic classes. No guesswork. A structured pathway from where you are now to how you want to feel.

If you've been putting up with pain or stiffness and just managing it — this is your sign to address it properly.

📍 Abbysan Yoga & Wellness Center — Ko Kaew, Phuket and Cherngtalay (Choeng Thale) Phuket | 

Book: info@abbysan.com | WhatsApp: +66625475107

We don't put new clients straight into classes. Here's our process, and why it matters.

Most yoga and Pilates studios will sign you up for a class on day one.

We don't. And here's exactly why.

Everybody is different. Every client who walks through our door has a different history, different injuries, different habits, different areas of tension and restriction. Putting everyone into the same class from day one ignores all of that.

Our process starts with a private 1-on-1 assessment. We look at your posture, your movement patterns, and identify the root causes of any pain, stiffness, or imbalance you're experiencing.

From there, we build a programme that's structured around what your body actually needs not a generic routine.

Only when you have the right foundation do we introduce group sessions.

It takes more commitment upfront. But it's why our clients see lasting results instead of temporary relief.

If you want a structured, personalised approach to how your body moves and feels, we'd love to start with your assessment.

📍 Ko Kaew, Phuket and Cherngtalay (Choeng Thale) Phuket | Private sessions by appointment | info@abbysan.com

Still in pain after months of yoga or gym? Your posture might be the reason.

Most people dealing with chronic back pain, neck tension, or joint stiffness have already tried something; yoga, physiotherapy, the gym, stretching routines. And yet the pain keeps coming back.

Here's what most fitness and wellness approaches miss: they work the muscles, but they don't address why your body is holding itself the way it is.
Poor posture and misalignment are the silent root cause behind most recurring pain. If your body is structurally out of balance, no amount of exercise will fix it — it may even make it worse.

At Abbysan, we start differently.
Before any class or programme, every new client goes through a private postural and movement assessment. We identify exactly where your body is out of alignment and why — then build a corrective plan specific to you.

If you've been trying to fix your pain and it keeps returning — this might be the step you haven't taken yet.

📍 Ko Kaew, Phuket and Cherngtalay (Choeng Thale) Phuket | Book your private assessment with a initial treatment — 4,900 THB | info@abbysan.com

Struggling with knee pain after 50 in Phuket? At Abbysan Yoga in Boat Lagoon, we offer structured assessment and movement therapy to remove the root cause of your knee pain and knee pain relief by improving joint stability.

👉 Start with 3 Alignment Reset Sessions to reduce knee strain and move with confidence.

reviews.name: Richard Joynes
reviews.text: I can't speak highly enough of this place. I am 76 and have old shoulder and ankle injuries from skiing and was advised years ago that I would eventually require a shoulder replacement. But over the last 5 years Dr. Abhishek (aided by his wife Denny) have done wonders in restoring my range of motion and virtually eliminating my chronic pain. And that’s only some of the wonders they've worked on this old carcass! The facilities are impeccable and the very efficient staff are delightful. Don’t wait another minute – get yourself over there and transform your life!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you, Mr. Richard, this genuinely moved me. Restoring your range of motion and easing long-standing pain over these years has been a privilege, and Denny sends her warmth too. Here is to keeping that shoulder capable for a long time yet. — Dr. Abhishek, Abbysan

reviews.name: Sean Doherty
reviews.text: This is a wonderful studio with wonderful teachers. Their method is very unique and they are very focused on each student’s own situation.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you, Sean. Reading each body on its own terms is the heart of what we do, so it means a great deal that it came through for you. You are always welcome back. — Dr. Abhishek, Abbysan

reviews.name: Diana Young
reviews.text: We have been in Thailand for a month and the highlight for me was discovering this wonderful Yoga Studio within walking distance from our condo. I have attended about 15 classes at different times and levels. Master Ravi is awesome. Within 2 sessions he was able to demonstrate and teach me how to do knees/chest down flowing into cobra. It had always alluded me so I am thrilled. There were many other poses that he taught me the proper technique and alignment for. I am 66 years old and I appreciated that he didn't expect any less from me that he did the 30 year olds in the classes and when I thanked him personally for this courtesy he reaffirmed with proper alignment age isn't a limiting factor. The office staff were wonderful and booking on the app or in person was easy. We will definitely come back specifically for this studio and will then look at adding on to Yoga  the personal health programs and also adding pilates. I can't recommend this studio highly enough. Thanks to the staff and Master Ravi.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you, Diana. What a wonderful note to read. Ravi will be delighted, and you have put your finger on something we hold to: with proper alignment, age is not a limiting factor. We would love to welcome you back for the movement and longevity work whenever you return to Phuket. — Dr. Abhishek, Abbysan

reviews.name: Shub Qureshi
reviews.text:
"I have been practicing various styles of yoga for over 20 years, and attending Yogi Ravi’s breathwork workshop at Abbysan was a profound and transformative experience. This was the fundamental class I never knew was missing from my practice. Yogi Ravi’s authentic knowledge and guidance brought a depth and clarity that truly stood out. His approach to breathwork felt like a return to the roots of true yoga, something that transcends the usual classes we see today.

The techniques and wisdom shared in this workshop are invaluable, and I genuinely believe that this kind of breathwork should be a foundational part of education, ideally taught in all primary schools. It's a practice that offers much more than basic fitness or relaxation; it's about cultivating a deeper connection to oneself and the world around us.

A heartfelt thank you to Abhishek for creating this workshop and bringing Ravi’s teachings straight from Rishikesh to Abbysan.

If you're seeking a class that goes beyond the surface and truly connects you with the essence of yoga, yogi ravi’s breathwork, Yoga classes and workshops are a must.  I can't recommend it highly enough."
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your heartfelt review, Shub! Ravi's authentic approach truly captures the essence of yoga. It’s wonderful to have dedicated learners like you in our community. Thank you for recommending us, and we look forward to seeing you again soon! 🙏

reviews.name: Nikolay Karpuzov
reviews.text: Abyshek is very knowledgeable professional. His private sessions are like a combination of physiotherapy, Pilates, yoga and kinesiotherapy. Very holistic individual approach. He has helped me big time with the lower back pain and hip issues. Highly recommend.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you, Nikolay. Lower back and hip issues so often trace back to how the whole body moves together, which is exactly what those private sessions are built to read. I am very glad you are moving more freely. — Dr. Abhishek, Abbysan

reviews.name: Tricia Lau-Lewis
reviews.text: I highly recommend Dr. Abbyshek at Abbysan.  After receiving a degenerative arthritis diagnosis in my right big toe, I began seeing him for treatment.  With each session, I gained confidence and strength, eventually being able to walk without a limp.  Dr. Abbyshek was patient, kind, and extremely knowledgeable about the body.  He introduced new exercises at every session, including ones I could do at home, and even helped me prepare for a small hike with balancing exercises.  Prior to seeing him, I had been walking with a limp for nearly two months and was feeling very depressed.  Now, I can walk normally and confidently, although I do need to modify my activities.  I am very grateful to have found such a helpful practitioner in Phuket.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you, Tricia. Walking confidently again after months with a limp is exactly the kind of change we work toward, one session at a time. It meant a great deal to be part of your recovery, and I wish you many more confident miles ahead. — Dr. Abhishek, Abbysan

Helping the body work around something like that, step by step, is the work I love most. I look forward to continuing it with you. — Dr. Abhishek, Abbysan

reviews.text: เล่นโยคะมา 4 ปีไม่มีความก้าวหน้าเท่าไหร่เปลี่ยนสตู  มาฝึกโยคะกับครูหนูเพียงแค่ 3 เดือนร่างกายแข็งแรงขึ้นCore body แข็งแรงขึ้นมาก สามารถตีกอล์ฟได้ดีขึ้น ครูหนูฝึกในแนวทางสร้างความแข็งแรงให้ร่างกายเรา และช่วยให้เราเข้าใจร่างกายเรามากขึ้น ขอบคุณคุณหนูมากๆครับใครอยากแข็งแรงแบบระยะยาวแนะนำมาฝึกกับครูหนูนะครับ แล้วคุณจะรู้ว่าโยคะทำให้คุณแข็งแรงได้จริง ที่สำคัญครูหนูสอนสนุกและมีอุปกรณ์ให้ฝึกเยอะมาก สอนแบบไม่กั๊กความรู้ เหมือน private class เลยครับให้เวลาการสอนเยอะมาก ๆ แนะนำให้มาฝึกที่นี่เลยครับ
reviews.textTranslated: I've been practicing yoga for 4 years without much progress, so I changed studios. After only 3 months of training with Teacher Nu, my body is much stronger, my core is much stronger, and I can even play golf better. Teacher Nu focuses on building strength and helping me understand my body better. Thank you so much, Teacher Nu! If you want long-term strength, I highly recommend training with Teacher Nu. You'll see that yoga can really make you strong. Importantly, Teacher Nu's classes are fun, she has lots of equipment to use, and she shares all her knowledge generously – it's like a private class! She dedicates a lot of time to each lesson. I highly recommend training here!

reviews.name: Natty Somsawtdiwatt
reviews.text: เล่นโยคะมาประมาณ 3 ปี เล่นไปท้อไป เพราะทำท่าไหนก็ไม่ได้ จนได้มาเจอครูหนู ชญาดา บ้านโยคะ ครูหนูน่ารักมากเลย ค่อยๆแก้ท่าพื้นฐานที่เราผิด แล้วเพิ่งรู้สึกว่าแขนแอ่น เข่าบิด คุณครูก็คอยแก้ ปรับให้ คอยเชฟให้ มาเรียนกับครูหนูประมาณ 3 เดือน รู้สึกเลยว่าตัวเองแข็งแรงขึ้น ทำท่าต่างๆก็เบาขึ้น เหมือนปลดล็อกตัวเอง สนุกทุกครั้งที่มาเล่นโยคะ คุณครูหนูมีของเล่นเยอะมาก คอยเติมความแข็งแรงให้ทุกส่วนของร่างกาย ทำให้เรียนในคลาสไม่น่าเบื่อเลย ออกกำลังกายให้สนุกแถมได้สุขภาพที่ดีขึ้นด้วย แนะนำที่นี่เลย โคตรดี ถ้าใครเล่นโยคะมานาน ท้อ บาดเจ็บ ลองมาที่นี่เลย แนะนำมาก ราคาดี คุณครูคุยง่าย แบบมีความครูสูงมากก กันเอง ยืดหยุ่นตามร่างกายผู้เรียน  สอนแบบไม่กักเลย ทุกเทคนิคให้หมด ลองเปิดมากับที่นี่ ให้ the best of yoga mobility and flexiblity place
reviews.textTranslated: I've been practicing yoga for about 3 years, and I often felt discouraged because I couldn't do any of the poses. Then I met Teacher Nu, Chayada, at Baan Yoga. Teacher Nu is so lovely! She patiently corrected my basic poses that I was doing wrong. When I realized my arms were too arched and my knees were twisted, she would fix and adjust them for me, shaping me perfectly. After about 3 months of classes with Teacher Nu, I feel so much stronger, and the poses feel easier. It's like I've unlocked something within myself. Every class is fun! Teacher Nu has so many toys and exercises to help strengthen every part of my body, making classes anything but boring. It's a fun way to exercise and improve your health. I highly recommend this place! It's amazing. If you've been practicing yoga for a long time, feeling discouraged or injured, try this place. The price is good, the teacher is easy to talk to, and has a really strong teaching spirit. She's friendly, flexible, and teaches without holding back any techniques. Try it – it's the best yoga mobility and flexibility place!

title: InDepth Yoga Academy
ownerDescription: InDepth Yoga Academy is a family owned international yoga school under Yoga Alliance providing trainings and classes in hatha vinyasa, aerial, prenatal, yin, ashtanga, and unique programs like Yoga for Athletes.
address: 80/128 Phuket, Phuket 83100, Thailand
plusCode: Q8WJ+MG Rawai, Mueang Phuket District, Phuket, Thailand

reviews.name: Unusual Emma
reviews.text:
I studied here for a month, doing my 200hr Hatha Vinyasa teacher training, with a 30hr Aerial Yoga add on, and would highly recommend InDepth to anyone who wants to learn more about yoga, whether to teach or simply to deepen your own practice. I have leaned so much, achieved more than I thought myself capable of, and had a wonderful time doing so!

Ana and Natalie are both passionate, dedicated teachers who have an incredible depth of knowledge about Yoga - from anatomy to philosophy, meditation to asana, and everything in between. Be aware that covering a 200hr YTT in 3 weeks is a very intensive course, so expect long days with a mixture of practice and theory, and a lot to learn in a short time frame!  Although it can seem overwhelming, especially in week one, material is covered from several angles during the course so it all makes sense by week three, and with very small class sizes there is plenty of opportunity to ask questions and delve deeper into aspects of yoga that interest you. Ana and Natalie both love to share their knowledge and wisdom, as well as personal experience, which is extremely wide ranging, from being and coaching athletes, to working with addicts, to studying at monestaries.

As well as courses they also run fantastic regular yoga classes of various styles on the roof here, from Hatha to Aerial to Yin to Yoga Nidra, so there's something for everyone. They also have a flexible schedule so if you can't see the class you want at a time which suits you, get on touch and they may be able to arrange something that works for you...

reviews.name: en wen
reviews.text:
I am a student of the YTT200 course. I'm very disappointed here. The advice to anyone who really wants to learn yoga is don't come.
1, this is not a professional yoga teaching academic, and the cost is not in line with professional real institutions. This is the home of anna and her mother. There is no school atmosphere, the environment is very dirty, there is no air conditioning, and the area that can be used is very small. The environment here will definitely surprise you.
2, false publicity, environment, pool, etc., the fact is that the pool is very small and dirty, no one wants to use it, and does not even include the use of drinking water and the use of toilet paper. I don't know why I'm so mean.
3, this is not a place of positive energy, because you do not feel any welcome and friendliness to you, the words and attitudes are very unfriendly, I have been treated unfairly.
4, every group of students are complaining, can give examples of all kinds of bad. And beat up my classmates first.
5, If you want to think carefully, the energy here is very low. The tuition and the environment and the faculty are totally out of line.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi Delilah, 

Unfortunately, although our teachers did everything in our power to help you including providing you books and materials in Chinese, going above and beyond to print out worksheets and diagrams in your native language and helping make flashcards if you give up after the first week of the course and proceed to lie and tell us you are either sick or tell us that you are coming and then never come to the lectures and classes that put the other students at a great disadvantage. Both of the other girls were often waiting for you and falling behind because of this. 

We are sorry that you felt that we were rude to you, that was not at all our intention - in fact we were only trying to make sure that you had all the necessary knowledge and resources to graduate this course. 

As you left after only 1 week and did not come back you were not present when Jin Soo attacked one of our teachers and threw our furniture. 

Keep in mind that the pool amenities are provided not by us but by our accommodation partner and you stayed in your own accommodations. That being said our pool is cleaned regularly and is not dirty. Neither is the rest of our school. 

We are sorry to hear you had a negative experience and wish you all the best on your yoga journey.

reviews.name: MJ Rivers
reviews.text: What an amazing training. Nathalie is a great teacher with loads of knowledge and life experience. It can feel intense at at times, but if you're in it for the right reasons, you are eager to learn and don't being outside your comfort zone, I can definitely recommend this training. You won't regret it.

reviews.name: Korey Leach
reviews.text:
Words can’t even begin to describe how content I am with my experience at InDepth Yoga. I ventured to Phuket specifically for the 2-Day Yoga Nidra course. I left with far more than just another certificate.

Not only did I learn far more than I had expected, but I left with a new outlook on life as well as lifelong connections.

Nathalie holds a world of knowledge inside her. Her classes are thorough and well explained (in multiple languages!). She is a light to be around and the classes are personal. She is inspiring and somehow (in such a short amount of time) was able to help me find/realize what just may be my purpose in life.

I hope to have the opportunity to study here again. 🖤
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your kind words Korey! 🙏🏼🥰

reviews.name: a. p.
reviews.text: I had a fantastic experience with InDepth Yoga Academy! I got to know myself more, got to understand myself, know what I like and what I don’t. Nathalie is such a kind and amazing person and teacher, she was alwas supporting and helpful. She teached me so much, physical and emotional and I am so glad I went through this beautiful journey with her. I highly recommend her, you won't regret it.THANK YOU so much for everything, I will always keep this wonderful memories in my heart 🙏
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you darling!

reviews.name: Elliott Peacock
reviews.text: This month I finished my 200hr hatha vinyasa teacher training at InDepth Yoga Academy in Phuket, Thailand and it was a great experience. Nathalie and Ana were the best teachers! Everything was set out in an efficient way which allowed my to learn properly. For anything I struggled with they adapted very well and helped in Every way possible! I would recommend InDepth yoga academy to anyone getting involved or wanting to improve their journey!

reviews.name: Thomas Singh
reviews.text:
I did my Yoga Nidra Teacher training with Ana at InDepth Yoga and it was great decision. Definitely ideal for teachers that want to learn how to guide Nidra session and get started with this beautiful practice. Once you've done the training it's up to you to bring your teaching where you want and it's super exciting.
Thanks 🙏
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Thomas!

reviews.name: Alma Jonuzi
reviews.text:
Frist of all the energy in your house was not good. None of us students fell good.
The house was very dirty. No AC. No water. No snacks. No toilet paper. We had to get everything by our self. We had theory lessons in a dirty room that fell like 50 degrees inside.
One day I bought myself a 6pack of water bottles. As soon as I entered the house Natali  (the owner of Indepth) just took my 6 pack of waterbottles off my hands and said to me: „you are a smart girl, we don’t have water to drink anymore“ and then she opened a bottle for herself and started laughing. I was so terrified of what she just did that I couldn’t say anything. I never saw this kind of behavior. I WAS SHOKED

It was very very hard and challenging to stay concentrated during our lessons in this heat. Right before the yoga teacher training I already was in Thailand for months and I was healthy all the time but when I started the yoga teacher training I had a lot of problems with my health. Breathing problems, panic attacks, diarrhea and dizziness every time I entered this house. I already paid a lot for the teacher training and over 700 USD for my room and food so that’s why I didn’t want to quit. Overall I spent over 4000 USD for the 3 weeks yoga teacher training, the room and food. Jin had the same problem that’s why we didn’t quit and we decided to continue the yoga teacher training even we felt terrible.

As soon as me or Jin started complaining about something that bothered us, you and Natali started getting angry and made us feel bad for saying anything. It was very challenging. Natali and Jin had a lot of arguments and Natali was always very rude to her. Natali gave us lessons always very quickly and without motivation, I felt like she was always in a rush and didn’t even wanted to teach us something. Whenever I asked Natali something that I didn’t understand she seemed very annoyed, as soon as she was finish with teaching us she went straight to her jiu jitsu training.

One day when she came back from her jiu jitsu training she came back with a broken rib. Natali and you had passive aggressive behavior.
Me, Delilah and Jin had to feel all this bad energy everyday during our teacher training. You were just talking to each other in Russian. Sometimes you were talking bad about us in russian I know that because I could understand sometimes. I always felt humiliated for me and the other 2 girls. You  made us feel small in your presence.

In my opinion a yoga teacher training should be a wonderful experience where you can grow in a beautiful community and environment.

Also there were workers in the house neraly everyday to fix something. DURING OUR YOGA TEACHER TRAINING. You also had a lot of other clients coming and going DURING OUR YOGA TEACHER TRAINING.

2 days before the exams you create a yoga lesson with me. This yoga lesson I had to teach to Jin on my exam day. There were some positions I never learned during the training or positions that I couldn’t do and it was just so hard for me to follow you it was one of the worst days of my entire life. So I had to learn a whole new lesson to teach 2 days before my exam. I felt exhausted and forced. I was crying the whole day and the yoga teacher training felt like hell to me. During our exams you and Natali didn’t even pay attention to our lessons, so how could you evaluate us? You were talking to each other and sometimes one of you teachers left and came back again. That felt disturbing during our exams.

None uf us got the original certificate. Not even Jin and she is already a yoga teacher for 2 years.  We both just got the Certificate of participation. My Familyname was written wrong on the certificate you never asked me what my family name is. Jin got mad because you didn’t give her enough time for the written test, then Natalie and her had a very rough argument nearly fight. In this fight Natali s real face came out. I think if you didnt stop that argument your mum would hit jin.
And now after complaining you blocked us everywhere😂 I mean what kind of behavior is this? YOU WILL GET YOUR KARMA.

reviews.name: Theodor Dufvenmark
reviews.text: Been having lessons with Ana each time I come back to Thailand.  It’s such a retreat for your mind and soul. reviews.name: Lucy Greenway
reviews.text: I can not recommend Nathalie from InDepth yoga academy enough to help you with your sports injuries. She has been using her in-depth knowledge of yoga therapy for athletes to assist me with strength and mobility training that have been a key factor in recovering from a partial MCL tear. I went from being in constant pain to being pretty much painless because of her fantastic one on one sessions. Thank you Nathalie!!

reviews.name: Даниил Пухов
reviews.text: I highly recommend it for anyone looking to deepen their practice of Yoga Nidra. Their expertise in this transformative practice is truly exceptional. With their guidance, I have experienced a deep sense of relaxation and inner peace, and have gained a greater understanding of my own mind-body connection. If you're looking for a skilled and knowledgeable Yoga Nidra teacher, look no further than Natalya. Thanks for all!

reviews.name: Yasha Guo
reviews.text:
Course structure: I took the 21 days hatha vinyasa yoga teacher training from Dec.11 2019 with another three girls. We're from China, Mexico, Denmark and Turkey. (what a diverse class!)
The actual training days are about 19 days. The normal schedule for us is
6.30-8.30 morning practice
8.30-9.30 breaksat
9.30-12 lecture
12-3 lunch break
3-5 lecture
5-7 evening practice
Then doing homework, shower and bedtime

We have two prestests about yoga philosophy in the middle of the courses, we also take turns to teach mobility series and sun salutation. In the end, we learned how to design a class and have a teaching exam, plus a writing exam. The pressure to have a good result on the exam really pushes me to learn yoga, its philosophy, anatomy, Sanskrit names etc. I wouldn't become so confident and enjoy teaching yoga without Nathalie's help.

Accommodation: I chose the private accommodation, it comes with a decent bedroom，private bathroom and balcony. You do need to bring your laundry out for cleaning including your clothes and bed sheets. Also buy toilet papers, shampoo etc. The water in the house comes from two big tanks in front of the house, if it runs out, Nathalie will call the water truck to refill it. Which reminds us to preserve the water and be more mindful when using it.

Food and water: there is a shared kitchen we can use. Buy your own food, there is a juice bar and 711 nearby where you can get pretty much everything, also a lot restaurants are walkable. The second day of the course, Nathalie took us out to a large supermarket, where we got a lot of groceries. Drinking water comes from a nearby water stand where we take a big bottle out to refill (only 5 bahts) , you can also buy your own drinking water from 711.

Other notes: we also went out to see big Buddha and did meditation in front of it. Throughout course, we have Ana to take pictures for us, she is such a talented and awesome photographer! We had a half day on beach to do photoshooting, as well as a lot great pictures on the graduation day. Ana also did yoga nitra for us, which is the best relaxation technique EVER!

Nathalie is so kind to let me stay one night more for free and we did Aerial Yoga! Wish I had more time to train this as well! But I will come back for other trainings, such as prenatal yoga. They offer many types of trainings, you will find something that suits your time and needs!

My words for this experience:
Nathalie is an amazing lecturer! We had so many great discussions and sparkling moments during our classes. The whole course is intensive at the beginning but such a great learning opportunity for me, who really enjoyed discussing yoga in depth, talking about why we practice yoga and how to live a better life, bring peace and happiness into our body and mind.

Thanks to this course, I'd love to carry on my yoga journey, doing more reading(yoga sutras of Patanjali is my current and lifelong reading!), delivering what I believe in yoga to more people who are searching for purpose of life.

A millions of thanks to Nathalie and Ana, who organized this transformational course and took care of us!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for such a thorough and wonderful review!

reviews.name: Jin Soo De Jong
reviews.text:
I attended the 200h YTT. I was very disappointed. NO airconditioning. The temperature felt like 40* inside the concrete house where we spent most of the time. Dirty toilet, hospitality level low. Don't think they want you to complete the teacher training after the 3 intense weeks but rather you come back so they can earn more money. On the day I had to do my exam the owner attacked me because I wanted to take my exam papers with me. Big ego's...
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Jin Soo did not pass our 200hr training even though she had already supposedly completed a 200hr online when she learned this she attacked our lead instructor and started throwing furniture. reviews.name: Savannah Rueløkke
reviews.text: At this school, you are sure to get good professional education. A yoga school I can highly recommend and would visit again at any time. Sweet, amazing talented people who educate you.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Heidi!!

reviews.name: Lila Roy
reviews.text: Looking back on my trip to Thailand, my stay at Non La Mer hostel was a huge part of what made my experience so amazing. The hostel itself is so warm and inviting with clean, comfortable common areas that encourage new friendships, a large clean bathroom with many stalls/showers, the sweetest staff members!!!, great location (so close to the beach/great restaurants/convenience stores&live music!🎶 a highlight for me and my friend was Toby’s scooter lessons. He was SUCH a great teacher and made us both feel so much more confident about driving which in turn allowed us to experience the whole island! The free breakfast made by Mina was the perfect way to start your day after a great night sleep with comfortable beds, individual curtains, AC AND ceiling fan. Mina and Lisa were so smiley, helpful & constantly cleaning / tidying the space to keep it clean & comfy for guests! Nora is a fantastic yoga teacher & the studio is gorgeous open air, overlooking the mountains in the background. Such a great experience, hope to make it back one day!! Ps the kitty’s running around are soso sweet!

reviews.name: Maya Gerlach
reviews.text: Wow wow! This is hands down my favorite hostel from my 2 months in Thailand. I can not recommend this place enough. I stayed for a total of 6 nights and that was not enough. The yoga is fabulous (the best hostel yoga I have done by miles). The staff is amazing. Toby offers great scooter lessons, which really helped my confidence as I had only driven a few times prior. I consistently saw staff cleaning/sweeping the common areas, and I thought the bathrooms were always clean. I thought the beds were comfortable. The free breakfast was great. It's a social hostel but not a party one. Hope to be back someday! ❤️🧘‍♀️
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so, so much, Maya. When you and Lila were here, we were truly happy.

Your happy emotions, positive energy, and kindness meant a lot to us. Every time you came to the reception with a big smile, it really made our day.

We hope that one day we’ll get to share travel stories together.

And one last thing—please relax when you ride, stick to the left side, wear your helmet, and take it slow. Enjoy your new life with the scooter!

Have a great day, Maya and Lila! :D

reviews.name: Ivett Horváth
reviews.text:
We were looking for three beds in a bit of an emergency situation. Even though it was last minute, Toby went out of his way to help us and managed to sort everything out for us. He was incredibly kind and helpful — we really can’t appreciate him enough.

The hostel itself was great: cool place, nice people, and a very chill vibe. The beds were quite big and comfortable, with curtains for privacy. Every room also has its own toilet, and they were clean and well maintained.

If I come back to Koh Lanta, I will definitely book here again.

Thank you again, Toby!

reviews.name: Sara-author
reviews.text: Fantastic hostel with amazing staff who were always friendly and helpful. I've staying in 5 hostel on Koh Lanta and this is by far the best in comfort, vibe and location. Everything was spotlessly clean, the location was perfect for exploring, and the facilities were excellent — comfortable, considered and well maintained. Specifics , 2 pillows!!, the best yoga teacher I have ever had ( book early) small gym on the ground floor and a  really chilled and thoughtfully laid out communal area. Very good black out curtains on each bunk, free breakfast - and cats!!! What's not to love!

reviews.name: sabah bazzi
reviews.text:
Mind you this is my first experience in a hostel & feel like I chose the best place. We’re about 5 minute walk to the beach! They had me at cats & yoga 🥺
Toby was so polite and helpful, I felt like all my tiny little complications were taken care of.
There’s a gym attached which is an absolute blessing, hammocks, and a co ed kitchen.
Toby greeting me by name everyday 🫣😌😌
I’d definitely come back here!

reviews.name: Gina-Madeleine Rösenberg
reviews.text: I loved the free yoga and the amazing crew! The rooms are big, the beds are super comfortable, and everything feels so welcoming. Honestly, there was nothing I didn’t like — such a perfect place to stay in Koh Lanta. Definitely one of my favorite hostels in Thailand. I’d happily come back anytime!

reviews.name: Bee
reviews.text:
This is a place I want to like, as Toby is nice and free yoga is offered to guests. The price per night is also very reasonable for high season.

Pros: Good opportunity to socialize with others at the breakfast table. Guests are friendly, on the quieter side, and sensible toward others. Location is ideal for those who don’t rent scooters.

Cons: Not a homey vibe. As others have mentioned, we have to take off our shoes and the floor isn’t the cleanest. The bathrooms are also not the cleanest, but that does depend on the guests who use them. Personally found the yoga and stretch sessions just okay, and would not have paid for them.

reviews.name: Tyler Irvin
reviews.text:
One of the dirtiest hostels I’ve ever stayed in. The shared bathrooms were honestly disgusting. Over my 4 day stay I didn’t see them get cleaned once; used tampons, hair, mud, etc everywhere. Floors in the common area never swept.

Value for money is very low. The yoga classes have very limited availability. There were a few extra hidden costs upon arrival for basic items. Which for a pricier hostel was surprising. I found staff dismissive and unhappy to be there.

Otherwise, the vibe is nice. It’s in an easy location to access Koh Lanta. But really, I couldn’t wait to check out.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
We’re sorry that you consider our hostel “one of the dirtiest” you’ve stayed in, but we need to correct several inaccurate statements in your review.

First of all, you stayed with us for 3 days, not 4. We have a strict cleaning schedule every day from 11:00 AM to 2:00 PM, which is during check-out and check-in time, and the common areas are cleaned again in the evening. So it is simply not true that the bathrooms were never cleaned during your stay.

Please also understand that this is a shared hostel (6–8 people per room) and we are located close to the beach, meaning guests constantly move in and out. Cleanliness in shared spaces also depends on guest behavior. If there had been an issue, you could have informed us at reception and we would have handled it immediately.

Regarding yoga: yoga classes are not included in the room rate. Around 90% of our guests want to join, which naturally limits availability. We already offer yoga 3 days a week with up to 5 classes or more, and we also provide a fitness area where guests are free to practice on their own or follow online sessions.

The “hidden cost” you mentioned is a 20 THB towel fee, which you keep for your entire stay. As we are on an island with limited clean water, this small fee helps us manage laundry responsibly. This information is communicated on arrival.

Finally, about the staff being “dismissive or unhappy”: I personally enjoy my job, even though it can be tiring. On your check-out day, you remained in bed well past the 11:00 AM check-out time, close to noon, which disrupted our schedule. This situation may have influenced how you perceived our attitude.

We respect that not every place suits every traveler, but we believe it’s important to correct the record and provide accurate information for future guests.

reviews.name: Ban Sai
reviews.text: We really liked this place. The reception staff were very helpful and it was always clean, especially the big guy who cleans regularly. The gym downstairs is well-equipped and clean. The rooms are a suitable size for one person to sleep in Nora's 10 am yoga class was excellent. I loved it here and will definitely come back.

reviews.name: Carina Roca
reviews.text:
My expectations were very high because of the reviews, but in reality my experience was quite average.

Bad:
I don’t really understand why the ratings are so high. The hostel feels quite old.
The dorm rooms have no sunlight and feel a bit like a bunker.
The bathrooms inside the rooms look quite harsh, almost like a prison.
Cleaning seems to consist mostly of spraying air freshener. One day I was still sleeping and they sprayed it directly inside the curtains of my bed, and the smell was very strong.
The bedsheets are dark blue, which doesn’t really give a feeling of cleanliness.
The atmosphere sometimes feels a bit like a low-budget school trip.
There were spider webs in the common areas that looked like they had been there for a long time because they were already dusty.
There were also spider webs in the showers on the main floor.
During my whole 10-day stay, the same dead mosquito stayed on the shower wall, which made me question how often they clean.
The gym was disappointing — it’s very small. It’s okay for stretching, but there’s almost nothing if you want to properly work out. There’s also no air conditioning, which makes it hard to use in the summer.
The yoga cancellation policy is strict and made me feel a bit stressed.

Good:
I met some nice people during my stay.
They offer yoga classes, which are okay (although they can get quite busy).
There is a gym area where you can stretch or do light exercise.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
First of all, thank you for taking the time to leave a review. I am actually glad you shared your thoughts here because it gives me the opportunity to clarify some of the questions and concerns you mentioned. 

The reason our reviews are generally very high may be because many of our guests appreciate the effort and care we put into our service. When guests notice any issue during their stay, they usually inform us immediately so we can fix it right away rather than waiting weeks or months to mention it in a review. Your experience with us may have felt average to you, but many other guests have had very positive experiences here, which is why our ratings remain high. 

Regarding the points you mentioned: 

The dorm rooms were intentionally designed to be darker so guests can truly rest without sunlight disturbing them. As you know, the dorm rooms are shared with 6–7 other people, and everyone has different sleeping schedules. For this reason, every bed has its own personal light. Also, during your stay you covered most sides of your bed with your towel, which may have made the space feel more closed than it actually is. 

The bathrooms were designed to accommodate usage for around 30–40 guests. If the design made you feel uncomfortable, we sincerely apologize that it did not meet your expectations. 

Regarding the cleaning and the air freshener, we sometimes use it because some long-stay guests may not manage their clothing properly, which can occasionally create unpleasant smells in the room. The time you mentioned about spray being used inside your curtain may be a misunderstanding. During your stay, the bed above you had 2–3 different guests, and we always spray that area when a new guest checks in if there is any smell. 

Our bedsheets are dark blue because some guests feel uncomfortable when they see small marks on white sheets, even though they are properly washed according to hotel standards. 

For the spider webs on the ceilings and walls, we sincerely apologize and appreciate you pointing this out. Our cleaning team has mostly focused on the walking areas, but after reading your review we will improve our cleaning routine to include ceilings and walls more carefully. 

However, I was a little surprised because you stayed with us for about 8 days. You knew me, and I knew you as well. If these things were bothering you, you could have told me directly and we would have been happy to address them. During your stay, we did assist you several times, including with your transfer bookings and even issues related to your credit card. 

Regarding the gym, it is a small gym, but it includes equipment such as a barbell, bench, bicycle, punching bag, and yoga mats. For guests who want a larger gym, there is another gym only about 3 minutes away from our hostel, or stretching on the beach is also a great option. 

Our air-conditioning schedule is clearly set from 17:00 to 10:00, and this is communicated to guests. During the daytime we prefer to encourage guests to go out, explore the island, and enjoy their time rather than stay in bed all day. 

The yoga class policy is simply a standard rule because many guests want to join the classes and they are free for our guests. We respect the class and want participants who follow the rules so everyone can enjoy it. Perhaps the class structure was not the best fit for you, and we noticed that you only joined a few sessions during your stay. 

Finally, although your review contains many criticisms and only a few positive lines, we still appreciate the feedback. Please don’t worry — I (Toby) and my family remember you well because we tried to help you more than many other guests during that time. 

We sincerely hope you find a place that suits your expectations better in the future. And if you still have any questions or concerns, you are always welcome to contact me on WhatsApp, just as you did during your stay.

reviews.name: chiara kolfin
reviews.text: i loved this hostel! the location was perfect, very close to the beach and places to eat and next to a supermarket. the staff was very kind and helpfull, especially since i forgot something  small there and they looked for it, plus offered to send it back!! the atmosphere in this hostel is great, very relaxed and a lovely common area and kitchen. they offer breakfast, toast with eggs, if that’s not your favourite, you can just put something in the fridge or go out to eat. i definitely recommend this hostel! one of my favourites yet

reviews.name: Maya Nordbye
reviews.text: I really liked the hostel and the staff was really friendly. The bike was really easy to drive and personally I really liked the design. It was no problem with the bike. I got much help from Toby that work at the hostel with the bike before and after. The vibe at the hostel was good and relaxing🥰

reviews.name: Thivi
reviews.text:
This hostel is fabulous by its very great location (near the beach) and by the decoration and the spacious place!
The hall is very big, with hammocks and sofas!
The kitchen space is also very nice for the breakfast!
The staff are very kind and very helpful! I rent a bike with them and booked some day trip for snorkeling.
It is one of the best hostel experiences I had!

reviews.name: Laura Kondraschow
reviews.text:
the hostel itself was okay, not really clean, but the motorbike rental at the hostel was awful. we rented some bikes and the receptionist gave us really old bikes. the mirrors were loose and you couldn’t use them while driving. the trunk didn’t open and close properly. also the battery died on one of the motorbikes. it wasn’t our fault the battery died; we turned off the lights and engine properly. we called the hostel for help and waited one hour until the receptionist came. however the receptionist charged us 400 baht even though it wasn’t our fault that the battery died. we explained the situation but he didn’t care that the battery dying was due to the motorbike! he just called us a liar and told us that it was our fault!! the receptionist was disrespectful and not understanding at all! furthermore he charged us 200 baht for gasoline although the tank was half full. before we paid 80 baht for a full tank of gasoline!! I would never rent a motorbike there again, let alone stay at this hostel.

addition:
We would like to clarify that our review was based on our personal experience at the time and was influenced by a misunderstanding.
After speaking with the receptionist, we were able to resolve the situation and appreciate the time and effort taken to assist us.
We did not intend to harm the reputation of the hostel or its staff.

reviews.name: Raynil Laxmidas
reviews.text:
One of the best hostels I’ve ever stayed at during my trip to Thailand, and definitely one of the best on Koh Lanta. The staff is incredibly friendly and goes out of their way to learn your name and get to know you personally. They’re also very helpful.

I rented a moped with the hostel, and Toby, one of the staff members, even gave me a helpful 300-bhat lesson as a beginner. The hostel is incredibly social without being a full party hostel, which is facilitated by events like their Christmas Party and daily breakfasts. I personally made some really good friends here, and it made Koh Lanta a very special place for me. They also have daily yoga, but the spot fills up quickly, so book sessions early in your stay.

The only room for improvement is the bathrooms in the rooms. They could use a bit more bench space to organize your toiletries when using them, so your things don’t get wet.

reviews.name: Mia Toth
reviews.text: Non La Mer - one of the best hostels I’ve ever stayed. It has absolutely everything you need, my boyfriend and I stayed for 1 week total, it rained most of our time on Lanta unfortunately but the hostel was the perfect place to unwind, chill out and exercise. Free gym and yoga and breakfast, amazing hang out area with hammocks to chill in or socialise with other guests. Not a party hostel, great security, very cute and friendly cats, comfortable beds, clean amenities. All the staff were so friendly and welcoming and really made us feel like it was our home. Will definitely be back!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi Mia
Thank you so much for your wonderful review! 🌸 We’re so happy to hear that you and your boyfriend enjoyed your stay at Non La Mer, even with the rainy weather. It’s great to know that you loved the yoga, gym, breakfast, and our hangout areas—and of course, our friendly cats!

We really appreciate your kind words about our team. It means a lot to us to hear that you felt at home here. We can’t wait to welcome you back to Non La Mer on your next visit to Lanta!

Warm regards,

We really appreciate your kind words about our team. It means a lot to us to hear that you felt at home here. We can’t wait to welcome you back to Non La Mer on your next visit to Lanta!

reviews.name: Irina Hr
reviews.text:
Very poor cleanliness, shoes/flip-flops are not allowed inside but the floor is so dirty that your feet turn black in 5 min. I didn't see them swipe it even once during 3 days.
The room was cramped, barely any space to leave your backpack and no daylight. Room's bathroom was never cleaned and it's floor was covered in dirt.
Staff very unfriendly. Supposedly the breakfast is free, but you need to chase them to make it for you.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much for your review. We would like to clarify a few points to avoid any misunderstanding. First, regarding Asian culture: we do not wear shoes inside the house. However, if you noticed, our staff wear indoor slippers only. About room cleanliness, we change bed sheets and pillowcases once a day for new guests, between 11:00 a.m. and 1:00 p.m. If any guest requests additional cleaning, they are always welcome to inform the reception, and we are happy to assist. During your stay, as we remember, after breakfast you usually went out for the entire day and returned at night to sleep. We are therefore unsure how the infection you mentioned could have occurred. At the same time, another guest stayed in the same room and did not become ill, and they also left us a positive review. Regarding the room space, we provide a locker, a table, and sufficient facilities. If the space felt limited, it may depend on how personal belongings are arranged. Most of our guests use the room mainly for resting during the day or night. Each bed is also equipped with its own reading lamp. For breakfast, we prepare food fresh and do not pre-cook large quantities in order to avoid food waste. Finally, regarding your comment that “the staff were very unfriendly,” we felt this may have been due to the situation with the lower bed request. As explained at check-in, bed availability depends on current occupancy, and we had to communicate through your partner at that time. Upon check-out, the room key was thrown toward our staff, which was also confirmed by CCTV footage. That is why I (Toby) clearly remember this incident. We regret that your experience did not meet your expectations. While we strive to provide fair and consistent service to all guests, we understand that our property may not be the right fit for everyone. We wish you all the best in the future. After reviewing your past feedback on other properties, we believe that staying in a private accommodation with full personal control over the environment may better suit your expectations.

reviews.name: CR
reviews.text:
Missleading reviews. For the ones that find Google maps useful I need to add a more razonable view.
-location: noise hostel just located at a road of many cars and motorcycles. To go to the beach you need to cross this street.
-the beca is not as good as expected. Big waves and not good enough

Apart from that, the hostel is beautiful inside and the team are very very welcoming. Unfortunately the rooms are tiny and they make money with people comfort. Not only that, there is a video-cámara pointing out, It is important people know this in advance. In many places thus is illegal.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you very much for your feedback.

Regarding the CCTV, it is installed purely for the safety and security of our guests, as we have experienced incidents in the past. However, we truly appreciate your suggestion, and we will review this matter carefully with our team.

As for the beach conditions, the strong waves were due to the recent storm, which affected many areas on the island. During normal seasons, Koh Lanta’s beaches are calm, beautiful, and very peaceful.

Thank you again for sharing your thoughts, and we hope to welcome you back in better conditions.

reviews.name: Ciaran Cooke
reviews.text:
Great stay at this hostel in low season. The staff are very friendly and after drinking with them one night, they offered to make us a complimentary meal! They sorted out transfers for our next stop and also was able to rent bikes very easily.
The common area is very comfortable with beanbags, hammocks, benches and tables, as well as plenty of games to keep yourself entertained.
Toby, one of the staff was speaking to us about improvents they plan on making to the hostel, so we will definitely be returning in the future!

reviews.name: Woranat SDB
reviews.text: I recently stayed at Nonlamerhostel for two nights and had a fantastic experience. The location is ideal, situated close to key attractions and public transport, makiThe atmosphere was welcoming and vibrant, perfect for meeting fellow travelers. The common areas were well-maintained, and the staff were incredibly friendly and helpful, providing great recommendations for local activities. My room was clean and comfortable, with ample space and good facilities. The hostel also offered a delicious breakfast, which was a great way to start the day

reviews.name: Jeremiah
reviews.text: The 2 hour class was wonderful. It focused on the thyroid gland/ throat chakra. The yoga teacher was patient and super knowledgeable about proper technique with asanas and pranayamas. There was sound healing also given by her. Her English good and she accommodates for everyone, paying attention to everyone’s development. Many thanks, Namaste 🧘🏽‍♂️💗🎼

reviews.name: Eric Hansen
reviews.text: Good yoga instructor and class. Very detailed and precise on postures and positioning. Always keeping focus on moving with our breath. Offered more challenging progressions in many postures. Nice studio with cool wind coming in from outside, made the temperature pleasant. The outside noise from the open windows made it challenging to hear the instructions during the session. I had to keep eye contact with the instructor to follow the flow.

reviews.name: Kateryna P
reviews.text:
Best yoga class in Phuket and even in all my life .
In this yoga studio, each student receives an incredible amount of attention and individual approach. This is a yoga class from the soul and from the heart and carries the true teachings of yoga. Our classes could last even longer than the specified time because the teacher saw the need for this. I will definitely come back again when I come to Phuket. Forever in my heart.❤️🙏

reviews.name: Barbara Stella
reviews.text: Best place to practice yoga in Patong. The teachers are beautiful lovely souls. They pay so much attention to the details and really support and looking after you. Spent wonderful 10 days with them. Really grateful ☺️

reviews.name: Will Barry
reviews.text:
Excellent 90 minute Gentle Flow yoga for beginners. I was on holiday and wanted a one off class to jump into to keep moving. The price was definitely worth it.

I'm not a beginner but I'm not used to practicing in Thai heat and wanted to take it slow!

Studio was super clean and men's changing room had a shower with small lockers.

I'd definitely go again if I was in Patong.

reviews.name: ΚΑΤΕΡΙΝΑ ΝΑΣΗ
reviews.text: I recently visited this excellent yoga studio with a beautifully designed, peaceful atmosphere. The lessons were impressive, led by an experienced and welcoming instructor, making for a refreshing experience. Worth visiting this place!

reviews.name: Tom McDonough
reviews.text: I have practiced yoga in many many studios. This is my favorite. Authentic. The owner is a lovely soul and was there for every class. The instructors (including owner) were fantastic. Felt like home. Highly recommend.

reviews.name: Jayde McArthur
reviews.text:
I just did the detox class, I’m very new at yoga and I felt comfortable and welcomed into this studio, the instructor was so kind and amazing at what she does.
Thankyou for this experience I highly recommend this studio for anyone in Phuket wanting to move their body

reviews.name: Heather Dial
reviews.text: What a beautiful place. I wish I could take the studio home with me. I did a class where aromatherapy was used in conjunction with the poses. It was perfect and the class was small so I had one on one attention. If you are in patong and yoga is your thing, you have to go.

reviews.name: Gary Boyle
reviews.text: I had a fantastic practice at Anantra yoga.Be prepared for a good workout.Cindy and Nang paid much attention to detail.Exactly what you would expect from a yoga of high quality.I highly recommend Anantra yoga.The studio is a great piece of paradise away from the crowds of Patong.

reviews.name: Mike Davis
reviews.text: I had the pleasure of visiting this yoga studio on holiday in Phuket. Super friendly, amazing classes and great teacher. Her son is very cute too.

reviews.name: Elizabeth
reviews.text: This was me favourite yoga class I’ve done whilst travelling in SE Asia. Such care and attention put into adjustments. Thank you!

reviews.name: Tal Nahman
reviews.text: Dropped in for one class, great place and instructor. Fair price, classes are 90 minutes and totally worth it.

reviews.name: Martin Dominik Wildhaber

reviews.text: 삶에 무기력함을 느낄때,잠도 안오고 너무 힘들다고 느낄때 꼭 한번 해보세요~ 이걸 해내면 못해낼게 없을겁니다.살면서 했던 모든 운동중 가장 힘들었어요.수업전 물이나 밥을 절대 먹으면 안됩니다.1시간 15분 운동시간이라고 했는데 2시간수업했어요.마지막동작이라는 말만 20번은 한것 같아요.덕분에 꿀잠잤어요.얼굴.몸의 붓기도 쫙 빠졌어요~다시 도전하기에 조금 무섭지만 한번씩 할만해요~
reviews.textTranslated: When you feel powerless in life, can't sleep, and feel overwhelmed, definitely try this! If you can do this, there's nothing you can't do. It was the hardest exercise I've ever done. You can't eat or drink before class. They said it would be 1 hour and 15 minutes, but it lasted 2 hours. I think I said "this is the last movement" at least 20 times. Thanks to this, I slept like a log. The swelling in my face and body has gone down a lot. It's a little scary to try again, but it's worth doing once in a while.

reviews.name: achour melraz
reviews.text: Premier cours de yoga pour moi, exaltant, un vrai bonheur de 1h30 avec un bon équilibre entre spiritualité et exercice physique, j’en sort très heureuse et en paix ❤️ merci pour l’attention de la professeure.
reviews.textTranslated: My first yoga class was exhilarating, a real 1.5-hour delight with a good balance between spirituality and physical exercise. I left feeling very happy and at peace ❤️ Thank you to the teacher for her attention.

reviews.name: Melanie Kelm
reviews.text: Wir haben Ball Yoga gemacht, was herausfordernd war aber sehr viel Spaß gemacht hat! Die Lehrerin bot immer Alternativen für die Übungen an, was als Beginnerin super war! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
reviews.textTranslated: We did ball yoga, which was challenging but a lot of fun! The instructor always offered alternatives for the exercises, which was great for beginners! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

reviews.name: Carina F.
reviews.text: Kann ich nur empfehlen wenn man im Urlaub Yoga machen möchte. Super Lehrerin und schweißtreibende Stunde. Top!
reviews.textTranslated: I highly recommend this if you want to do yoga on vacation. The teacher is fantastic, and the class is a real workout. Excellent!

reviews.name: Jordan Hebert
reviews.text: Professionnel, excellent pour enseigner merci ça m'a vraiment apporté beaucoup de bien!
reviews.textTranslated: Professional, excellent for teaching, thank you, it really helped me a lot!

title: Castaway Yoga
ownerDescription:
Castaway Yoga Koh Lipe sessions consist of warm-up exercises, surya namaskar (sun salutations), holding asanas (poses) for 5 breaths or more, shavasana (corpse pose) for at least 10 minutes, with verbal instructions to relax each body part (from feet to head), followed by a period of time in which you will experience quietness and relaxation.

Classes are taught in English and class size ranges from 2-21 people.

Mats and blocks are provided.
