reviews.name: Sirirat Intahnai
reviews.text:
I create and teach Hatha Yoga by adapting each posture to the individual body of the practitioner. My teaching focuses on mindful movement and breath awareness, allowing students to practice safely without force or pressure. I guide each person to improve their practice naturally, respecting their body’s limitations and avoiding injury through gentle adjustments and conscious breathing.

Kimju 🧘‍♀️

reviews.name: Giuseppe Parrinello
reviews.text:
I took a yoga class at Castaway, and it was honestly one of the best yoga classes I’ve ever experienced. The instructor, Kimju, really took her time and paid close attention to what my body could handle. She introduced many new poses and challenged me in a way that felt safe, thoughtful and empowering.

Kimju is incredibly passionate and clearly knows exactly what she’s doing. Her explanations were clear, detailed, and easy to follow. Whenever a pose didn’t work for me, she would come over to correct it and offer genuine support. I felt truly seen and guided throughout the entire class.

An unforgettable yoga experience with the best instructor and beautiful view! Highly recommended.

reviews.name: Aina Ask
reviews.text: I practiced yoga with Kimju every morning at 7  for 12 days and I was so happy to join her classes. I bought a package for 1,000 THB and joined three sessions, it was very affordable. Practicing yoga while looking out at the ocean view felt amazing. I really enjoyed my time practicing with her

reviews.name: Lamiaa Abraro
reviews.text: I recently practiced yoga with Kimju and absolutely loved it. She is a wonderful teacher. I especially appreciated the technical tips she gave me during class. Those little adjustments helped me enter the poses more safely and stretch a bit deeper without forcing anything ❣️🙏🧘 Namaste 🙏

reviews.name: Eva Pasquini
reviews.text:
Kimju is absolutely amazing! Her sequences flow beautifully, smooth and just the right amount of challenge. Every session feels balanced and uplifting.
Morning practice is my favorite, the gentle sea breeze and the stunning ocean view create the perfect atmosphere to breathe deeply and start the day with a clear, refreshed mind

If you’re staying at Castaway Resort, joining Kimju’s yoga class is an absolute must

reviews.name: Cecilia Hughes
reviews.text: I couldn’t recommend Kimju’s yoga classes at the Cast Away resort more. Held in the most beautiful location under a wooden canapé with the breeze blowing, Kim’s teaching was excellent. Perfectly tailored to one’s capabilities and clearly demonstrated she had kind positive energy and was very skilled. Thank you Kim we hope to be back one day!

reviews.name: Sarah English
reviews.text:
My sister and I came to 4 yoga sessions at Castaway, and we both agreed they were amazing.
The instructor, Kimju, was friendly, welcoming and very knowledgeable. She took her time to vary classes, paid close attention to what we were doing and made important adjustments in the most incredible way. We were challenged but also felt safely guided.
Kimju is passionate. You could see her commitment and hear her instructions clearly and they were very easy to follow. I loved that she counted down the amount of time in each hold.
She offered alternatives where necessary and encouraged ourselves to reach our potential.

If I could I’d go every day. I wish she was in London! The yoga area was wonderful and had a great view to boot ! Highly recommended.

reviews.name: Nela Nelchen
reviews.text: The 7 am yoga class is wonderful. The atmosphere is amazing, right by the sea with the sound of waves that makes the practice even more relaxing and grounding. The teaching is great, easy to follow, and suitable for both beginners and experienced practitioners.

reviews.name: Sofie Kampmann
reviews.text:
I stayed at Castaway and had to try the yoga class, which can be pre-booked at the reception for only 400baht per session or 1000baht for three sessions

It was the best yoga I’ve tried in my life!! I’ve tried many yoga classes classes, but this was the best. I ended up joining sessions every day 😍
If you are into Hatha yoga then Kimju will be the best yoga instructor you have ever tried ❤️ She is so professional, kind and very good at teaching yoga stances ☺️ she reads the class to see the level of experience and make the programme personal ❤️
When I joined, people came from other hotels as well, due to the good yoga classes.

The yoga class is held at a terrasse and mats and blocks are of course available. A maximum of 10 people can join the classes, but when I joined it got so popular that more people joined and there was space for all of us ☺️

reviews.name: เกตุกัลยา ปิจดี
reviews.text: Thank you, Kimju, for such a great yoga class. Your teaching is clear and easy to follow. The poses are challenging but not too difficult, which makes the practice enjoyable and helps us improve. I really enjoyed the class. 🧘‍♀️

reviews.name: Beautiful
reviews.text: It was amazing and that I learned so much from her class. I practiced yoga with her every day, and it felt so good to wake up and start my morning yoga 🙌🧘💯

reviews.name: Koran
reviews.text: If you’re staying at Castaway Resort and want to begin your day feeling energized, connected, and inspired by nature, Kimju’s morning yoga class is an absolute must. It’s the kind of experience you’ll wish you could enjoy every morning

reviews.name: Kwok Tang
reviews.text: I’ve had a couple of lovely hatha style (restorative) yoga classes with Kimju. Suitable for beginners but not too easy either, so suitable for intermediate level yogis. Everybody is welcomed here, you don’t have to be a guest at the resort. I think classes are at 7am, 9am and 4:30pm everyday. Although 400 baht for 1 class may seem expensive, you can get 3 classes for 1000 baht which is much better value. As the yoga takes place close to the sea, there’s a lovely strong breeze to cool you down as you practice. Well worth going.

reviews.name: Luca Francini
reviews.text: Beatiful experience! The teacher was amazing, I really enjoyed the practice. If you come here, I suggest you to try it🥰

reviews.name: Jules
reviews.text: Kimju is a wonderful teacher - she was very attentive, her cues were clear and she was leading the flow adjusting for my body capabilities and it’s limitations. We had a wonderful class because she smiles with her whole body. Thank you Kimju for your energy and guidance.

reviews.name: milesjourneys
reviews.text:
Wonderful spot that offered me the best yoga session I ever joined.
The instructor was kind and helpful, and adapted the session to my skill level. I got to push myself while feeling comfortable and having fun.

Price was 400 THB but they also offer 3 sessions for 1000 THB.

reviews.name: Clara Färber
reviews.text: Came here for yoga three times and enjoyed it every time! The teacher Kim really pays attention to the participants and customizes the class accordingly.

reviews.name: Rita M
reviews.text: Pretty nice yoga in early morning. You have to book in advance 400bahts. As people are changing every day it can't be difficult positions. It's aligned to participants. The place is nice, in front of beach, quiet, nice view, thick mat.

reviews.name: Shannon R
reviews.text:
I only did one sunrise session, but it was not my favorite. Maybe she was having an off day, but her directions were confusing and the sequence didn't flow. Being near the beach is always nice, but the uneven floor boards make balance poses extra challenging and they need better sanitizing equipment for the mats.

Keiritas down the beach has a better shala, more experienced teacher, and real ashtanga and vinyasa principles, with plenty of variations for beginner or advanced practice. Same prices.

If you are just looking for a morning stretch one day and you are staying there, it's fine. If you are looking for real yoga, I'd head to keiritas.

reviews.name: Sapir Ben yosef
reviews.text: They confirmed our arrival for a couple, but when we got there, we were told there was no space for us. They didn’t even try to help. It was a very unpleasant experience. I do not recommend planning your day or wasting your morning on a place like this.

The class atmosphere was friendly and relaxed, suitable for both beginners and experienced practitioners. I felt relaxed and improved my body at the same time. It was fantastic! ♥️♥️

reviews.name: Melon Pinopi

reviews.textTranslated: I'm a full-time mom who gained a lot of weight and became quite flabby after childbirth. So I hired a private yoga instructor to teach me at home. My goal was to lose weight. The actual class time is one hour, but the instructor always goes over. She's very open and doesn't hold anything back. She teaches wholeheartedly, covering exactly what I want. I feel like I enjoy yoga because of her. It's not stressful; it's relaxed and easygoing, but it yields great results. I hope to be able to attend her studio when my child starts school.

a beautiful surprise just near the airport

her classes are basic and intermediate,  welcome to most of yogis and who travel around, you can simply drop in or buy a member card with different entrance time. Garden in front of the yoga room is lovely and inside the space you can find as well clothes, or books about yoga! reviews.name: Clementine
reviews.text:
This may be my favorite place on the planet!

Absolutely beautiful, peaceful, intentional space, with wonderful knowledgeable teachers. I have taken different styles of class with a range of teachers and they were all excellent!

I highly, highly recommend coming for a class here. Whether you are an absolute beginner or an experienced practitioner, here for a while or just a day! I have brought friends with me who just loved it too!

Stop in and feel the warmth, wisdom, and welcome of this very special place on the world! It is a balm for both body and soul.

reviews.text:
Was staying nearby for 10 years and wonder why I never come to Baan Yoga Studio.
Felt amazing & streghing the body. Good instructor. No need to bring a yoka mat. All are provided with good & clean.
Highly recommend!!

reviews.name: Chayanee P.
reviews.text:
“I used to hate Yoga before but this place is my life changing”

I love to be here, I feel calm and relax with all sessions. Especially,the sunset class. You will do yoga with vanilla sky sunset ❤️. The class is not that tight and the instructor is always focus on our problems (like me I have office syndrome) to make sure that our practice will be smooth and not injured ourselves.

Recently, I tried new mat pilates class, it was awesome. Surely, I’ll go again.

P.S. love watermelon on Saturday after the class. 🙌🏽🫶🏽

reviews.name: jacqueline mitrovic
reviews.text: Baan Yoga is a little Oasis in Naiyang Beach. In the morning I did a Hatha Yoga class which was the class I enjoyed most whilst I've been here (and I've done 19). We were treated to lemon water and fresh fruit, then next up was a sound bath which was beautiful & relaxing. There was a delicious lunch & mindful colouring along with a chance to chat with other participants. Then in the afternoon a 2 hour Yin Yoga workshop, themed on the 5 elements and focussing on liver and gall bladder meridians, which left me feeling stretched & relaxed. All in all a perfect day. I thoroughly recommend taking a class here if you get the chance.

reviews.name: Angel V
reviews.text:
I attended yoga 3-4 times a week for 6 months here and this is my honest feedback on this place.

I’d recommend to attend the classes here if your only intention of practicing yoga as a form of exercise or for stretching only. The teacher runs the place as a business instead.

I do not recommend attending any external guests classes run by this place as all the guests come here to use the regular students as a means to earn money. Having personally attended a few, most of the ‘spiritual/mediatation’ class run by external guests are usually hoax and I leave the sessions feeling uneasy.

The teacher may sell you her products in the name of awareness and mindfulness and market classes by external guests as both the centre and guests earn from each class.
What really bothered me is when I actually informed Onusa I was personally cheated by one of her guests Teachers, she did not even reply and went on to advertise more on the class with the individual. This shows the respect someone has for their students versus an opportunity to earn money during the peak season.

reviews.name: Betty Kelly
reviews.text: Was staying nearby and came here nearly every day for 1 week. I loved all of the classes and the way that she structured them, challenging but with lots of stretching incorporated. Felt amazing after each one! Highly recommend!!

reviews.name: Mari
reviews.text:
I love going to the Baan Yoga studio!
Teacher Taan shows a lot of posture modifications. Everyone chooses according to their strengths and capabilities. Very interesting, time flew by very quickly! Teacher Taan helps, approaches and corrects! Hatha Yoga is suitable for everyone. I feel very comfortable! I recommend!

reviewContext.Safety: Free room, lots of air! Mosquito nets, fans work. Windows to the floor! Beautiful garden outside the window! Large parking lot. There is a shower. All this is very convenient and safe!
reviewContext.Walkability: Nearby there are shops, a market and 7 minutes to the airport by car.
reviewContext.Noteworthy details: Every Saturday, after class, a treat from Baan Yoga for everyone. Tea, fresh fruit - it's great! And it’s also very interesting, there is a treat - juice made by the hands of teacher Taan! It's magical!

reviews.name: Martina K
reviews.text: A serene place. Even though the yoga shed is actually just a few steps away from the main road, it feels secluded, as if you were far in the jungle. The yoga flow was a challenge for me, especially in the hot Thai climate, but the teacher will make sure all levels are accommodated, you can use props and are welcome to modify your practice. Both Caroline, the teacher, and her place are awesome, highly recommended.

reviews.name: Tatjana Stolzenberg
reviews.text: Caroline gave such an amazing class today. It was like a mix between vinyasa and hatha yoga where you have a sun salutation but also have to hold poses. Stunning setting with birds chirping and trees moving with the wind. At first I was worried I would be too warm at a 9am class, but the breezed and fans kept me at perfect temperature. Left the place floating and was hoping I could go back before leaving Koh Lanta on Sunday, but no more classes until Monday. Definitely visit for a lovely class and experience.

reviews.name: Charlene Barber
reviews.text: Went to multiple classes and each class had variations, Caroline is a fantastic instructor! It really was one of the highlights of my stay in Koh Lanta. Beautiful, serene setting, perfect for yogis at all levels. No need to go anywhere else and reasonably priced!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Charlene, it was an absolute pleasure to share my practice with you.  Thank you so much for joining.  I hope to see you again one day! Enjoy your travels.

reviews.name: Andrea Rudlstorfer
reviews.text: Lanta Yoga is great! I went there five times while staying on the Island. It does not matter if you are a beginner or a pro. Caroline is a very friendly and open person who remembers all the names of the participants. I had injured my knee and could not do all the poses, but she always showed me alternative poses that I could do. Also the location is beautiful. Highly recommended! :)

reviews.name: Julia Buhagiar
reviews.text: Lovely visit to Lanta Yoga this morning. After all the travel, extensive walking, extensive sitting, Caroline provided a lovely vinyasa flow class adaptable to all levels. The pace was calming and challenging at the same time. The location was easy to find. It is open-air so be prepared to another yourself I'm bugspray and step on a few ants. My class was blessed with the sound of rain during savasana. Highly recommend!

The yoga sala is set in beautiful gardens with no distractions just nature and the odd butterfly fluttering by helping to focus on the mind and breath.  The classes have been a great help during these unsettling COVID times just to detach for 90 mins 🙏 Thanks Caroline xx

P.S.: To the participants: it's incredibly disruptive if you arrive late or leave (earlier) during Shavasana. Show some respect ;)

reviews.name: YogaMitViki
reviews.text: Ich habe hier insgesamt zweimal yoga praktiziert und fand die Stunden super. Die Atmosphäre ist der Hammer , ein offener Space im grünen . Die yoga Lehrerin sehr sympathisch und professionell. Die Stunde ist herausfordernd da die Asanas anfangs bevor es in den Flow geht länger gehalten werden. Aber sie bietet Optionen an die man sehr gut nutzen kann und die helfen langsam in den Flow zu kommen. Super Stunde. Kann ich empfehlen !
reviews.textTranslated: I've practiced yoga here twice and loved the classes. The atmosphere is fantastic, an open space surrounded by greenery. The yoga teacher is very friendly and professional. The class is challenging because the asanas are held for longer periods at the beginning before the flow starts. But she offers options that are very useful and help you gradually get into the flow. Great class. I highly recommend it!

reviews.name: Melli
reviews.text:
Während meines 3-wöchigen Aufenthalts hier habe ich 6mal an den Yogaklassen teilgenommen, und ich freue mich jetzt schon auf's Wiederkommen im nächsten Jahr. Caroline macht einen sehr guten und qualitativ hochwertigen Unterricht, bietet immer Optionen für mehr oder weniger Anspruch/Können an. Durch ihre immer sehr freundliche und ruhige Art bringt sie immer eine gute und ausgeglichene Energie in die Klasse.
Der Platz ist zudem sehr schön, ruhig und inmitten von Natur gelegen. Last but not least: der Preis von 300THB ist mehr als fair, und im Gegensatz zu einer teureren Adresse hier, bei der ich 500THB für 60min. bezahlt habe, mehr als gerechtfertigt  Danke & Namaste!
reviews.textTranslated:
During my three-week stay here, I participated in six yoga classes, and I'm already looking forward to coming back next year. Caroline teaches excellent, high-quality classes, always offering options for different levels of experience. Her consistently friendly and calm demeanor always brings a positive and balanced energy to the class.

The studio is also beautiful, peaceful, and surrounded by nature. Last but not least, the price of 300 THB is more than fair and, compared to a more expensive studio in the area where I paid 500 THB for 60 minutes, more than justified. Thank you & Namaste!

reviews.text: I absolutely love Kitty’s home Pilates studio! The space is beautiful, clean, and very welcoming — it instantly makes you feel comfortable. reviews.name: Mint Tanatkorn
reviews.text:
I recently had the chance to take Pilates classes at this studio, and I honestly couldn’t be happier with the experience.

From the moment you walk in, the atmosphere feels warm, clean, and welcoming. The studio is beautifully designed, well-maintained, and fully equipped with quality machines. It’s a space that immediately makes you feel comfortable and motivated to move your body.

What truly stands out is the female trainer. She is incredibly professional, knowledgeable, and attentive. She takes the time to understand your body, your goals, and your limitations. During each session, she carefully corrects posture and alignment, making sure every movement is done safely and effectively. You can really feel the difference after just a few sessions — stronger core, better posture, and improved flexibility.

I also appreciate how encouraging and supportive she is. She creates a positive, non-intimidating environment where you feel confident, whether you’re a beginner or more advanced.

If you’re looking for a Pilates studio that focuses on quality, personal attention, and real results, I highly recommend this place. It’s absolutely worth trying, and I’m so glad I found it. 🩵

reviews.name: אחינועם חוגים
reviews.text:
The perfect place to start your day. A pleasant atmosphere — it feels like doing yoga in the middle of the sea.
Benni is an excellent teacher, always attentive and precise. She knows how to accommodate different levels in the class and give each person exactly what they need.
There’s also an ice bath and a sauna on weekends.
Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Lalaloo Kaali
reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Wow wow wow—what a magical place!

Yoga Love at Panwa Beach is truly something out of a fairy tale. The location is breathtaking—right on the oceanfront, with soft sand and the most beautiful views. It’s not just the setting though; it’s the heart behind it. The family who runs this wellness center radiates love, compassion, and genuine care. You can feel that they are here to support your healing journey, or simply to guide you if you’re exploring a new adventure.

Their offerings are incredible: free diving, ice-cold plunge, sauna, yoga, meditation, sound healing—everything you could want for body, mind, and spirit renewal. On top of that, they even have accommodations on site, so you can fully immerse yourself in the experience without having to go anywhere else.

Whether you’re seeking deep transformation or just a peaceful reset by the sea, I highly recommend Yoga Love. It’s not just a wellness center—it’s a sanctuary by the beach where you feel held, loved, and inspired. 🌊✨🙏

reviews.name: Tati & Max
reviews.text:
What a lovely way to start the day!

We enjoyed an incredible power yoga practice followed by an ice bath and steam session.

The instructor created a very thoughtful practice with sound bowls to open and close the experience.

Additionally, the space is absolutely beautiful with the ocean, trees, grass and cute animals all surrounding you while you breathe and move.

Definitely recommend while you’re in this area!

reviews.name: daiwe 131
reviews.text:
I had a truly beautiful experience at Yoga Love studio . I joined a Hatha and Vinyasa class with teacher Ben, and I loved everything about it. Her teaching style is calm, clear, and deeply grounding — perfect for both beginners and those with more experience.

The studio itself is peaceful and quiet, located right by the sea, so you can hear the sound of the waves during your practice. It creates the perfect atmosphere to connect with yourself and be present in the moment.

I’m so grateful for the session and want to say a big thank you to teacher Ben. If you’re thinking about joining this yoga studio — just try it, just start. You will fall in love with the space, the energy, and teacher Ben’s technique. Highly recommended!

อีกอย่างที่ชอบมากคือสามารถลงไปว่ายน้ำทะเลได้ตลอด บรรยากาศดีมาก ได้ทั้งเรียน ได้พัก ได้อยู่กับธรรมชาติอย่างเต็มที่ ทำให้ประสบการณ์การเรียนที่นี่พิเศษมากขึ้นไปอีก

ตลอด 200 ชั่วโมงของการเรียนที่นี่ ป๊อบรู้สึกดีและมีความสุขมากกับการตัดสินใจเลือกมาเรียนที่นี่จริง ๆ ได้ทั้งความรู้ ประสบการณ์ และการเติบโตทั้งในด้านร่างกายและจิตใจ

ที่สำคัญ ครูเบนและครูป๊อบสอนดีมาก ให้ความรู้แน่นมาก อธิบายละเอียด เข้าใจง่าย และถ่ายทอดประสบการณ์ได้อย่างเต็มที่ ทำให้การเรียนเข้มข้นแต่ก็สนุกและน่าประทับใจมากค่ะ เป็นอีกหนึ่งสถานที่ที่ป๊อบอยากแนะนำมากสำหรับคนที่กำลังมองหาที่เรียนโยคะดี ๆ ในบรรยากาศสงบ อบอุ่น และเต็มไปด้วยพลังงานที่ดี 🤍🥰
reviews.textTranslated:
Pop was very impressed with her experience completing the 200-hour Yoga Teacher Training here. The atmosphere and location were very peaceful, surrounded by nature and green spaces, making her feel relaxed and at ease – perfect for practicing yoga. Throughout her time here, Pop felt positive energy and tranquility every day.

Another thing she loved was being able to swim in the sea anytime. The atmosphere was amazing. She could learn, relax, and fully connect with nature, making the experience even more special.

Throughout the 200 hours of training here, Pop feels very good and happy with her decision to choose to study here. She gained knowledge, experience, and growth both physically and mentally.

Most importantly, Teacher Ben and Teacher Pop were excellent teachers. They provided solid knowledge, explained things in detail, made it easy to understand, and shared their experience fully. This made the learning intensive yet fun and very memorable. It's another place Pop would highly recommend for anyone looking for a great yoga studio in a calm, warm, and positive atmosphere. 🤍🥰

#anongpilates #พิลาทิส #pilates #พิลาทิสถนนจันทน์ #pilatesstudio #ทนายสายสปา
reviews.textTranslated:
Suddenly, I'm bored with my old habits and I'm into doing acrobatics and flips.

The story is, I used to have neck, shoulder, and back pain – office syndrome – that even frequent massages wouldn't help.
Then a follower commented and suggested I try exercising.

So… once I tried Pilates, I became completely hooked, like crazy! If I don't go to a Pilates reformer session one day, it feels like I'm going to die!! I have to admit, Pilates has saved me a lot on massages. Now I only get massages for relaxation because I haven't had any pain in a long time, and my life is so much happier.

I've been doing it every day for almost half a year now, and I'm starting to want to hang upside down to get that blood rush to my face, so I can take my face on a time machine and fight gravity like everyone else.

So I signed up for a private Pilates class with Instructor Nong at Anong Pilates, a new studio near Sathorn. Instructor Nong is amazing, with 13 years of teaching experience and a Certified Balanced Body from the US!

Instructor Nong teaches in incredible detail, delving into anatomical terminology. The workout time was amazing! So intense and worth every minute. They teach Reformer, Cadillac, Chair, and Blader Barrel exercises. It was so much fun! With so much equipment, I didn't want the hour to end.

Anyway, the equipment is top-notch!! They use brand-name machines; a reformer alone costs over 200,000 baht… just knowing the price instantly gave me the motivation to work out!

Currently, they offer Private and Duet classes (for two people). Soon they'll have Group classes (for three people) too.

📌 Anong Pilates
Located in Vanilla Moon Project (2nd floor), Chan Road
Free parking for 3 hours

reviews.name: Riya Dhariwal
reviews.text:
Diving at Carabao was the highlight of my whole Thailand trip. Absolutely loved our experience. It also wouldn't have been possible without Marco and Camilla, our dive instructors!! They were both professional and funny and curbed any anxiety I had in the beginning. I also appreciated how thorough they were and how easy it was to ask questions.

The rooms were great and clean. The restaurant food was delicious and reasonably priced. The resort dogs were also a highlight! All super cute

Definitely recommend Carabao Dive Resort and Marco and Camilla as your dive instructors :)
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much, Riya! 💙 Reading that diving with us was the highlight of your Thailand trip truly means the world to us. We're so happy that Marco and Camilla helped make you feel comfortable and confident from the very beginning. We'll be sure to share your kind words with them! We're also glad you enjoyed your room, the restaurant, and of course our resort dogs—they'll always be here to welcome you back! 🐶🐠 We hope to see you both again for more underwater adventures at Carabao Diving Koh Tao. Safe travels and happy diving! 🌴😊

reviews.text: What an amazing place to dive and then extremely cheap, quality accomodation. Me and my Dad booked  the 3 day open water course. For this we were given Sophia as our instructor. She made our dives truly memorable, kind, supportive and informative throught. A very skilled and well rounded woman we truly appreciated her immende knowldge which was clearly reflected underwater. Woukd truly love to come back someday and continue my training. Thank you Sophia and the whole Carabao Team!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much! 🙏 Sophia will be so happy to read this — I'll make sure she sees it. Doing the Open Water together with your Dad is something pretty special, and it sounds like you both got a lot out of those three days. Glad the accommodation worked well too — having the rooms right here at the resort means you can roll out of bed and be on the boat, which makes the course a lot easier. The door's always open when you're ready for the Advanced! 🤿 Matteo – Carabao Diving Koh Tao

reviews.name: biffh123
reviews.text: Stayed here with my partner for 3 nights to do the open water diving course & a refresher for him. I didn’t complete the course due to my own issues but my partner continued to go out and dive with the group and I was allowed to come and just chill on the boat which was lovely. Matteo the manager was really understanding and incredibly friendly and approachable and made our stay very memorable.||||The rooms are very simple but it’s to be expected with the price as the rooms are very much hostel style. Lots of backpackers come and go so great to meet new people. Our room had a balcony with a beautiful sea view and a clothes rail to hang wet clothes.||||We had burgers twice at the adjoining restaurant, mine was a vegetarian burger which I was pretty impressed with as it was a homemade bean burger - very tasty.||||Some other great places to eat & drink locally too, a really nice community vibe.||||Overall we had an amazing time! We were very sad to be leaving. The diving course package is great value for money, there’s a very friendly atmosphere here and in a beautiful location. Thank you!

reviews.name: Daniel Novotný
reviews.text: Diving with Carabao was an amazing experience! Our guide Niki made sure that everyone felt comfortable and I really appreciated that we were diving with small groups only. I had 4 dives with her and all the dive sites are really beautiful. It was also convenient that their boat docks right near there center so it was no big hustle to get on it to leave to the dive site. They had some coffee, tea and snacks on board which of course makes the breaks between dives wa more enjoyable. It is also convenient if you're not a local that you can simply pay by Revolut transfer which I appreciated.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much, Daniel! 💙 We're delighted you had such a great experience diving with us. It’s wonderful to hear that you enjoyed our small groups, beautiful dive sites, and the relaxed atmosphere on the boat. We'll be sure to pass your kind words on to Niki—she'll be thrilled to hear them! 😊 Thank you as well for mentioning the convenient boat access and payment options. We hope to welcome you back to Carabao Diving Koh Tao for many more unforgettable dives. Safe travels and see you again soon! 🐠🌴🤿

reviews.name: R Brassey
reviews.text:
Stayed here and completed my open water course.

The diving side of things was excellent. Anna, Clara, and in particular Yannick, were great, and the theory was taught well. My mistakes when diving were always corrected gently, and the small group size was ideal. The gear was also good quality.

The location is fine, with easy access to various restaurants, 7/11 and other shops and services. Carabao Dive Resort is also located right by the beach, and has a swimming pool and various comfortable places to relax, though common areas are not amazing for meeting people.

The room was clean and the temperature inside was adequate. However, privacy was notably absent, even when compared to other dorms. The privacy curtain only covered 1 side of the bed, with the other 3 sides exposed. And if someone turned on the bedside lamp, the light would reach all neighboring beds.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for taking the time to share such a detailed review.
We're delighted to hear that you enjoyed your Open Water course and that Yannick, Anna, and Clara helped make it a great experience. We'll be sure to pass on your kind words to them—they'll really appreciate it!
We also appreciate your honest feedback about the dormitory. We understand your concerns regarding privacy, and comments like yours are very valuable as they help us identify areas where we can improve the guest experience. We'll definitely take your suggestions into consideration for future upgrades.
It was a pleasure having you stay and dive with us, and we hope to welcome you back to Carabao Diving Koh Tao for more underwater adventures in the future. Safe travels! 🌊🤿

reviews.name: Hallie
reviews.text:
We stayed here for a few nights but ultimately decided to check out early. The staff were very kind and helpful throughout our stay.

Unfortunately, the room wasn’t for us. The bathroom had a strong musty smell and visible mold, and we felt it may have been affecting how we felt. We were able to switch from the larger round-bed room to another private room, which had a more comfortable bed, although it was still quite firm. The A/C and fan worked well together and kept the room cool.

The diving, however, was excellent. We did several fun dives with Ilahn and Camilla, who were both fantastic—professional, fun, and made the experience memorable. They even took and shared some great photos and videos with us afterward.

We’d recommend the dive center, but the accommodation could use some improvements.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for taking the time to write this, and I'm sorry the room let you down. The bathroom issue you describe isn't acceptable and I've taken that room out of service to deal with the damp properly — Chalok gets very humid this time of year and it's on us to stay ahead of it, not to wait for a guest to point it out. Thank you also for flagging the mattress; I'm reviewing those across the rooms. On the diving side, I'm really glad Ilahn and Camilla gave you such a good experience — they'll be pleased to hear it, and sharing photos afterwards is very much their style. I'd genuinely like the chance to host you properly if you're ever back on Koh Tao. Matteo – Carabao Diving Koh Tao

reviews.name: Hans Dampf
reviews.text:
I had an amazing diving experience today with Carabao Divers and can highly recommend them!

Everything was well organized from the start. Professional, but still relaxed and easygoing. The equipment was in good condition and the dive sites we visited (Southwest & Shark island) were absolutely beautiful.

A special thanks to my instructor Ilahn. He is patient and knowledgeable. I felt safe at all times and still had a lot of fun underwater. His relaxed and supportive approach really made this dive a highlight.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi Hans,
Thank you so much for your kind words, we really appreciate you taking the time to share your experience with us!
We’re very happy to hear you enjoyed the dives at Southwest and Shark Island — two of our favorite sites here on Koh Tao as well 🙌
A big thank you also for mentioning Ilahn. He’ll be super happy to read this! Creating a safe, relaxed and fun environment underwater is exactly what we aim for, so it’s great to know you felt that throughout the dives.
We hope to see you again soon for more adventures under the surface!
All the best,
Matteo & the Carabao Diving Team 🌊

reviews.name: paula verdier
reviews.text:
I did my Open Water at Carabao and it was such a good experience overall.

The whole setup is great , the classes were clear and easy to follow, and everything felt very professional but relaxed at the same time. Everyone there is super friendly and welcoming, which makes a big difference when you’re learning something new.

Loris was my instructor and honestly, he made all the difference. On the first day I had a bit of a panic because I was having trouble with my mask and I felt really overwhelmed. He stayed calm, talked me through it and helped me relax. I never felt judged or pressured. If it wasn’t for him, I’m not sure I would have continued. But thanks to his patience and support, I gained my confidence back and ended up really enjoying the whole course.

Also, the restaurant is great. Really good food and such a nice place to hang out after diving.

Very grateful for the experience. I would definitely recommend Carabao to anyone thinking about doing their course.

reviews.name: Amy Rozeboom
reviews.text: Caraboa was an amazing experience! I highly recommend for anyone wanting to get their open water certification. Our instructor Niki was incredible! She made the whole process feel safe and fun. Her presence was so calming and she was there for any worries or issues that happened. Caraboa was also a great place to stay, really enjoyed the location along the beach, the kind staff, and the evening games of volleyball :-) thanks for having us!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your wonderful review! 💙

We're delighted to hear that you had such a great experience with us. Niki will be especially happy to hear your kind words—creating a safe, relaxed, and enjoyable learning environment is exactly what we strive for.
It's also great to know you enjoyed both the diving and your stay at Carabao. From our beachfront location to our amazing team and those friendly volleyball evenings, we're glad you got to experience the full Carabao vibe! 🌴🏐🤿

Thank you for choosing us for your Open Water certification. We hope to welcome you back to Koh Tao soon for more dives and adventures underwater!

Safe travels and see you again soon! 🐠🌊
The Carabao Diving Team 🐃💙

reviews.name: Roope Kääriäinen
reviews.text:
We had pleasure of staying here for 4 nights. Cheap prices. Hotel staff was really friendly. Also restaurant staff was always smiling and helpful. Food was tasty and affordable. Rooms are pretty Basic and aircon a bit loud but for this price it was ok.

We went diving rwice with this school. Both dives were leaded by super friendly and professional instructors Bruno and Marco. They both made us very relaxed with their local knowledge and awesome attitude. We are really greatful for our time here.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much, Roope, for your thoughtful review! 💙 We're delighted that you and your family enjoyed your stay, our restaurant, and especially your diving experience with us. Bruno and Marco will be very happy to hear your kind words! We also appreciate your honest feedback about the room and air conditioning—it helps us continue improving. We hope to welcome you all back to Carabao Diving Koh Tao for another relaxing holiday and more amazing dives. Safe travels and see you again soon! 🐠🌴😊

reviews.name: Thomas Tiebach Gómez
reviews.text:
I spent the last 3 days completing my Open Water certification at Carabao Diving and had a great experience. My instructor, Marco, was excellent—very helpful, professional, and supportive throughout the course.

The diving was awesome, and the training was well structured and easy to follow. I also stayed in the private dorm, which was comfortable and had everything I needed, including good AC and clean bathrooms.

I can definitely recommend Carabao Diving, especially for anyone looking to learn or improve their diving skills.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your wonderful review, Thomas!
We're delighted to hear that you enjoyed your Open Water course with us and that Marco helped make your experience such a positive one. We'll be sure to pass on your kind words to him.
Congratulations on earning your SSI Open Water certification! We're also happy that you enjoyed both the diving and your stay at our resort 🙂🙏 
Thank you for choosing Carabao Diving, and we hope to welcome you back to Koh Tao for more adventures underwater in the future!
Safe travels and happy diving! 🌊🤿

– The Carabao Diving Team 🐃💙

reviews.name: Jayde Gauvin
reviews.text:
I went here this past week for my open water dining certification. First i’ll start by saying anyone looking to do a course this place had the best price on the island we could find and with accommodation included in a package. We were recommend here by two friends who took the course last year and I ca see why.
My boyfriend and I both took the course, we had Yannick as our instructor.

I can say he was an amazing instructor, in slight moments of anxiety he was very calming and helpful. We went into the water with full understanding of what we would be doing and what is expected of us. I always went under water at ease and assured. He brought us in great dives and helped us make great memories learning. On top of that he was also quite funny which kept things entertaining.

Thank you Yannick!!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi Jayde! 🐟🤟 

Thank you so much for this amazing review!

We’re really happy to hear that you and your boyfriend had such a great experience during your Open Water course with us. It means a lot that you chose us based on your friends’ recommendation — and even more that we lived up to it 😊

Yannick will be super happy to read your words! Creating a calm, supportive environment — especially in those first moments underwater — is so important, and it’s great to hear he made you feel comfortable, confident, and even had you laughing along the way.

We hope to see you both again soon for more dives and maybe the next step… Advanced? 😉

All the best,
Matteo & the Carabao Diving Team 🌊

reviews.name: Ed Dowling
reviews.text: I spent just over a week here doing my open water certificate and then decided to extend my stay as I loved the resort itself and wanted to do some fun dives. The course was brilliant and Marco made it engaging, safe and fun. The fun dive was also great thanks to Eduardo. I stayed in both the double room and dormitory. The double rooms are great with plenty of space and a nice balcony. The dormitory is basic but for the price you can't really complain! The restaurant is also brilliant and the pool is an added bonus. Really enjoyed my time here and has been the highlight of Koh Tao.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your amazing review! ❤️
We’re really happy to hear you decided to extend your stay with us — that’s always the best compliment we can get 😊
Marco and Eduardo will be very happy to read your words, we’re lucky to have such a great team making every experience safe, fun and memorable 🙌
It’s great that you got to experience both the private rooms and the dorm — and of course enjoy the restaurant and pool as well!
We’re really glad we could be the highlight of your time in Koh Tao 🌊🐠
Hope to see you again soon for more dives!
— Matteo & the Carabao Diving Team

reviews.name: Jarrah Lukjanov
reviews.text:
We are a family of five, 2 parents and 3 kids ages 9-14 from Australia 🇦🇺.

We came to Koh Tao to experience scuba diving but were not 100% sure what we were getting into and how it would all work.

We booked our stay at the Carabao Dive Resort which included a taxi pick up from the pier. We were warmly greeted by Mateo in the reception. We were able to book a whole family ‘try dive’ experience to complete during our stay.

Our teacher and guide was Marco, and we were also assisted by Clara and Juan on different dives.

We thoroughly enjoyed Marco’s teaching and guidance and particularly his attention to safely and detail. As a family diving with kids we felt confident to go out diving with Marco after our theory sessions as we knew we would be safe. We also appreciated the reminders of what to do whilst we were underwater diving when any of us were off track. Marco also kept the kids inline if they were getting distracted.

Marco was very friendly and fantastic with our children and they all thoroughly enjoyed the experience with our eldest continuing on with Marco to complete the open water course and achieve the certification.

We didn’t really know how the island worked before arriving, but it turned out to be a very convenient spot to learn how to dive as the diving courses (and other tours) depart directly from the beach right in front of the Carabao Dive Resort. This definitely made things easier and more fun.

Having the pool at the resort was also a great feature.

The rooms themselves are simple, clean and have good airconditioning.

There are some great restaurants with reasonable prices nearby. We particularly liked ‘Mellow Submarine’ for light, fresh, healthy meals. There is also a 7/11 just around the corner which was handy.

So if you’re looking for a family friendly diving experience then ask for Marco and enjoy your stay at Carabao Dive Resort!

Cheers 🍻🍻
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for taking the time to write all of this — what a brilliant review to read. 🙏 Marco will be thrilled, and I'll make sure Clara and Juan see it too. Teaching a whole family together is genuinely one of the most rewarding things we do, and it takes an instructor who can keep three kids engaged and safe at the same time. Marco is very good at exactly that, so it's lovely to see it recognised. Huge congratulations to your eldest on the Open Water certification — 14 and certified is something to be proud of. You've described the Chalok setup better than we do: departing straight off the beach makes a real difference with kids, no long pier queues or early boat transfers, and the pool is where most of the confidence gets built before anyone sees the ocean. Good shout on Mellow Submarine too. Thank you for trusting us with your family's first dives. The door's open whenever you're back in Thailand — and there's an Advanced waiting for your eldest! 🤿 Matteo – Carabao Diving Koh Tao

reviews.name: palm natkamol
reviews.text:

Niki was our instructor and of course she did really good job and Niki…if you reading this right now…Thank you so much and we love you 🫶🏽🥹hahaha.
I was panicking at first but Niki stayed with me all the time, hold my hands and made me so relaxed and comfortable. So I became more confident, relaxed and really enjoyed this first experience.🙏🏽♥️

The Carabao Diving Team 🌊🐢

reviews.name: Mansi Chauhan
reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Carabao Diving was truly a life-changing experience for me and that’s largely because of Nicole, my instructor.

I’ve always been afraid of the ocean, but I decided to step out of my comfort zone and try something completely new. From the very beginning, I felt incredibly lucky to have Nicole as my instructor. She is one of those rare people who leaves a lasting impression on your life. Patient yet disciplined, calm yet energetic, and always the happiest person around — she embodies everything you would hope for in a teacher.

Our entire group was nervous, and I was especially anxious. Nicole handled everything with such professionalism and warmth. She taught us step by step, making sure we understood not just the techniques, but also the safety rules and the importance of respecting the ocean. She made us feel comfortable in the water, confident in our abilities, and completely safe at all times.

What amazed me most is how well she prepared us. In just three days, I was able to dive to 18 meters and complete my certification; something I would have never imagined possible before this experience. That transformation happened because Nicole believed in us, guided us patiently, and never let fear take over.

If you’re considering going to Carabao Diving, go all in. It’s an unforgettable experience. And if you’re lucky enough to be assigned to Nicole, know that you’re in the very best hands. She is, without a doubt, the best scuba instructor I could have ever asked for.

Thank you, Nicole, for helping me conquer my fears and discover a whole new world underwater. 🌊🤿

reviews.name: John Ye
reviews.text: The rooms were awful and bedsprings were stuck out, towels smell bad. But the diving experience is 10/10. they have private boat and it’s super instructive and fun. Instructors are super nice and professional
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for the honest review John 🙏

We’re really happy to hear you enjoyed the diving experience, our instructors, and the private boat setup — that means a lot to us!

At the same time, we truly appreciate your feedback regarding the room conditions. We’re currently working on improving the accommodation side of the resort, including mattresses, linens, and overall room comfort, so comments like yours genuinely help us improve.

We hope to welcome you back to Koh Tao again soon — next time with both amazing diving *and* a much better room experience 😊🌊

reviews.name: Ashikul Islam
reviews.text: Attending a cooking class in Bangkok offers an immersive journey into the heart of Thai cuisine, blending traditional recipes with the vibrant culture of Thailand. The experience is not just about learning to cook Thai dishes; it's about understanding the essence of Thai flavors, ingredients, and cooking techniques. The instructors are usually passionate and knowledgeable, sharing insights into the significance of each dish within Thai culture, making the learning experience both educational and enjoyable. Participants get hands-on experience in preparing various dishes, from the fiery Tom Yum Goong to the delicate flavors of Pad Thai, all within a welcoming and well-equipped environment. The highlight is, without a doubt, the communal meal at the end, where everyone gathers to taste their creations, fostering a sense of community and shared achievement. It's an enriching experience that leaves you with not only new cooking skills but also a deeper appreciation for Thai culinary traditions.

reviews.text: Professional and cool place! เข้ามาครั้งแรกคือ ประทับใจในความเป็นมืออาชีพ และความเป็นระเบียบ สะอาดตา ช่วงปิดเทอมก็จะโล่งๆ แต่พอเปิดเทอมก็คึกคัก และกลิ่นหอมไปด้วยอาหารที่นักเรียนทำไม่ซ้ำเมนู ที่จอดรถกว้างขวาง เพียงพอแน่นอน ห้องเรียน ห้องครัว ห้องกิจกรรม และโดยเฉพาะห้องน้ำ สะอาดมากๆเลย ดูเค้าใส่ใจกับเรื่องนี้ อาจารย์ก็เฟรนด์ลี่ทุกคนเลย ที่นี่เค้ามีวุฒิ ปวช-ปวส หรือ ต่อป.ตรีไปเลย ก็ได้ด้วยนะ หรืออยากไปเป็นเชฟที่ต่างประเทศ เค้าก็มี MOU ติดต่อให้เสร็จสรรพ all-in-one ไปเลย ตัดสินใจได้ง่ายขึ้นละ happy ทั้งนักเรียน ทั้งผู้ปกครอง
reviews.textTranslated: Professional and cool place! My first impression was the professionalism, orderliness, and cleanliness. During school breaks, it's quite empty, but during the school term, it's lively and filled with the delicious aroma of students' uniquely prepared food. The parking lot is spacious and more than enough. The classrooms, kitchen, activity rooms, and especially the restrooms, are incredibly clean – they clearly pay attention to detail. The teachers are all friendly. They offer vocational certificates (P.V.C. and P.V.S.) and even bachelor's degrees. If you want to become a chef abroad, they have MOUs to help you with everything – an all-in-one solution that makes the decision easier. Happy for both students and parents!

reviews.name: Jaysen T
reviews.text: Our family had an absolute blast at Roschas Culinary School in Bangkok! Chef Wip was a superstar, her expert guidance and vibrant personality transformed our first cooking class into a joyful family adventure. She patiently guided us through each step, making it fun and accessible. The professional kitchen was top-notch, and cooking with authentic Thai ingredients while wearing aprons made us feel like true chefs! We were pleasantly surprised by the arrangement to enjoy our creations at the stunning rooftop restaurant, set against Bangkok’s skyline. I highly recommend sharing this unique experience with family and friends!

reviews.name: Hing Eli
reviews.text: I had a wonderful experience communicating with Roschas Culinary School! They were remarkably polite, and provided thorough, detailed answers to all of my questions. Even though I couldn't move forward this time because of personal reasons, their customer service is top-tier and makes them a fantastic choice. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Arinda Fita Fatimah
reviews.text: I’ve joined several cooking classes in different countries, and this was by far the best!! Chef Wip was absolutely LOVELY—cheerful, skilled, and made learning new techniques so fun and easy. Her thoughtfulness with the ingredients was incredibly sweet and appreciated. The class was enjoyable, with professional-grade equipment that elevated the experience. I also loved the after-class experience of enjoying the delicious food in their beautiful rooftop restaurant—it was so pleasant and relaxing. Highly recommend it to anyone looking for a top-notch cooking adventure!

reviews.name: Tom Chui
reviews.text: Amazing cooking experience!! Highly recommend to go in pairs or a group, not only you can taste others cooking but also got a few more hands for the photos. Those dishes are favourite Thai food and are not too complicated to follow (...much more relaxed than imagine), so it is for everyone! Apart from a little drama (late pick up due to heavy traffic, I guess it's welcome to Bangkok) in picking up from BTS station,  the whole user experience was five stars. They will place you on the top floor to enjoy your cooking and cocktail on the rooftop next to the swimming, somewhat meaningful way to spend our afternoon. By the way, it is not a long walk from BTS to the venue.

reviews.name: Manuel N
reviews.text: My first Thai Culinary experience. Chef Whip was pleasant, professional, knowledgeable, engaging, and was willing to share so much of her culinary fountain of knowledge. In one session, she had us put together a soup, main dish, and dessert.  She is easy to understand and very professional. The class was replete with valuable information that will affect my cooking skills and lifestyle forever. It was highly organized.  I’m not from Thailand but would do it again in the future. Highly recommended. The certificate of completion brings the whole experience to another level. They have other students studying to be professional chefs. Thank you Ms Whip for an excellent culinary adventure.

reviews.name: Y Chiang (Y Chiang)
reviews.text: Highly recommend! Glad to sign up this cooking class and learn from sous chef W who is super friendly and helpful! The course is well-designed and provides different cuisines everyday.

reviews.name: Jo W
reviews.text: Amazing cooking experience and you can try to make cocktail as well. Recommend to try.

reviews.name: Ed Domingo
reviews.text: It's the Best culinary experience I have ever had. The VIP treatment for beginners like me and the excellent service from the staff to the managers. The marketing manager Ms. Lizette welcomed me and showed me around their wide library collection of recipes, they gave me welcome drinks and ushered me to the class. Chef Prae was so skilled in what she is doing but teaching me how to cook with easy step by step demonstration. They served my dishes at their cozy restaurant with a nice view and gave me a certificate and souvenirs for my experience. Akara Hotel staff were very friendly and nice. I would recommend Roschas Culinary  school to all my friends.

reviews.name: Deb Strobridge
reviews.text: My wife and I had a wonderful experience at ROSCHA Culinary School. The instructor, Chef Woot, was a great teacher and communicated his instructions in English very well. If you love Thai food, recommend the experience for any visitors to Bangkok!

reviews.name: Siriwan Johnson
reviews.text: Had the best time learning to cook Thai food. Good value for its money. Highly recommended:). Also at the end we got to make Thai mojito cocktail at the bar which top of the class off :)

reviews.name: Mei Ling Bonnie Chiu
reviews.text: Good experience with Chief Bank and his team.  We tried several menu today and I successful cooked all the dishes particularly Tom yam soup.

reviews.name: R Chx
reviews.text: We had a fun experience here

reviews.name: Yian Chen
reviews.text: 非常值得來的cooking course體驗！教室很乾淨也是專業的料理廚房，老師很友善，教學也很仔細，不只是讓你完成料理，也分享很多吃法和泰國料理的關係！最後會在頂樓餐廳吃，view跟氛圍都很棒👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻
reviews.textTranslated: A highly recommended cooking course experience! The classroom was very clean and had a professional kitchen. The instructor was friendly and very thorough, not only helping you complete the cooking but also sharing many cooking tips and insights into the relationship between Thai cuisine and food! The final meal was at the rooftop restaurant, with a fantastic view and atmosphere. 👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻

reviews.name: 김가연
reviews.text: 진짜 재밌었어요~~ 원래 후기 많은 곳으로 가려다가,  숙소 이동하는 날이라 파야타이 역에서 가까운 곳으로 써치해서 예약했는데 좋은 의사결정이었습니다. 아카라 호텔에 있어, 수업 후 수영장 보이는 루프탑에서 만든 음식 먹을 수 있습니다 ㅎㅎ 셰프님이 친절하게 알려주고, 옆에서 같이 지켜봐줍니다. 직접 외국에서 요리해보는 경험 너무 좋았어요. 요일별로 만드는 음식이 다른데 저는 목요일이었습니다!
reviews.textTranslated: It was really fun! I originally planned to go to a place with lots of reviews, but since I was moving accommodations that day, I searched for a place close to Phaya Thai Station and booked it, which was a great decision. It is located at the Aqala Hotel, so after the class, you can eat the food you made on the rooftop overlooking the pool. The chef kindly teaches you and watches right by your side. It was such a wonderful experience to cook in a foreign country. The dishes you make vary by day of the week, and mine was on Thursday!

reviews.name: 김유진
reviews.text:
에어컨 빵빵한 쾌적한 주방에서 경험하는 타이음식 만들기 최고였어요
이쁜그릇에 세팅해서 수영장보이는 레스토랑에서 식사도하고 굿 내이름 박힌 이수증이랑 앞치마도 제공해주세오
reviews.textTranslated:
Making Thai food in a pleasant kitchen with powerful air conditioning was the best experience.

It was great to have a meal at a restaurant overlooking the pool, served on beautiful tableware. Please provide a certificate with my name on it and an apron as well.

reviews.name: H
reviews.text:
行前找三，四家比較，其他都是Blog或網紅介紹，但都有些負評，有些人數多，有些可選菜，因為大家做的不一樣，老師應付不來，讓學生看影片～
最後決定這裡，精緻小班，老師很棒，人也很Nice，有問必答，很好玩，因為在飯店裡，最後上頂樓用餐，上課及用餐環境都很好也很好吃^^
謝謝老師，讓我們的旅程更加有趣及加分，我一定會向別人推薦這裡的cooking shcool。
reviews.textTranslated: Before the trip, I compared three or four restaurants. The others were recommended by bloggers or online influencers, but they all had some negative reviews. Some were too large, and some only offered a limited selection of dishes. Because each restaurant's cooking was different, the teacher couldn't manage everyone and had the students watch videos. Finally, I decided on this place. It had a small, exclusive class, the teacher was fantastic, and very nice, answering all my questions. It was a lot of fun. Since it was located in a hotel, we ate on the rooftop at the end. The classroom and dining environment were both excellent, and the food was delicious! ^^ Thank you, teacher, for making our trip more interesting and enriching. I will definitely recommend this cooking shcool to others.

reviews.name: Byeongjin Jay Yang
reviews.text:
Awesome awesome! 음식 총 5개 만듬 친절하고 요리도 만들기 쉬움 다만들면 음식두고 칵테일 만들러감 각자 만든 칵테일 가지고 꼭데기층 레스토랑 가면 거기우리 자리있고 음식도와있음 그럼 그거먹으면 됨 ㅎ
주의 하나. 피시소스는 최대한 적게 넣어야함 무지찜
reviews.textTranslated: Awesome awesome! I made 5 dishes in total. They are friendly and easy to make. After making them, they leave the food and go make cocktails. Take your cocktails to the top floor restaurant and they will give you a seat and food. Then you can eat that. One thing to note. Use as little fish sauce as possible.

reviews.name: 劉宥慶
reviews.text: 學校場地很棒專業,wip老師很用心講解,食物好吃，不會很官方版,幽默,專業,非常退薦想學泰式素食料理的人
reviews.textTranslated: The school facilities are excellent and professional. The instructors at WIP are very dedicated to their teaching. The food is delicious, not too formal, and the teachers are humorous and professional. I highly recommend this school to anyone who wants to learn Thai vegetarian cuisine.

reviews.name: Younsoon Sung
reviews.text:
It would be great chance to see the kitchen of the hotel. And all the food I made were plated at the restaurant at 17th floor.
Only one con was the foods got cold while making othere foods.
호텔 주방을 볼 수 있는 기회에요. 셰프님이 먼저 설명하시면서 시연을 보여주시고, 우리가 그 다음에 각자 자리에 가서 요리하는 식입니다.
5가지 음식을 해서 한쪽 테이블에 올려놓았다가 17층 식당에 세팅해주어서 분위기 있게 음식을 먹을 수 있지만, 음식이 식는 단점이 있습니다.
요일별로 메뉴가 바뀐다하니 미리 확인해보고 가는게 좋을 듯 합니다.
reviews.textTranslated:
It was a great opportunity to see the hotel kitchen. All the food I made was plated at the restaurant on the 17th floor.

The only downside was that the food got cold while I was cooking the others.

It is a chance to see the hotel kitchen. The chef explains and demonstrates the cooking process first, and then we each go to our respective tables to cook.

They prepare five dishes, place them on a table, and then set them up at the 17th-floor restaurant, allowing for a stylish dining experience, but the downside is that the food gets cold.

Since the menu changes daily, it would be a good idea to check the schedule beforehand.

title: Wandee Culinary Art School โรงเรียนสอนอาหารครัววันดี
ownerDescription: โรงเรียนสอนอาหารครัววันดี สอนอาหารไทยและอาหารนานาชาติ แบบครบวงจร สามารถเรียนเพื่อไปประกอบอาชีพ แะลไปทำงานต่างประเทศ
address: 294, 16-17 Soi Pradipat, Phaya Thai, Bangkok 10400, Thailand
plusCode: QGQX+W4 Bangkok, Thailand

reviews.name: Sasin Sahisuk
reviews.text:
Had a really great time here!
The teachers/instructors are very kind and patient! You will definitely learn a lot, especially if you have never cooked before!

P.S. All the fried recipes are exceptionally good!

reviews.name: Nanchaya Thiangtham
reviews.text: Great experience here :)What I’ve learned is very useful for my career. Nice experience to start learning Authentic Thai Food from the roots.Teachers and classmates make every practical classes fun.

reviews.name: piyada thepanuan
reviews.text: Had a great experience here, good technique, good lessons and good vibe from all the staff. 🎉🙏🏽🤘🏼🤘🏼

reviews.name: Gail Alcabaza
reviews.text: I enjoyed my courses here. Good school

reviews.name: miho o
reviews.text: I met some great teachers and friends and learned everything from the basics to advanced techniques and Complete cooking  class will better undestand Thai food.

reviews.name: yannick sanquer
reviews.text: Nice school of good level. I followed the basic Professional Thai Food cooking lesson. At my request everything was in Thai language even though I dont master the language yet but I wanted to have the local knowledge. The teachers are all of high level, very patient and helpful. I spent 3 weeks there and I am very satisfied. I will be back for the next training level and for the vegetarian food cooking lessons.

reviews.name: Pattana J.
reviews.text: ไม่ผิดหวังจริงๆครับ ตอนแรกตัดสินใจว่าจะเรียนที่นี่ดีไหม เพราะกลัวเป็นเหมือนที่เก่าที่เคยเรียน ที่ให้แค่เข้าไปดูครูเขาทำเฉยๆ ที่นี่ครูทำเองทุกขั้นตอน ไม่ต้องเรียนเป็นกลุ่มด้วย คุ้มค่ามากๆครับ
reviews.textTranslated: I'm really not disappointed! At first, I was hesitant about studying here because I was afraid it would be like my previous school, where we just watched the teacher do things without doing anything. Here, the teacher does everything themselves, and there are no group classes. It's totally worth it!

reviews.name: Arunee Limsukhakorn
reviews.text: อาจารย์ใจดี ใจเย็น ชอบแชร์ความรู้ประสบการณ์ บอกทักษะการพัฒนาของอาหารขั้นถัดไป ได้รับความรู้เกี่ยวกับอาหารเพิ่มขึ้น มีเมนูหลายอย่างให้เลือกทำ สอนทักษะฝีมือหลายด้าน การแกะสลัก การจัดจาน การทำเพื่อจัดเลี้ยง การจัดโต๊ะ พับผ้าเช็ดปาก อาจารย์แต่ละท่านมีเทคนิคแตกต่างกันไป ได้เรียนรู้กับอาจารย์หลายคนในคอร์ส สูตรอาหารอร่อย จบคอร์สสามารถทำอาหารได้อย่างมั่นใจ เจ้าหน้าที่ใจดี ช่วยเหลือเรื่องตาราง มีความยือหยุ่น เป็นกันเอง
reviews.textTranslated: The instructors were kind, patient, and enjoyed sharing their knowledge and experience. They guided us on how to develop our culinary skills to the next level. I gained a lot of knowledge about food, and there were many menus to choose from. They taught various skills including carving, plating, catering, table setting, and napkin folding. Each instructor had different techniques, and I learned from several different instructors in the course. The recipes were delicious, and by the end of the course, I could cook with confidence. The staff were kind, helpful with schedules, flexible, and friendly.

reviews.name: Co D.Meyer
reviews.text:
Ich habe die Schule einen Monat lang besucht.
Alle Mitarbeiter und Lehrer sind sehr freundlich und hilfsbereit.
Die Schule hat sehr viel spass gemacht und ich konnte vieles lernen.
Ich werde die Zeit hier vermissen!
Vielen Dank
reviews.textTranslated:
I attended the school for a month.

All the staff and teachers are very friendly and helpful.

School was a lot of fun and I learned a great deal.

I will miss my time here!

Thank you!

reviews.name: maxx maxx
reviews.text: ไม่คิดว่าตัวเองจะทำอาหารได้ ขอบคุณโรงเรียนนี้มาก สะอาด คอร์สดีราคาคุ้มค่า เรียนสนุกมากค่า
reviews.textTranslated: I never thought I could cook. Thank you so much to this school. It's clean, the courses are good and worth the price, and learning is so much fun!

reviews.name: Wukong Sun
reviews.text: เจอก้อนกรวดในกะเพรา2เม็ดด้วยจ้า ค่อยๆเคี้ยวกันนะ ระวังฟันแตก 😭
reviews.textTranslated: I found two pebbles in my basil stir-fry! Chew carefully, or you might break your teeth! 😭

reviews.name: ชีคิว - She'Q
reviews.text: ใครหาโรงเรียนสอนทำขนมอยู่ แนะนำที่นี่เลย ครูใจดี สอนเข้าใจง่าย มีทั้งครอสเดี่ยว,กลุ่ม ประทับใจมากๆค่ะ มีโอกาสจะไปเรียนเพิ่มเติมอีก
reviews.textTranslated: If you're looking for a baking school, I highly recommend this place. The instructor is kind and teaches in an easy-to-understand way. They offer both individual and group classes. I was very impressed and will definitely go back for more classes if I have the chance.

reviews.name: WCC Admissions
reviews.text:
This school is fantastic where it provides you a competency study and cooking. Students can continue the internship or job offer after finishing the course as well. But you need to study as the hotel indicate around 300 hours then the school is able to send the letter for students to intern around 3 months. One of the student interned in marriott marquis bangkok after that they hired him to work in the newest restaurant.
**สมัครเลย เรียนได้ทันที ตามวันที่สะดวก มาไม่ได้ แจ้งล่วงหน้าก่อน 1 วัน มีเรียนชดเชยให้   ดีกว่านี้ ไม่มีแล้วนะ เริ่มได้ที่นี่ โรงเรียนครัววันดี
เปิดมาแล้ว 31 ปี
***ไม่ใช่โรงเรียนที่เพิ่งจะเกิด แล้วบอกตัวเองคืออันดับ 1
reviews.textTranslated:
This school is fantastic, providing competency studies and cooking training. Students can continue with internships or job offers after completing the course. However, you need to study as the hotel requires, around 300 hours, after which the school can send you a letter for an internship lasting approximately 3 months. One of our students interned at the Marriott Marquis Bangkok, after which they were hired to work in their newest restaurant.
**Apply now! Start learning immediately on your convenient dates. If you can't attend, please notify us one day in advance for make-up classes. There's nothing better than this! Start here at Wan Dee Culinary School.
Established for 31 years.
***This isn't a newly established school claiming to be number 1.

reviews.name: Kwanjira Saejung
reviews.text: จากที่คิดว่าการทำขนมยาก ที่นี่คือดูง่ายไปเลย คนรอบตัวชิมฝีมือก็คือชมว่าอร่อย เป็นการเรียนที่คุ้มค่ามากค่ะ

reviews.textTranslated: This is a really great baking school. I highly recommend it. I went from having no baking experience to being able to open my own shop!

reviews.name: JYISHAPPY B.

reviews.textTranslated: It's worth learning, even for those who know how to cook at all. Get ready to be a full-fledged housewife for your husband 🤍

reviews.text:
เดินผ่านแล้วได้กลิ่นหอม เลยต้องแวะเข้ามาสมัครคอร์สเรียน คุ้มค่ามาก

reviews.textTranslated:
I walked past and smelled the delicious aroma, so I had to stop in and sign up for a course. It was well worth it!
