title: May Kaidee Chiang Mai
subTitle: Vegan Home cookery classes by May kaidee x Morning glory
address: 13 Charoenmuang Road Soi 2, Tambon Chang Moi, เมือง Chiang Mai 50000, Thailand
plusCode: Q2Q4+GH Chiang Mai, Mueang Chiang Mai District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

reviews.name: Michael Howard
reviews.text:
Had an amazing time here. This came highly recommended from some friends and it did not disappoint.

We chose the 3 day course and it was absolutely perfect.

The first day was the fundamentals of Thai cooking, what order to prepare things And the order to add ingredients to the stir fry’s.

Every time I’m near food I can hear Diana in my head spicy, salty, sweet, sour!

This course is excellent at actually teaching you about cooking and how to prepare vegetables etc rather than just chucking 4 ingredient in a wok and calling it pad Thai.

Diana and her husband are a dream team. Everything was always exactly where we needed it you would turn around for a moment to look at something with Diana as you looked back your old cookware was gone and everything was ready again.

The class is fast paced but Diana takes her time to check you have what you need or have understood when taking notes on the recipes or shopping lists.

One of the absolute highlights of our 4 months in south east Asia.

Ps. Please don’t regard the only single star review by Silvan Fischhöfer of this cooking school. They showed up for the last day of our 3 day course and complained about everything from the second they got there. Who books a class about how to make tofu from scratch and complains they aren’t cooking Thai food..? Please take your complaining somewhere else… it was a drag on an otherwise fantastic day!

reviews.name: Astrid張郁萱
reviews.text:
Had an exceptional learning experience with the incredible teacher Diana here! Not only learned about the classic dishes but also Diana’s mom secret recipe. 💗

I’m not vegan but I’m curious about creating umami without animal products or msg, and I’ve come to the right place! During the 3 hour course I was constantly blown away by how such combination of simple, natural ingredients can turn into taste like for example fish sauce and bone broth. Diana was so thoughtful and would always make a note for me as an non-vegan about the variations I can make with animal products.

Can tell that the whole learning process is well-designed, starting from the basic cutting techniques and the essential sauces. Even though fast paced but Diana will always leave time for students to digest (the recipe, not enough time for the food tho 😆) make sure we’ve make detailed notes (a recipe book with memo blanks is provided). She knows quite a lot of mandarin for food ingredients, so Mandarin speaking students can double check if we’re understanding it correctly (after all there’s so many herbs with similar names in different languages, right?).

Also, shout out to Diana’s husband who is the teaching assistant I assume. Always quickly and quietly prepping and cleaning up after one dish was done. When you are ready for the next one, you’d turn around and find out that the wok is clean again and heating up already! 🙏🏼

reviews.name: Viola Yeh
reviews.text: 10 out of 10 a must try cooking course in Chiang Mai, even if you ain’t a vegan. We had so much fun on the class with beautiful Diana. She is dedicated into everything she has taught us, we had great memory there n can’t wait to try make our self meal duplicated when back home. Love from Taiwan🤍

reviews.name: Ashley Fernandes
reviews.text:
Really amazing vegan cooking class. They start from the basics and teach you how to cook different Thai dishes from scratch.
You cook so many different dishes and you get to eat all that you cook. So highly recommended to go as hungry as possible.
The chef is very patient and focuses on details. They can adjust the class content according to your taste and dietary preferences. The owner and also runs a vegan restaurant on the old town by the same name.
Best cooking experience ever.

reviews.name: Alice King
reviews.text: We were so impressed by this masterclass in Thai cooking we did the 9am-12pm longer class, me and my partner are both Vegan so we’re so excited to find a Vegan Cooking class here. The class was fast paste straight into the action we learnt how to cook a menus worth of healthy and incredibly delicious Thai food, but starting from the 3 key sauces as the base for all the most famous dishes. Curries to Rice paper rolls, to Pad Thai, to the famous Mango sticky rice everything was exceptionally tasty and accessible to learn. We felt well prepared with everything we needed to massively level up our home cooking. We found out about the class though visiting the May Kaidee X Morning Glory restaurant in Chiang Mai.

reviews.name: Lucy Doyle
reviews.text: Incredible vegan cooking class, very fast paced but you get to make so much and she makes sure you understand each step. Delicious food, wonderful person, couldn’t recommend more!!!

reviews.name: Annon Tuli
reviews.text:
It was a really Fun experience learning about fundamental of Thai cooking and interactive class made it memorable. The teacher was really kind and friendly and she taught us step by step how to make a proper Thai food.
I will surely use it back home.

reviews.name: Cósmica
reviews.text: Thailand continues to surprise me; every day I get to know the people, the places, and the culture more, I fall more in love. The course was one of the most surprising moments, for the flavors, the exchanges, and especially for the way Diane teaches everything with sweetness and joy. I intend to return soon, but I'm happy to know that I will carry with me and be able to experience the knowledge and the longing I already feel for Thailand, even from afar. Thank you so much for sharing, I loved it!

reviews.name: Meg A
reviews.text: Our FAVE place to eat in Thailand. They do the best Thai food that cannot be compared anywhere else. Vegan, vegetarian, gluten free. Tasty. Definitely recommend to everyone you NEED to eat here. Also did their cooking class which we definitely recommend too!! Just the best

reviews.name: Lira Lira
reviews.text:
Mai Kaidee Cooking School is remarkable! Diana is an excellent teacher as well as an excellent cook! We learned how to make green and red chili paste and then used the red paste to make 7 soups. We also learned how to make Masaman Curry and Thai sticky rice. Diana has so much wisdom, and she shares her recipes with passion, quick tips, and skill.

Her recipes are pure and the food you make in her class will change the way you eat! So good.

reviews.name: Gabriella
reviews.text: Amazing experience. I've never done a cooking class so I have no comparisons...but you learn so many things in a few hours. All healthy and delicious. All taught with passion and humour. Highly recommend it if you are vegan

reviews.name: Silvan Fischhöfer
reviews.text: We cannot understand the positive reviews. Although we did make the tofu ourselves, instead of cooking several dishes there was only a fried platter and one dessert in the end. In between, different teas were prepared, which did not interest us. Hygiene was very poor..everything was constantly touched and tasted with licked fingers or used spoons from shared bowls, without hand washing. There was hardly any real cooking, the tone was very commanding, and the atmosphere felt uncomfortable. Overall, it was not a pleasant experience.

reviews.name: by ASIYA
reviews.text: The best cooking class I have ever done. Diana is a wonder - she is so knowledgeable and an incredibly dedicated teacher. I cannot recommend this class enough. I previously took many cooking classes and this was by far the best

reviews.name: Tânia Garcia
reviews.text:
Incredible experience that I will take for life! You cook around 15 vegan Thai recipes so rich of flavour and fresh. Besides that you learn how to meal prep and get dinner ready in 15 min or less or host a dinner party without spending hours in the kitchen 😊 You receive a cook book where you can write down all the tips, tricks and secrets of the chef. And I save the best for last. You will be completely inspired and energised by the passion and power of this amazing woman!
Also don’t miss out on her restaurant with the same name 😉

reviews.name: Helen m
reviews.text: Awesome cooking class experience with Diana. We learned to make so many things from scratch and with easy steps to follow and what to buy when we get back home so we can recreate the delicious base pastes, sauces and dishes.

reviews.name: 曾呈立
reviews.text:
(The wishes from Taiwan)
If you are Vegan,
Thai flavor lover, and
searching truly Thai cooking method...

HERE'S THE VERY BEST KITCHEN ABSOLUTELY!!!!!!

reviews.name: Jamie
reviews.text: The best cooking class ever! Really friendly bubbly lady. We learned about 15 dishes in 2/3 hours that’s amazing. Don’t miss out

reviews.name: Nikita Varia
reviews.text: What a wonderful for experience for our entire family of adults and teens! Diana was an amazing and fun teacher. She made our kids and us enjoy learning and cooking. Thank you for such a lovely experience. Highly recommend this cooking school!

reviews.name: Suzy Stanford
reviews.text: The most amazing vegan food, so excited to get home and make some more recipes. The sticky rice is delicious! Make sure you visit the restaurant in town as well.

reviews.name: Lea T
reviews.text: A fun and quick way to learn how to make delicious Thai vegan food. They cater for special dietary restrictions (Allium free). We've spent the morning learning over 10 Thai dishes.

title: Siam Carving Academy
ownerDescription:
The heart & soul of Siam Carving Academy is an International award-winning and distinguished Master Carver Wan Hertz. Her skill as an artist and personalized approach to teaching truly set her technique a cut above instruction available elsewhere.

Medals from numerous competitions have made SCA the first and only school of its kind to win approval from the American Culinary Federation as a Continuing Education Provider.
address: 802, P.D. Mansion, Room, 130/1 Soi Rung Rueang, Samsen Nok, Huai Khwang, Bangkok 10310, Thailand
street: 802, P.D. Mansion, Room, 130/1 Soi Rung Rueang
plusCode: QHVG+F6 Bangkok, Thailand

reviews.name: Mattias Lanas
reviews.text: Fantastic experience! Wan (Leong) is a patient teacher and true master at her craft, and both she and Larry took such great care of me and offered all kinds of insights about Bangkok (it’s my first time visiting). I really enjoyed my 6-hour session learning the basics of fruit and vegetable carving, an ancient and unique Thai practice. I now have major respect for the skill, patience and sheer effort it takes to make these masterpieces. I highly recommend a carving session with Wan if you’re in Bangkok and want a different and memorable experience.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Hi Mattias, thank you very much for your review and we are very happy you enjoyed the experience.  it was our pleasure having spent the day with you, and also confident you will love our online video course.

reviews.name: Jenn Odell
reviews.text: Laong is so sweet, kind, funny and was so patient with me as I learned how to carve vegetables for the first time! We talked and laughed a lot and I had a great time. She even walked me to the subway after class! Definitely goes above and beyond for her students. Thank you to Laong and her husband for their wonderful hospitality!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: You were such a good student and we are happy to hear you had a great time. Thank you so much for comming.

reviews.name: Natalie Billick
reviews.text: I signed up for the 3-hour carving workshop. I was looking for an interesting indoor, air-conditioned activity to beat the afternoon heat, and this did not disappoint! It was such a fun way to learn a new skill and participate in a little bit of Thai culture. The workshop even includes the carving knife so you can continue to practice at home. I definitely enjoyed myself. Thank you, Wan and Larry!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi Natalie, 
We are both very happy to hear that you enjoyed yourself and gained a new skill.
Thanks for writing the review.

reviews.name: Woody Lee
reviews.text: This was a wonderful experience. My wife and I participated in a half-day vegetable carving workshop. We arrived 45 minutes early, and the instructor was able to help us get started in no time. The entire process took place in a comfortable environment, and the instructor provided appropriate support, allowing us enough time to complete our creations. It was a truly enjoyable experience.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your review and it was our pleasure having you as our student.

reviews.name: Manoj Pawar
reviews.text:
A Remarkable Watermelon Carving Experience at Siam Carving Academy

I recently had the privilege of attending a watermelon carving workshop at Siam Carving Academy, and it was an absolutely amazing experience. Under the expert guidance of Wan, the instructor, I delved into the art of transforming ordinary watermelons into stunning edible masterpieces.

Wan's teaching style was exceptional. She patiently guided us through the intricate process of watermelon carving, instilling confidence in each participant. Her expertise and attention to detail were truly remarkable, as she shared invaluable techniques and tips that brought our creations to life.

The workshop fostered a creative and supportive environment, allowing us to explore our artistic abilities with enthusiasm. Wan encouraged us to think outside the box and experiment with different designs. It was a joy to witness the incredible transformations that took place as we carved the watermelons into intricate patterns and shapes.

The hands-on experience was truly rewarding. Wan ensured that each participant received personalized attention, offering guidance and encouragement every step of the way. Her passion for watermelon carving was evident, and her dedication to sharing her knowledge and expertise was inspiring.

Beyond the exceptional instruction, the warm and inviting atmosphere at Siam Carving Academy made the experience even more memorable. The friendly staff and comfortable surroundings created a pleasant environment for learning and creativity.

I highly recommend Siam Carving Academy to anyone interested in exploring the art of watermelon carving or seeking a unique and enriching culinary experience. Wan's expertise, coupled with the welcoming atmosphere, guarantees an unforgettable journey into the world of edible art.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We are very grateful for your review and recommendation. It means a great deal to us coming from a culinary arts professional such as yourself.

reviews.name: Stephanie Yap
reviews.text: My partner and I signed up for the 3 hours course. Definitely something different from your normal cooking class! It was not easy but interesting to learn a traditional skill. We worked on tomatoes, carrots and cucumbers and were amazed how these everyday vegetables can turn into intricate pieces of art. Wan was a very professional and patient teacher who taught us passionately.. She went to help us individually to make sure we got the right angles to carve the vegetables. Larry was also responsive with messages and assisted us the best directions to get to their school. Definitely recommend this activity for a break in Bangkok.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for the review and it sounds like you were very pleased with the outcome. It was a great pleasure having you spend a few hours with us and wish it could have been longer.

reviews.name: Norman Frendberg
reviews.text: Great day. I actually learned how to turn two tomatoes into a flower. Lots of others too with carrots and cucumbers Teacher was wonderful. Helping just enough with instructions and encouragement. This is a day to remember Now I can work on my own BUT I will be back for more advanced leanings when I master these skills
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much for the review and very happy to hear you enjoyed yourself. Would love to see you again in the near future for another class.

reviews.name: Caragh C
reviews.text:
Wow, what a find!  In 3 hours I learned so many different and stunning carving techniques to transform tomatoes, cucumbers and carrots.  Wan is an amazing teacher, such a beautiful, warm, patient person who went out of her way to help me.   I really loved the carving afternoon and look forward to putting what I learnt into practice.

Don't be put off by the building entrance, which initially looks empty,  as you take a lift up into a comfortable area for the carving.  You even get your very own carving knife to keep.  I'll definitely be back if I'm in the area again.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks for the review and would love to see you again in the future. You were a very good student.

reviews.name: Toni Williams
reviews.text: Learning at Siam Carving Academy has been one of the most rewarding things I have done. I felt comfortable and at ease while learning. My skills have greatly improved and my confidence has risen as well. I can't recommend this experience enough!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for the recommendation. It is great hearing that you have benefitted from the teaching. You were a great student and we know you will keep improving with practice.
We would love to see some of your carvings in the future, and keep in touch with us.

reviews.name: Santiago del Rio
reviews.text:
Siam Carving academy was one of the best experiences I had at Bangkok. In the class you learn how to make beautiful fruit and vegetable carvings that you can replicate at home. With what you learn in the class you can enhance your dishes in unique ways (such as elegant lotus tomatoes that could hold small foods, cucumber leaf carvings that can be placed on glass cups for cocktails, and more). The class itself is fun, and included in the class is delicious local Thai food that you can munch on while carving. At the end of the class you get to keep the tools you used so that you can continue carving well after the class is done. The service itself is also
incredible, as the Teacher went out of her
way to make sure I understood the
carving techniques. To add to this, she
went above and beyond afterwards in
helping me get to the train station i
needed to go to after, and let me keep a
bag of lychee fruits from the class
Overall im very grateful for their help, and
highly recommend the class
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Very happy hearing you had such a great experience.
It would be great seeing you again in the future and would love teaching more different things for you.

reviews.name: shweta
reviews.text: Completed advanced master carving course in April 22. Master Carver Wan is one of the best carvers and instructors in the world, privileged to have learnt this art under her supervision. She has infinite patience, extremely kind and co-operative and takes care of her students like a family. Thanks to her, we were also able to visit the best and most authentic places in Bangkok. Thanks to Mr Lawrence for assisting us for our accommodation and all the help during our stay. I would recommend this academy to everyone who desires to learn the art of carving. You will learn from the best and it will be worth your time and effort.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We are thrilled to hear your review and it was an intense pleasure having you as a student. Soon hopefully we will be in India and will be with you and Suneej.

reviews.name: Joe upup12 Lin
reviews.text: We were very happy with the class. Very experienced and skillful teacher who gives you direct hands on experience in carving.  The skills can be applied in other artistic expressions like clay or pottery work. This is a unique lesson. My child enjoyed the class and would go there again when we visit Thailand.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks for the review, and we would love to see you again when you return to Thailand.

reviews.name: Priya Hathiramani
reviews.text:
My husband and I took the Carving course this April. It was one of our best highlights and productivity of Thailand trip. The Master Chef, ,despite being an expert Carver and instructor, is superbly creative. She patiently took us the process and explained all technicalities of using a carving knife and gave numerous creative ideas. In 3 hours, we learnt the foundation well, ready to plunge into the business world.
We will be back again for the advanced workshop.
Big thanks to Chef and to Mr. Larry for guidance all through. See you!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
It was great having you with us and we are very happy to hear you enjoyed yourselves
We would love to see you again in the near future and
thank you for the review.

reviews.name: Manoj Pawar
reviews.text:
Exceptional Carving Workshop Experience at Siam Carving Academy

I recently had the pleasure of participating in a three-day full-time carving workshop at the Siam Carving Academy in Bangkok, and I must say it was an extraordinary experience. As an avid enthusiast of culinary arts, I was thrilled to explore the art of fruit and vegetable carving, and this workshop surpassed all my expectations.

Under the expert guidance of Wan, our instructor, I acquired invaluable skills and knowledge in various carving techniques over the course of three days. Each day focused on different produce, ensuring a diverse learning experience.

On the first day, we delved into the intricate world of tomato and carrot carving. Wan's teaching style was clear, patient, and encouraging, making the learning process enjoyable and rewarding. She provided insightful tips and tricks that enabled us to create stunning carved designs.

The second day was equally captivating as we ventured into the realm of pumpkin, carrot, and radish carving. Wan's expertise and attention to detail truly shone throughout the day. Her ability to break down complex designs into manageable steps allowed us to achieve remarkable results.

On the final day, we embarked on watermelon carving, which proved to be a true highlight of the workshop. Wan's passion for her craft was evident as she shared her extensive knowledge and demonstrated advanced techniques. I left the workshop feeling inspired and eager to continue exploring this art form.

Aside from Wan's exceptional instruction, I would be remiss not to mention the warm and welcoming atmosphere created by Wan and her husband, Larry. They went above and beyond to ensure our comfort and satisfaction throughout the workshop. Their hospitality was unparalleled, and the fact that they served us delicious homemade Thai food each day was simply delightful. It added an extra layer of authenticity to the entire experience.

The workshop provided a perfect balance of theoretical instruction, practical demonstrations, and hands-on practice. Wan's teaching style instilled confidence in each participant, regardless of their prior experience. The class size was intimate, allowing for personalized attention and guidance from Wan whenever needed.

Overall, my three-day full-time carving workshop at Siam Carving Academy was a truly remarkable experience. Wan's expertise, along with her husband Larry's hospitality, created an environment conducive to learning and growth. I wholeheartedly recommend this workshop to anyone interested in fruit and vegetable carving or simply looking for a unique and enriching culinary experience. I am grateful for the opportunity to learn from such talented individuals and for the memories that will undoubtedly last a lifetime.

I can't wait to continue honing my carving skills and applying everything I learned. Thank you, Wan and Larry, for an unforgettable experience!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi Manoj,
Thank you for you very much for your review, and it means a great deal to us, especially hearing this from a culinary professional who is a co-founder of a culinary arts school. It was music to our ears hearing you had an extraordinary and rewarding experience.
We are looking towards seeing you again in the very near future to teach you the intermediate and advanced course.

reviews.name: Sandra Evans
reviews.text: Visited Bangkok in January and February and participating in this class was awesome! Learned a lot and it was a very calm and funny session. Happy to do it again to learn more. Definteley a great experience!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for the review. 
It was a lot of fun teaching you and I am happy hearing that you enjoyed the class and learned a lot of techniques.
We would love to teach you another class in the future.

Laong

reviews.name: Sienna Barten
reviews.text: We had a great experience in a private 3 hour carving class. Such a unique hands-on activity perfect for my daughter and I to learn together!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Hi Sienna, We are very happy to hear you and your daughter had a perfect experience. We always aim to please to the fullest.

reviews.name: TT II
reviews.text:
I attended the half-day carving class.
Great teacher, interesting content and a wonderful experience!
I learned a lot in this half-day class, and I look forward to coming back again to take the longer advanced course. I highly recommend learning here, if you are interested in carving.

We are very pleased to hear that you benefited from the class and enjoyed the experience. It will be great seeing you again in the near future and teaching you more carving techniques.

reviews.text: “I had a great day learning Thai vegetable carving at Carving Academy Bangkok and would definitely recommend it.”
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: It was great pleasure having you as a student and would love seeing you again to teach you more.

title: Bees Garden Cooking School
ownerDescription: Set in the serene countryside to the north of Chiang Mai, Bees Garden is around 14 kilometers from the city. The school is set in an organic garden, from where you will have beautiful views of rice fields and mountains. You will learn the art of cooking authentic Thai food, with expert instruction from our resident cooking instructor, Bee. When you have finished preparing your food you will have time to enjoy your meal and to relax in the natural beauty of Bees Garden.
address: 89 San Sai District, Chiang Mai 50210, Thailand
neighborhood: เทศบาลเมืองแม่โจ้
plusCode: V3Q4+5V เทศบาลเมืองแม่โจ้ San Sai District, Chiang Mai, Thailand

reviews.name: Chloe
reviews.text: My best experience of Chiang Mai! Bee is very passionate about cooking and introducing the vast array of ingredients and substitutes that can be used in Thai cuisine. What really makes the class come to life is her bubbly personality and love for life and food. Her husband as well is a great host and helps in providing transport to the markets and cooking school.

reviews.name: Georg “Dokk” Döhring
reviews.text:
My wife and I were looking for a cooking class in Chiang Mai and stumbled upon Bees Garden. We are glad we did! Embee is surely the most energetic, positive and joyfull person you'll ever meet! They recently opened, so the building and all tools are brand new. The cooking room is very open and bright and as the school is located just outside of Chiang Mai this makes for a lovely surrounding.

Before the cooking started Embee gave us a tour through her organic garden and we learned a lot about the ingredients we used later.

The recipes were easy to master yet very tastefull. We've got a cooking booklet afterwards so we'll surely recreate some of them at home.

If you're looking for more than a simple cooking class but a wonderful, unforgettable  experience then this is the place for you!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi Georg,

Please come and visit next time you are in Chiang Mai!

Bee xx

reviews.name: Keith Bridgen
reviews.text: Had a fabulous day here learning how to cook some wonderful Thai dishes. The flavours were amazing and the environment was perfect, being out of town in peaceful surrounds in well thought out facilities. Embee was fantastic, super fun and was able to open my very fussy taste pallet to new gastronomic experiences. I highly recommend this cooking school.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Andrew, for the review and the beautiful photographs you took while you were here.

reviews.name: Shivan Sivakumaran
reviews.text:
If you have traveled this distance to Chaing Mai, you are definitely wanting an authentic experience away from the busyness of the city. With Bees Garden Cooking School all you need to do is simply take a single step outside your door, where you are personally chauffeured to a culinary experience among the rice fields of Chaing Mai.

Our journey to the cooking school was greeted by the warm and friendly handshake from our transporter, Andrew. Providing a punctual pick up at a convenient location right outside our accommodation, Andrew was able to fill the drive with handy insights into Thailand with his almost two-decade experience living in the country as well as a genuine interest in our travel.

Stopping by a local market, our anticipation had finally met its climax, where we meet the wonderful chef-teacher, Embee (or Bee as her apt nickname). Bee combines the knowledge of a master chef with the uniqueness of an entertainer. Like she was introducing us to her friends, Bee would guide us through the stalls explaining each herb, vegetable and animate food of the locals.

Next, we were ushered to the location where we would create our tantalising meals. The sight of flanking tree-covered hills backing vast rice fields and farmland satisfied our eyes before our stomachs. Our ears were filled with sounds of nature and devoid of honks and engine noise of the city. Tea consisting of warm water bathed in lemongrass and sweet basil welcomed our tongues and throats as our bodies enjoyed the peace and tranquility of the Bee's cooking garden. Bee's true passion wags its tail (as much as their friendly dog, Dingo) when we are familiarised with the variety of vegetables and herbs growing in her picturesque, organic garden.

Thai food communicates a certain complexity of flavours. Bee's talent in demonstration gives simplicity to the daunting task of constructing a banquet from this mouth-watering cuisine. We started with Tom Yum Soup as a warm-up to cook and consume. We followed with Khao Soi. The paste made from the herbs and vegetables grown from the earth of Bee's garden. Spring rolls deep-fried and chicken with basil combined with a unique twist of purple rice lined our stomachs. Our bellies were forced full with our finale dish of dessert, sticky rice with mango.

We went away not only with a completely satisfied and enlarged gut but an experience that we can take home with us and use in our own kitchen. We cannot thank you enough Bee and Andrew for your hospitality and showmanship. To add, we were also entrusted with a book of Bee's favourite recipes. A previous review mentioned that we would be "lying in bed typing your songs of praise" and that is exactly what we have been doing and soon you will be too.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for your wonderful review Shivan, it must have taken you ages to write; have you ever considered writing a book!
We really enjoyed our evening with you both and the energy that you brought to the class.
Miss you both, and when we finally come to New Zealand we will be coming to visit you.

Have a great trip!

Bee xx

reviews.name: Sonya Bagley
reviews.text:
We were picked up from our hotel in Chiang Mai by Andrew, Embee's husband who drove us to the cooking class. On the way not far from the cooking school we stopped off at a local market where we met the lovely Embee and she showed us around the market carefully explaining what everything was and what it is used for. It was great to finally find out what some of the things we had been eating in the local Thai dishes actually were!

Bees Garden Cooking School is a short drive from Chiang Mai located in a small village. It's surrounded by beautiful countryside, farm land, rice fields and views of the mountains in the distance. It really is a stunning and peaceful place to look out on to whilst taking part in the cooking class. A welcome change from the hustle and bustle of Chiang Mai.

Embee and Andrew have a lovely garden that they grow different types of vegetables, herbs and fruits which you get to take a tour of, try and pick different produce that you will use to cook with in the class. All of which is never sprayed with pesticides so is clean and fresh.

Following the tour of the garden and the tree house (you must take some time to relax in the hammocks overlooking the countryside) we enjoyed a cup of lemongrass herbal tea from the garden and then began the cooking class.

We started off by preparing the rice using the flowers we had picked from the garden to dye the colour to a blue/purple. We cooked Tom Kha Gai, Pad Thai, Thai Green curry, Chicken with cashew nuts and banana and coconut milk pudding. Embee was a great teacher, very passionate and funny and has lots of knowledge about what she does after working in some of Chiang Mai's biggest cooking schools over the past 10 years. Of course we got to eat all of the food we had cooked which was delicious and portion sizes were great. We didn't need to eat again the rest of the day!

Thank you Embee and Andrew for a fantastic day and being so welcoming!

If you are looking for a cooking school that has something a little different, smaller/more intimate groups with fresh air, fresh produce and stunning views then this is your place. Embee is so passionate about what she does and truly loves cooking and teaching people to cook. When you leave you'll be given a cook book which has lots of recipes in not just the dishes you will cook that day.

We cannot recommend Bees Garden Cooking School enough and hope to be back again in the very near future!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi Sonya!
Thank you so much for taking the time to write such a wonderful review for Bees Garden Cooking School.  We really enjoyed you and Jon visiting us, and we got some lovely pictures of you both; You should consider a modeling career!
We have posted the pictures on our web site if you would like to take a look:

https://www.beesgardencooking.com/gallery-december-2019

Hope to hear from you both soon!

Bee xx

reviews.name: Emily Cook
reviews.text: The best cooking class you could book onto. It was amazing right from the start. The market you go to is full of locals and all fresh product with no tourists at all. Bee’s garden was so interesting, she takes you around shows you all the food she grows and you try anything and everything. All the meals you make are so tasty, you do everything yourself and she let you pick how spices you want it. She is a great teacher and the friendliest person. She was joking around and making it so fun for everyone. I could not recommend this class more, you even get a cook book at the end with everything you’ve made and some extra recipes.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Emily for writing such a lovely review!

reviews.name: Alexie
reviews.text: Bee's garden was an absolutely exceptional experience. My friend and I both agreed this was the highlight of our trip. We began by walking around their local market where she showed us a different ingredients we would use for the day and some special local ingredients. Anything we hadn't tried before she got for us to try which was really amazing. We then went to her cooking school set in their beautiful garden fully open overlooking her organic garden and the scenery from afar. We walked through her garden trying all her organic herbs and veggies as she explained to us what they were and what we would be using. During the cooking lessons we made exceptional dishes and she really showed us that this is something we can definitely recreate at home and showed how simple it can be. Not only this but she was incredibly open to any dietary preferences and found alternatives on the spot. Bee is incredibly lovely, lively and above all so passionate about cooking and excited to share her knowledge with you, you wish you would never have to leave. This is and will remain one of my best holiday memories and you cannot find an experience like this anywhere else as Bee is truly one of a kind.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi Alexie,
Thank you for your lovely review.  I am so happy that you enjoyed your visit to Bees Garden, and I wish you didn't have to leave either!  Please come to pay us a visit next time you are in Chiang mai, either for a cooking class or just to see us!

Hope to see you soon.

Bee xx

reviews.text: Embee was a fantastic teacher with very good English. She was the highlight of our Thailand trip. The farm was stunning with pretty Lily's and organic vegetable patch. The food was delicious and kept on coming.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you Reece,  we are so glad you enjoyed your time with us.

reviews.name: Alex Garske
reviews.text:
My wife and I booked this cooking class after reviewing many of the options in the Chiang Mai area. We picked it particularly because of the benefit of being able to do a half day class either in the morning or evening, the ability to get outside of the city to see some different views including Embee and Andrews garden, and their local market.
We were picked up at our hotel by Andrew, Embee’s husband and we’re taken first to a local market where we tasted several unique ingredients and foods, and Embee described the other items of which we were not familiar. We then rode out to their cooking school which is adjacent to their home and garden. We were greeted with hot tea and water and were able to get to know Andre and Embee a little better. We then took a tour of the garden with Embee where she showed us all the different plants they grow (some intentionally, some by coincidence) and use in the food they cook and eat. I have no idea how many different plants she has growing, but there are dozens and dozens, all of which she suggested we taste. We then got to cooking 5 different items which we were able to modify slightly for our personal tastes and preferences. The class was informative and we got a great little cookbook to take home and try making, unfortunately, without Embee being there to guide us through each step.
We have done a number of classes in the US, but Bee’s garden Cooking School was absolutely the best. Embee and Andrew are amazing people. They are humorous, kind, passionate, and humble. They were fantastic hosts, and we would ABSOLUTELY recommend booking a class with them.

Also to note- our class ended up being just the two of us, which we enjoyed very much. In past experiences, other cooking classes or tours, have cancelled, but not Embee. She marched right ahead with just us and made sure we had a fantastic time.

Thank you Andrew and Embee!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi Alex,
Thank you so much for your lovely review, it was an absolute pleasure having you both cook with us.  We look forward to the next time that you come to Chiang mai to see how our trees are growing!

Bee xx

Going around a local food market and getting to know what will you cook later on helps to understand thai cooking. Bee xx

reviews.name: Peter de Laat
reviews.text: This is the most beautiful cooking class I ever see. So very clean with a nice location and very friendly staff. So a must to do when you stay in Chiang Mai.

reviews.name: Natalia Raczyńska
reviews.text: It was an exceptional experience! Starting with „door to door” pick up, then visiting local market, Bee’s property (spectacular with beautiful Garden) and ending with cooking and eating. The whole evening was amazing! I highly recommend.

Bee xx

reviews.name: Capi Copter
reviews.text: Wir haben zu zweit den Kochkurs besucht. Würden pünktlich am hotel in chiang mai abgeholt und sind direkt los zum dorfmarkt, in der Nähe der Kochschule. Wir waren an dem Nachmittag die beiden einzigen Schüler. Nach dem Markt Besuch, wo uns alles erklärt und gezeigt wurde sind wir weiter zur Schule in einer traumhaften Umgebung. Dort haben wir im biogarten alle anderen Zutaten zusammen gesucht und durften alles probieren. Anschließend haben wir mit unseren ersten Gericht angefangen. Nachdem dies fertig war, konnten wir dies in Ruhe genießen. So ging es nun weiter von Gericht zu Gericht. Am Ende erhielten wir ein umfangreiches Kochbuch und wurden zurück zum hotel gebracht. Es war eine wundervolle Erfahrung und hat sehr viel Spaß gemacht. Die Lehrerin spricht perfekt englisch und geht auf jede Sonderwünsche ein. Ein sehr guter Nachmittag mit leckerem Essen in einer wunderschönen Umgebung. Würden jederzeit diese Erfahrung wiederholen. MILES
reviews.textTranslated: The two of us attended the cooking class. We were picked up promptly from our hotel in Chiang Mai and went straight to the village market near the cooking school. We were the only two students that afternoon. After visiting the market, where everything was explained and demonstrated to us, we continued to the school, which is situated in a stunning setting. There, we gathered all the other ingredients from the organic garden and were allowed to taste everything. Then we started on our first dish. Once it was finished, we could enjoy it at our leisure. We continued from dish to dish in the same way. At the end, we received a comprehensive cookbook and were taken back to the hotel. It was a wonderful experience and a lot of fun. The teacher speaks perfect English and caters to every special request. A very good afternoon with delicious food in a beautiful setting. We would repeat this experience anytime. MILES
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you Miles!
I really enjoyed having you and Anna with me for the evening!  Cooking with you both was a pleasure.  I hope you can visit us again sometime!

Bee xx

p.s.  There are some videos of you both on: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCQ6Bd77KnPQNBbGWaxU5ipQ

reviews.name: M O
reviews.text: Bees Garden cooking school war ein super tolles Erlebnis. Der Garten liegt in einer ruhigen Umgebung und ist wunderschön. Der Kurs beginnt mit einer Führung über einen lokalen Markt, wo man viele neue Dinge kennen lernen kann und auch probieren darf. Anschließend geht es dann in den Garten, dort bekommt man ein Einblick was dort alles wächst und gedeiht, hier darf man auch gerne alles probieren was man in die Finger bekommt. Und dann geht es auch schon ans kochen, die Gerichte welche man kocht sind meistens relativ simpel und wirklich sehr lecker, sie werden in einer modernen und gut ausgestatteten Küche Zubereitet. Zum Schluss darf man sich dann etwas in der Hängematte ausruhen, bevor man wieder zurück zum Hotel gebracht wird. Dank der lebensfrohen und unterhaltsamen Art der Inhaberin hat man hier wirklich viel Spaß. Ich empfehle die Kochschule jedem der die thailändische Küche mag und sich gern damit auseinander setzen will.
reviews.textTranslated: Bees Garden cooking school was a fantastic experience. The garden is located in a peaceful setting and is absolutely beautiful. The course begins with a guided tour of a local market, where you can discover and sample many new things. Afterwards, you head into the garden, where you get a glimpse of everything that grows and thrives there, and you're welcome to taste anything you can get your hands on. Then it's time to cook! The dishes you prepare are mostly quite simple and incredibly delicious, and they're made in a modern and well-equipped kitchen. Finally, you can relax in a hammock before being taken back to your hotel. Thanks to the owner's cheerful and entertaining personality, you'll have a truly enjoyable time. I highly recommend this cooking school to anyone who loves Thai cuisine and wants to learn more about it.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Manuell for such a great review, it was great having such a skilled chef cooking at Bees Garden Cooking School.  Have a great time in Pai and hope to see you again!

title: Chakrit Muaythai School
address: 15 Sukhumvit 39, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand
plusCode: PHMC+28 Bangkok, Thailand

reviews.name: Oliver Noel
reviews.text: Great gym, I've been going for a few months now. The people are really friendly and the instructors help you improve in different strengths and weaknesses. The Visa process as also extremely quick and organized extremely well. Couldn't recommend them more.

reviews.name: Ashley Garcia
reviews.text: I can not complain about this gym. Did my visa here and I was helped since the first day I inquired.  All questions answered. I just needed to show up. Price is very reasonable and process is straight forward. Trainers are more than helpful when it comes to helping you get better and they have tons of experience. I would 100000% reccomend. The energy in this gym is amazing and uplifting.

reviews.name: Sofia Maria Rocco
reviews.text: I’ve been training Muay Thai for a few years so when I visited Bangkok I knew I wanted to find a gym to train at for my stay. I had a wonderful experience at Chakrit! I highly recommend it. The coaches are all a lot of fun and very knowledgeable, and you can tell they care about teaching you. I got very valuable instruction even tho I was only visiting for a week. It was a good combination of bag, pad work, sparring, and conditioning. Very well rounded! Also, the women who worked in the office were wonderful and so kind, always making sure I was comfortable and had what I needed. I would definitely come here again if I return to Bangkok!

reviews.name: Lavetta Cannon
reviews.text:
Studied at the school while on my ED Visa and they were amazing!!! I learned so much about the technique and history of Muay Thai. It's a very tough sport to learn so the fact that you get to work with so many different teachers with different fighting styles while studying makes a huge difference in your training. And the ladies in the office (Khun Aoy and Khun Nan) were so professional when it came to all the Immigration paperwork, i took away alot of the anxiety around the process.

I highly recommend this school! Especially if you're looking to do an ED Visa while learning a wonderful part of Thai culture. Muay Thai is such an amazing discipline, but you need the right kind of instruction to correctly learn and improve.

reviews.name: y.
reviews.text:
How can you charges 800 for the class which lasts shorter than 60 minutes? (This include sparring so not even 60min) No coach involvement, no teaching techniques or any helps just effortless padwork is worth 800?
Where in any asian country charges 800 baht for a gym that does not have any AC, high level fighters? I have lived in bangkok for more than 5 years and I have not seen one gym that charges over 650 per group session (which I think is still very expensive) when it is not a private class. Complete nonsense. The facility is not great quality as well and this gym should be avoided if you are trying many other gyms to find the fit for you. Charging 800 first time is ridiculous 😂

reviews.name: Art Life
reviews.text: My son (11) has been going to boxing and Muay Thai for several years in Denmark, so we wanted to get some training while we were on holiday. I highly recommend Chakrit if you want to fine tune your technique with an incredibly talented team of professional trainers and fighters.

reviews.name: O EN
reviews.text: The coach was terrible, had a awful attitude, was completely incompetent, and had absolutely no skill. Take my advice and don't waste your money.

reviews.name: Grace Dansirikul
reviews.text: It was my first time trying Muay Thai. When i arrived, I was greeted by the staffs and they were generous. Even though the price was a bit too high compared to how long the class was (45 mins). I still enjoyed every moment of it. The coaches there were friendly and funny. Their English isn’t that good, but still able to communicate with you. They provided sparring and pad work. They even corrected my techniques and let me took my time for resting. I would very much recommend you go try this place out.

reviews.name: Rohit Tripathi
reviews.text:
I paid 800 baht for 1 hour private training. Trained for 2 days.

The first day, the session lasted 35 minutes, and I was sent home. This included stretching, 4 rounds of pad work, 100 knees to the bag, 100 push kick and 50 crunches.

Second day was 5 rounds of pad work, and rest same and training time was 40 minutes.

I went to group training at other gyms, where i paid less. The durating was 1.5 hr, i still got 3-4 rounds of pad work with a trainer, 3-4 rounds of bag work, technique, sparring and more.

I felt disappointed with what Chakrit Muay Thai school has to offer.

I read other similar reviews which complained about training time being only 35-40 min.

I hope the gym changes its style to make their private training offering truly private and distinguished from group training.

reviews.name: Ulys
reviews.text:
Perfect MuayThai gym for beginners and intermediates.

Only 1/1 coaching wich is amazing.

1 class 800

15 class 6500 !

Have ED visa options

Teacher are kind and good

A must family gym

Must visit even beginers

reviews.name: JIHERO Channel
reviews.text: The most popular  muaythai in sukumvit  ppl in there very nice and kindly must go!

reviews.name: Fiona
reviews.text:
Nan is very accommodating and kind. Was my first time here for my short stop in BKK. Interesting they only do 1 on 1 sessions. The space is clean & nice. No frills. Thank you Jaroud for pointing out where I can improve in the short session we spent training 🙏🏼🤗 Communication easy.

I will say it might be hard to pick your specific trainer if it’s walk-in. The hour long sessions can also be cut short as they stop after the 5 rounds. It all depends - just communicate with the trainer & im sure they will accommodate.

reviews.name: Stefan Shilgalis
reviews.text: This is the perfect Muay Thai gym for me.  I have very little experience in Muay Thai but that didn’t matter to my trainer who took me through five rounds of of work and then some coaching on the heavy bag.   The atmosphere is great and the location is very convenient.   I had a good experience communicating with management prior to my visit so I knew what to expect.  I signed up for 15 classes and can’t wait to see the progress.

reviews.name: Louis Bois
reviews.text: Amazing gym I go there about 3x a week since almost a year now. I initially went there for the visa but since I really enjoyed Muay Thai I wanted to keep training so I did. The trainers are super fun and you can quickly build friendships with them.

reviews.name: Michael Shuldman
reviews.text:
This is not  a traditional muay thai gym, but a place for having one-on-one sessions with a trainer, then leave, or hang out and continue training on your own on the heavy bags.

It's fairly well organized and I will recommend it for people who already know the basics and want to do muay thai for fitness, or for people who want to learn some basics, but don't have the time/motivation/whatever to attend a regular muay thai gym.

Trainers vary a bit.  Some are advanced and able to correct and improve the technique of intermediate and advanced fighters/ex-fighters, while other trainers are more suitable for beginners or fitness training mostly.

You can come, usually quickly get a trainer, do your 30-45 minute session, and then continue your day.  Perfect if that's what you want.

reviews.name: Corinna Seitz
reviews.text:
The reason I went with Chakrit is that they offer a 6 months Muay Thai visa (please keep in mind that I got this visa before Thailand introduced the new Digital Nomad visa). Here is my experience:

- you will not learn many skills here since the trainers are not very interested in your improvement
- most trainers do not correct you if you do a movement incorrect
- each session you will train 5 times for 3 minutes pad work (however, sometimes the trainers try to reduce the 3 min to 1.5 min. In this case you have to tell them you want to train the full 3 min.)
- almost every session you’ll have a different trainer, nobody monitors your progress
- in 6 months I never once learned how to defend myself or any kind of special moves
- after the pad work some trainers will instruct you to do some weight lifting exercises. However, some trainers just ignore you and tend to the next student

If you want to get a Muay Thai study visa, this place is okay. However, I recommend getting the new Digital Nomad visa instead (it’s cheaper and you can learn Muay Thai at a school that actually teaches you skills)

reviews.name: Ben Jutabha
reviews.text: Very nice and welcoming people. Good for beginners

reviews.name: Maxim Eliseev
reviews.text:
My wife and I have attended the gym for a year total.
There are a lot of Muay Thai gyms in Bangkok, but few offers Muay Thai visa. But Chakrit Muay Thai gym is the one I would recommend. We bought half a year MT visa and had no problem getting the visa, enjoyed attending sessions, and developed great endurance. Also, immigration officers likes these visas and treat you nice.

We stayed with Chakrit gym for another half year - just buying packages. The gym itself has no group classes, just individual sessions. Muay Thai visa is the best type of visa you can make in Thailand, and Chakrit gym is the best to get it.

Chakrit and his wife are running this gym for many years, constantly buying new gear. It doesn’t look fancy, but extremely comfortable. The atmosphere is super friendly, and teachers are not only nice people, but also professional and fierce fighters.
Miss it very much!

reviews.name: The one
reviews.text:
I was there two times.
The first time was ok, good trainer.
The second time with other trainer was bad. 5 peds rounds with the same combinations. He didn't try to fix my technique. I told him that i can't throw a high kick because injury but he still wanted me to throw high kick. I ask him to teach me push kick, but he ignore the request.
In general the trainers here doesn't understand english at all.
After 40 min the lesson is over !..They will not guide you for other exercises.
I hope the owner will talk with the trainers to be more creative with combinations.
Some people will like this gym and his program and because the price but i will not go to this gym again

reviews.name: Desmond Lee
reviews.text:
1.During the warm up time, the trainer were busy chatting to a new client who were signed up for PT session.
2.after 5mins of Stretching, then come to warm up session, the trainer ask me to do skipping, oh ya then he went to talk to the girl client again and never do any observation on my warm up.
3.after the skipping done, there were 5 rounds of pad works with the trainer, 2 mins per round, everytime after 2 mins padworks done the trainer went to talk or flirt? With the new female client, and asked me to rest for 1 mins, even the bell went off, he was still busy flirting. In summary, the trainer only did a 10 to 12mins pad works with me.
4.the most funniest part is, after the 5 rounds padworks done, this trainer ask me to do the knee on the punching bags and ask me do sit up, then he started to train the female client while i only did 30mins training in total. And when he start the pad works with the girl, meant my session finish, and didnt even bother to guide me for the rest of my sessions lol.
5. Dear owner dont argue with me regarding above points, my friend had recorded the whole training session.
6. Guys, pls search for other places if you looking for a professional trainer. Absolutely not this!

MAVINN Muay Thai began its journey in 2016 as a Muay Thai boxing camp. Over a decade of dedication, we have cultivated and introduced elite talent into the global Muay Thai industry, spanning both domestic and international circuits.

Today, MAVINN Muay Thai is opening its doors to the world. Our new, state-of-the-art facility offers world-class amenities paired with the expertise of master trainers. reviews.name: Connie Hum
reviews.text: Just finished my first trial Muay Thai class here and had an amazing experience! The coaches are super enthusiastic and friendly. It's a great environment with many professional fighters training together, which creates an awesome and motivating vibe. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Andre Foo
reviews.text: Attended their 4pm to 6pm class and throughly enjoyed their hospitality in welcoming foreign students to train there. Trainers there attended to me straight away when I reached, fighters there are friendly to engage with me to train with them. Administration was smooth and they went the extra mile to ensure I get the merchandise that I like. Recommend students of all levels to give this gym a try!

reviews.name: A
reviews.text: I had a great training session at Mavinn Muay Thai. The welcome was very warm, and the atmosphere in the gym was excellent. You can really feel their passion for Muay Thai and the positive energy in the gym. Thank you to the whole team for the warm welcome.

reviews.text:
Good Gym!

The group session was full of fighters,and I felt like “ is it ok for me to join?” at first, but they were all welcoming and kind.

Even top fighters taught me patiently 🙏

Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Mark Cleary
reviews.text: Singha Mawynn is without a doubt a superb gym in every capacity. They have legendary trainers including The Emperor Namsaknoi, Kaolan, Koanar and numerous other fabulous trainers. Their stable of fighters is best of the best and includes several ONE CHAMPIONSHIP fighters, 4 RWS CHAMPIONS, Channel 7 stadium champion fighters, and numerous other up and coming stars. The owner Marco, and the manager who oversees everything, Mac, are both incredibly kind, caring, generous and very warm individuals. After fighting and training in Thailand for the past 40 years I feel this gym offers the best training opportunities and experiences, and certainly welcomes all students and fighters with kind, open arms. It’s a true family feeling. I strongly recommend this gym to any individual interested in Muay Thai. I simply can’t thank them enough for all they have done, and continue to do for me and my fighters from Canada who I brought here to train. 🙏🥊🇹🇭❤️

reviews.text:
Lost for words. I was so lucky to experience the muay thai training here. They take you in like a family. If you the understanding of the basics of muay thai then you will learn a lot! I will say as a fighter or a coach you have to see how the guys do it. Namsaknoi and Kaolan Kaovitchit. Fightere like Loempo, Tapaokaew etc is also helping you.

I hope I can stay there longere next year.

Believe me the price is worth it. 🙏🏾❤️

reviews.name: J C
reviews.text:
State of the art facility and world class people in it. They have stadium champions of current and past; Namsaknoi “The Emperor”, Kaolan Kaovichit, Tapaokaew Singmawynn, and Kaonar to name a few, there are many many more. They cater to both Thais and foreigners alike as they speak fluent in English as well. Very clean and well equipped indoor facilities.

I had the pleasure to train with Kru Namsaknoi who has been a personal hero of mine and meeting/training with such a humble person really showed me that Muay Thai is truly for everyone.

Kop khun maa krub to Singmawynn Muay Thai gym and Kru Namsaknoi

700 baht per person

reviews.name: Thomas Alatti
reviews.text:
The female masseuse was very polite, friendly and I felt very relaxed afterwards. I enjoyed the massage. It’s also a very reasonable price so I tipped her well.

However, this is the noisiest massage parlour I’ve ever been to. Throughout the massage, I could hear a sliding door closing and opening constantly, and hear loud conversations next door for the entire 1 hour I was there. It made the experience overall not that great. I’ve never experienced this before.

I hope this business understands that customers come for a quiet, relaxing experience. Your clients don’t want to hear shouting when they are trying to relax. Because of this, I won’t come back again and I wouldn’t recommend friends to either.

reviews.text: I went there around 5 pm, but didn’t know it was a cooking school in mornings/afternoon. The restaurant is authentic, original and beautiful. One of the best places I have tried in my whole life. I would just call before you go, they use to be very busy.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your five-stars

reviews.name: Sandra Greensill
reviews.text: There were only two of us for the cooking class and it went ahead. The tutor was very informative and the food we cooked was amazing and so very delicious. Thai cooking made easy. They are even going to email us recipes.

reviews.name: Jasmijn Sluijs
reviews.text:
We did the morning cooking class. Long story: it was not what we expected. The morning started with a visit to the local market, but we didn't buy anything and got little to no explanation. We just literally walked behind the chef and that´s it. He didn't even buy something so all together it was a really weird experience. After that we went to the cooking school, but that was weird as well. Everyone can choose from a good variation of dishes (you can choose 4 in total), but there was only one chef for 12 guests. So the whole time everyone was just waiting while some of us received instructions. It was sooo much waiting ... The cooking itself is a disappointment as well; you literally throw things together on comand, and just stir a little. That´s truly it. Not much explanation and no room at all for individuality. We didn't even got to cut up our own vegetables. Everything was already prepared, we just had to throw everything in a pan. If you already spenned some time in Thailand, the food isn't even good. It tastes quite cheap and some of us even didn't feel good in the stomach afterwards.
The only good thing about the cooking class is that the chef was really trying his best, but unfortunately that was not enough.

reviews.name: Shai Ronen
reviews.text: Amazing cooking class. We were collected from the hotel, selected 4 dishes that we would like to cook, went to a guided tour in a small local market, prepared everything, and ate. It was so gentle, professional, delicious, fun. Great half day adventure.

reviews.name: Jerome DeLain
reviews.text:
Excellent Thai Massage Experience!

I had two amazing visits at Bamboo Da Thai Massage, conveniently located across from my hotel. My first session was a foot and leg massage with a wonderful therapist nicknamed Lotus—she was friendly, animated, and gave an incredible massage that really focused on my calves and ankles.

Later that evening, I had an upper back and shoulder massage with Gon, who was exceptional. He noticed my tightness and even how my movement was limited, then suggested I return for a focused session. I did—and it turned into a two-hour massage with an herbal heat compress that was deeply therapeutic. Gon used translation to communicate, took his time, and truly cared about improving my mobility.

Highly recommend this spa and especially Gon for his skill and professionalism!

reviews.text:
My wife and I had an absolutely awful experience here. We came in midday and waited 10-ish minutes for a second masseuse to come for our 1 hour foot massage. There was only 1 masseuse in the store at the time. We honestly didn’t mind waiting.

Then when the massage started it was extremely bad. The two men who did the massages were very distracted and one of them was constantly looking down at his phone while doing the same back and forth movement on my foot. They both at various times got up from the massage to do something.

About half way into the massage 3-4 other massage therapists showed up and with each therapist showing up there was more ruckus and distraction. Talking, texting, etc

There was no solid technique to the massage rather just rubbing back and forth for an hour. It was not relaxing at all and there was no type of relief felt

To top it all off they have a cat who is very cute but is also jumping all over the clean massage beds after being outside, making the place dirty.

Avoid at all costs.

Just back from nearby massage parlour. Originally told lady boss only wanted an hour Thai massage to try out first if like then extend. An hour is at 250 thb quite a fair pricing.

Usually I don't chat and prefer quiet time but lady boss Ms Aom was exceptionally hospitable so I obliged. Somehow the chat lead to her advising me on tips to travel in Chiangmai such as where to go for great local shopping and food. This indirectly relaxed my body and hence less pain for Thai massage. Promptly I extended another hour massage at additional 250 thb. I went with a lower right backache on right side but the pain miraculously gone after Thai massage.

Ms Aom is a one lady show shop with 20 over years of massage experience she said. Do expect slight disruption on calls pickup. Her skills are professional with firm and constant  medium pressure throughout without nerve racking pain. She was thoughtful and kept checking if you had pain or felt cold throughout the massage session. Shop also played relaxing music.

Later I gave a small tip and added her in line for correspondence.  She sweetly line me good shops to visit. I  would definitely support her again for my next. Well done 👍

reviews.name: Wayne Lim
reviews.text:
One of the hidden gems in Chiang Mai for a good massage. Located at Wua Lai 1 Alley. Outside the alley can be crowded and blocked by streets stalls during weekend street market, but still managed to find it with maps navigation.

Victoria Massage offers packages with great deals. For the session, I chose 2 hour Aroma Oil Massage (990 Baht), and my masseur is Khun Tui. Before the real action, the front desk will provide a form to fill up my details, along with preferred massage strength, any sickness ie. Pregnancy, High Blood Pressure, Injuries & etc. that the masseur should take note, and body parts that I would like to focus. As for the Aroma oil, there are 3 selections: Thai Smile (citrus), Rice Milk, and Thai Aromatic (Lemongrass). They also provide Panpuri, could be for premium packages, or with add-ons.

On the skills wise, Khun Tui did a good job on my back pain and sore calf due to long hour flights (almost 4 hours) and walking exploration around Chiang Mai old city & street markets. His elbow pushes the pain away, I really can feel the sores crying inside my body, and my body feels relieved with lesser pain points. A credit for him, his hands are warm (rare not everyone has it), imagine with hot oil massage, it will be awesomely goooooddd.

There's no minimum tips. Do tip wisely for the services.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much 💓

reviews.name: EdT
reviews.text:
Recommended by a Thai friend, I visited this place because they claimed to use coconut oil from Phutawan, one of my favorite local brands in Thailand. However, the coconut oil used during my session didn’t have the distinctive scent that I associate with Phutawan.

The therapist was skilled and applied medium pressure, which was exactly what I needed after walking around 15,000 steps a day for the past few days. Under normal circumstances, I would prefer much stronger pressure.

In my opinion, the quality of the experience depends more on the therapist you get rather than the establishment itself. So if you come across negative reviews, they may reflect individual therapists rather than the overall standard of the place.

reviews.name: Landon Brickey
reviews.text: Victoria's was clean, quiet, and relaxing. I tried the 2 hour aroma oil massage with Wit and it was great. The staff was warm and welcoming, and the front desk staff has you fill out a form to select your massage preferences and lets you pick out your oil from four different selections. The session started with a light foot scrub and then a shower. I requested a light to medium massage and Wit did an excellent job, using many techniques.

reviews.name: Boston Blake
reviews.text:
Excellent 2-hour massage from Print. I asked if he could spend extra time on my neck and shoulders tension. He went above and beyond. Such relief.

The space is clean, intentional, and beautifully appointed — and everyone kind and friendly. I’ll be going again soon.

reviews.name: Chingting Hong
reviews.text:
I had an extremely poor experience here today. From the very beginning, the foot wash was done in a very sloppy and careless manner.

While the therapist seemed to have the basic skills, the pressure was far too strong for me. When I asked him to go lighter, he became passive-aggressive and started barely touching me (just stroking). I even used a translation app to explain specifically: "Please be gentle and slow with stretches or when stepping on my body, but normal finger pressure is fine."

Instead of being professional, the therapist looked at me with disdain and even dismissively mentioned, "I know how to massage."

The attitude was so disrespectful that I couldn't even finish the session. I left halfway through, and the reception refunded me 100 THB. I am not sure about other therapist, but today I had a really terrible experience.

By the way, the staff at the reception was not very willing to help. She didn't seem to sincerely care about the situation or have any intention of truly understanding the problem to help resolve it. Looked like she just wanted to brush it off.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
ทางร้านได้รับทราบถึงข้อเสนอแนะของคุณแล้ว และต้องขออภัยหากประสบการณ์ที่ได้รับไม่เป็นไปตามความคาดหวัง อย่างไรก็ตาม ทางร้านขออนุญาตชี้แจงข้อเท็จจริงในส่วนของพนักงานและขั้นตอนการให้บริการดังนี้ครับ:
​การคัดเลือกผู้นวด: เนื่องจากคุณลูกค้า Walk-in เข้ามาในช่วงเวลา 21:30 น. ซึ่งเป็นคิวสุดท้าย ทางร้านจึงจัดสรรพนักงานที่พร้อมให้บริการตามมาตรฐาน โดยพนักงานท่านดังกล่าว (หมอตุ้ย) เป็นผู้เชี่ยวชาญที่มีประสบการณ์นวดแก้อาการกว่า 10 ปี ซึ่งปกติจะมีน้ำหนักมือที่เป็นมาตรฐานสำหรับการนวดแผนไทย ประเภทนี้
​การสื่อสารและการแก้ไขปัญหา: ทางร้านเสียใจที่เกิดความเข้าใจผิดเรื่องน้ำหนักมือ แม้จะมีการปรับเปลี่ยนตามคำขอแล้วแต่ยังไม่ตรงตามความต้องการของคุณลูกค้า ซึ่งทางเราได้พยายามดูแลอย่างเต็มที่ในขณะนั้น
​การสิ้นสุดการบริการ: คุณลูกค้าได้ยุติการนวดในช่วง 15 นาทีสุดท้ายก่อนครบเวลา ซึ่งทางร้านได้แสดงความรับผิดชอบด้วยการคืนเงินจำนวนหนึ่งให้เพื่อความสบายใจ แม้ว่าการบริการจะดำเนินมาเกือบครบเวลาแล้วก็ตาม
​ทางร้านขอน้อมรับคำติชมเพื่อนำไปปรับปรุงบริการให้ดียิ่งขึ้น และหวังว่าคุณลูกค้าจะเข้าใจในส่วนของระเบียบการจองคิวและการจัดการของทางร้านครับ ขอบคุณครับ

reviews.text: 5 stars from me. If you want to truly relax, this is the place. What a beautiful spa and considerate staff. Highly recommend a two-hour massage

reviews.name: shikai ko
reviews.text: I went there for the first time last night and it was an absolutely terrible experience.  I arrived at the store around 22:10 and planned to do a 2-hour essential oil massage package. The receptionist told me that because it closed at 23:30, I could only do a 1-and-a-half-hour package.  Then I went upstairs to take off my clothes and take a shower, which took about 10 minutes to prepare. The massage started at about 22:22, but the masseuse ended at about 23:32, and he also went to the toilet during the massage, which took a long time.  This is equivalent to my actual massage time being only about 1 hour.  This behavior of cutting corners and deceiving customers happened to me for the first time in a Thai massage shop. First of all, I was not informed in advance that the 90-minute package could only be served at 23:30, nor was I informed that bathing time was also included in the massage time. Moreover, the masseuse's techniques were very unprofessional. He would only use brute force to overwhelm me, which was very painful and did not provide any special services.  Finally, because the front desk was off duty, I asked the masseur to refund my money. He was very reluctant at first, but later drove me out the door and made me wait outside for a long time before refunding me for 20 minutes. It was very rude, unapologetic, and had a bad attitude. Everyone must avoid this store. The service was perfunctory, the water in the shower was very cold, and the air conditioning temperature in the room was also very low, very cold. The price was about 1,000 baht, and what happened was very scary. It was all a real experience last night.

reviews.name: EY
reviews.text: A hidden gem in the downtown behind the Wua Lai Walking Street. It’s so far the cleanest men’s massage spa I’ve visited. The large massage room is immaculate and exudes elegance. The massage mattress is large and comfy. I didn’t experience any neck pain lying face down. My two-hour hot oil massage with Nong Kiti was truly a bliss. Kiti excels in delivering deep tissue massage, which significantly alleviated my back pains. One thing that particularly impressed me was that he’d help to wipe off the oil with the towel after completing each session. So I didn’t find myself covered in greasy oil after the whole treatment. Small things as such show that Kiti is a gentle, considerate, and detail-oriented therapist. I highly recommend him if you want to experience a quality massage. Another branch of this shop is called Victor’s Massage located at Tha Pae. I’ve visited that branch twice, but I personally think Victoria’s Massage is the better of the two, with more capable staff and a more pleasant environment.

ไปลองคอร์สสระผมผ่อนคลายของ RIRAKKU มา ประทับใจตั้งแต่บรรยากาศร้านที่เงียบ สะอาด และให้ความรู้สึกผ่อนคลายมาก มีการใช้น้ำมันสมุนไพรและดนตรีบำบัดช่วยสร้างความสบายตั้งแต่เริ่มคอร์ส

ขั้นตอนค่อนข้างครบ ทั้งนวดศีรษะ นวดคอ บ่า ไหล่ นวดแขน มาส์กหน้า ประคบสมุนไพร และแช่เท้าด้วยเกลือหิมาลายัน ทำให้รู้สึกเหมือนได้ทำสปาแบบเต็มรูปแบบมากกว่าการสระผมทั่วไป จุดที่ชอบเป็นพิเศษคือการนวดศีรษะและการนวดอโรม่าบริเวณคอ บ่า ไหล่ ช่วยคลายความเมื่อยล้าได้ดีมาก

ผลิตภัณฑ์ที่ใช้เป็นออร์แกนิก กลิ่นหอมอ่อน ๆ ไม่ฉุน และปิดท้ายด้วยการเป่าผมด้วย Dyson AirStrait ทำให้ผมเรียบสวย ไม่ชี้ฟู

โดยรวมถือว่าคุ้มค่ากับราคา 890 บาท เหมาะสำหรับคนที่ต้องการพักผ่อน คลายความเครียด และดูแลทั้งหนังศีรษะ หน้าทคอ บ่า ไหล่ ในครั้งเดียว แนะนำให้ลองสักครั้งค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated:
Premium Relaxing Hair Wash (1 hour 45 minutes) (890 THB) ⭐️ (I went during a promotion and got a 10% discount!)

I tried RIRAKKU's relaxing hair wash course and was impressed from the moment I arrived. The atmosphere was quiet, clean, and very relaxing. They used herbal oils and music therapy to create a comfortable feeling from the start of the treatment.

The process was quite comprehensive, including head, neck, shoulder, and arm massage, face mask, herbal compress, and Himalayan salt foot soak. It felt more like a full spa treatment than a regular hair wash. My favorite parts were the head massage and the aromatherapy massage on my neck, shoulders, and back – it was excellent for relieving fatigue.

The products used were organic, with a light, pleasant scent that wasn't overpowering. The treatment ended with a Dyson AirStrait blow-dry, leaving my hair smooth and frizz-free.

Overall, it's worth the 890 THB price. It's perfect for those who want to relax, relieve stress, and take care of their scalp, face, neck, and shoulders all in one go. I highly recommend trying it at least once.

reviews.name: Marin Relja
