reviews.name: Baz
reviews.text:
One of the better “duck in and out” massage places in the Nimman area. Went 4 times during my trip and never left disappointed. Very consistent masseurs - esp this gentleman, he’s a legend!

Very affordable and very clean.

reviews.name: NC CN
reviews.text: I booked a 2-hour massage, but the actual massage time was no more than 1 hour and 40 minutes. The session time started before the massage began, including time for changing clothes maybe. Normally, it’s not like this

reviews.name: Ashley H
reviews.text: Good Environment, Reasobly priced and friendly staff. Very near Eastin Gan 🏨

reviews.name: Tiffany Tan
reviews.text: The front desk/ cashier have the worst attitude and service ever. Stated close at 11pm. I ask what’s the last call timing (if I were to get a 2hours massage) to visit he/she said 9pm. Then I ask to book an aroma oil for 2 hours. She just said no and ask me to go other shop. Wow! When at the first place I have stated all and they just suddenly said they can’t do. Why waste time at the first place

reviews.name: Patrick Cheung
reviews.text: I was having massage very quietly. Later a group of people speaking putonghua came to the same floor with me. The atmosphere changed completely. They spoke and laughed loudly. I was arranged to another floor. Peaceful again. Very relaxing if you are away from the source of noise.

reviews.name: Li Naomi
reviews.text: I chose a one-hour Thai massage. My masseuse was very kind and had good skills. She didn't press too hard but always hit the key points. Moreover, she was willing to chat with me in English. Knowing that I was going to Chiang Rai in a few days, she enthusiastically recommended me some delicious restaurants. It was really a great experience!

reviews.name: Yuki Shiu
reviews.text: Value for money! We walked in for  a foot+shoulder massage which only costed 350baht for 1 hour, although it mention shoulder, but they massage your whole back after foot massage.

reviews.name: Jenny Noe
reviews.text: I left with a bruised shin and sore legs, extremely poor customer service (same thing happened to my friend that went in with me). There’s no trained masseuse there, they will just rub your shin uncomfortably for the whole hour with some oil. Hella bad attitude from the staff and the manager was impossible to communicate with.. the whole establishment feels like a scam, targeting gullible tourists who won’t be back anyways, such a wasted opportunity at a good location like that. Would never recommend it, waste of valuable time and money in exchange for pain and terrible experience. Management needs to do better, they’ll have a lawsuit coming their way soon if this continues.

reviews.name: Lily Ramírez
reviews.text: The 4 that we went in, we did not liked our massage, the back massage with no oil or balm created a lot of friction and left our skin sore shortly after the massage. The strength was not well applied, as it is in other places. And we all have muscle pain in our backs and necks. They are probably lacking training, and they keep in business because of the location 🥺

reviews.name: Giacomo
reviews.text: Good massage - friendly staff - good location - not expensive

reviews.name: Dennis Goh
reviews.text: Good massage and decent price. If you need more pressure, do ask for it!

reviews.name: Jozsef Buky
reviews.text: I just stopped in on a whim for a foot massage and had the best therapist. She was perfect in her pressure, technique, and symmetry. I was able to completely relax despite the outside noise and feel refreshed. I will be back again and recommend this place.

reviews.name: Vickie Yong
reviews.text: I came here the first time for foot massage, it was superb. The masseuse Nui was so good that she knows all the right acupoints to press on. Their way of massage is really different from other parlors. I booked the same masseuse for another thai massage, she was really great at it. It’s the best massage i had so far in thailand!

reviews.name: Clare Hart
reviews.text: My partner and me had an excellent thai massage here for 300B each. The rooms are nice, you get a light cotton comfortable massage outfit to put on. We had our own little area with 2 soft floor massage beds and a privacy curtain. The pressure used for the massages was just right for us. A man massaged him and i had a lady massage me. We were very comfortable with the whole experience. We’d definitely go back.

reviews.name: A Jin
reviews.text: I would like to express my opinion about this massage shop. I parked my car in front of the store. In order to ask for service But a man (I think it was the owner's husband) came and spoke in a very hostile tone (bad language) and with an expression that was very dissatisfied. that it smelled of smoke and chased me to park my car somewhere else I haven't asked anything about the store yet. Then I drove out in my car. And I came back to think that this shop has a bad attitude and manners, so I recommend finding a new massage shop. If you think you will use this shop, you should think again. For me, I will not come to use this shop.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: I'm sorry, I don't have a husband. Before you write anything,  you said that this shop is not friendly. You've never come to get a massage.  So how do you know if it Complain about my shop. Even though you had no intention of coming to get a massage, you came to see your friend in the dormitory behind my shop. You had bad intentions with my shop. I saw you run inside the dormitory.you aYou are angry at the man who told you to do it for you, but you shouldn't have written that you gave it to my shop because my shop isn't related to you guys and you didn't plan on coming for a massage.

reviews.name: Vasily Simon M.
reviews.text:
if you're looking for a relaxing massage or if it's one of your first massage experiences in Thailand, it's fine, you might enjoy it. but I'm a bit of a massage connoisseur and I was not happy with the oil massage.

I got up halfway and left, the light touch was getting on my nerves. And I did politely ask for more pressure. This place is not cheap for what it is either. Needless to say, I won't be back.

reviews.name: Alejandro Paz
reviews.text: The best massage place in Chiang Mai without a doubt. 1 hour Thai massage, the masseuse was super nice and pleasant. She took away all my back pain!! I will go back without thinking twice.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for the good review you wrote for me. I hope we will meet again and I will improve my massage skills. I hope you will come back to my shop for a massage again. Thank you very much. 🥰🥰🙏

reviews.name: Kristina Jones
reviews.text: I recently experienced 2 different massages here! One was a Thai Massage and the next day a Thai/Oil Massage - both were truly exceptional. The skilled therapist combined traditional techniques with a serene atmosphere, creating a deeply relaxing session. The kindness and attention to detail made the entire experience memorable. I could tell that certain tight spots were paid more attention to and when I mentioned my lower back and hips being in pain they helped relieve the issues. The practitioners  here know what they're doing! After the massage I enjoyed hot tea and a friendly conversation with the owner. I highly recommend this place for anyone seeking an authentic Thai massage in Chiang Mai!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: I would like to thank you for the review. I am very glad to hear this. I will continue to improve my skills. You are a very good and lovely customer. I hope you will come again. Thank you very much❤❤

reviews.name: nei huynh
reviews.text: I hope to write this review so that the owner can improve the guest experience in the future. To my disappointment, my massage therapist technique was just okay, it feels like he is rushing to finish, not really therapeutic at all. He also has a runny nose so he keeps sniffling so that makes me feel a bit tense right from the beginning. Secondly, his cell phone keeps vibrating nearby and his necklace keeps making distracting noises while giving the massage that elevates my tenseness. Lastly, the place is very small so you can hear everything. Besides the sound of motorbikes coming and going, I can hear the opening and closing of door, and conversation between my therapist and the other person, so that's very annoying on top of already feeling tense. Finally, two very noisy customers came in making all kind of noises changing their clothes and getting settled in, then they started to casually chat right next to me. It didn't help that their therapist also asking them questions to start more conversation while I am literally a foot away from them. I was so frustrated at the last 20 minutes of my massage that I almost got up and left but didn't want to be rude. I feel more tense than before I get the massage. I have to say that was probably the worst massage experience I have ever had. The woman massage therapist apologized at the end but that didn't help with the bad experience.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: But I think if you encounter a problem or you are dissatisfied with something, you should tell me so I can find a solution and help you feel good, or maybe change someone to massage you to relax. It would be better. You don't have to be patient to get a massage.  If the time is up and you tell me later like this, I'm sorry again.

reviews.name: Michelle
reviews.text: Massager is really professional and friendly even if it's just a small shop. There's limited space for 3 people only, so if you come in a big group, it is better to make appointments (lady boss needs to contact other massager it takes some time) and split in group so you don't waste time waiting.

reviews.name: Steven Ostling
reviews.text: We stayed in Chang Mai for a week and we went here for a massage on day one. I'm glad we did because we came back every day thereafter. Noot is so sweet and caring. She creates a relaxing environment and she is so loving and nurturing. I had pain in my upper back and shoulders and she paid special attention in that area. She also helped with some knee pain and ankle pain I was experiencing on other days. She even offered some lovely tea after the massage and recommendations around town. I cannot recommend enough and I will go back as soon as I'm back in Chang Mai.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: I would like to thank you for the review. I am very glad to hear this. I will continue to improve my skills. You are a very good and lovely customer. I hope you will come again. Thank you very much🥰🙏

reviews.text: Excellent thai massage. She really focused a lot on my tight shoulders, one of the most therapeutic thai massages I have ever received.

reviews.name: Samogon iz lapukhov
reviews.text: Обожаю это место!!! Хожу сюда 3 раза в неделю,  давно не испытывала такого блаженства. После постоянного ношения ребёнка на руках моя спина уже забыла, что такое расслабление и жизнь без режима вареной креветки. Меня буквально поставили на место за два сеанса (тайский и расслабляющий массаж). Мастер сразу нашла мою проблемную зону и большую часть времени уделяла именно ей. Сейчас ничего не болит, и я просто наслаждаюсь отличным глубоким массажем! К какому бы мастеру я не попала, никто не разочаровал, здесь действительно все знают своё дело. Цены очень демократичные - такой результат стоит гораздо дороже. Тут нет атмосферы дорогого спа, но если вам важен результат, настоятельно рекомендую это место. Единственное, о чём жалею, что не пришла сюда раньше.
reviews.textTranslated: I adore this place!!! I come here three times a week and haven't felt such bliss in a long time. After constantly carrying my baby in my arms, my back has forgotten what relaxation and life without boiled shrimp are. I was literally put back in my place in two sessions (Thai and relaxing massage). The therapist immediately found my problem area and spent most of her time on it. Now nothing hurts, and I simply enjoy a wonderful deep massage! No matter which therapist I've seen, no one has disappointed me; everyone here truly knows their stuff. The prices are very reasonable – this kind of result is worth much more. It doesn't have the atmosphere of an expensive spa, but if results are important to you, I highly recommend this place. My only regret is that I didn't come here sooner.

reviews.name: Света Мак
reviews.text: Делала оил массаж, попросила слабенький. Такого кровотока в спине за свою жизнь я еще не ощущала. Полтора часа прошли максимально полезно и хорошо для тела. Примерно с таким лицом я лежала на массаже и периодически подбирала слюни
reviews.textTranslated: I had an oil massage, asking for a gentle one. I've never felt such blood flow in my back in my life. The hour and a half was incredibly beneficial and good for my body. I lay there during the massage with a face like this, drooling periodically.

reviews.name: Wunda Stone
reviews.text:
Space nicely laid out, clean and thoughtfully furnished. The receptionist was also attentive and accommodating. Unfortunately, these were the only pleasantries at this massage shop.

My therapist's (for Thai massage) understanding of applying pressure is limited and incorrect multiple times. She also had long figure nails, and at times I just had to endure occasionally stabbings here and there - not something I'd expect AT ALL in any massage establishments.  The therapist also wasn't proactive, and NEVER asks if the pressure was adequate. Not only the long nails is troublesome; it also reflects on the poor sense of hygeine and professionalism from the therapist, and management that allows her to operate. My massage timing was only 30 minutes so I didn't bother asking much.

I can only summarise my impression as a neat looking massage shop with unprofessional setup, unfortunately.

reviews.text: Me & sis enjoyed our Thai massage here! Menu is English & Mandarin friendly, masseuse recommended us their signature Thai massage, is good 👍! I think the traditional Thai massages put more focus on the legs (mostly), this Thai massage 1 will spread out evenly for the back, legs, arms, neck & head 🥰 if u are here at central Phuket & looking for a massage, can give them a try :)

reviews.text:
Great massage and service. My mum and I had a great and relaxing 2 hours massage. And they prepared this simple but sweet surprise.
As with the other reviews, there was indeed some noise from the mall. But by focusing on the spa music and the soothing strokes of the masseuse, I was able to tune out those noise. Still a wonderful experience.

reviews.name: Mikhail Kalita
reviews.text:
I paid for a one-hour foot massage performed by two different therapists, but in the end only my right leg was massaged while my left leg was not massaged at all.

We chose a one-hour foot massage. At first, we were seated in regular chairs even though we were wearing jeans. We asked how the massage would be done in that case, and were told to go and change, which we did.

My girlfriend’s massage started shortly after, while I had to wait about 10 minutes for my therapist. When the therapist finally arrived, I was asked to move to another seat, which I did. The massage began, but after about 10 minutes the manager came and changed my therapist in the middle of the session.

The new therapist started the massage with cold hands and continued the session. However, despite the massage lasting for a full hour in total and being performed by two different therapists, only my right leg was massaged. My left leg was left completely without oil, while the right leg was already covered in it.

I asked the manager how long she had been working in this business and whether she knew that once a therapist has started the massage, they should not be changed. She confirmed that she knew, but apologized and explained that the therapist had another client with a prior booking.

In the end, I paid for a full one-hour massage but received treatment on only one leg. The manager simply apologized and offered no solution.

On top of that, the price here is about 2.5 times higher than in other professional massage salons.

I absolutely do not recommend this place. It is very difficult to call this a real massage salon — it feels more like a training practice for beginners.

reviews.name: Stephen Chan
reviews.text: A serene oasis in the heart of Central Department Store! Tucked away on the ground floor, Nuad Massage offers a peaceful escape from the hustle and bustle. The environment is clean and calming, with soothing spa music setting the tone. The masseuse is skilled and attentive, providing a truly relaxing experience. The only drawback is that some customers can be inconsiderate and talk during their massage, disrupting the tranquil atmosphere. Otherwise, Nuad Massage is a wonderful spot to unwind and rejuvenate.

reviews.text: I had a massage today with Noi (I think that was her name). I requested a light and soft massage and that’s exactly what I got. title: The Spa @ Paradox Resort Phuket
ownerDescription:
Welcome to The Spa, located at the 5-star Paradox Resort Phuket, Karon Beach, which balances the traditions of Eastern and Western treatments to create indulging mind, body and soul-soothing experiences. From the elegant Sala lounge areas to the serene villa treatment rooms – all are infused with an ambiance enhanced by touches of Thai aesthetic charm.

Scenic outdoor bathing pools and couples-friendly suites accentuate The Spa philosophy of providing an intimate, rejuvenating haven for sharing those special moments. Renewing treatments available range from traditional massages to body scrubs, facials and wraps that incorporate local, tropical ingredients for the ultimate pampering experience.

reviews.name: Yvette Shaqir
reviews.text: While staying at the Paradox hotel I had the opportunity to use their beautiful and serene spa. And while there are many Massage options in town, the spa was sophisticated in private and competitively priced. I highly recommend the 90 minute deep tissue massage 🤩 🧘‍♀️❤️

reviews.name: Hujwiri Sabri
reviews.text:
I had an exceptional experience at the spa in Paradox Resort from start to finish. The entire journey—from the booking process to the warm welcome at reception—was seamless, professional, and genuinely hospitable.

I opted for the Gold Package, and it exceeded my expectations. Every detail was thoughtfully curated to create a truly relaxing and luxurious experience.

A special thanks to my massage therapist, whose professionalism, gentle touch, and exceptional skill made all the difference. The treatment was perfectly tailored, allowing me to completely unwind and leave feeling refreshed, rejuvenated, and well cared for.

If you’re looking for a premium spa experience with outstanding service in a tranquil setting, I highly recommend it. I’ll certainly be returning on my next visit.

reviews.name: Ymane Sanou
reviews.text: It was my first time getting a Thai massage and the experience was amazing. From the service to the location, everything exceeded my expectations. We changed our request last minute, and the staff was incredibly understanding and accommodating. The atmosphere was calming, the team was professional and kind, and the massage left me feeling completely relaxed. I would definitely come back and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a true Thai massage experience!

I was served when arrived by a small cold cup of lemongrass tea that was nice touch. The environment is also top notch. It definitely levels higher than massage parlor along the streets.

Excellent experience. Therapist knows perfect strength on different body parts depending on my sensitivity. She hits right spot.

I am sure I will be back.

reviews.name: It's Asammuell
reviews.text: I chose aroma massage and didn’t regret at all: technique was wonderful, I felt all the spots that were in tense and flew away from the room after finishing 🌸 If you like light massages, I definitely recommend this one.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear It's Asammuell,

Thank you so much for your lovely review! 🌸 We're absolutely delighted to hear that you enjoyed the aroma massage and felt completely relaxed afterwards. It’s wonderful to know the technique helped ease the tension and made you feel like you were floating out of the room!

We truly appreciate your kind words and your recommendation. Looking forward to welcoming you back for more peaceful and pampering moments at our resort. 💆‍♀️✨

Tranquil regards,
The Paradox Resort Phuket Team

reviews.name: andy kadish
reviews.text: The Spa at Paradox Resort is amazing.  Had body scrub/back/shoulder/neck/head massages by Mimi and Honey.  Feel like a new person. Was incredible and worth every cent (bhat). Don’t leave Paradox without attending the Spa!! 💆‍♀️

reviews.text: We would like to recommend this massage studio. We booked via WhatsApp the morning before from our hotel, the Crown Plaza Resort. reviews.name: Tan Bing Yuan
reviews.text:
Greetings all, I was around the area after having breakfast and decided to head over to Sea Sand.

The owner saw me and invited me in. Seeing me sweating due to the hot weather, Dada offered me a bottle of chilled water without me asking. Knowing that I arrived at Phuket via cruise, she also offered me a ride back after massage. I gladly accepted, and I asked to drop at the nearby Super Cheap supermarket due to do some shopping before heading back.

Massage is decent and good. With no shortage of massage time. Staff asked how was the massage strength and diligently did her work.

Please do support this humble shop which was just opened a month back.

reviews.name: Олеся Торлопова
reviews.text:
Это был лучший массаж, который нам делали в Тайланде. Мы приходили семьёй, мы с мужем были на массаже, ребёнок нас ожидал, внимание, добродушие и чуткость со стороны девушек к нашей семье. Обычно мы делали тайский массаж, но Дада посоветовала ойл массаж и это было нечто невероятное, окунулусь в атмосферу расслабления с элементами тайского массажа. Дада — невероятный мастер своего дела, знающий своё дело и невероятно добродушная, как и её коллега. Ойл массаж действительно расслабил, после него мы чувствовали себя прекрасно. Мы остались очень довольны! Полное расслабление, девушки стараются каждый раз, прорабатывают тщательно каждую зону. Очень рекомендуем!!!

При следующем посещении Пхукета, на массаж только к ним, номер телефона записала, поэтому будем на связи!
Удачи и успехов Дада❤️
reviews.textTranslated:
This was the best massage we've ever had in Thailand. We came with my family; my husband and I were there for a massage, our child was waiting for us, and the girls were so attentive, kind, and considerate of our family. We usually get Thai massages, but Dada recommended an oil massage, and it was incredible. I was immersed in a relaxing atmosphere with elements of Thai massage. Dada is an incredible professional, knowledgeable, and incredibly kind, just like her colleague. The oil massage was truly relaxing; we felt wonderful afterwards. We were very pleased! Total relaxation, the girls do their best every time, working meticulously on every area. Highly recommended!!!

Next time in Phuket, I'll only go to them for a massage. I've saved their phone number so we can keep in touch!
Good luck and success, Dada ❤️

reviews.name: Thomas Schroeder
reviews.text: Wow, meine Frau und ich hatten eine tolle 90 min. Thai Massage (meine Frau inkl. Oil). Super nett, kleines Studio mit 2 Liegen, schön ruhig. Da wir auch in Deutschland regelmäßig zur Thai Massage gehen, haben wir schon ein bisschen Erfahrung und auch hier in Puhket waren wir schon 3 mal. Nächste Woche gehen wir noch mal hier hin. Nicht abschrecken lassen, von außen macht es nicht viel her und da der ggü. liegende Hotelkomplex z. Z. Geschlossen ist, hat auch das benachbarte Restaurant (Sam s kitchen) geschlossen. Das Massage Studio ist innen sehr gepflegt und sauber. Hingehen!
reviews.textTranslated: Wow, my wife and I had a fantastic 90-minute Thai massage (my wife's included oil). The place was super friendly, a small studio with two massage tables, and nice and quiet. Since we regularly go for Thai massages in Germany, we already have some experience, and we've been here in Phuket three times already. We're going again next week. Don't be put off by the exterior; it doesn't look like much, and since the hotel complex opposite is currently closed, the neighboring restaurant (Sam's Kitchen) is also closed. The massage studio itself is very well-maintained and clean inside. Go!

reviews.name: SAM
reviews.text:
After a very hectic early morning arrival, I went here for a foot massage before proceeding with the day. I guess they were about to start so staff members were just arriving and the lady available did the foot massage which was great. Felt relaxed, but it was only foot and shoulder was not included. Also no after tea for me. I left too to explore the city. I was happy anyway because I got a good massage by a elderly but well experienced lady.

Evening I came back to this place again, and the assigned massage therapist was in such a hurry that she pulled up my legs in the air without even addressing me, to adjust the ottoman, threw the towel at me to do the work myself and without saying anything again pulled away the cushion from my seat to apparently help me sit comfortably.

I kept my calm even though I noticed the anxiety and haste in her actions. She started the massage and the only massage she did was up and down stroking action before switching to another leg. She did no pressure point action with the little wooden pen like thing and did not work on calf even.

I have a flat feet and I told her already to not give hard press on my feet bottom, inspite of that she hurt me atleast 3 times. And then only continued her up and down stroke. When I asked her to work on foot she got annoyed and pressed hard to let me know it is me who is having the problem with her technique so I can’t get a massage. She kept mumbling something after. She’s a relatively taller and leaner lady, did not notice the name.

Unlike her colleagues, she had no basic sense of atleast talking and handling stuff in a professional manner. I got the manager to change the lady soon after.
But then another older lady who was very sweet but unfortunately tired enough to work with full pressure was sent. I was only happy by her way of talking, but the replacement also did not work in my favour.

Dissatisfied with the service the second time. And yea the ambiance is not that calming, chitter chatter and random call-outs keep happening, so one looking for that ambiance can skip this.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ต้องขอโทษด้วยนะค่ะคุณลูกค้า

reviews.name: Macro Tourist
reviews.text: 499 THB for a day pass which is too expensive! Unboarding takes a while because they want to see an ID (even for a day pass) and register you in their database. No free trial option available even if you stay in Bangkok for six months. Gym is mediocre equipped. No heavy dumb-bells (max 40 kg), no squat machine, no standing calf machine. Only one bench and only two wracks. No proper rowing machine on which you can assemble plates. Staff was not so friendly. No single rope for the cable tower. Unfortunately, I did not feel very welcomed. At least, the gym was clean and not crowded.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We appreciate your honest feedback. Our goal is to make your gym experience the best possible. Share your suggestions via the contact info at infothai@f24s.com

reviews.name: 夏恩
reviews.text:
This was a really terrible experience.

When I contacted your team online, I was told I could use the gym for a free 3-day trial.
My friend also went to another branch and had no issues at all.
Now you’re telling me that the other branch staff gave us the wrong information?

At this branch, I was told that foreigners must have a Thai work permit to use the free trial. If that’s really the policy, that’s fine

I’m okay if I’m not eligible to use the trial. What I’m not okay with is the attitude of the front desk staff. They were extremely rude and unprofessional.

I definitely would not recommend this branch based on my experience.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We regret that we didn’t deliver the experience you deserve. Your voice matters. Let us know how we can make things better through the contact channels at infothai@f24s.com

reviews.name: Jerry Lee Dormido
reviews.text: I have my monthly subscription to Anytime Fitness, and I used to go to AF Nanglinchee. AF is not that far from my condo where I am staying for 2 months, but it was April and May, where the heat is too much to bear when I like using the Grab bike as it is fast and saves time. Thankfully, Fitness24seven offered a 2 month half price for the Songkran festival. I was so lucky as it is just 30 seconds away from my condo. It saved me time and money from taking Grab 5 days per week! Fitness24seven is fully equipped and very well maintained. It has a drinking station and clean shower room. The staff are always friendly as usual. And I don't need to have it canceled. When I applied for this 2 month promo deal, they ensured that it would be canceled after 2 months. And I received an email that my subscription ended hence. No hidden fees or wrong charges on my credit card. Great gym, great  service, great promo deal!!!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Wow, thank you for the amazing review! Your energy keeps us motivated. See you soon for your next workout!

reviews.name: Mambo
reviews.text:
It's crowded even at 6am, with all the machines and benches taken. Every couple of meters there's someone, and people are even doing farmer's walks all over the place in the gym.

It's not very clean, the floor is littered with plastic bottles and used tissue. Plenty of machines and equipment are damaged and not replaced.

Almost nobody wipes down after using a machine, except for a rare few.

The accessible bathroom (on the ground floor) gets used by able-bodied people.

I've never tried the showers since the locker rooms themselves aren't very clean.

PS: I've been asked for my work permit
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Your experience is important two us, and we’re sorry we fell short. Let’s work together to make your next visit better. Reach us via infothai@f24s.com

reviews.name: Jordan King
reviews.text: I’ve been bouncing around to a few gyms in Bangkok and this is my favorite! It’s never been too crowded and the weekly and monthly member rates are very affordable. Plenty of space with all you need including machines, free weights, and a club room for Zumba and Yoga. Staff are very friendly and helpful and create a nice atmosphere by really leaving you alone. Personal trainers available on request. Women also have a private gym area if they’d rather not hang around with the meat heads….but don’t be scared it’s just the money boys 😉

reviews.name: A New American Life ຊີວິດແບບອະເມຣິກາໃຫມ່
reviews.text: Small, but nice gym. Has everything you need. 2,000 Baht a month membership gives you 24 hour access and to all of their locations.

reviews.name: A. Lopez
reviews.text: I joined this gym for a month in October 2025. The place was pretty good, I've read some reviews talking about bad maintenance but I never saw that, all the machines were operative a working well. If you are member you can go to all of their branches, I visited three an they were very similar. When I joined I paid 2000 baht (around 54 euros) which was a little overpriced, the gym was good but still was very small. If you subscribe online you can pay by card. Something important to say, on my first day, when I got the card, there were two charming ladies on the reception, they were very polite and explained how everything worked in perfect english, absolutely great customer service, 5 stars for them.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Boom! That’s the sound of your awesome review landing! Thanks for choosing us.

reviews.name: Ian Fan
reviews.text: The “free trial” advertised on the website is misleading. It’s only available to people who are employed in Thailand, and this restriction isn’t clearly disclosed.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for sharing your thoughts. We understand how important your fitness experience is, and we’re here to listen. Connect with us via infothai@f24s.com

reviews.name: Camila Lerner
reviews.text: I recently joined this gym so I can't speak to the overall quality, but I wanted to leave this review because the girl at the front desk was so kind and helpful with the payment process when my credit card was having issues
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Wow, thank you for the amazing review! Your energy keeps us motivated!

reviews.name: jacek kopiniak
reviews.text: I have been visiting this club for about 1.5 years. At first, after covid, the staff tried very hard, they were kind and helpful. So it was for a long time. Unfortunately, it's getting worse now. Fitness is a bit dirty in some places. The cloakroom and men's restroom stinks. Some of the staff who still work there are very obliging and nice and I thank them for their service. Unfortunately, my partner and I met some new employees who have no idea how to deal with customers and are arrogant. He doesn't know how to keep the customer still a customer of this company. We decided to cancel the cards right away and we don't want to use a place that has this service. I think that in some time other people will see this approach and will have a large selection around in other fitness clubs, the competition on the market is high, but the unthinking employee does not understand.

reviews.name: Nicc11221
reviews.text: Really cool place. Has most thing despite being very small. Cardio area is very extensive however I did find myself queueing for machine for up to 10 minutes during busy times. I enjoyed coming before 15:00. Staff very friendly.

reviews.name: Rob LeBlanc
reviews.text:
Great gym! The staff here (always friendly) helped us find a membership that would suit our needs.  No attempt to up-sell which tends to be the norm with gyms here.
The equipment is new and very well maintained.  A good assortment of free weight and machines, with plenty of space to exercise within.  I also like that the cardio equipment is set facing outside, it is always more enjoyable to watch the world go by while getting a good sweat on.
Additionally to being a quality gym, the cleaning staff is constantly in motion ensuring you have a clean environment to work out in as well. When you add that to the mix, Fitness24Seven is a great gym.

reviews.name: Long Cheng
reviews.text:
6/10 for overall experience. 4 points not given for their facilities not repaired. 6 points given for low membership fee compared with other gyms.
However, I don't really know what exactly the reason can be for their broken facilities left unrepaired for months (See picture below). For instance, this Deltoid Fly facility has been "out of order" for at least over one month and half and their staff doesn't seem to concern about it.

reviews.name: Tim Jones
reviews.text:
There are a couple guys on roids, one of them growls at people and throws the bench down when he moves it. 5/5 stars very entertaining

Kidding aside, I was here for a month and trained in the mornings. Paid 2,000 baht for a single month membership (no card, just cash). It can get quite busy and there is only one cable machine, so if you use that one a lot prepare to wait unless you come in off peak times.

Staff are extremely friendly and helpful. Only negative I can think of is the lockers do stink of sweat when you open them (might need a deep clean). Overall would definitely sign up again if I came back, love training at this gym.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks for the stellar review! Keep the momentum going. We’re here 24/7 and looking forward to welcome you.

reviews.name: Elizabethh
reviews.text:
myself and my partner visited today and were bowled over by the helpfulness of the three staff at the front desk, who were all very kind and extremely helpful.

we were just passing through but if we had longer in bangkok we would definitely join this gym, which itself was clean and well-spaced —  backpackers I definitely recommend this gym (remember to bring your passports!)

thank you again to the lovely staff ^.^
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We’re thrilled you had a great time! Keep smashing those goals. We’re open 24/7 for you!

reviews.name: Earl Nicolle Sideño
reviews.text:
why this gym hasnt been rated enough baffles me, came in to train Brazilian Jiu Jitsu but was given much more than the modern jiu jitsu is.

Wrestling and stand ups, self defense + concepts, drills and some sparring.

It’s hard to find a BJJ gym that can give you this much in 1 session.

Coach Phil, the residing black belt, had an excellent lesson flow with the class. We learned so much in such a short amount of time. Alongside the brownbelts, Kru Arm and Ping, the class was well attended and everyone had good rolls in.

My friends, Tee and Dream, were excellent partners to roll and do situational drills. It’s so hard to get people like this to train with where they emphasize getting the drills and technique right over winning every round.

Thank you so much for accomodating my walk-in session! Cant recommend this gym enough for people wanting to roll in BKK while they are here for short or long term stay.

reviews.name: Kelvin Keigher
reviews.text:
Family Bjj has an incredibly welcoming and friendly atmosphere. The head instructor Phil demonstrates everything step by step in a clear and relaxed manner, making it easier to learn, with an emphasis on safety for yourself and training partners.

There is also a good explanation of sport vs self defense Jiu Jitsu throughout the lessons which shows a deeper understanding and clear passion for the art.

If you want to learn Jiu Jitsu and Self Defense (Red Zone Threat Management as it's called here) this is the place for you. It's like a family on the mats, everyone is made to feel welcome, and not an ego in site.
See you on the mats.

reviews.text:

A kind American instructor teaches in an easy-to-understand way!
Instruction is conducted in English and Thai.

The availability of self-defense classes is also appealing.

reviews.name: N
reviews.text:
Tl;dr
Gym owner asked to spar me and then proceeded to go hard, despite other coaches intervening telling him it is only light sparring. When I asked him what was the reason for the aggression he told me he’d “kill me if we were fighting in the ring” and other similar statements. The equipment and mats are also deteriorating, unhygienic and unsafe to train on.

I’ve attended more than a handful of different gyms in Thailand, and I’ve been able to reflect on my experience and compare since then. I’m writing this review to warn others of the potential safety risks and concerns of training here.

For a bit of background, I’ve been training Muay Thai for a bit more than a year in my home country and came here on holidays with friends. We did a group class together through our hostel’s partnership with this gym. There were a couple of immediate red flags regarding the hygiene and equipment. The mats were not properly set up and would often slide out from underneath you, and they were also very dirty and unclean. However the assistant coaches were very friendly, most did not speak English but had a good demeanour.

The issue however was when light sparring begun and we had a few rounds with some of the gym’s fighters. One of what I presumed to be at the time a coach, walked up to me after I had just finished a round and asked to spar me. I sensed his attitude to be somewhat a bit confronting and he laughed at me when I asked for a minute to rest - but I shrugged it off due to language barrier and cultural misunderstanding.

He walked up to me again and just stood next to me, which confused me as to why he was so eager to spar but I obliged anyways.

When the sparring begun it was clear there was a significant difference in intensity. He swept and dumped me after I threw a light and slow kick. I was confused as from my experience this is poor etiquette. It was also loud and significant enough that my group turned and watched (10 people). After the second sweep and hard dump from him, as well as confusion from my friends. A coach intervened and tried to de-escalate, telling him to go lighter, only 50%. I asked him if the guy I was sparring was a coach or another student and they told me he was a coach.

We resumed sparring and I swept him in return, which seemed to really upset him because when he got up - he seemed really angry and threw a strong hook which rocked me. I immediately ended sparring and an argument ensued. I asked him if I offended him and why he was going so hard. To which he responded many things, such as “that was nothing to me, only my 10%”, “if I wanted to and we were in the ring I would kill you”, “this is Muay Thai you cannot be soft” etc.

This person turned out to be the gym owner, and they eventually offered me a free session as an apology. I did show up to this session and it did seem like he did attempt to make amends. But I wonder if this was more damage control than anything as many of his fighters - including his wife, who was also very kind and apologised to me on his behalf - witnessed this altercation.

I am rating this two stars rather than one because his fighters and assistant coaches were very gracious and all checked up on me. And otherwise I did have an enjoyable session up until this. Plus the complimentary session. But ultimately this was a sour experience for me on what was supposed to be an enjoyable holiday experience with my friends.

reviews.name: Kritika Kamra
reviews.text:
I attended a Muay Thai class here in Chiang Mai, and it was by far the worst training experience I’ve ever had.

To be honest, it wouldn’t even qualify as basic exercise—forget proper Muay Thai training. The trainers were extremely disengaged and lazy, with almost no instruction or correction given throughout the session. It felt like a pure tourist gimmick, and a poorly executed one at that.

Even tourist-oriented gyms usually provide basic facilities such as drinking water and access to washrooms. This place had neither, which was disappointing and unprofessional.

The owner spent a significant amount of time taking videos, clearly for promotional content to attract more foreigners, rather than focusing on the quality of the class or the students’ experience.

The class duration was also misleading. While it’s advertised as a 1.5-hour session, it started at 5:10 PM and ended sharply at 6:00 PM—not a minute more. There was no one at reception when I was leaving, either.

If the owner happens to read this review: I would like a full refund for the amount charged.

For anyone genuinely interested in Muay Thai—or even those trying it for the first time—please refrain from training here. This place will only spoil your experience of the sport.

I’m not a professional Muay Thai practitioner. I’ve only recently taken up the sport, but I’m genuinely interested in learning and progressing. That’s exactly why this experience was so disappointing, especially while trying to train during a short vacation.

Complete waste of money. Deeply disappointed.

reviews.name: DJ Fuzz
reviews.text:
One of Bangkok's True Muay Thai Institutions
Training at Kiatsongrit Gym was an incredible experience. This isn't a tourist gym—it's a genuine Thai fighter's camp with over 40 years of Muay Thai history behind it.
Kiatsongrit is famous for producing legendary fighters, most notably Changpuek Kiatsongrit, the "White Elephant," who helped introduce Muay Thai to the international kickboxing world.Training is intense and very authentic, with many active Thai fighters preparing for top Bangkok stadium bouts.
What impressed me most was the atmosphere. There are no gimmicks, no influencer culture, and no shortcuts. If you want to experience authentic Thai Muay Thai and train where real fighters are made, Kiatsongrit Gym is one of the best places in Bangkok.

I made sure I arrived early to start doing my own warm up before the 121 commenced- I saw at the end me arriving early was taken into account when timing the lesson. Never had that happen before. It was a solid pad session but not really any corrections or feedback. Being fresh off the plane and not being on the mat for a good while I know I wasn’t doing everything great. It was only at the end I was told my blocks are bad and need work- which to me could have been worked on in the session?? It was the oddest 121 I’ve had- more like a class attitude with no nuance to my session. I wouldn’t go back again and for that reason I wouldn’t recommend. I’ve been to far better in the area.

Dès mon arrivée, j’ai été impressionné par le sérieux et le professionnalisme des coachs. Ils sont non seulement experts dans leur domaine, mais aussi très attentifs à chaque élève, offrant des conseils personnalisés pour améliorer notre technique et notre condition physique. L’encadrement est top : chaque entraînement est structuré, avec un focus sur la progression individuelle tout en maintenant un haut niveau d’intensité.
L’ambiance du camp est incroyable, on se sent tout de suite intégré dans une équipe. Les coachs créent une atmosphère à la fois exigeante et bienveillante, ce qui permet de pousser ses limites tout en se sentant soutenu à chaque étape. Que ce soit pour les débutants ou les pratiquants plus avancés, l’environnement est motivant et stimulant.
Les infrastructures sont également de grande qualité, avec un espace d’entraînement spacieux et bien équipé. Bref, si vous cherchez à améliorer votre technique de Muay Thai tout en vivant une expérience intense et positive, le camp Kiatsongrit est l'endroit idéal !
reviews.textTranslated:
From the moment I arrived, I was impressed by the coaches' dedication and professionalism. They are not only experts in their field but also very attentive to each student, offering personalized advice to improve our technique and physical conditioning. The coaching is top-notch: each training session is structured, with a focus on individual progress while maintaining a high level of intensity.

The camp atmosphere is incredible; you immediately feel part of a team. The coaches create an atmosphere that is both demanding and supportive, allowing you to push your limits while feeling supported every step of the way. Whether you're a beginner or a more advanced practitioner, the environment is motivating and stimulating.
The facilities are also of high quality, with a spacious and well-equipped training area. In short, if you're looking to improve your Muay Thai technique while enjoying an intense and positive experience, Kiatsongrit Camp is the perfect place!

reviews.name: Phapapin Dinakara Na Ayudhaya
reviews.text:
I recently had the opportunity to experience the Hydration Facial by Valmont (60 minutes) at SPA InterContinental, and I was truly impressed.

The spa has just officially launched Valmont, the renowned luxury Swiss skincare brand, and is the first spa in Thailand to offer the complete Valmont Face & Body Ritual experience.

The treatment features more than 13 Valmont skincare products, making every step feel incredibly luxurious. The facial includes deep cleansing, exfoliation, cleansing, a facial mask, and multiple skincare applications using Valmont products. In addition, the treatment includes a relaxing massage for the neck, shoulders, and arms. The massage technique was excellent and left me feeling completely relaxed.

Immediately after the treatment, my skin felt deeply hydrated, plump, radiant, and noticeably brighter. It was a wonderful experience and perfect for anyone looking to enjoy a premium skincare treatment in a peaceful and elegant spa environment.

I would also like to give special recognition to Aoy, whose massage skills are exceptional. She was attentive throughout the entire treatment, making the experience incredibly relaxing. Pa and Fai provided such a warm welcome and outstanding service from beginning to end.

A special thank you to Ice Cream for always taking such wonderful care of me whenever I stay at the hotel or visit the spa. Your attention to detail and genuine hospitality make every visit memorable.

Thank you to the entire team for such an amazing experience. I will definitely be back and highly recommend SPA InterContinental to anyone looking for a truly luxurious spa experience in Bangkok.

reviews.name: H H
reviews.text:
Hands down the best massage I’ve had in Bangkok so far.
Yes, the price is on the higher side but it truly matches the experience.

I ended up going two days in a row with the same masseuse (Aoy, also known as Poony in Thai not sure if I spelled her name correctly), which says everything. Her technique, pressure, and consistency were exceptional. I felt like a new person afterwards.

From the therapist’s skill to the calm, elegant environment, everything is on a different level. If you’re looking for a refined, high-quality spa experience rather than just a massage, this is absolutely worth it.

My Most Memorable Spa at InterContinental Bangkok 🌸✨🌺

This was my inaugural visit to the spa facilities at the InterContinental Bangkok, and I must convey how truly impressed and delighted I was with the entire experience.

The level of personalised attention and care was nothing short of exceptional, and I was deeply touched by the thoughtful preparations made for my birthday celebration.

I would like to extend my most sincere thanks to P'Tong, P'Paa, P'Foil, and P'Yo for orchestrating such a wonderful surprise for my special day—it was the most memorable part of the visit.

A special commendation must be reserved for P'Yo, who delivered a supremely excellent 2-hour massage treatment. Her technique, the perfect consistency of pressure, and the consistently attentive manner in which she conducted the entire session were exemplary. She ensured my comfort and well-being were perfectly catered to throughout.

It was a deeply relaxing and restorative experience, and I eagerly anticipate my return.

reviews.name: db cc
reviews.text:
This was one of my best spa experiences in Bangkok. Maybe in Asia too! I’ve tried massages from Sri Lanka to Bali. But this must be one of the most professional and effective treatments.
I had the two hour treatment comprising of a scrub and a hot compress with massage. The former took up about half and hour while the latter 1.5 hours.
The therapist communicates well in English. Has initiative and knows how to adapt to differing massage strength as instructed. Her technique is also quite good. She doesn’t just repeat the same massage strokes. She varies a lot and also depending on the area she focuses on, the movements change. She’s also got a very aware of her pressure. Some therapist get too light or too heavy. She’s just perfect. The oil used was also top quality oil. Absorption is fast and your skin is left feeling like a new born baby’s. The only slight quibble I have is the hot compress - not a fan of it. Besides the treatment itself, the facilities and massage room and the environment all worked seamlessly together to create an unforgettable spa experience. U forget that you’re in the middle of Erawan ; the heart of the city. The treatment rooms have complete privacy and the room is very well appointed - it has everything u need. The rain bath  shower was so good too. But the one thing that i appreciated the most was the room temperature. It’s not too hot and not too cold. Let’s not forget you’re completely naked in a treatment room. So if you’re sensitive to cold like myself, u can get quite sick from the cold air of the air con. I usually get a terrible blocked nose, sometimes a runny nose if it’s too cold. But the temperature in the room was just nice. No towels are used only cotton sheets to cover your body. It was so pleasant and comfy. So glad and grateful that I discovered isawan. Will return soon.

reviews.name: C L
reviews.text: I paid alittle over 16000 baht for the 360 well-being retreat package and all in all the service was mediocre at best. I was there for several services. One being a pedi and 90 min facial. The facial I was given was one of the worse ones I have ever had, mind you the body scrub and wrap preformed by the clinician was good but, the facial left a lot to be desired. She didn’t do a deep cleaning nor extractions and it seemed she keep doing the same 3 things on a loop to run out the time and she wasn’t very kind either. It was that fake kind when someone doesn’t want to do their job and then she wanted to complete all treatments before I had lunch which is not what I asked for or what was advertised. She just wanted to get it done instead of taking care of the customer. Also the pedi wasn’t great either it lacked a lot of elements that make a pedi. Plus, I asked her twice to cut back my nails but, she didn’t and to have gel was extra she didn’t make my nails the shape that I asked for either but, the saving grace for her is that she was kind and friendly. Then comes the meal that I was given was cold and old possible made hours before. It wasn’t fresh at all then I was charged for my drink which should be included. I expect alot more when I come to an upscale place for services that’s why I chose them not to be nickeled and dime for extras when it should be a part of the treatment. So, if you are looking for upscale services I would avoid this place.

reviews.name: XFA Jaguar
reviews.text:
BEWARE, this shop is a scam.
조심하세요, 이 가게는 사기입니다.
注意してください、このショップは詐欺です。
请注意，这家商店是一个骗局。

1) The price showed is wrong ; they will add 250 THB for the room, and 190 THB for you to pay a drink to the lady and 190 THB for you to get a drink. So, for a 40 mins session at 2140 THB you will actually pay 2770 THB. They exploit the incapacity for some gentlemen to say "no" or the shyness of some of us.

2) Once you enter in contact with the lady at the reception, the time start, meaning if your session is 1 hour, the time start once you say "Hi" to the lady. Once you enter the room, you will wait 5 to 10 minutes before the lady comeback. So, your session already has 15 minutes less than expected.

3) Then the lady will slowly wash your body, very slowly. Now, she will take her shower ... yeah, very slowly.

4) Then, she'll offer you a regular massage that you can / should refuse.

Now, the one hour you bought turns into 35 minutes.

5) Into the action, the lady will ask you about 5 times a minute if "you'll finish soon". Also, she's gonna try to control the rhythm to make sure you cannot enjoy your experience with the rush of having to finish soon AND she'll say "I have pain, stop for a minute".

Yeah, all the tricks in one person. Fang told me that they do that because they want you to buy more time.

6) Hopefully, I add my own timer, and 10 minutes before my session ends, in the middle of the action the lady said "ok it's finish". So I showed my timer to her, and she said "Ah, sorry, my mistake". It really happened !

At this point, I knew she was playing me, I knew my money was gone forever.

Yes, this shop is a big scam using well known strategies to steal people's money, people who cannot do anything to argue and fight for their money lost.

They don't care if they destroy that "special night" with your friends or that rare specific time you had to be happy in your crazy work schedule. They will eat your happiness without hesitation.

Paying for fake reviews, this shop doesn't deserve your attention. I'm sure one day a customer will react very aggressively, let's hope the owner will one day choose to be honest. But I don't think so.

Losers approach that works in Bangkok. In China or in Korea or in Japan, business values are in place. In Bangkok, that doesn't exist.

7) Finally, after your session, you'll maybe had an experience with a man : Yeah, I'm not sure all ladies are real women. Some were bigger than me : I'm 6'1'' fit boy and 95 kilos.

In short, be aware, or simply avoid this place.

Thanks for reading my review.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Ah, what a gripping tale! We must thank you for your creative writing skills—if only fiction writing paid as well as defamation. Let’s go through your fascinating claims one by one, shall we?

1.	The Price Conspiracy
It’s always impressive when someone manages to get scammed out of… a discount. You paid less than the actual price, didn’t pay for any lady drinks, and yet somehow, we “exploited” your inability to say no? A true tragedy.

2.	The Vanishing Time Trick
Yes, indeed, our time starts when you enter, much like in every professional service ever. But considering you were here for a grand total of 40 minutes, the only thing disappearing faster than time seems to be your grasp on reality.

3.	The ‘Slow-Motion’ Scheme
A thorough, relaxing wash and a gentle approach—clearly, another scam! The fact that we don’t rush you in and out like a factory line must be infuriating. Apologies for our hospitality.

4.	The Evil Massage Offer
Imagine the nerve—offering a massage at a massage establishment! We can’t begin to understand why you’d find this suspicious.

5.	The Mysterious Urgency
Ah, yes, the classic “Are you finished yet?” ploy. An age-old trick used by… no one except, apparently, our imaginary team of deception artists. Odd that you mention this, considering you were in such a rush to leave that you forgot your bracelet.

6.	The Timer of Justice
Your trusty timer, the hero of the story! If only it had also reminded you that you received a discount, didn’t pay for lady drinks, and were in and out in 40 minutes. But let’s not let facts get in the way of a good dramatic retelling.

7.	The Grand Finale—A Shocking Revelation
And now, a surprise plot twist: questioning our staff’s gender. What a mature and respectful observation! Your detective work is truly inspiring—perhaps next time, you’ll also uncover the mystery of basic human decency.

As for your lost bracelet, which we kept safe and returned to you today—what a remarkable scam! Returning lost property must be part of our elaborate master plan.

Now, since you are so deeply dissatisfied with this “scam,” we’re sure you’ll have no problem removing your defamatory review before we take further steps. Consider it a final act of goodwill from your favorite “scammers.”

Have a wonderful day!

The Management

Go to next door unless you want to just put your money into garbage bin
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Good afternoon Sir, 

First we want to apologize for what happened. This should have never occurred.

We have identified the culprit staff. In fact it was a new employee that started the day before yesterday. It is not an excuse for what happened but she didn’t follow the guidelines we provided during her induction training. Further more she lied to our Manager when he enquired about the quality of the service she delivered (this is a standard procedure for new staff).

The result is clear: We have fired her because our place has one of the best reputation in town with 1000s of satisfied customers, who are mostly repeat customers.

Please stop by today. Our manager have a special gift for you which we hope will ease your frustration.

Alternatively, you can also call him directly so he can provide you with additional details: 022594528

We again would like to apologies for the inconvenience and hope to see you return to our establishment.

Warm regards.

The management

reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for the feedback. 

We always value the comments from our customers as we strive for excellence and we are sorry to hear that your experience was not as per your expectations. 

Our cashier is generally very courteous and helpful with our Chinese speaking customers. 

Regarding the service which you seem to rate as average, would you remember the name of your therapist? 

It would have been best if you could have discussed with our manager right then instead of leaving a one star review. He would have no doubt help out. We have thousands of satisfied Chinese customers but of course chemistry is an important factor in the experience. Maybe you didn’t pick as per the recommendation of our manager which is always best to listen to. 

As for the price, in order to maintain certain cleanliness standards and decent remuneration for our therapists there is a cost. You can find cheaper elsewhere but the standards are not the same. We hope this helps and wish to see you again at our establishment. Make sure to mention this to our manager next time, he will take special care of you.

The management

reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Shaochen,

Thank you for the feedback. We are always happy to hear from our customers and their experience at our establishment as we continously seek to improve our services.

We indeed have Jacuzzi rooms, however, depending on the affluence, rooms may not be available. To ensure you can enjoy a Jacuzzi we suggest to visit between 12 pm and 4pm or after 9pm. Weekdays are also usually less busy.

The pricing you referenced is incorrect for 1h as we are below that threshold. Also, please note that our staff are trained to make the best of the time you book with no rush. Would you recall the name of your masseuse? We will ensure this is corrected if she rushed you. That being said, we recommend 90min service to ensure you can take your time.

Kind regards

102 Management

reviews.name: Razlin Dawina
reviews.text:
It was our last day in Bangkok and we wanted to squeeze in a last massage. TL Massage opens at 9:00am. We were the first customers. They offer body and foot massages. They offer Thai, aromatherapy and oil massages. Prices are reasonable.

One of the best massages I've had. I opted for 60 minutes and 40min in, I wished I had opted the 90 minute one.

Before you leave, you're offered a drink. Definitely recommend this place and will go here again if I am in Sukhumvit.

reviews.name: Priyank Sharma
reviews.text: TL Massage is located right opposite Shama Lakeview Asoke, and from the moment we walked in, it felt very welcoming – as you’d expect from Thai hospitality. We booked a couples massage and it turned out to be a wonderfully relaxing experience. They used a balm instead of oil, which felt unusual at first but actually worked really well. It’s a cash-only place, and we didn’t have enough on us, but the kind elder lady at the counter let us pay later that evening. Such warmth and trust really stood out – a lovely experience overall.

Overall, I'm impressed with both the cleanliness and the service. Free parking is convenient. P.S. I bought a coupon during a promotion, which was very cheap and worthwhile. I'll definitely be back!

reviews.text: พนักงานนวดชื่อ ริน เล่นมือถือแทบตลอดการนวด 90 นาที นวดไปเล่นโทรศัพท์ไปค่ะ ที่นี่มีนโยบายให้พนักงานนวดนำมือถือมาใช้ในขณะทำงานได้ด้วยหรือเปล่าคะ ไม่เคยเจอร้านไหนทำแบบนี้เลยค่ะ ควรจะตักเตือนหรืออบรมพนักงานให้มีมารยาทและการบริการที่ดีกว่านี้ หลังจากนวดตัวและนวดเท้า ควรจะล้างมือก่อนนวดศีรษะด้วยค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: The massage therapist, Rin, used her phone almost the entire 90-minute massage. She was using her phone while massaging. Does this salon have a policy allowing massage therapists to use their phones while working? I've never encountered a salon like this before. The staff should be warned or trained to have better manners and provide better service. After the body and foot massage, she should wash her hands before massaging the head.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
ทางร้านขออภัยกับเหตุการณ์นี้เกิดขึ่นมากๆค่ะ
ทางร้านจะนำเรื่องไปอบรม ตักเตือน พนักงาน ปรับปรุงและพัฒนา ขอบคุณสำหรับข้อมูลและขออภัยมากๆจริงๆค่ะ 🙏🏻

reviews.name: Princess Lada
reviews.text: พนักงานนวดดีแค่บางคน ตอนครั้งแรกไปนวดดีมาก อีกสองครั้งหลังไม่ได้เรื่องเลย ยิ่งนวดไทยคือไม่ดีเลย นวดแบบใช้ข้อศอกกับแขนกดๆ เจ็บไปหมด ไม่ได้สบายเลย ต้องคอยบอกให้เบาตลอด นวดเท้าแล้วมานวดศรีษะไม่ล้างมือ พนักงานหน้าเคาเตอร์ไม่แน่ใจว่าแค่พนักงานหรือเจ้าของ หน้าและน้ำเสียงไม่รับแขก เสียดายสถานที่ดี แต่บริการไม่ดี
reviews.textTranslated: Some of the massage therapists are good. The first time I went, the massage was excellent. The next two times were terrible. The Thai massage, in particular, was awful. They used their elbows and arms to press hard, it was painful and not relaxing at all. I had to keep telling them to be gentler. They didn't wash their hands after massaging my head after the foot massage. The staff at the counter—I'm not sure if it was just an employee or the owner—had an unwelcoming expression and tone of voice. It's a shame because the place is nice but the service is poor.

reviews.name: Giuseppe di meglio
reviews.text:
Grande Rin!
Gestisco una spa da 15 anni in Italia ed ho provato massaggi e terapisti di vario tipo, sono stato in Thailandia varie volte e girato molti posti qui e fatto massaggi thai ovunque, quando vengo mi fermo sempre a Bangkok qualche giorno per fare i massaggi qui con Rin.
Il centro è pulito, professionale e nella media come ce ne sono tanti in Thailandia. Il massaggio Thai con Rin è invece straordinario ed unico. Lo suggerisco se siete a Bangkok, difficilmente potrete fare una esperienza simile in Thailandia. Il 90% delle massaggiatrici dovrebbe andare a scuola da Rin.
Grazie
reviews.textTranslated:
Great Rin!
I've been running a spa in Italy for 15 years and have tried various types of massages and therapists. I've been to Thailand several times, toured many places, and had Thai massages everywhere. When I come, I always stop in Bangkok for a few days to get a massage here with Rin.
The spa is clean, professional, and average, like many in Thailand. Rin's Thai massage, however, is extraordinary and unique. I highly recommend it if you're in Bangkok; you're unlikely to have a similar experience in Thailand. 90% of masseuses should go to Rin's school.
Thank you

reviews.name: chananya srisawas
reviews.text: ดีทุกอย่าง ยกเว้น พนักงานรับโทรศัพท์ตอนจอง น้ำเสียงเเย่มาก
reviews.textTranslated: Everything was great except for the person who answered the phone during booking; their tone of voice was terrible.

reviews.name: Noongning Wong
reviews.text: น่าจะมาอ่านรีวิวก่อนจอง ไม่เคยนวดร้านไหนแย่แบบนี้ นวดโดยการโถมน้ำหนักตัวมาทับ จนเราร้อง เอาศอกกดท้ายทอยกับก้านคอ เอาท่อนแขนทั้งท่อนมาบี้ก้านคอ ระบมมาก เป็นการนวดที่หมอนวดขี้เกียจสุดๆ เล่นเอาน้ำหนักตัวทับอย่างเดียว นวดไทยแบบใดแทบไม่ใช้มือเลย ไม่ยอมใช้นิ้วมือเลยยกเว้นตอนนวดศรีษะ ใช้แต่ศอก กับเข่า และท่อนแขน แย่มาก แถมนวดเวลาขาดไป 15 นาทีอีก ที่ไม่แย้งเพราะอยากให้จบๆ ซักที คงไม่ไปอีกแล้ว สถานที่สวย บรรยากาศสะอาด และสงบก็จริงแต่หมอไม่เวิร์คค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: I should have read the reviews before booking. I've never had such a terrible massage. The masseuse just slammed her entire body weight down on me until I cried. She pressed her elbow against the back of my neck and rubbed my neck with her entire forearm. It was incredibly painful. The masseuse was the laziest I've ever seen; she just used her body weight without any effort. It was practically a Thai massage, with almost no use of hands except during the head massage. She only used her elbows, knees, and forearms. It was awful. Plus, the massage was 15 minutes short of the scheduled time. I didn't complain because I just wanted it to be over. I definitely won't be going back. The place is beautiful, clean, and peaceful, but the masseuse was incompetent.

reviews.name: pitchaya P
reviews.text: ร้านประจำในดวงใจ สถานที่สะอาด พนักงานมีมารยาท บริการดีมากค่ะ ไปจนมีหมอนวดประจำตัว วันนี้อยากนวดหนัก นวดเบา แจ้งได้หมดเลยค่ะ ที่สำคัญราคาดี ใกล้บ้าน
reviews.textTranslated: This is my favorite massage parlor. The place is clean, the staff are polite, and the service is excellent. I even have a regular masseuse! Whether I want a strong or light massage, I can just let them know. Most importantly, the prices are good and it's close to home.

reviews.name: Aphinya
reviews.text: ร้านนี้นวดดีมากเลยค่ะ หมอนวดนวดดีทุกคน ร้านสะอาดมากค่ะ พนักงานฉีดแอลกอฮอล์ให้ทั้งก่อนและหลังเข้าใช้บริการสะอาดและปลอดภัยมากเลยค่ะ ชอบมากๆค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: This massage parlor is excellent. All the masseuses are great. The shop is very clean. The staff sprays alcohol before and after each service, making it very clean and safe. I really liked it!

reviews.textTranslated: I come here for massages regularly. My regular masseuse is excellent, and the shop is clean.

reviews.textTranslated: The massage shop is clean, the masseuses are friendly, and the prices are reasonable. I highly recommend this shop. It's conveniently located; just get off at Charoen Rat BRT station and you're there.

reviews.text: My wife and I were staying at the Sheraton and wound up with some free time. In a whim we stopped by and were able to get 2-hours Thai massages. I highly recommend if you’re at the Sheraton!

reviews.text: Incredible experience, I did both foot and hand massage and also on another time back and shoulder massage. Both exceptional therapist her name was Ratsamee. Really one of the best massages, place is clean, beautiful views, tea at the end. A must when in Thailand.

reviews.name: William Liu
reviews.text: 很棒的體驗，三樓落地窗外正對昭披耶河，選了香氛按摩，開始前可以指定要加強或減輕力道的部位，師傅的按摩手法細膩，也很在意客人感受。按完還附一份芒果糯米與熱茶，有機會會再來！
reviews.textTranslated: A fantastic experience! The third-floor windows offer a direct view of the Chao Phraya River. I opted for an aromatherapy massage, where you can specify which areas you want more or less pressure on beforehand. The masseuse's technique was delicate, and she was very attentive to her clients' comfort. After the massage, they even served a mango sticky rice and hot tea. I'd definitely come back!

reviews.name: patcharin pipatdomrongkit
reviews.text:
ที่จอดรถเก่าไปนิด แต่ที่วิวนวดที่ร้านคือดีมาก  มองเห็นวิวแม่น้ำเจ้าพระยาและไอคอนสยามเต็มๆ วันที่มาเพิ่งเปิดเลยอาจจะยังไม่ค่อยลงตัวนัก

ส่วนการบริการการรันตีชื่อเสียง let’s relax มาตรฐานอยู่แล้วคะ
reviews.textTranslated:
The parking lot is a bit old, but the view from the massage shop is amazing. You can see the Chao Phraya River and Icon Siam in full view. It had just opened when I visited, so things might not have been perfectly organized yet.

As for the service, Let's Relax's reputation speaks for itself – the standards are as expected.

reviews.name: Rojjana Rungrattwatchai
reviews.text: วิว เป๊ะปัง ริมแม่น้ำ และ วิวไอคอนสยาม คือดีงาม ในการที่เรามาทำสปามาก ส่วนLet’s Relax ก็ไม่ต้องสืบ ถ้าไม่แน่จริง ไม่มีสาขาเยอะขนาดนี้  ราคาเท่ากันทุกสาขาด้วย เราไปลอง signature oil massage 1 ชั่วโมง 1300 นวดเสร็จเสิร์ฟข้าวเหนียวมะม่วงกับชาด้วย ดีงาม
reviews.textTranslated: The view by the river and the view of Icon Siam are amazing, perfect for a spa treatment. As for Let's Relax, there's no need to question its quality; it wouldn't have so many branches if it wasn't good. The prices are the same at all branches too. We tried their signature oil massage, 1 hour for 1300 baht. After the massage, they served sticky rice with mango and tea – wonderful!

The spa itself is beautiful, peaceful, and tranquil. Every member of staff was welcoming and made me feel completely cared for throughout my visit.

I would recommend Burasari Spa to anyone looking to unwind, reset, and feel genuinely pampered. A definite 5-star + experience

reviews.text: ร้านนี้ฝีมือดี ประสบการณ์เป็นช่างเสริมสวยมาเแ็นสิบปี ใช้ผลิตภัณฑ์ Atomy ซึ่งเห็นผลลัพธ์ ชัดเจนมากๆค่ะ ที่ บริการประทับใจ ไว้ใจได้ค่ะ

title: Kaizen Jiu Jitsu Chiang Mai
ownerDescription:
We are a Brazilian Jiu Jitsu Academy located on the 2nd Floor of Ruamchok Mall.

Schedule
Monday 6pm No Gi Fundamentals
Tuesday 6pm Gi BJJ Fundamentals
Thursday 6pm No Gi Fundamentals
Sunday 5pm No Gi All Level

Contact
kaizenjiujitsuthai@gmail.com

Approach
We attempt to practice Jiu Jitsu in accordance with the principle of Kaizen, continuous incremental improvement everyday.

We tend to focus on modern no-gi submission grappling techniques, strongly influenced by the techniques, training methods and philosophies of John Danaher.

Thank you so much! It’s a shame my stay in Chiang Mai was so short.

reviews.textTranslated: This is a great spa for men. All the staff are male, which greatly reduces awkwardness. The massage standards are excellent, providing a very relaxing experience with its atmosphere and superb massage techniques. After the massage, they serve hot tea and a snack. Last time it was a delicious pineapple pie, and on my most recent visit it was a fancy jelly dessert, which paired very well with the tea.
