reviews.name: lari a-f
reviews.text: I came here today to ask about Muay Thai classes prices - when I arrived I saw the prices so took a photo, I then asked the lady if I could wash my hands - to which she said to pay her 10 baht. It wasn’t about the money but the way she spoke to me, I said I have an infection on my leg (which I was in hospital for the last 5 days and just wanted to clean it - to which she immediately started shouting at me - acting like me asking to wash my hands was something criminal. She was racist. She wouldn’t do this to an older white man or woman- she specifically flipped on me and spoke to me like I was nothing. I then saw an outside tap on my way out and saw the water was flowing out of it into a bowl and overflowing. I picked up the hose and she ran after me and then looked to the security guard, still shouting after me- bear in mind I am limping and in a lot of pain… was interested in the classes but obviously after this I would rather go somewhere that will treat me as human not shit.

reviews.name: Isaac
reviews.text: Muay Thai Street gym offers an exceptional experience for fitness enthusiasts. The facility is impressively clean, creating a hygienic and inviting environment for workouts. Moreover, the gym boasts a comprehensive selection of equipment, ensuring that all your fitness needs are met. Whether you're a beginner or a seasoned athlete, Muay Thai Street provides everything you need to achieve your fitness goals. If you're seeking a top-notch gym experience with cleanliness and quality equipment, Muay Thai Street is the place to be.

reviews.name: Jan Vácha
reviews.text: Great Muay Thai session for two beginners. We had about 5 people in our 10am class on Sunday.

reviews.name: N P
reviews.text: Wanted to try a Muay Thai class today… unfortunately even the lady in the front desk doesn’t even know when the classes start. As I asked where to see the times of the classes she pointed at the sign. The sign literally says 2:00- 9:00( anytime) I guess anytime doesn’t mean anytime in this gym. After two attempts and two unfriendly responses. I am certain to never go to this gym again. Would not recommend.

reviews.name: Roger Kirschner
reviews.text: Modern, clean and aircon. Muai Thai training and a full gym. Staff is great. Actually a nice place to have a workout.

reviews.name: Trent Archer
reviews.text:
Google's listed hours are for the Muay Thai offering. The gym opens at 06:00 🙂

This is a good, budget gym. 250 for one day pass isn't crazy cheap, but 1,000 baht for a week or 1,700 for a month seemed like great value to me. There's a pull up bar, treadmills etc and a good selection of dumbbells. The only thing I wanted but couldn't find was a kettlebell over 4 kilos. The dumbbells go up to 50, though.

reviews.name: Don Eagleton
reviews.text: Great gym ended up with a PT one on one lots of pad work and lots of light sparring Kru Don And Kru Aria very professional old-school muaythai very clean and playful trainers I will be back.

reviews.name: Felix Zilk
reviews.text: This small but neat gym has everything you need: free weights area, kettlebells, dip station with pull-ups, bench press, T-bar row, multi-press etc. There's also a boxing area. The trainer (Olli?) seems extremely relaxed and chilled out, but he's highly skilled with a lot of experience and was able to give me valuable feedback in a one-on-one session. In general, I recommend private training, as the group sessions apparently only consists of 5 rounds of pad work per person. Overall, I can recommend it, especially if you stay nearby.

reviews.name: Wojciech Kacper Pachowicz (Casper)
reviews.text:
Fully equipped gym Plus MUAYTHAI.
Very clean Place, friendly staff.
Recommend to all.

reviews.name: chopsocky
reviews.text: Found this Gym whilst on a short stay in Bangkok, can either use the gym or the Thai boxing studio, both for a cheap price. Plenty of machines & weights and a small open space upstairs. Friendly service also you can buy water here. 1-2-1 Thai boxing sessions are available. Would recommend this place..:))

reviews.name: Oudad Younes
reviews.text:
I had an amazing experience at Muay Thai Street in Bangkok! I initially booked a group session, but since there weren’t many people at that time (as they offer daily sessions), I ended up having a one-on-one class with the instructor. And honestly, it was perfect!

As someone who had never tried Muay Thai before, I was a bit nervous, but TOP, the instructor, was incredibly patient and pedagogical. He took the time to teach me the basics, encouraged me a lot, and really pushed me to give my best. His support and motivation made a huge difference!

If you’re looking for an optimal Muay Thai experience, this is the place to go. The atmosphere is great, and I truly had a fantastic time. I highly recommend it!

reviews.name: Constanza Grili
reviews.text: The receptionist that was working tonight wasn’t nice or friendly. We just went in for a session on our holidays, it’s a basic gym with basic equipment. They charged for towels and water even though you pay 250tbh for the day.

reviews.name: Brady
reviews.text:
Muay Thai training was great.
Both trainers were super helpful and fun.
This is a very small gym so you often get one on one time which is great for a beginner.
The 2500 for unlimited group training for a week was good value for Bangkok.

They gave me enough confidence to go to larger gyms where I would get less attention and need to be doing the right thing for myself.

The space was very clean, there was always a cleaner on site and she was very diligent.

Gym felt too expensive, price is more than Jetts which just has better newer equipment,more variety, longer and classes.

Only reason to use the gym is it’s convenient being at the same space if you want to do Muay Thai training.

reviews.name: Gianni Panelli
reviews.text: I trained Muay Thai here for a class and happened to be the only one, so it turned into a one-on-one session. Hall, the coach, was top quality — super knowledgeable, patient, and professional. He tailored the workout perfectly to suit my strengths while also taking the time to correct any technical flaws I had. I got a lot out of the session and would highly recommend training here to anyone, whether you’re a complete beginner or a more experienced fighter.

reviews.name: Thomas McIntyre
reviews.text: Quality gym with everything you need for a complete workout. 250 for a session. Pretty reasonable.

reviews.name: Simone Bedin
reviews.text: Truly recommended, perfect combination between service and price! Love it

reviews.name: Josh Dyer (JoshCanJump)
reviews.text: Combined gym and Muay Thai facility. Unlimited weekly use of both included in weekly membership feels like incredible value. The drop-in Muay Thai is not too crowded so you are almost 1-to-1 with the coach until you are on the bag or rope.

reviews.name: Logan Cotton
reviews.text:
I went here to use the gym for a day. I didn’t get a Muay Thai training session because I didn’t have time.

As a gym while on vacation, I thought this was fantastic. For 250tb, I could use all the weights and machines. There are proper racks for squatting and bench press, all the essential machines, and loads of weights (plus free wifi). I wish I could have a gym like this everywhere I travel. It was clean, professional, and helped me feel like I was maintaining a little bit of my routine even while traveling.

Five stars and a big thank you to this gym for existing!

reviews.name: C Clarkeey
reviews.text: Great new and clean gym! First time trying out Muay Thai. Reasonable price, friendly and experienced team helped me to learn the fundamental skills. They had a morning 930 and a 1630 afternoon class.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:

We really appreciate your kind words and hope to welcome you back again very soon 🙏💛

reviews.name: Michelle Keehan
reviews.text:
Just checked out the newly opened MP Muay Thai Gym on Wualai Road in Chiang Mai (Old City area) and it’s a great addition to the local scene. Super easy to reach by songthaew and only a few minutes from Wat Sri Suphan.

The space is fresh, clean and thoughtfully set up — quality branded bags, a full boxing ring, and a newly laid mat area that feels great to train on.

Communication with the owners before attending was excellent — clear, friendly and helpful, which made joining a morning session really easy. As the gym has just opened, I ended up having a 2-hour 1:1 session, which was a bonus!

Kru Zalapau was outstanding — intuitive, encouraging and highly skilled, with great English (he’s studied and fought in Australia). We worked pads and technique, and he focused on helping me find my rhythm and flow. He coached, corrected and supported throughout — exactly what you want from a trainer.

This is a fantastic, non-intimidating gym for beginners or anyone trying Muay Thai in Thailand for the first time — but with the experience and coaching ability to challenge more advanced fighters too.

Highly recommended 🙌🥊
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much Michelle 🙏🥊

We truly appreciate you taking the time to share such a thoughtful and detailed review about MP Muay Thai Gym here in Chiang Mai. It means a lot to us, especially as a newly opened gym on Wualai Road.

We’re so happy you enjoyed the space and felt comfortable training here. Creating a clean, welcoming, and well-equipped environment for everyone — from beginners to experienced fighters — is very important to us.

Kru Zalapau will be especially grateful for your kind words. He always puts his heart into every session, and it’s wonderful to hear that you felt supported, challenged, and able to develop your own rhythm and flow during training.

It was a pleasure having you train with us, and we hope to welcome you back again soon for another session 🙌🥊

Warm regards,
MP Muay Thai Gym

This deserves more than 5 stars!
On vacation for the second time with our 3.5-year-old son, and this is one of, if not the best, gym we have trained at. Our son can walk around freely, and they have play equipment for the little ones. The owner also keeps a close eye on things when my wife and I take PT at the same time. Professional trainers who easily adapt to the level of both beginners and advanced. Extensive warm-up and cool-down. The trainers also play and box with the little one, which he loves. All in all, a great gym with a real family feel. We trained here every day for 8 days, and when we come back, we will definitely go again!

title: In Balance Spa
ownerDescription:
“In Balance Spa by Novotel Phuket Vintage Park” a winner of World Luxury Spa Award 2019 is the best choice for those seeking a rejuvenating experience at a spa in Patong.
We offer a variety of spa treatments where guests can choose the right massage and beauty services according to their needs.
The services we provide include body treatments as well as facial treatments, such as Phytomer After Sun Rejuvenate Facial, Thai Herbal Facial, Oriental Thai Massage, Summer Solstice by In Balance, and more.
These services are performed by our professional team of massage therapists, who will make you feel relaxed and comfortable at every moment during the treatment.
address: 89 Rat U Thit 200 Pee Rd Pa Tong, Kathu District, Phuket 83150, Thailand

ownerUpdates.text:
Relax, Restore & Rejuvenate 
Immerse yourself in the timeless art of Thai healing with our Absolute Traditional Thai Massage at In Balance Spa. Experience the perfect harmony of stretching techniques and soothing pressure points, designed to release tension, ease your body, and restore a sense of well-being. 

55 / 80 Minutes | THB 1,090 / 1,490

Travel Recovery Escape 
Restore your balance with our Travel Recovery Escape. This 60-minute rejuvenating treatment combines a back tension relief massage and restorative foot massage, helping ease fatigue, release stress, and refresh your body.

The spa is clean and well-maintained, with a quiet, relaxing room that made it easy to unwind. They use natural products that smell lovely, which added to the overall pleasant atmosphere.

reviews.text:
I came to this place expecting at least a basic level of massage, but the experience was unprofessional and uncomfortable.

The room was very hot and unpleasant. The therapist performed the massage while wearing jeans, which is completely unacceptable in this type of service. The treatment itself felt amateur and below any reasonable standard.

I stopped the massage after about 15 minutes because I did not feel comfortable continuing. Despite this, I was charged the full price of 550 baht as if I had received a full session.

Charging full price for a service that was not properly delivered is not fair and not acceptable.
I do not recommend this place

reviews.name: Richard A Francisco
reviews.text: Asia Thai Traditional Massage is a large massage spa. Prices are competitive here. As soon as you go through the entrance, the boss lady will come over to assist you. She'll explain the services and even take you around when they don't have clients. The foot massage area is like a lounge. The second floor has multiple beds that are separated by curtains. The third floor has private rooms.

reviews.name: Jon
reviews.text: Massage shop down a small alley 5 mins walk from Ratchathewi BTS station.  Nice premises set over a few floors.  Clean & nice decor.   Staff friendly & professional, foot 🦶 massage was quite well done, not the best I’ve had but by far not the worst .. competitively priced too . Shall visit again soon .

reviews.name: Shehab Alhattami
reviews.text: I think it was worst massage i have ever done. If your stuff tired and sleepy don’t accept clients and let them sleep. She was falling asleep while massaging and just wiping the oil over my body with zero strength. Not recommended and waste of money.

reviews.text: This is the fifth time I have been here getting massage. P’ Tuk is really skillful and nice ! I enjoy the whole process !

reviews.name: Ng Y. Chia
reviews.text:
My first experience in a Thai massage. Observed and learn many things, process was elaborate.
3 different oils or creams used for foot massage.
Environment was calming, dimmed, soothing music, makes you want to sleep during the process.
The masseuse's techniques were very gentle, stretching muscles, applying pressure at various points.

Remember wear shorts, even if you've forgotten like I did, they will provide you with clean shorts.

reviews.name: Sean Goh
reviews.text:
This massage shop is located at one of the hotel that i have stayed during this recent trip to Bangkok. Speaking of this shop, i have been patronizing this massage shop since 2011, chance upon this shop as we were previously staying at Asia hotel, which is less than 5mins walk away.

Came by last year march, only to find out they were not operating due to Covid. Since i was staying nearby this round, decided to dropped by and was surprised that they were back in operations. Prices still remain the same, still saw that familiar lady boss.

Had a 2hr full body massage which was 500baht. massage was pretty good. Price is slightly higher as compared to others. The quality of the masseuse can be a hit and miss. Overall, would still recommend if you happen to stay nearby.

reviews.name: Kirill Musto
reviews.text:
If you’re in Bangkok and want a really good massage, I can honestly recommend her. She has her own special technique that makes the treatment feel both relaxing and healing at the same time. Her full Thai massage is done with real skill , the pressure is just right, and you can feel how experienced she is with every movement. It’s not just the usual routine you might get elsewhere , she really puts care and attention into it, and you leave feeling lighter, looser, and completely refreshed.

Name is SA

reviews.name: Tiffany Nguyen
reviews.text: She doesn’t know how to massage, no techniques. Seems like she just learned yesterday or something. The reviews are true.

reviews.name: jean-jacques BARBAROUX
reviews.text: I had a foot massage last sunday with three friends of mine. It was really professionnal. I use to go to this place since 2010 and I still love it.

reviews.name: Hui Chuin Chan
reviews.text: Clean & convenient place as nearby our stay at Asia Hotel Bangkok. My husband & me just did 1 hour foot massage with THB250 per person. I got very good experienced massage by therapist WAN, she was so skillful, caring & observant as when I took the pillow put on my body she noticed I was cold then get a blanket for me. Not only that, she has an excellent skill on massage with right point & right pressure on my foot! And, she is also a knowledgeable therapist as she knew I got stomach bloated when she massage on my certain part of my foot. I was so shock! Compared with other massage places I visited these few days during my Bangkok trip, I strongly recommended this place because of therapist WAN! You are an asset of Asia Thai Traditional Massage! I want to thanks to therapist WAN. Thank you so much!!!

reviews.name: Parker Pan
reviews.text: Wow, if you are looking for good and comfortable massage, you must come here. I have been to more than 20 massage stores, and this store's bed has a hole so that my head can be placed more comfortably when lying on my stomach. This makes for a truly relaxing massage. I have to say, I only saw this kind of bed in this store, otherwise you have to see it in Taiwan.

reviews.name: Air Wasa
reviews.text: Bad experience. Masseuse was amateur and did not apply proper pressure to the right places. I was hurt in a couple of places and had pain the next morning where I didn't have any issues before. It made me very uncomfortable. She was also distracted the whole time. My friend had a terrible experience here with another lady. I would recommend "run!"

reviews.name: Bayon
reviews.text: One of the worst massages I ever had in my life and while living in Thailand. First the 'masseuse' arrived in a crop top to start the massage and soon realised that this is not the right outfit as she was constantly pulling on her pants and top - finally she went to change her shirt. During the massage she mainly did the legs and spend about 5 minutes on my back before going back on the legs - honestly, I had the feeling she had no glue what and how a traditional thai massage should be done. During stretching she did not pay attention where she was putting her leg. There are plenty of other places around this area where you can get a traditional real Thai Massage - avoid this place at all costs.

reviews.name: N Chan
reviews.text: Booked the BeWell Spa through ClassPass,. Abit skeptical at first bc some spa offer on the app wasn’t up to par - but BeWellSpa did not disappointed, and I had beyond great experiences for both first time foot massage with khun LukNam and also second time a full body massage with khun Suda. It’s all in the tiny details. Not just the masseuse, but the whole experience, every touch point with every staff and the facilities at the spa were very pleasant. I tried out the steam room, not only they have prepared iced water and cool towels for me to use, but the post-spa experience was also great (especially the energy ball! Can’t close off the end of a good day without chocolate at Movenpick)! ps. Thank you again to the kindness of the staffs that bought hot tea for my 70 year-old mom who came to have a look at the spa. I will make sure she try the service next time 🤍
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear N Chan,

Thank you so much for your thoughtful and detailed review.

We’re truly delighted that you chose Be Well Spa through ClassPass and gave us the opportunity to welcome you, especially as we understand your initial hesitation. It means a great deal to know that your experiences with Khun Luknam and Khun Suda exceeded your expectations.

Your kind words about the little details, from the care of our therapists to the overall journey and facilities, are deeply appreciated. We’re so pleased you enjoyed the steam room and the post-spa touches, including the iced water, cool towels, and of course the energy ball—paired perfectly with a bit of chocolate to end the day on a sweet note.

It also warms our hearts to hear about your 70-year-old mother’s visit. We’re very happy our team could extend a small gesture of care with hot tea, and we would be absolutely delighted to welcome her for a full spa experience next time.

Thank you once again for your trust and for sharing such a lovely account of your visit. We truly look forward to welcoming you and your family back again soon.

With kind regards,
Wiyada Laoharawe
Director of Rooms
Be Well Spa at Mövenpick BDMS Wellness Resort Bangkok

reviews.name: J. Ford
reviews.text: What a luxurious & beautiful experience. I was so well looked after by Su @ reception and Kratai, an amazing therapist. I recently had surgery and left feeling wonderfully relaxed and spoiled.

reviews.name: Kimber Lee
reviews.text: I had a 30 minute head, neck, shoulder and foot massage by Mona and I left feeling energetic. Mona made me feel extremely comfortable and was a pleasure speaking to. I cannot wait to book my next appointment before I leave Bangkok!

Thank you once again for your review. We look forward to welcoming you back for another rejuvenating treatment before you leave Bangkok.

With kind regards,
Wiyada Laoharawe

reviews.text: Excellent technique by the therapists, very clean and beautiful rooms, warm and friendly staff. Reservations were a breeze. Sauna and steam room in the female area was spotless and well maintained. Little touches like having iced water and iced water were very welcomed. I was expecting basic facial products  to be provided in the locker area for post-shower/steam/sauna, as is common at other spas I visit, hence did not bring my own. However I could ask the staff and they provided a small sample which I appreciated. Thank you to everyone!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:

Wiyada Laoharawe

reviews.name: Valerie Marin
reviews.text: I've been living in Asia for many years and this is by far the best massage i've had . Suda was my massage therapist. She was amazing and understood exactly what I needed. I highly recommend this spa, the facilities are beautiful, relaxing ambiance with an attention to detail and the staff is adorable. Though prices are higher than many massage place you may find in the streets of Bangkok, the prices remain reasonable for the quality of service and atmosphere.

reviews.text:

A special thanks to Ms. Suda and Ms. Kratai for their kindness, professionalism, and excellent service. They made the experience even more enjoyable and comfortable.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for a relaxing and high-quality spa experience in Bangkok. I will definitely come back again!

reviews.text:
Be Well Spa มีบริการหลายอย่าง ห้องทรีตเมนต์ที่นี่ ตกแต่งอย่างสวยงาม ครั้งนี้ได้ลองทำเล็บ พี่โมนาและพี่สุดา มือเบามาก บริการด้วยความสุภาพอ่อนโยน ให้คำแนะนำเรื่องเล็บดีมาก และที่ชอบมากๆ คือเป็นใช้สีของแบรนด์ Morgan Taylor ซึ่งเป็นสี Organic เด็กๆ ทาได้

reviews.textTranslated:
Be Well Spa offers a variety of services. The treatment rooms here are beautifully decorated. This time, I tried getting my nails done. Mona and Suda were very gentle and courteous, providing excellent advice on nails. What I really liked was that they used Morgan Taylor nail polish, which is organic and safe for children to wear.
My daughter loved it! ...After getting her nails done, we sat in the relaxation area and enjoyed hot chamomile tea served with energy balls, which were delicious and guilt-free. ...Then we had a hot compress, which was very relaxing.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
เรียน พี่ผัก Family

ขอบพระคุณเป็นอย่างสูงสำหรับการแบ่งปันประสบการณ์สปาที่ Be Well Spa ค่ะ เราดีใจมากที่คุณและลูกสาวประทับใจกับการทำเล็บ และการดูแลจากคุณโมนาและคุณสุดาที่ให้บริการด้วยความสุภาพอ่อนโยน 

เรายินดีที่ได้ทราบว่าคุณชื่นชอบผลิตภัณฑ์ของ Morgan Taylor ซึ่งปลอดภัย เป็นมิตรต่อสุขภาพ และเหมาะสำหรับเด็กๆ เช่นกันค่ะ รวมถึงการได้ผ่อนคลายในโซน Relax พร้อมชาคาโมมายล์และเอ็นเนอร์จี้บอล รวมถึงการประคบด้วยแผ่นสมุนไพรอุ่นๆ ที่ช่วยให้รู้สึกสบายและผ่อนคลาย

ขอบคุณอีกครั้งที่เลือกใช้บริการกับเรา และหวังว่าจะได้มีโอกาสต้อนรับพี่ผัก family อีกครั้งค่ะ

reviews.textTranslated: I really regret spending 450 baht. Such bad luck before Songkran... My 7-year-old niece at home gets a much better massage... I'm someone who's had a lot of massage experience... The owner should really reconsider this. Do customers have to take a gamble like this? This was my first time at this shop and I had the same experience. The masseuse didn't click with the customer, and the masseuse wasn't skilled at all. Customers can tell the difference... This is really bad. The 2 stars I'm giving are for the atmosphere and cleanliness of the shop.

reviews.text:
นวดมา 3 หมอไม่ซ้ำ
เจอหมอนวดดีทุกคน รู้เส้น นวดเป็นจริงๆ ไม่ใช้ศอกพร่ำเพรื่อ

แนะนำให้โทรจองก่อน
reviews.textTranslated:
I've had massages from 3 different masseuses.
Everyone was excellent. They knew the pressure points and were truly skilled at massage. They didn't use their elbows unnecessarily.

They only used their fingers to gently press and massage the pressure points. When they hit the right spot, they didn't need to press hard to release the tension.

They weren't talkative and were genuinely skilled.

reviews.textTranslated: Honestly, this place doesn't deserve even one star. I'm extremely disappointed. I arrived at the shop around 2:40 PM, but the masseuse wasn't available. Everyone was asking what time she was available, and someone said 3:30 PM. The owner asked if I wanted to book an appointment, so I did. She took my number and said she would call to remind me closer to the time. I asked what number ended in, and she pointed to the shop's number, ending in 3245. Around 3:25 PM, I went back, and they told me the masseuse I booked was no longer available. They said they called but no one answered. I asked what number they used, and she said the same number I called from. It turned out the number that called ended in 0135, and no one answered. The masseuse who was unavailable had already booked a new client and called to cancel my appointment. What was the point of booking me at 3:30 PM if she wasn't available? Did she not want to provide service? Or is it a different price for massages? Do they make more money massaging other clients? Or what? Am I at fault for not answering the phone? A two-hour massage costs 450 baht, and I always tip 100-150 baht. I don't understand the context, the service, or the shop's management system. I am extremely disappointed and saddened. I urge the shop owner to improve and rectify the service and store management system.

reviews.text:
We visited Nakara Spa in Phuket for a full body massage with scrub, and it was a truly relaxing and enjoyable experience. The spa has a calm and soothing ambience, perfect for unwinding.

The massage was very professional, and the therapists were skilled and attentive, making sure we were comfortable throughout the session. The body scrub left the skin feeling refreshed, smooth, and rejuvenated.

Everything from the cleanliness to the service quality was well-maintained, and the staff were polite and welcoming. Overall, it was a great spa experience, and we left feeling completely relaxed.

The only downside is that it’s a bit on the pricey side, but the quality of service and experience make it worth it. Highly recommended if you’re looking for a quality massage in Phuket!

reviews.name: Hatish Kanbi
reviews.text:
Nakara Massage in Phuket offers a truly luxurious and high-end experience from start to finish. The setting is elegant, peaceful, and beautifully presented, creating the perfect atmosphere to relax the moment you walk in. Every member of staff was exceptionally polite, attentive, and professional, making the service feel refined and welcoming throughout. The massage itself was outstanding — expertly delivered, deeply relaxing, and tailored with real care and skill. Everything about the experience felt premium, polished, and thoughtfully done. I left feeling completely refreshed, restored, and very impressed all 5 times!

I would highly recommend Nakara Massage to anyone in Phuket looking for a first-class wellness experience.

Thank you all at Nakara and for the lovely wooden stick for reflexology, a perfect souvenir.

Many thanks!

reviews.text: My husband and I came in after dinner. We had been walking for a quite a bit and wanted to end the day with a foot massage. I'm not big on massages and haven't been to one in at least a year, so I wasn't looking forward to it. Lol. But by the time we finished, I was glad that he suggested it. Fern, the masseuse, was attentive and kept reminding me to relax so that I could get the full benefits of the massage. As massages go, there were uncomfortable moments as my body naturally pushed back to the pain. But interestingly, there was no soreness after it ended, which I liked. Oh, the foot massage ended with a back massage actually and that was something I didn't think I need lol. Perhaps hardcore Thai massage enthusiasts would prefer something more... hardcore but this is my kind of massage. The price is perhaps a bit more than other places but they have a menu outside of the shop so no one is blindsided into paying more than they agreed for. I was happy with what I got. I had a good experience and and that's what matters.

reviews.text:
It was okay. Got one of the packages. It felt really rushed and at one point I was lying there in a towel that didn't cover much in an icy cold room, a cloth over my eyes and no idea where the beautician went (there was a wait for showers). There was no communication and eventually another beautician gave me a robe. We got one of the bundles and for the price the experience should have been relaxing.

The scrub was great, the massage was average (rushed) but I loved the facial. Perhaps it was a busy day but we did book in advance.

You get to choose your own body scrub and massage oil. The spa is gorgeous and very clean. The manager/owner has impeccable customer service.

reviews.name: Terence Heng
reviews.text:
One of my worst massage experiences in Thailand.

What I ordered: a 1 hour head, neck and shoulder massage. This place charges 3x the street price. I requested for a focus on my head and agreed with the counter staff that 20 mins of the massage be dedicated to the head. I watched her convey this to the masseuse but to be sure I also repeated this request directly to the masseuse who nodded in apparent confirmation.

Quality of massage: Bewilderingly terrible. The massage was unbearably sloppy with almost no technique.

First, the masseuse was clearly inexperienced and spent almost the entire hour haphazardly rubbing the same area on my back. She seemed clueless where the knots were.

Second, despite my repeated requests for the masseuse to apply more strength/pressure, I can only describe the massage as, at best, an hour long exercise in merely applying massage oil.

Third, and this is the real kicker, instead of 20 mins dedicated to the head as agreed, the masseuse "massaged" my head for a grand total of 6 squeezes (15 seconds at most?!) before announcing that the massage had ended.

To be fair, it probably is the luck of the draw as my friend's experience here with a different masseuse was good. Nevertheless, given the number of poor reviews here, the quality control here appears to be a persistent unresolved issue.

reviews.name: Claire Hu
reviews.text:
Service: Hot Oil & Coconut Oil Massage
Price: 1,100 Baht

Private room: yes, but the setting was not great and towels were very low quality and almost sandpaper like, my skin hurt after the massage.

Unfortunately, this massage was an absolute disappointment from start to finish. Despite paying a premium for oil treatments, the execution was far below professional standards.
Major Issues:
• Lack of Technique: The therapist seemed completely inexperienced. Instead of a proper massage, it felt more like light tickling on the back and legs with zero pressure applied.
• Unstructured Head Massage: The head massage was chaotic, with no rhythm or pattern. It felt as though the therapist had no training in how to properly target pressure points.
• Abrupt & Unsatisfying Finish: Every section ended with a "light tap" that felt unfinished and served no purpose, leaving me with the impression that the massage was incomplete.

Verdict: For 1,100 Baht, I expected a skilled practitioner. I would not recommend this place if you are looking for an actual therapeutic or relaxing massage.

reviews.textTranslated: Today I used their service for 4 hours. Normally it's 130 baht per hour, and I tip 300 baht. Today was normal, but the masseuse didn't inform me of the price during the massage, and it was on a shared bed on the lowest floor. When it was time to pay, another masseuse said it was a Thai massage focusing on neck, shoulders, and back. Normally, a full body massage includes neck, shoulders, and back, and sometimes the masseuse adds balm or oil. They charged me 800 baht for the entire massage. I was confused. My friend got a massage on the other side, and we met outside. They charged 130 baht for one hour and included balm and oil. I wasn't impressed with this service. There seems to be a double standard in charging customers. However, the masseuse who massaged me was skilled, so I tipped her 200 baht. I'm giving this place 1 star because of the double pricing.

reviews.text: Io e mio marito abbiamo scoperto questo centro per caso rientrando in hotel a tarda sera. reviews.textTranslated: My husband and I discovered this spa by chance while returning to the hotel late in the evening. Although we weren't entirely convinced at first, it turned out to be the best massage we've ever had in Thailand. This is our second year here and we get about one massage a day, so we have a few points of comparison: the masseurs are supremely skilled! Unfortunately, due to time constraints, we weren't able to return, but I assure you it's absolutely worth it. Never judge a book by its cover: try it and you won't be disappointed!

reviews.text: 태국에 여행을 오면 하루에 한번은 마사지를 받는데 작년 여행에 매일 마사지를 받던 분이 이번에 가니 그만두셨다고 해서 새로운 곳을 찾다가 3일째에 ‘다’라는 여자마사지사분께 마사지를 받게 되었습니다. 꼬집히거나 팔꿈치로 찍히는 느낌이 아닌 넓게 강한 압으로 꾹꾹 정성껏해주셔서 너무 시원하고 좋았습니다. 여행이 끝나고 돌아가는 날에는 목, 팔, 허리 관절 곳곳의 가동범위가 여행전보다 훨씬 좋아진게 느껴졌습니다. 마지막 날 ‘다’에게 올가을에 다시 여행 오겠다고 했는데 왔을 때 ‘다’가 여기 꼭 있었으면 좋겠어요.
reviews.textTranslated: Whenever I travel to Thailand, I make it a point to get a massage at least once a day. Last year, the masseuse I used to get massages from every day had quit, so when I arrived this time, I was looking for a new place and ended up getting a massage from a female masseuse named 'Da' on the third day. She applied strong, broad pressure with great care, rather than pinching or being pounded with elbows, which was incredibly refreshing and wonderful. By the time I returned home, I could feel that the range of motion in my neck, arms, and lower back joints had improved significantly compared to before the trip. On the last day, I told 'Da' that I would travel again this autumn, and I really hope she will be here when I come back.

reviews.name: Denis Čaušević
reviews.text: By far the best Muay Thai training I’ve ever experienced! Trainer gave me his full attention and tailored each lesson perfectly. I only wish I could stay in Thailand longer and train with him for a whole year.

reviews.name: Solefood AU
reviews.text: One of the most nice and friendly coach in Chiang Mai, he has very good English and always takes the time to fix your technique. One thing that he focuses on that is different to others is on western boxing as well as traditional Muay Thai. Highly recommended

reviews.name: Niamh C
reviews.text: Kru Ton is one of the nicest trainers I've ever met. He's so helpful, and also makes training and fighting super fun. Can't wait to go back train with him again!

reviews.name: Alexandra
reviews.text:
Learning Muay Thai can feel intimidating especially when there’s a language barrier with the coaches and pressure from the gym to buy memberships just to make money off of you as a tourist.
I was recommended to train with Kru Ton as he’s patient, very friendly, speaks clearly and calmly, is passionate about technical skills, and has loads of experience fighting. He was amazing! I’m so eager to learn more with him and watch my progress! I highly recommend him if you’re looking for a trainer that will go above and beyond in your Muay Thai journey and focus on form in addition to power. Thank you Kru Ton! 🙏🏼

reviews.name: Cait Charles
reviews.text: After taking classes at many different gyms and with many different teachers, I can say that Kru Ton is a really, really exceptional teacher. He's kind, patient, and very attentive to details - he can fix small things in your technique that other teachers might not notice or say anything about. His passion for Muay Thai really comes through in his teaching, and it's contagious! WARNING: Don't go to Kru Ton if you don't want to get addicted to Muay Thai.

reviews.name: Marco Genovese
reviews.text: I’ve trained muay thai in thailand for a couple years and this is the best gym I’ve ever trained at. Kru Ton is experienced, patient, technical and has a very good english level to give you tips and adjust your style in the most efficient way. Hidden gem, outside the touristy traps.

reviews.name: Eugen Patru
reviews.text:
If you want the true thai boxing experience, train with Ton.

Spent one month training with him. It was amazing. Going for a run through the rice fields at sunset, then grinding through physical exercises, bag work, pad work and sparring for a bunch of hours.

Definitely coming back as soon as I return to Thailand

reviews.name: Angela Leuenberger
reviews.text: He is by far the best trainer I've ever had! I've been to about 20 different gyms throughout Thailand, and nothing compares to this one. I can wholeheartedly recommend it.

reviews.name: Karson Cheng
reviews.text: Kru Ton is the best! He is super knowledgeable and sharp. He can see the smallest issues with your form or technique and can help you adjust it accordingly. Plus, he can make training very fun.  Any questions you might have, just ask Kru Ton!

reviews.text: Old style Thai coach but speaks amazing English and cares for fighters which you don’t find a lot.

reviews.textTranslated: Great gym! I trained here for two weeks. Kru Ton is a fantastic trainer with a keen eye for detail. He conveys this in a very fun and engaging way. Besides the group classes, I can also highly recommend the personal training sessions.

De trainingen zijn uitdagend en motiverend, met misschien wel een van de beste trainers om van te leren. Iedereen is welkom, ongeacht je niveau. Zeker een aanrader!
reviews.textTranslated: A great place to train Muay Thai! The gym has a very family-like atmosphere and a fun, close-knit group where you easily make new friends. The workouts are challenging and motivating, with perhaps one of the best trainers to learn from. Everyone is welcome, regardless of your level. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Moises Bautista
reviews.text: We wanted a massage and were intrigued by the number of their customers. We had to wait a little bit but well worth it. Their masseuses were very accommodating. Also, I believe they’re the most affordable from all the other spa we went to and that’s a plus plus.

reviews.name: Sae Potter
reviews.text:
I really like this place.
It’s clean, reasonable prices and good massage who I got.
People keep coming to get service.

reviews.name: Mango M
reviews.text: Had a terrible experience here and I’ve been to Thailand 5 times and my partner 7 times always getting massages along the way. Upon entry, they were not friendly at all. During my Thai massage, my masseur was too firm and after repeatedly telling her to be more gentle, I felt like she went in harder. I have walked away pretty sore and most definitely not relaxed. The masseurs for me and my partner were talking throughout, quite unprofessional and ruined it. I preferred the massage parlour down the hill from them where the ladies were more friendly and the massages better and more relaxing.

reviews.name: Denise E
reviews.text: My partner and I had a terrible experience and would not recommend this place to friends and/or family. The workers were not friendly when we walked in. We asked for a 2hr massage and were more than willing to pay 1000 baht each and they were so bothered. It was obvious they did not want to do a 2hr massage for both of us so we opted for the 1hr. The masseuses talked the ENTIRE time to one another and were so loud. Nothing was relaxing about this massage. The massage felt rushed and we felt like an inconvenience to this shop. I would pay quadruple the price for another massage anywhere else before going back to this store. Do not go here.

reviews.name: V Jackson
reviews.text: Very close to Bandara Beach Resort so I stopped in for a gel color change on my hands and feet. Quoted 1020 baht. A second person came in to do my nails and told me I needed a fill-in which would be an additional 300 baht. When k was done my total was 1500 baht. Can I not add? How did 1320 become 1500? Price gauging when servicing foreigners seems to be the norm in Thailand. Very unfair. Service was good, people were extremely nice, and my nails and feet look great (although no mani or pedi just color change), basically $44 USD which would be the exact same price in the US. They also took their time. My one star off is due to charging more than what was quoted to me in the beginning.

reviews.name: Prabin Bhusal
reviews.text:
Had a great massage, me and my wife did thai and foot massage and was great. Body feels so relaxed after the message.
Ladies over there were very friendly.

reviews.name: Bhavna Lakhenpaul
reviews.text: Good staff, professional however not the most relaxing experience as you can hear the staff talking during massages and other customers. There is good AC, they treat you well and give you water at the end of treatments. The massage salon is the cleanest and most reasonable priced around that area / hill of massage parlours.

reviews.name: Sri Izzati
reviews.text: Very bad experience. We request to add some pressure during massage, but the masseur makes face in front of us. Dont try foot scrub because they will scrub very hard even if you are hurt they will continue to scrub and even scold us to stay still. Their attitude is like DIVA

reviews.name: Hui Zhong Chow
reviews.text: Only come here if you DO NOT MIND the masseurs KEEP TALKING throughout your massage session. I did back and shoulder massage and my first masseur was pressing against my spinal cord which is extremely painful, I requested to change to another masseur which is much better but still do not feel great after the session. My partner enjoyed the session but again the masseurs are way too talkative.

I had to ask on several occasions to go harder and was told I should have order a sports massage. My son pedicure and mani was not up to scratch. Cut file job. Won’t be back. Try Na Ananta spa opposite the Pullman.

Highly recommend!

Offer water as well.

reviews.text: This was our choice of massage place in Panwa, clean, lovely ladies and every massage lady had their own slightly different style but each was relaxing and enjoyable.  Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Franciska Bianka Olsson
reviews.text: Lovely experience here. Nice air-conditioned environment and friendly staff. I had a reflexology foot massage here and had my nails done and was very happy with the quality of the service and overall experience.

reviews.name: Mahmood Usmani
reviews.text: This amazing massage place is located steps (uphill) from Cape Panwa Hotel. They have high quality massages and spa items like facials and scrubs for a reasonable price. One downside is that they do not accept Visa even though there is a Visa sticker so bring cash!

title: Massage
address: WCQH+P4H, Ko Kaeo, Mueang Phuket District, Phuket 83000, Thailand

reviews.name: Billy Green
reviews.text: Great massage, just a short walk from the hotel and nice to support the local business 600 Baht 😍 lovely people 🇹🇭🏖️

reviews.name: Loretta Köhlmoos-Santos
reviews.text: Nicest local massages, super friendly and humble and great prices!!!

reviews.name: GSTreiber16
reviews.text: Simple location with a very nice atmosphere and a good Massage. We were here 3 times in our holidays

reviews.name: Armita Ghalandar
reviews.text:
Nice woman! Go visit her and get a massage for 1 hr full body 400 BAHT!
Facials too 300 Baht

reviews.name: Ary
reviews.text: One of the most authentic massages!!

reviews.name: Mila Wendt
reviews.text: Had a lovely experience, great massage and very kind service.

reviews.name: Kenneth Choo
reviews.text: Know what to expect and you'll be fine. :) As with the other reviews, price is now 600thb with oil (is needed cos of the pressure they apply). The place is well kept but do not expect frills like background music or Aircon, rather the sounds of mopeds going by. For the price you get a really good massage and really friendly and attentive staff. Max 2 people at any time. Would go back!

reviews.name: Alina Kotrubenko
reviews.text: Najlepszy tajski masaż w moim życiu! Panie wykonujące masaż są niezwykle miłe, uprzejme i bardzo profesjonalne. Cały zabieg był wykonany z dużą starannością. Miejsce jest zadbane i ma przyjemną atmosferę. Herbatką i poczęstunek super. Zdecydowanie warto odwiedzić będąc na wyspie.
reviews.textTranslated: The best Thai massage I've ever had! The ladies performing the massage are incredibly kind, courteous, and very professional. The entire treatment was performed with great care. The place is well-maintained and has a pleasant atmosphere. The tea and refreshments were excellent. Definitely worth a visit while on the island.

reviews.name: Anna
reviews.text: Extrem freundlich, gute Massage, Massagestudio einfach aber nützlich. 60min Massage kosten 600 Bath (Februar 2026).
reviews.textTranslated: Extremely friendly, good massage, massage studio simple but functional. A 60-minute massage costs 600 baht (February 2026).

reviews.name: Katha
reviews.text:
Eine richtig schöne, authentische Massageerfahrung. Der kleine Laden liegt nicht weit von unserem Hotel entfernt und die beiden Frauen waren unglaublich freundlich und aufmerksam. Die klassische Thai-Massage war technisch wirklich sehr gut und sie sind toll auf unsere Verspannungen und Bedürfnisse eingegangen.

Die Räumlichkeiten sind eher einfach, aber sauber und angenehm. Irgendwie hatte die ganze Atmosphäre mit den vorbeifahrenden Rollern und den krähenden Hähnen draußen genau diesen besonderen, ursprünglichen Thailand-Charme. Wir haben uns sehr wohlgefühlt.
reviews.textTranslated:
A truly wonderful, authentic massage experience. The small shop is located not far from our hotel, and the two women were incredibly friendly and attentive. The classic Thai massage was technically very well done, and they perfectly addressed our tension and needs.

The premises are rather simple, but clean and pleasant. Somehow, the whole atmosphere, with the passing scooters and the crowing roosters outside, had that special, original Thai charm. We felt very comfortable.

reviews.name: Magda Zapadka
reviews.text: Serdecznie polecam jeśli jesteście na wyspie! Panie są przemiłe i świetnie wykonują masaże. Byliśmy z mężem dwa razy i jesteśmy bardzo zadowoleni.
reviews.textTranslated: I highly recommend it if you're on the island! The ladies are incredibly kind and give excellent massages. My husband and I have been there twice and are very pleased.

reviews.name: Heiko Schlewitt
reviews.text:
Februar 2026
Tolle Erfahrung, die Frauen waren sehr einfühlsam, Bei der ersten Massage gab es ein Check und ab dann die nächsten 10x eine angepasste Massage.
Preis/Leistung Super
Dankeschön für die tolle Pflege 🤗
reviews.textTranslated:
February 2026
Great experience! The women were very empathetic. The first massage included a check-up, and the next 10 sessions were tailored to my needs.

Excellent value for money! Thank you for the wonderful care! 🤗

reviews.name: Sylwia Lehmann
reviews.text: Doskonały masaż tajski, natychmiast czuć powrót energii, masażystka zaangażowana i serdeczna jak całe otoczenie. Idealne rozwiązanie dla osób przebywających na wyspie kokosowej. Nie trzeba nigdzie jechać, ceny bardzo rozsądne.  Polecam to miejsce. Byłam 3 razy podczas mojego urlopu ,zbyt późno odkryłam, że takie miejsce jest 5 minut pieszo od hotelu. A warto się przejść codziennie:-)
reviews.textTranslated: An excellent Thai massage. You immediately feel a return of energy. The masseuse is dedicated and warm, as is the entire family. It's a perfect solution for those staying on Cocos Island. No need to travel anywhere, and the prices are very reasonable. I recommend this place. I went three times during my vacation, only to discover too late that such a place was a five-minute walk from the hotel. It's worth a daily visit :-)

reviews.name: keni
reviews.text: Mejor lugar de hacerse masajes en la isla! Muy agradables y buen precio
reviews.textTranslated: Best place to get a massage on the island! Very nice and good price

reviews.name: Sabine K
reviews.text: Sehr zu empfehlen, tolle Massage und zwei sehr freundliche Frauen. Haben uns 2x massieren lassen.
reviews.textTranslated: Highly recommended, great massage and two very friendly women. We had two massages.

reviews.name: M. G.
reviews.text: Waren 5 Tage im Barcelo Coconut Island und haben uns hier 2x massieren lassen. Preise liegen jetzt bei 600 Bath, was aber vollkommen in Ordnung ist weil man hier eine richtig gute Massage bekommt. Die Damen sind super freundlich und haben uns sogar selbstgemachten Tee, selbstgemachte Kekse und Wasser angeboten.
reviews.textTranslated: We spent five days at the Barcelo Coconut Island and had two massages here. Prices are now around 600 baht, which is perfectly reasonable because you get a really good massage. The ladies are incredibly friendly and even offered us homemade tea, homemade cookies, and water.

reviews.name: Deluca Med
reviews.text: Super freundlich, usgezeichnette massage!
reviews.textTranslated: Super friendly, excellent massage!

reviews.name: Ali
reviews.text:
So eine nette Frau bietet hier etwas versteckt  Massagen an. Wir haben uns erst nicht getraut, aber so einen herzlichen Menschen habe ich noch nie kennengelernt. Wenn ihr auf Coconut Island seid, lasst euch hier massieren, ihr werdet es wirklich nicht bereuen.
Eine Stunde Massage kostet nur 400 Baht.
reviews.textTranslated:
This lovely woman offers massages in a somewhat hidden spot. We were hesitant at first, but I've never met such a warm and welcoming person. If you're ever on Coconut Island, get a massage here; you really won't regret it.

An hour-long massage costs only 400 baht.

reviews.name: Ewa Leszczyńska
reviews.text: Jeśli mieszkasz w hotelu obok polecam masaże w tym miejscu, cena ok 400-500 batów, panie wykonują świetnie masaże:)
reviews.textTranslated: If you are staying in the hotel next door, I recommend massages at this place, the price is around 400-500 baht, the ladies give great massages :)

reviews.name: Michaela Žáková
reviews.text: Už nestoji 400,ale 600 THB.I přesto stojí zato, nedejte na první dojem.Je zde čisto a masáž super. Pouzívaji, voné oleje  k masáži. Kdo rád podpoří místní obyvatele, tak at jde do toho.
reviews.textTranslated: It's no longer 400, but 600 THB. And it's still worth it, don't be fooled by the first impression. It's clean and the massage is great. They use fragrant oils for massage. If you like to support the locals, go for it.

title: what a WHY Sanctuary
ownerDescription:
“Where Curiosity meets Creation”
Co-creating Space, Café and Workshop.
address: The Ascend, 107/07 Soi Sathu Pradit 6, Thung Wat Don, Sathon, Bangkok 10120, Thailand
plusCode: PG3G+4Q Bangkok, Thailand

reviews.name: Max Okazaki
reviews.text:
I went for the Drink Creation Workshop and it was an awesome experience to try and design a drink to represent a moment, a feeling, a milestone, or a future. The process was one that engaged all my senses and parts of my brain that I feel like I usually don’t - from smelling different spices and ingredients, to tasting and experimenting, all in an effort to turn a feeling into a taste.

The sanctuary offers a bunch of workshops and was a lovely place to spend a few hours!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for visiting us and we hope that we would have an opportunity to welcome you again. Our core value stays the same and we have evolved over time, you would find much more things to do with us.

reviews.name: Elisa Serafini
reviews.text:
Amazing space to enhance creativity and thinking. I visited the space and fell in love with the vibes and the activities that are offered. For example: 3D printing, arts, reading, and more. You can come and try the activity alone or with a group, the staff will help you and guide you if you need.
Plus: they serve amazing and rare tea. This is a very innovative concept that deserves to be explored and lived.

reviews.name: Karishma Anand
reviews.text: What a WHY Sanctuary is an amazing amalgamation of a lot of creative spaces put together to create a unique experiences for whoever visits. I felt right at home from the moment I entered the space. This was my first visit and I hope to make it a regular one. 🙂

reviews.name: Alpha Sinworn
reviews.text: A fun way and safe space to make arts and learn how your head, heart and hands connect.

reviews.name: K P.T
reviews.text: There're many workshops to help you find more about yourself. I went there with my friends. We did the clay sculpture. It's very nice to see how you and your friends express themselves through it. I really enjoyed the atmosphere. Highly recommended!!🫶🏻🫶🏻

reviews.name: Navarerk Kaewphakdee
reviews.text:
Went there for a crafting workshop and really
loved it. The staff were super helpful in guiding you to explore your own creativity!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for visiting us and glad that you had a wonderful experience, your voice keep us growing and we would love welcome you again soon.

reviews.name: Keith Baird
reviews.text: Such an incredible space for workshops. I recently participated in a public speaking group activity here and loved the vibes and environment. Highly recommend

reviews.name: Supo
reviews.text: Such a cool concept! Bamm and her team are the nicest. Highly recommend for those looking for an activity to hang out and connect with friends

reviews.name: Julian Tse
reviews.text: Bamm’s mission to encourage us to be more curious and appreciative of the life we live, and world we live in is incredible - I highly recommend a visit!

reviews.name: Puntila Sapsorn
reviews.text: Fun activities! Great place to explore with curiosity!

reviews.name: Daina Bartusevičiūtė
reviews.text: Amazing experience at What&Why today ❤️❤️❤️

reviews.name: kanyarrut rojkiratikarn
reviews.text:
วันนี้ได้มีโอกาสไปร่วมเวิร์กช็อปที่ What a Why sanctuary ประทับใจมากๆ ทั้งการดูแลของพี่ๆ ที่ร้าน กิจกรรมที่หลากหลาย และบรรยากาศที่อบอุ่น กิจกรรมแต่ละอย่างช่วยให้เราได้ฝึกสมาธิ อยู่กับตัวเอง และได้ทบทวนช่วงเวลาต่างๆ ในชีวิต วันนี้เราได้ลองทั้งการชงชา และปั้นดินพอลิเมอร์ สนุกและมีความสุขมากๆ ทุกคนในกลุ่มเต็มไปด้วยรอยยิ้มตั้งแต่เริ่มจนจบ คนที่แนะนำร้านนี้อย่างเราก็ปลื้มใจสุดๆ ร้านน่ารักมาก เครื่องดื่มก็อร่อย พี่ๆ ที่ดูแลเอาใจใส่อย่างเต็มที่จริงๆ เป็นประสบการณ์ที่ดีที่อยากแนะนำให้ทุกคนมาลองค่ะ

I had a wonderful experience joining a workshop at What a Why sanctuary. I was truly impressed by the care and attention from the staff, the variety of activities, and the warm atmosphere. Each activity allowed me to practice mindfulness, stay present, and reflect on different moments in my life. Today, my friends and I got to experience tea brewing and polymer clay crafting — it was so much fun and filled with joy. Everyone had big smiles from start to finish, and as the one who recommended the place, I couldn’t be happier. The café is lovely, the drinks are delicious, and the team truly puts their heart into every detail. I highly recommend this wonderful experience to everyone!
reviews.textTranslated:
Today I had the opportunity to participate in a workshop at What a Why sanctuary, and I was very impressed. The staff were incredibly attentive, the activities were varied, and the atmosphere was warm and welcoming. Each activity helped me practice mindfulness, connect with myself, and reflect on different moments in my life. Today, I tried both tea brewing and polymer clay sculpting. It was so much fun and I felt incredibly happy. Everyone in the group was smiling from start to finish. As someone who recommended this place, I'm so glad! The shop is adorable, the drinks are delicious, and the staff are truly caring and attentive. It was a good experience that I would recommend everyone to try.

The café is lovely, the drinks are delicious, and the team truly puts their heart into every detail. I highly recommend this wonderful experience to everyone!

Some days they have special events. Skilled baristas can even pay to create their own drinks. The drinks and desserts are delicious! 🥤🍹 #Happyboy💯 what a WHY Sanctuary

reviews.name: Chacha shbgem
reviews.text: ร้านเล็ก ๆ แต่คูลมาก ! สั่งชาร้อน ๆ มาแต่แอร์ที่ร้านฉ่ำเกิน ชวนหลับมาก เสียดายที่ไม่ได้ทำ workshop รอบหน้าจะไม่พลาดแน่นอนค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: This small shop is super cool! I ordered hot tea, but the air conditioning was so cold it made me want to fall asleep. It's a shame I missed the workshop; I'll definitely be back next time!

reviews.name: Bae Work Work

reviews.name: Chanakant Kulnipat

reviews.name: Jargalsaikhan Erdene (Jason)
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for visiting us, your voice keep us growing. We hope that we could welcome you again soon.

title: Sabai Dee Body Massage
address: 380, 4 Pattaya Sai Song Rd, Muang Pattaya, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri 20150, Thailand
plusCode: WVWQ+FG Pattaya City, Bang Lamung District, Chon Buri, Thailand

reviews.name: J N
reviews.text:
Very good.. been here twice, and always left satisfied. The ladies I chose were amazing.. they have different prices for the fish bowl. Yellow is the lowest price but there's not many of them. Pink is the 2nd most expensive and I think green is the highest.
First time I came here I paid 4500, second time was 4223 (they charge a fee for card payments, think 3%). Think they also revised their prices since last year.

PS I can see a lot of people (foreigners) leaving bad reviews for this shop - I am guessing they came into this shop with a large group of their friends acting like complete idiots, talking loud, drunk, and were rude / disrespectful to the staff and ladies, hence they didn't get a good experience.
Too many ignorant tourists (mainly western) in Thailand with no respect for the people and culture.. remember you are a guest here, and that nobody owes you anything. Follow the rules, be respectful , and you will have a good time.

reviews.name: Stan M
reviews.text: I went to Sabai Dee March 23, 2026.  Absolutely amazing. I will go back again today.  I went at about 1:30pm, rather early in the day and there were only about 20 women, but they were beautiful.  It was difficult to select only one.  Nana gave me a wonderful experience that I will remember for a long time.  Her English was good, which added a lot.  She was all smiles and her enthusiasm was intoxicating.

reviews.name: Leon van der Heijden
reviews.text: First time for me but worth every penny! I had the most amazing massage++ from Min. Wow....Super! Prices bit higher then before as I read, but again worth your time and money.

reviews.name: Timothy Loveday
reviews.text: Amazing experience would recommend the soapy massage to everyone. No photos allowed please forgive the random photo added it wouldn't let me post with adding an image.

reviews.name: MOHAN KUMAR
reviews.text:
1. Very few good looking and the rest are average
2. Prices for those were expensive than other similar massage parlours next door like honey 2
3. It is definitely worth trying the soapy massage, but the rooms are not clean and I doubt the hygiene
4. There’s too much of milking clients, asking to buy drinks for girls which are super expensive even the coke is like 140 THB when it’s only 16THB in 7-11
5. Asking for tips a lot, already I felt I paid to much for her and asking tip again.
6. People are preferring honey2 over this, and this lobby is a bit empty in the morning hours especially after lunch till 3pm

reviews.name: Priyant Ranjan
reviews.text: Very attractive ambience but when I visited here there were no good girls available, comparatively Honey 3 better, Rates are also same

reviews.name: For Liquidsky
reviews.text: Unfairly low rating—a really interesting experience, worth trying at least once. Just remember to smile and pick the ones who wave back or smile at you. Yeah, it narrows your options, but chances are you’ll actually enjoy the service. Only downside? For the price, I’d expect the girls to speak a bit more English than just a couple of phrases—but hey, at least they understand what you’re saying

reviews.name: Putra Pribowo
reviews.text: Their security guard lied to me about the fare on the "one baht bus." This was my first time in Thailand, and it was going straight to Pattaya. The hotel I was staying at wasn't far from here. After walking a few meters, I asked their security guard how much the minibus to Pattaya's Walking Street would cost. At first, I didn't know it was a "one baht bus," which only costs 1 baht. The security guard replied, "50 baht per person." He then directed me to one of the parked buses and told the driver it would be 50 baht. And I was scammed.

reviews.name: Boots Mcghee
reviews.text: The low end girls are 3300 baht. The high end girls are like 6000 baht. Both sides look the same. Older and full of silicone. Maybe I went on an off day, idk.

reviews.name: Alan R
reviews.text:
I come here every year, and they always raise the prices. Plus, with the Thai baht exchange rate, it's not worth coming here anymore.
And the waiter is terrible; they'll force you to buy 500 baht worth of lubricant, even if you can choose not to.

reviews.name: Tobias Dacoir
reviews.text: 2 stars because it was it clean and the staff was polite but these are the only good points. I went there for the first and it felt like a scam. They will give you a price list and show you the menu. After you make your decision you will go to the counter to pay. Suddenly there was a surcharge of 500 baht for cosplay and oil massage. I said I didn’t need this but they made it clear that it is a mandatory option. Funny enough, the lady never touched the cosplay costume nor did I get an oil massage. When we entered the room the lady ordered a drink for herself, which cost me another 300 baht as I found out later (and it wasn’t even alcohol). The room was tidy and clean at least. You will relax in the bathtub for a few minutes and then have the soapy massage. Afterwards you can relax for a few more minutes on the bed before the lady will ask for a tip and escort you downstairs after not even one hour. Even though I chose an experienced looking lady, the massage was very weak. I asked her if she studied somewhere and has a certificate but she said, her manager at this massage shop taught her. That explains the bad massage probably. All in all, it is way too expensive for what you get. You will spend less money and have a much better experience (and probably better massage too) on walking street. I will not come again.

reviews.name: joe jeeramongkol
reviews.text: Nice place, good service with reasonable price. Now they have new service with yogurt topping adding when massage. I went there about 8pm there were about 80 beautiful girls. The place offer service for all customer male or female also service for couple! You can choose more than one girl at the same time if you can pay.

reviews.name: Harsh Rastogi
reviews.text: Went there today at 5 pm, it was empty (no customers). Found one awesome girl and took soapy massage. Boy it was worth it, too good. Will visit again.

reviews.name: Srini Chittaluru
reviews.text: Soapy massage is something unique, they charge randomly.  No happy ending, never cared for one.. worth to try once.  Wish they are transparent about the pricing and standardize. Paid 3100 Bahts but they were quoting randomly for different girls.

reviews.name: Alexey
reviews.text: Everything happened very mechanically, the girl tried to finish as quickly as possible, the massage lasted exactly 2 minutes. The girl has a lot of hair, on her legs and not only.

reviews.name: Alexey Kokorev
reviews.text: I've been there in 2013. Everything was nice and went fine. Happy stuff😊.

reviews.name: Ben
reviews.text: DO NOT GO HERE unless you like lady boys.  Went yesterday and the one I choose was a lady boy.  I couldn't tell until he/she took me to the room and then spoke.  The manager fought me to change and then charged me 100 Bhat to change girls.  The second girl was not a lady boy - thank god.  The manager lied to me telling me they have no lady boys.  There were numerous obvious 6'2" lady boys and others and others that were less obvious.  I'd never go back since they mix lady boys with real women making it difficult for customers who don't like trans men.

reviews.name: Aleksandr Slobodsky
reviews.text: There are a lot of girls — beautiful ones, and there's even a certain purity about them. BUT everything is done like on autopilot. A 10-minute massage, everything else takes 10 minutes too, and that's it.

reviews.name: Tobias Kozlov

Yes papasan will push you pick a girl and people will ask for tips. Thats on par for course its nothing unique to here.

reviews.name: Paripat Pairat
reviews.text:
Very nice co working space. If you want to work in air conditioning zone you should order food/drink 100/person/hours.
Croissant is great because it made by order.

reviews.name: Ilya Lebedev
reviews.text:
Nice cafe & co-working space. You can use the main hall for free if you spend 100 baht per hour on food/drinks (or 500 baht for a whole day).
The desks are comfortable, WiFi is good, the place is quiet and suitable for calls. I liked the coffee too.
The only problem is that they close at 18:00 which is too early in my opinion.

reviews.name: Peartip T.
reviews.text:
Luv the vibe. Affogato and Espresso is very good but forgot to take the photo. A bit hard to find the way here if you dont have the care but it worth it!! Effective space for work.
They also have food with reasonable price.

Spacious Parking (10-12 cars) since it is a house turned into Cafe + coworking space.

Free wifi for 13 hours. Plug on the table.
Definitely come back for more.

reviews.name: Thy Đặng
reviews.text:
As my partner and I visited the place, it is surely a cozy place for a coffee shop ( nice coffee and freshly baked croissant) but for being a co-working place it lacks some critical elements:

1. The lighting is not enough for working. I guess because it was designed to be cozy, it lacks the natural light even during noon time.
2. The collection of music is not suitable for a working space... As they only play Korean pop songs for the whole time we were there...and it was a bit loud even though we already asked for adjustment.

Would definitely recommend for those looking for a cozy, chilling coffee shop. Hope the owners understand that this is a constructive recommendation.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your comment. Please visit us again, if you want to work, please inform our staff that you would like to work in a quiet room. They can arrange this for you with no additional cost.

reviews.name: Son Vu
reviews.text:
I rated it 3 because its supposed to be a co-working space, not a coffee shop. The problem is they mixed the co-working area with coffee chilling area together. But I came for working so I expected no noise, or at least no music, but the music was noisy, even though I asked staff to turn the volume down, but still it was.
However, the coffee (capuchino) was good, the food (croissant) was good too. So best for a cup of coffee, not recommended for those who need a co-working space.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your comment. Please come back again. We have a working room with no music and can work quietly!

Very nice and calm coworking space. I was planning to only sit here for a couple of hours,  ended up sitting here for nearly six hours. Consistent dl speed of over 1MB/s. One of the better coworking places visited in SouthEast Asia.

reviews.name: Dean W
reviews.text: AMAZING coworking space. Very chill, low music and conversation. 3 large tables for hot-desking, lots of power outlets, comfortable chairs. Outdoor patio. The owners are warm and welcoming, very friendly, making it a real pleasure to visit (M-F only). This is not your standard indifferent corporate make-use-of-an-empty-floor. Always clean bathrooms. Drink bar with sodas, coffees.  Also sells vintage music and clothes. Hosts occasional punk rock Tpop bands, and has a fully-equipped (and acoustic) musical rehearsal room.

reviews.name: Donny Boonyamanop
reviews.text:
Good Space BKK is situated behind BTS Mochit Station. It is around 7-8 mins walking away.

Homey and cozy ambient with lots of nice, smiling faces all around. K. Sa and team (owners) are lovely lads, speaks good English and have excellent knowledge on Pop Culture.

Good vibe here. They do offer renting space (co-working space) and their lobby floor sells coffee (they do have yummy oat milks too!).

Feel free to inquire them about co working space rental/leasing agreement.

Good space BKK opens Mon-Fri, and opens only occassionally on Saturdays, be sure to follow their facebook event pages prior to attendng.

reviews.text: Cool little place to work. Great wifi. 250 per day for desk space. And a great coffee shop inside to keep you caffeinated. Street food close by for lunch too. 😃

reviews.name: Niklas Kietaibl
reviews.text:
Absolutely loving it here! Best vibes and people.

I’m currently working from Good Space BKK, and I couldn’t be more satisfied. The atmosphere is fantastic—perfect for staying productive while feeling completely relaxed.

The best part, by far, is the people. Everyone here is super friendly and welcoming, which creates such a great community feel. It’s rare to find a place that feels this professional yet so warm and inviting at the same time.

If you’re in Bangkok and looking for a top-tier spot to get some work done, this is definitely the place to be. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: PS
reviews.text:
This is a comfortable workplace with an on-site coffee shop. The atmosphere here is warm and relaxed, making everyone feel at ease. I personally discovered this place while searching online and found that they offer office co-space for rent. I reached out, visited the location, and was impressed. The space is clean and spread across three floors.

The ground floor serves as a public area with a cozy café. The second floor is divided into rentable offices and also includes a shared meeting room that can be rented by the hour. The third floor also contains office spaces for rent, some of which are already occupied.

There are separate restrooms for men and women, and cleaning staff come in both morning and evening. The shared areas are equipped with air conditioning and fans.

Parking is available both in front and on the side of the property. As for food and drinks, the surrounding area offers several cafés and chill-out spots within walking distance.

ownerDescription:

คลาสของเราถูกออกแบบให้เหมาะกับทุกระดับ ตั้งแต่ผู้เริ่มต้นจนถึงผู้ที่มีประสบการณ์ โดยเน้นการเคลื่อนไหวอย่างปลอดภัย ช่วยเสริมสร้างกล้ามเนื้อแกนกลางลำตัว (Core Strength) เพิ่มความยืดหยุ่นของร่างกาย และปรับสมดุลของท่าทาง

ไม่ว่าคุณต้องการฟื้นฟูร่างกาย เสริมสร้างสุขภาพ หรือพัฒนารูปร่าง Kaew Pilates พร้อมดูแลและช่วยให้คุณบรรลุเป้าหมายด้านสุขภาพในระยะยาว
