title: Thai Cooking School
ownerDescription:
Take your taste buds on an exciting journey through the fantastic flavours and experiences of Thailand!

Right in the heart of Bangkok City, Thai Cooking School is nestled in Bangrak’s oldest fresh market, right next to the Shangri-La hotel. Our talented chefs have excellent English skills to help explain every detail of each dish so you can understand the ingredients and the roles they play in creating the final taste explosions!

Our menus change every day so if your first experience was one to remember you can return for more bursting flavours the following day and learn new dishes and cooking styles that you can carry with you for a lifetime.
address: 69, 2 Charoen Krung 44 Alley, Bang Rak, Bangkok 10500, Thailand
plusCode: PGC8+75 Bangkok, Thailand

reviews.name: Samuel Jeanblanc
reviews.text:
We had a terrific experience, all due to the great quality of the chef, Chef Sarin.
She's dynamic, adaptable, smiling and cheerful. And so knowledgeable about cooking.
We asked for something more advanced and she gave us great tasks to test our skills.
Overall, great session. Highly recommend.
Thank you chef Sarin!

reviews.name: lucia
reviews.text:
Sarin was the most amazing chef and teacher we could have hoped for! She guided us through cooking four delicious Thai dishes, sharing countless tips and tricks to help us elevate our cooking skills. Along the way, she gave us fascinating insights into Thai culture, making the experience both educational and enjoyable.

We loved how hands-on and engaging the class was, and the best part? We got to take home a lot of the meals we prepared, so we could continue enjoying our creations later. Sarin’s warm and friendly personality made the class feel extra special—she truly made us feel welcome and at ease.

If you’re looking for an unforgettable cooking class, this is it! I couldn’t recommend it more—it’s absolutely the best!

reviews.name: Chad P
reviews.text: Chef Nadcha was an amazing teacher. My wife and I took her class on our honeymoon and had a blast learning to cook classic Thai dishes. We are excited to cook these dishes back home and highly recommend this class to anyone visiting Bangkok. Thank you Chef Nadcha for the wonderful experience!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for taking the time to review us on Google. Enjoy the rest of your honeymoon ❤️

reviews.name: Sandra Slavinec
reviews.text:
It is good to find with Google Maps.
The market is outside in the morning so they go with the first group shopping too.
We (2 adults and a child 11yrs) took the evening cooking course. Very nice location, very clean in the kitchen and during cooking. I loved that everyone of us could prepare its own dish, so one could cook mild while I prefered to have a bit of chili inside. Really nice and funny chef, excellent English, we really had a lot of fun and our dished were surprisingly excellent 😂.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks Sandra for taking your time to sharing your experience on this platform. Most appreciated. Looking forward welcoming you again in the near future.

reviews.name: Chelsea Binnig
reviews.text: We can’t say enough good things about our experience here! For starters, we are sisters from the United States and booked this cooking class based on other reviews. We are so glad we did. Queen (chef) Natcha made the experience so memorable. She is clearly well educated and cares so much about cooking, and we had a blast learning from her. We found the school very easily after taking a Grab to the market, and spent the first part of the class walking around the market with Natcha as she taught us about local ingredients and unique foods to Thailand. We then got right into cooking and it was just absolutely amazing; everything we cooked was delicious. We were absolutely stuffed full by the end. Id recommend this class to anyone that wants a more authentic food experience in Thailand, especially for those that don’t have much cooking skill like us. We loved every moment of it. Thank you Natcha!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Dear Chelsea, thank you so much for visiting us. Can't thank you enough for leaving us such a beautiful review. Looking forward to seeing you again on your next trip.

reviews.name: Amber Mays
reviews.text: I booked this class through Airbnb and it was well worth it. We learned about each of the ingredients and our chef was great! I would recommend anyone traveling to Bangkok to take a class here. The classes are 4 hours long and worth every penny!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thanks Amber!
Great review! Happy you decided to give us a try!

reviews.name: Alex
reviews.text: Without doubt one of the highlights of our first trip to Bangkok. To start with the setting is fantastic, located right in the heart of a wet market. You start the lesson off by visiting the market with the chef and collecting ingredients that you will later use, along with finding out more about the food being sold. We were lucky to have chef Natcha for just the two of us and the experinece that followed was memorable. We cooked five dishes including a cold noodle salad, masaman curry, spring rolls and sweet mango with sticky rice. Our chef Natcha was very knowledgeable, kind and encouraging throughout. Each dish was better than the last and we gained some great insight that we will certainly be using back home. The whole experience was great and I would highly recommend it to anybody visiting Bangkok. Five stars!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks so much Alex for your brilliant review. It was an absolute pleasure having you as our guests. See you again soon!

reviews.name: Tim Salmon
reviews.text: Wonderful class with the lovely Sarin as our teacher.  I suggest the morning class as you get a amazing tour of the market the school is located in. We cooked six courses with great hands on teaching and ate after every section.  This will be one of the highlights of out visit to Bangkok.  We are American and their English was very good.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Mr. Salmon,

Thank you so much for taking your time in reviewing us on Google. It was a blast cooking with you and your wife. Looking forward doing another course on your next visit.

Best regards,

Ray

reviews.name: Jonathan Scheets
reviews.text: Amazing experience!  Chef Kimmy was awesome, spoke very good English.  Don’t eat before you go, and you will be full when you leave.  They take pictures for you as you cook and send them to you via email along with the recipes for later.  Thanks again!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thanks Jonathan! Love your review. Recipes on the way!
Ray

reviews.name: Pak Sam
reviews.text:
👍🏻
1) Chef Natcha is knowledgeable, and the skills she taught, could be used for Thai cooking at home
2) Nice kitchen setup, could be cramp if many participants at once
3) The session is rather relax and enjoyable
4) Food that we made tasted really good, almost the same street food that we have tried

👎🏻
5) Quite hard to find the cooking school, as it is also a walking tour, bike tour outlet, with the cooking attached (on the mezzanine floor).  Thanks to a local Thai lady, whom shown us the place
6) Located inside a day time market, that could be the reason why it is hard to locate.  More so if you are using Grab car service, we put a nearby restaurant/cafe as destination (after some trying on the address)
7) We asked the host if could replace the Som Tam with something else.  It was not replaced, but was removed from the street food menu totally.  We only realised that later.  So we were charged the full amount, with one item left out.  We did not make any fuss.
8) The Thai tea ice cream was made in advance, so we did not get to learn how to make it.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
It took me a while to trace down when you came cooking with us so that I could trace back on what day you did come here. I see that you are a serious reviewer as you have over 2000 reviews.
Once I did track down your booking it was clear that what you review today is an experience shared from a memory 3 years ago back in 2019. 
We appreciate your effort and looking forward welcoming you again.

reviews.name: Wallace Kolour
reviews.text:
Great Cooking Class with very bold asian flavors
Our instructor Chun was phenomenal
10/10

reviews.name: Ulrika Dijkstra
reviews.text:
Sarin was a great cook and teacher. Loved to walk around the little market in the morning and taste and learn about different fruits,veg and herbs. We cooked a very tasty meal. Sarin is great fun and completes the experience!
Made the best home made authentic Tamarind sauce  for the base of the Pad thai.

reviews.name: Stella Jarvis
reviews.text: This was one of the highlights of our stay in Bangkok and some of the best food we had on our trip. Kimmy was a great teacher!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thanks so much Stella!
It was a pleasure cooking with you.

reviews.name: Julian Chow
reviews.text: A very informative chef that’s willing to share her experience and knowledge. We had a great time learning, cooking, eating, laughing and bonding
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks Julian for coming in with your team and cooking up a storm! So cool meeting you all

reviews.name: Ryan Skraba
reviews.text:
Awesome way to experience Thai food!  Market tour was a lot of fun, with some pretty great information.  Our chef, Natcha, is both an expert in the kitchen, but also at ease giving us good instructions and explanations while we are cooking. She really emphasized tasting and adjusting each plate to your own preferences. The kitchens upstairs were impeccably clean and well-lit, and helpful assistants did a lot of the prep (setting out ingredients and ensuring everything went smoothly).

The cooking was *easy* and accessible to any beginner, but it was also pretty profound: Natcha went through each ingredient and talked us through how it affected the final dish, as well as how different prep methods change the flavour.  Thanks so much for such a pleasant morning!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks so much for taking your time into reviewing us though this media platform.

reviews.name: Michael Hoessl
reviews.text: Amazing experience, I came here now 2 times and each time I learned something new. Chef Natcha is very knowledgeable and loves her craft. It is so much fun listening to her stories and her cooking tips are really great. You can eat the food you cook and with the perfect tutoring it turns out super tasty. Big portions, 4 different meals, you will leave this place happy and stuffed! Thank you!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi Michael,
Thanks so much for coming to cook with us again. Was great seeing you. I will make sure the beers are cold on your 3rd time soon :-))

reviews.name: Greg Lesko
reviews.text: Well equipped kitchen, good English skills of the chef, very good atmosphere and setting. Highly recommended
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thanks Grzesiek!
Was great fun having you here!
Ray

reviews.name: Peter Walchhofer
reviews.text:
The cooking class was an extraordinary experience. We were a group of 5 and spontaniously wanted to do a cooking course on the same day. The chef was really nice, skilled and generally an interesting woman.
The food was the best I ate during my stay in Thailand. Especially the curry made me unlike my own one I made so far. We even did make the curry paste ourselves.

Highy recommend!

reviews.name: Priyanka Prasad
reviews.text: I booked this class with my husband and asked for a vegetarian option for me and they were very accommodating. My food was delicious and it was great to get hands on experience with some amazing Thai dishes. Our instructor Kimmy was so helpful and hilarious. This was a great way to spend an afternoon in Bangkok. Highly recommended!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thanks so much Priyanka! Was fantastic having you cooking with us.
Kindest regards,
Ray

reviews.name: Wei Liang Sim
reviews.text:
Hidden gem, but so worth the hunt. It's down an alley (look for Sarnies) then look around for another even smaller alleyway.

Chef Nattsan (not sure I spelt it right) is entertaining and really knows her stuff. Most importantly, this was some of the best food we tasted in Bangkok.

Highly recommended, but being a notebook to record the ingredients because I forgot most of them already 😱
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi Wei, thanks so much for your amazing review. Please note we have the recipes on hand. Just email us and we reply with all.
Thanks!

กิจกรรมสุดสัปดาห์ที่ทั้งสงบและผ่อนคลาย ปกติแล้วจะไปขันทิเบต เป็นประจำทุกคืนวันศุกร์ เพราะชีวิตในแต่ละวันเต็มไปด้วยความเร่งรีบและความวุ่นวาย คืนวันศุกร์จึงเหมาะอย่างยิ่งสำหรับการไปนอนพักผ่อน ฟังเสียงครูตีขันทิเบต เพื่อให้ร่างกายและจิตใจได้หยุดพักอย่างแท้จริง

บรรยากาศที่นั่นเงียบสงบและผ่อนคลาย ราวกับได้คลายความเหนื่อยล้า อาการเมื่อยขบ และความเครียดที่สะสมมาตลอดทั้งสัปดาห์ ทำให้ได้หวนกลับมาเชื่อมต่อกับโลกภายในของตัวเองอีกครั้ง

ครั้งนี้คุณครูจัดเต็มเป็นพิเศษ เนื่องจากมีการเปิดสาขา2  จึงได้มีประสบการณ์ลอยตัวในน้ำ พร้อมรับฟังเสียงขันทิเบตจากครูถึงสองท่าน ที่ตีสอดประสานกันอย่างกลมกลืน การลอยตัวในน้ำเปรียบเสมือนการปล่อยกายปล่อยใจ ให้อยู่กับร่างกายและลมหายใจในปัจจุบันขณะ เสียงที่ได้ยินช่วยพาเข้าสู่ภาวะลึกซึ้ง เป็นประสบการณ์ใหม่ที่น่าประทับใจอย่างยิ่ง

ก่อนเริ่มกิจกรรม ยังมีไวน์รสชาติดีให้จิบถึง2ขวด คู่กับขนมแสนอร่อย ช่วยเติมเต็มค่ำคืนแห่งการพักผ่อนให้สมบูรณ์แบบยิ่งขึ้น
reviews.textTranslated:
A peaceful and relaxing weekend activity, usually involving Tibetan singing, typically takes place every Friday evening. Because daily life is full of hustle and bustle, Friday night is the perfect time to unwind, listen to the teacher playing the Tibetan singing bowls, and truly rest both body and mind.

The atmosphere is quiet and relaxing, as if relieving fatigue, aches, and stress accumulated throughout the week. It allows one to reconnect with one's inner world.

This time, the teachers went all out because, due to the opening of a second branch, we had the experience of floating in the water while listening to the harmonious blend of two Tibetan singing bowls. Floating in the water is like letting go of the body and mind, focusing on the present moment. The sounds helped us enter a deep state of awareness – a truly impressive and new experience.

Before the activity began, we were treated to two bottles of fine wine and delicious snacks, completing the perfect evening of relaxation.

reviews.text:
I had an exceptional experience at Pro Boxing Gym in Chiang Mai. The boxing coach here is incredibly skilled and dedicated, providing personalized training that greatly improved my technique and fitness. Their attention to detail and motivational approach made each session both challenging and rewarding.

Equally impressive is the Muay Thai coach, who brings a wealth of experience and a deep understanding of the sport. The Muay Thai training is intense and well-structured, focusing on both traditional techniques and modern strategies. Their enthusiasm for the sport is infectious, making each
class both educational and enjoyable.

Overall, Pro Boxing Gym offers top-notch coaching and a welcoming environment for fighters of all levels. Highly recommended for anyone looking to enhance their skills in boxing or Muay Thai.

De passage à Chiang Mai, je me suis rendue au Pro Boxing Club pour un entraînement de boxe anglaise. J’ai été accueillie par Christian, qui parle français, anglais et thaï, et qui est un ancien champion de boxe anglaise.

Je me suis entraînée 1h30 avec lui, et la séance était intensive et 100 % axée sur la boxe anglaise, avec beaucoup de technique, de sparring et de travail aux pattes d’ours. Le coach a rapidement identifié mes défauts et a su les corriger efficacement.

C’est un coach passionné, très professionnel, qui sait parfaitement ce qu’il fait. C’est tout simplement le meilleur entraînement de boxe que j’ai eu à Chiang Mai ! C'est tout ce dont j'avais besoin

J’y reviendrai sans hésiter et je recommande vivement.
reviews.textTranslated:
While in Chiang Mai, I went to the Pro Boxing Club for a boxing workout. I was greeted by Christian, who speaks French, English, and Thai, and is a former boxing champion.

I trained with him for an hour and a half, and the session was intense and 100% focused on boxing, with a lot of technique, sparring, and focus mitt work. The coach quickly identified my weaknesses and corrected them effectively.

He's a passionate and very professional coach who knows exactly what he's doing. It was simply the best boxing workout I had in Chiang Mai! It was exactly what I needed.

I'll definitely be back and highly recommend it.

reviews.name: Delphine Claudio
reviews.text:
Mes deux ados, boxeur en kick et en K1 tous les deux ont voulu découvrir le Muay Thaï et perfectionner leurs techniques pour les championnats en France. C'est chose faite !
Nous avons été accueilli par Christian et l'entraîneur Santos avec une belle humanité et beaucoup de partage.
Mes ados sont venu chercher à repousser leurs limites, découvrir une nouvelle culture. C'est ce que nous avons trouvé. Ils ont pu s'entraîner avec des élèves thaï qui les ont également très bien accueilli.
Beaucoup de partage, de discussion, de rigolade. Un accueil rare et, comme toujours en Asie, les enfants sont chouchoutés !
On voit que les entraîneurs aiment ce qu'ils font et partagent leurs connaissances.
Les enfants sont rentrés fatigués (34h de boxe en 2 semaines) mais totalement ravi !
Un grand merci à Christian et à Santos pour leur accueil!
reviews.textTranslated:
My two teenagers, both kickboxers and K1 fighters, wanted to discover Muay Thai and refine their techniques for the French championships. Mission accomplished!

We were welcomed by Christian and Coach Santos with genuine warmth and a spirit of sharing.
My teens came looking to push their limits and discover a new culture. That's exactly what we found. They were able to train with Thai students who also gave them a very warm welcome. There was a lot of sharing, discussion, and laughter. A truly exceptional welcome, and, as always in Asia, the children are pampered!
It's clear that the coaches love what they do and share their knowledge.
The children came home exhausted (34 hours of boxing in 2 weeks) but absolutely thrilled!
A huge thank you to Christian and Santos for their hospitality!

J'espère qu'ils iront loin tous les deux dans les compétitions à venir.
Au plaisir de vous revoir tous les trois.
Toute l'équipe de Proboxinggym vous envoie un maximum de force

reviews.name: Code Junki
reviews.text:
The worst massage experience I have ever had. I visit Chiang Mai regularly and this was my first time coming here (it was late and my regular place had already closed for the day). Came in for an hour foot massage and they made me wait for a while to get another masseuse in. I only saw one masseuse with one other customer when I walked in. The masseuse they called in for me had no idea what he was doing. You can tell he was not a regular masseuse there. Half way through, suddenly a whole group of 10 or so people came out from behind curtains. It went from peace and quiet, to complete chaos. The group of tourists were talking loudly among each other. The 5 or so masseuses I didn't notice earlier started noisily packing and readying to close the shop for the night (there was still half an hour until closing time). The manager was talking loudly on the phone to organise transport for the group that just finished. They even turned on all the lights!! Totally ruined any chance of relaxation. I know I will never come back here again, I cannot advise strongly enough that others stay away as well!!!

Edit: The group of customers I understand may have been difficult to control, but the behaviour of the staff as well was unacceptable.

reviews.name: 내일로
reviews.text:
별하나도 아까운 집입니다.
타이마사지 1시간 30분짜리 하기로 하고 들어갔습니다.  너무 마사지를 못해서 1시간으로 해달라고 요청했습니다.
나는 친구만나러 간다고 한적이 없습니다.

그런데 1시간도 아닌것 같아서 30분받은것만 150밧주고 가겠다고 하고 계산할때 500밧을 냈습니다.

돈을 받고 나와서 밖에서 계산해보니 250밧입니다.  350밧이어야 할돈이.
그래서 주인과 cctv를 돌려 받지만 주인은 100밧짜리 세지도 않고 20밧짜리 2장하고 5밧짜리동전을 2개 내주었습니다.

이건 신뢰의 문제입니다.
최악의 마사지에 돈 계산도 참 나는 할말을 잃었습니다.

나도 그자리에서 보지 않은게 문제겠지만 참 살다살다 내가 100밧에 목숨걸일도 아니고 그냥 나와버렸습니다.

문밖으로 나올때쯤 따라 나오면서 100밧을
주는데 안받고.   잘먹고 잘살라고 했습니다.

참 오늘 일진이 별로 안좋네요.

추가

나만 이런 마사지를 받았나 리뷰를 찾아보니
10개월전 어떤사람도 별하나와 리뷰를 쓴것이 있습니다.  "최악의 마사지와 주인의 응대문제라고 말했습니다"

나는 이리뷰를 읽고 공감했습니다.
아 이런리뷰가 있다는것은 주인의 응대 문제가 있는 집입니다.  한번 참고하세요.
reviews.textTranslated:
This place doesn't even deserve one star.

I went in agreeing to a 1.5-hour Thai massage. The massage was so poor that I asked them to extend it to an hour.

I never mentioned that I was going to meet a friend.

However, since it didn't seem like an hour, I said I would just pay 150 baht for the 30 minutes and leave, but I paid 500 baht when I paid.

After receiving the money and leaving, I calculated the bill outside and it was 250 baht. It should have been 350 baht.

So I asked the owner to return the CCTV footage, but the owner didn't even count the 100-baht bills and just handed me two 20-baht bills and two 5-baht coins.

This is a matter of trust.

With the worst massage ever, I was truly speechless regarding the bill calculation.

It might be my fault for not seeing it right then and there, but honestly, I've lived long enough not to risk my life for 100 baht, so I just walked out.

As I was leaving, they followed me out the door and offered me 100 baht, but I refused to take it. I told them to eat well and live well.

Well, today is really not my day.

Addition

I looked up reviews to see if I was the only one who received a massage like this, and found that someone else wrote a one-star review 10 months ago. "They said it was the worst massage and the owner's attitude was problematic."

I read this review and agreed with it.

Ah, the fact that there is a review like this means there is an issue with the owner's attitude. Please keep that in mind.

reviews.name: Honest Reviews Only
reviews.text:
I was staying at the Avani hotel and noticed this massage place in the basement of the connecting mall. The prices looked reasonable, so I decided to try their 90 min foot, shoulder, and neck massage.

I waited about 10 mins for the therapist to arrive, which wasn't too bad. However, my seat was positioned directly next to the shop window. This was a bit uncomfortable as I was the first thing people saw when walking past the shop, offering very little in terms of privacy.
The massage itself was excellent. I requested a stronger massage, and the therapist delivered with exactly the right amount of pressure. If you are looking for a high-quality, strong massage, the skill level here is definitely there.

On the downside, the environment could be improved. The shop is quite cramped and doesn't feel particularly well-maintained in terms of hygiene. I didn't see the seats being cleaned or sanitized after customers who had been sitting or lying there for an hour or more.

Overall, it was a great massage at a very reasonable price point. If you don't mind the lack of privacy and a more basic environment, it’s a solid spot for a quick recharge.

reviews.name: Jerry C.C
reviews.text:
這次的按摩體驗令人非常失望，與期待有很大的落差。

1. 兩位男按摩師都遲到半小時，讓我們白白等待，服務態度有待加強。
2. 按摩過程中，兩位按摩師全程一直聊天，完全沒有顧慮客人的感受，原本想放鬆甚至睡一下，卻一直被聊天聲打擾。
3. 店家主打的「槌子按摩」並沒有感受到任何特別效果，反而覺得按完身體比按摩前還更不舒服。
4. 按摩時沒有提供毯子，冷氣下容易覺得冷；室內燈光也非常明亮，缺乏按摩店應有的放鬆氛圍。
5. 最重要的是按摩技術真的令人失望，男師傅手法粗糙、幾乎感受不到專業手法，力道、穴位都不到位，老實說，感覺甚至還不如我家的貓踩在身上的舒適感。
6、 最後提早結束，白白花了500泰銖！

整體而言，無論是服務、環境還是按摩技術，都沒有達到應有的水準。以這次的體驗來說，我不會再次光顧，也無法推薦給其他旅客。
reviews.textTranslated:
This massage experience was extremely disappointing and fell far short of my expectations.

1. Both male masseurs were half an hour late, making us wait unnecessarily. Their service attitude needs improvement.

2. During the massage, the two masseurs chatted the entire time, completely disregarding the client's comfort. I wanted to relax and even take a nap, but their conversation kept disturbing me.

3. The shop's signature "hammer massage" didn't provide any special effects; in fact, I felt even more uncomfortable afterward than before.

4. No blankets were provided during the massage, and it was quite cold in the air conditioning. The lighting was also very bright, lacking the relaxing atmosphere a massage parlor should have.

5. Most importantly, the massage technique was truly disappointing. The male masseur's technique was rough, almost devoid of professional skill. The pressure and acupressure points were not applied correctly. Honestly, it felt less comfortable than my cat stepping on me.

6. We ended the massage early, wasting 500 baht!

Overall, the service, environment, and massage technique all fell short of expectations. Based on this experience, I would not visit again, nor could I recommend it to other travelers.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We are sorry to hear that your experience did not meet your expectations.

We would like to respectfully clarify a few points for future readers.

1. Regarding the waiting time, our records show that the therapists arrived approximately 15 minutes later than the scheduled time, not 30 minutes. We sincerely apologize for the delay and understand that any wait can be frustrating.

2. We agree that therapists should keep conversation to a minimum during treatments to provide a peaceful and relaxing experience. We will remind our team to maintain a quiet environment throughout the session.

At the same time, after speaking with our therapists, we were informed that during the session you raised your voice and shouted at them. We understand that you may have felt uncomfortable, and we sincerely apologize if your experience did not meet your expectations.

However, we kindly ask that any concerns be communicated respectfully. If you feel uncomfortable at any point during your treatment, please let us know immediately so we can address the issue or make the necessary adjustments. Our team is always willing to help and ensure you have a comfortable experience.

We respectfully ask that our staff be treated with the same courtesy and respect that we strive to show every client. We hope for mutual understanding, as everyone deserves to work and communicate in a safe and respectful environment.

3. Our signature hammer massage is a traditional therapy that uses a unique hammer technique, making it quite different from a traditional Thai massage.Because the technique and sensation are different, the experience may not suit everyone’s personal preference. We respect that each guest may have different expectations and preferences.

4. Our standard practice is to dim or turn off the lights once guests are comfortably settled on the massage bed. We also keep blankets available and adjust the room temperature for guest comfort whenever requested. We are sorry if this was not your experience.

5. We are disappointed to hear that you were not satisfied with the therapist’s technique. The therapist who served you is one of our experienced practitioners for hammer massage, but we understand that every guest has different expectations and preferences.

We appreciate all feedback, as it helps us continue improving our service. Thank you for visiting us, and we wish you all the best.

I went to this place to get a foot and neck/shoulders massage. According to my understanding, this place belongs to the Thai Massage School Shivagakomarpaj, a place known for Thai Traditional massage teaching. As this is a traditional Thai massage place, the techniques are very  traditional and the massage  is done on hard mattresses laid on the floor (no comfortable chairs) in a kind of a hall. The massage therapist, an elderly lady, was professional but not particularly friendly and with minimum communication.

This place is not a standard massage place/business which you find in the town. I felt sometimes bit uncomfortable maybe due to the fact that it was my first visit to a massage shop where you are treated next to other clients without having closed separation curtains. Also I found the entrance/reception is uninviting and poorly maintained.

reviews.text:
Lors de mon séjour à Chiang Mai, j'ai pris rdv pour un massage traditionnel de deux heures.
La réceptionniste m'a demandé si je souhaitais plutôt une masseuse femme et expliqué que le meilleur était un homme.
J'ai donc accepté de prendre rdv avec Oi et je ne regrette pas du tout ! J'avais énormément de douleurs liés à un corps longtemps sous tension constante.
Ne vous attendez pas à un massage doux. Ici, on travaille plutôt à refaire circuler l'énergie dans tout le corps, étirer, soulager les tensions. Et Oi est excellent pour ça !
reviews.textTranslated:
During my stay in Chiang Mai, I booked a two-hour traditional massage.
The receptionist asked if I preferred a female masseuse and explained that a male one was the best.
So I agreed to book an appointment with Oi, and I don't regret it at all! I had a lot of pain from having my body under constant tension for a long time.
Don't expect a gentle massage. Here, the focus is on restoring the flow of energy throughout the body, stretching, and relieving tension. And Oi is excellent at that!

The sauna here uses authentic Thai herbs, which are fragrant and feel like they're detoxifying your skin. You sweat a lot, but you don't feel dizzy afterwards. You just feel relieved, light, and comfortable—like your body has been reset!

The massage:
I must emphasize, "The masseurs are incredibly skilled!" Each masseur is professionally trained. They have precise pressure points, know exactly where to hit the right spots, and know how to apply the right pressure. They know exactly where to release tension. After the massage, you feel like your body is being repaired from within. When you get off the massage table, you feel so light, like you're floating.

Rating: 100/10 without hesitation.

reviews.name: William Sandin
reviews.text:
It was a true joy to visit Rachanon gym. It’s rare in 2026 to see a place with ~15 (possibly more) local pro fighters going at it during the same sessions.

The gym has an interesting history spanning back to the 1990s. The founder himself is an Olympic boxing medalist. Other notable fighter for me coming out of this gym is F16 Rachanon who was an incredible puncher in his prime.

The communication in English was really friendly and straight forward. I could make a same day training booking, confirmed within 15 mins.

The trainer was strong, a good match for my size/reach. We did pad work + clinch and worked through the entire arsenal but i could see more specialised muaymat & muaybouk as well as feemu and muaykhao fighters thriving here.

The training was intense but i received constant feedback on what landed well, and what didn’t with some breakdowns and more detailed instruction as well.

I would recommend this gym to anybody who want a very authentic, high quality training experience in a professional setting.

Apparently the lady that I had a reservation with was not even on her way. Strange reservation concept.

Went with one of the three that was there since I did not have more time. Was not totally feeling it since she was not my original choice, but not her fault.

Place itself, the welcome area looks ok, but once you are escorted up, the place looks pretty run down. No effort was put in making the stairway area looking nice. The rooms were ok, but felt like an old Thai massage place. Paint coming off the wall, damaged window tints so that the sun comes through.

It felt like one of these places that are trying to ride the wave of the hype of Nuru, but are failing to deliver the experience while charging similar prices. Nuru is associated with something Japanese, so make sure to deliver the experience. This is not only reflected in the service but also in the details. For example, have proper music on instead of this strange Indian habibi music. Or have people at least ready to serve the customers when you open at 12:00 instead of having them still walking around in their pajamas

reviews.text:
Марина лучший тренер на Пхукете,  очень активный и заряжающий энергией тренер.
Каждая тренировка проходит в динамичном темпе, скучать точно не приходится. Особенно нравятся групповые занятия — атмосфера мотивирует, и работать в команде намного легче и интереснее.
Отдельный плюс — результат не заставляет себя ждать. Уже через две недели заметны реальные изменения: тело подтягивается, появляется выносливость и больше энергии.
Рекомендую всем, кто хочет быстрый прогресс и тренировки с драйвом!
reviews.textTranslated:
Marina is the best trainer in Phuket, a very active and energizing coach.
Each workout is fast-paced, so there's never a dull moment. I especially enjoy the group classes—the atmosphere is motivating, and working in a team is much easier and more engaging.
Another plus is the immediate results. After just two weeks, I see real changes: my body is toned, I have more endurance, and I have more energy.
I recommend her to anyone who wants fast progress and a workout with drive!

reviews.name: Ирина Золотова
reviews.text:

Хочу выразить благодарность тренеру Марине за ее удивительную энергию. Групповые тренировки под ее руководством были неотразимыми – полные энергии, веселья и, главное, результативные.
Марина имеет уникальный стиль преподавания, подкрепленный отличной музыкой и интересными упражнениями.

Сам зал поражает своей красотой, светлой атмосферой и современным оборудованием. Приятно проводить время в таком пространстве. Уходить жаль, но надеюсь, что наши пути еще пересекутся!
До встречи💪
reviews.textTranslated:
What a wonderful experience at the gym! I've been training here for a long time, and it's time to say goodbye.
I want to express my gratitude to trainer Marina for her amazing energy. The group workouts under her guidance were irresistible – full of energy, fun, and, most importantly, effective.
Marina has a unique teaching style, enhanced by excellent music and engaging exercises.

The gym itself is stunning with its beauty, bright atmosphere, and modern equipment. It's a pleasure to spend time in such a space. I'm sad to leave, but I hope our paths cross again!
See you later 💪

title: Ban Dalah Pai Resort/Retreat
subTitle: Ban Dalah Pai Resort
ownerDescription:
Ban Dalah Pai Retreat is a meditative environment set within a Zen garden. It is an immersive, safe and tranquil space for yoga, aloneness, contemplation, reflection, restoration or recovery. The resort is near Pai township, within a rich, diverse rural setting, surrounded by mountains, streams, and the very green serenity of rice fields. It is private and exclusive, for singles and couples only and is not open to the public. Airbnb is its only access. It is absolutely LGBTQ+ friendly.
The back balcony is large, as is the view. Sunrise can be viewed from there, or from your pillow, and sunsets from the front porch of each studio. The room is very comfortable with high ceilings for coolness, and large sliding doors to maximise the panorama
address: 404 Wiang Tai, Pai District, Mae Hong Son 58130, Thailand
plusCode: 9C78+8W Wiang Tai, Pai District, Mae Hong Son, Thailand

reviews.name: Dan Freene
reviews.text:
The quietest, most magical stay in the Pai area. Located 10min out of town, wake to the sounds of frogs and bird life. Experience your morning tea or coffee observing the sunrise over the Pai Valley… Spend afternoons pool side, flip flop between pool and sauna for deep relaxation, embracing the ever changing Zen Garden, and watch nature at work. For a moment of calm in your world.
Visit Ban Dalah in Pai.
Dan Freene Dec 23’

reviewContext.Rooms: The view from Each room encompasses the rice terraces as you look back to Pai and The White Budda far off in the distance. Words cannot describe the beauty each morning…
reviewContext.Nearby activities: Visit the nearby waterfall on hot days. It’s a real treat. And don’t miss the Lisu village on your way…
reviewContext.Noteworthy details: If you are interested in mindfulness meditation inquiry zen or yoga theory, have a chat with Garry your host. Much enlightenment can be observed here at Ban Dalah.

reviews.name: Early Retirement Abroad
reviews.text:
I am trying to write a summary of our short stay at this mesmerizing place. It is so difficult to put in writing the feelings of the peace and comfort that overwhelms you as soon as you step inside the premises. So I will skip this attempt and start with the practical stuff.

Garry is a wonderful host! He arranged a car to bring us from and to Chiang Mai. He helped us to rent a motorbike here in Pai and took a lot of time from his busy schedule to introduce us to Pai and his favorite areas.

The room is tastefully decorated, like everything else on the property, and has everything needed for a comfortable stay, including mini fridge, a kitchen sink and the most important - the balcony with the stunning view of the rice fields and the mountains. The hot water in shower is running momentarily.

The common area is designed in the such way, that the guests could fell into meditative and rejuvenative state without any extra effort.  Useful to mention, that the guests are allowed to use the kitchen, kitchenware and cooking stove, the washer, sauna and many other things that can be found in the common area.

Please note, that the place is completely renovated and is under the new management since November 2023. All reviews before November 2023 (positive or negative are irrelevant as of now and all information is not applicable)

We fell in love with this place and would love to come next year and stay much-much longer. (Do I still need to recommend this oasis? If yes, then it is highly recommend it!)

reviews.name: CAN
reviews.text: Ban Dalah is indescribably beautiful and there is a powerful energy here. Sunrises, sunsets, and mist, mountains and the constant flow of water surrounding the property. Each day seems to draw you in closer. leaving was quite sad. The water features and sounds were amazing, as was the Zen garden. Walking around the perimeter was an experience in itself. Garry was a great host. Ban Dalah is on my radar for a return in 2024 to further investigate kundalini yoga. The room itself was large, comfortable with a high ceiling and a sliding insect door which allows breathing the mountain air all night There is a beautiful white temple on the next corner. There is just something about Ban Dalah. Surreal

I informed him my personal reasons why I am training, Kru's wealth of experiences quickly shown through as he went through the details of the fundamentals that I requested to learn, where my mistakes where, and how to continue to improve. If you're looking for a place to train at, beginner like me or experienced, this is the place to be to train under a former 3x Lumpinee Champion, this is the place to be.

The gym is spacious, clean, and has ample parking.

During the COVID-19 pandemic, bookings are required for private training sessions, and the number of people in the gym is limited for safety reasons.

Recommended for anyone wanting to exercise through boxing; suitable for women, men, children, and adults.

The gym is open 24/7, which is super convenient for people with busy or unpredictable schedules like mine. The equipment is modern, well-maintained, and there’s a good variety for both strength training and cardio.

One thing I really appreciate is the cleanliness of the space. The staff clearly put effort into keeping everything tidy, and members also seem respectful about wiping down machines after use. The atmosphere is another highlight, people tend to focus on their own workouts, which makes it a comfortable environment even for beginners.

The staff are friendly and approachable, always willing to help if you have questions or need guidance. While it’s not a luxury gym, it definitely delivers great value for the price. Overall, Jetts Fitness Asoke is a reliable and well-rounded gym that I’d recommend to anyone looking for a convenient and comfortable place to work out.

reviews.name: Patty Patty
reviews.text:
I usually don’t write reviews, but after multiple safety concerns, it’s time to speak up.

I’ve been training here for a while and have tried to stay quiet out of respect, but after multiple incidents, it’s clear that this location has serious issues in safety and professionalism.

Just today, a 15 or 20 kg fixed bar was left standing vertically in the free weight zone near the row machine — something that should never happen. It fell violently to the floor just one step away from landing on my foot.

One more step, and it could’ve broken a bone. This wasn’t just careless — it was dangerous.

This is now the second time I’ve felt unsafe in this gym.

The first was months ago while walking on the treadmill, when a staff member accidentally shut down the machine I was on while walking past. I was mid-incline — had I lost balance, I could’ve been seriously injured. Yes, he apologized, but apologies don’t erase risk.

Add to this the ongoing lack of basic cleanliness and equipment organization:
- Barbells, dumbbells, and plates are left all over the floor.
- Nothing is ever put back where it belongs.
- Staff walk around, rarely if ever stepping in to maintain order.

Let’s be honest — clients may lack gym etiquette. That’s not new. But when staff show little awareness or accountability, it becomes a bigger problem.

The only reason I continue to come is because of my trainer — not because of the environment.

And if no one starts taking responsibility, this branch won’t improve — no matter how many apologies are given.

I’ve visited other branches and always received a warm welcome and a clean, structured space.

Please do better. For everyone’s safety.

reviews.name: Lightler Minize
reviews.text:
Jetts Fitness – Day Pass Payment & Refund Process Review

Overall Rating: 2/5 Stars
(The score reflects a failure in the service process, not the final financial outcome.)

Summary of Experience
I purchased a day pass via the online debit/credit card portal accessed through the QR code at the entrance and was able to enter the club without issue. However, when a payment-related matter arose (specifically, the need to void or refund a transaction, such as a duplicate charge), the subsequent process for resolving this concern was inaccurate, inconsistent, and highly frustrating.

⸻

1. Interaction with On-Site Branch Staff

Upon raising the payment issue at the branch, the staff members declined to assume responsibility for the card transaction. I was informed that it was “not their problem” and was instructed to contact the official support channel directly for any refund or void request.

This response suggests there may be insufficient internal training or unclear guidelines for handling payment disputes that originate from transactions made at the branch itself.

⸻

2. Interaction with the Official Contact Channel

When I contacted the official support channel as instructed, the guidance I received was contradictory. I was advised that the branch where the transaction took place was in fact responsible for initiating the void/refund process for the card payment.

This directly conflicted with what the branch had told me and resulted in a confusing and unproductive back-and-forth between the two internal parties.

⸻

Conclusion & Recommendations

The conflicting instructions from the branch staff and the official contact channel created an unnecessary and stressful loop, in which I was effectively placed in the role of intermediary between two internal Jetts Fitness departments. Both parties provided incorrect or incomplete information and neither initially took ownership of resolving the issue.

Although the refund was ultimately processed, the experience revealed serious gaps in:
•	Internal communication between branches and central support
•	Staff training on procedures for handling debit/credit card payment issues
•	Clear, customer-friendly protocols for resolving straightforward payment queries

I sincerely hope Jetts Fitness will review and improve its internal procedures and staff training in this area. A clear, consistent, and accountable process for payment adjustments and refunds would greatly enhance customer confidence and prevent similar situations for future members and visitors.

reviews.textTranslated: I don't know if the staff had any massage certifications. I had a massage with a small, short woman, and I'm not very big. During the massage, she only massaged my armpits and groin, which was painful because she's so thin. Imagine that! Instead of a relaxing massage, I was in pain for an hour. I've been to many professional massage parlors and know what good Thai massage should be like, but this was really not good. I'm not generalizing, because others might not be like this, but if you own a massage parlor, you should choose good masseuses or masseuses who suit your clients. I'm feeling unwell now. I'll update if I have any further symptoms. During the head massage, she was very rough; remember, that's my scalp, not my feet or anything thick. I usually don't leave bad reviews unless it's truly awful. It was a waste of time and I suffered unnecessarily.

reviews.text:
เช่าอยู่ที่นี่มา 3 ปีแล้ว ออฟฟิศน่ารักมาก productive spot สุดๆ เปิด 24 ชั่วโมง มาทำงานเสาร์อาทิตย์ หรือวันหยุด อยู่ดึกยันสว่างก็ได้ มีห้องอาบน้ำ มีห้องนวด มีตู้เต่าบิน ของขายดึกๆกินแก้หิวได้

พนักงานน่ารักทุกคน ดูแลดีมาก feel like home
พี่ยามขับรถรับ-ส่ง 24 ชั่วโมง

เหมาะกับ startup office ที่อยากมีที่ทำงานน่ารักๆอยู่กลางเมืองเดินทางสะดวกและ facilities ครบถ้วนในราคาไม่แพง แนะนำเลยค่า
reviews.textTranslated:
I've been renting here for 3 years. The office is adorable and a super productive spot. It's open 24 hours, so you can work on weekends or holidays and stay late until dawn. There are showers, a massage room, and a vending machine (like a turtle-shaped toy) with late-night snacks to satisfy your hunger.

The staff are all lovely and very attentive; it feels like home.
There's also a 24-hour security shuttle service.

Perfect for a startup office looking for a cute workspace in the city center with convenient transportation and complete facilities at an affordable price. Highly recommended!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:

reviews.name: Bomp Bomp
reviews.text:
เราเช่าออฟฟิศที่ Workstories บอกเลยว่าคุ้มค่าเกินราคามากๆ!
​ใครกำลังมองหาออฟฟิศให้เช่าหรือพื้นที่ทำงานย่านใจกลางเมือง แนะนำที่ Workstories เลิศจริงไม่จกตาครับ
​ประทับใจตั้งแต่เรื่อง การเดินทาง เพราะเดินทางสะดวกมาก ใกล้ BTS สถานีเพลินจิต แถมที่นี่เขามี บริการรถกอล์ฟคอยรับ-ส่ง สบายสุดๆ ไม่ต้องเดินตากแดดตากฝนให้เหนื่อยเลย
​ที่ตัดสินใจเลือกเช่าที่นี่หลักๆ เลยคือ ราคาถูกและได้ครบจบในที่เดียว บริการฟรีแบบจัดเต็มมากๆ:
​มีห้องประชุมให้ใช้ฟรี ไม่ต้องจ่ายเพิ่มเวลามีนัดคุยงานกับทีมหรือลูกค้า
​ปริ้นเอกสารฟรี ประหยัดงบค่าใช้จ่ายออฟฟิศไปได้เยอะมาก
มีพื้นที่ Co-Working Space ส่วนกลาง วันไหนเบื่อโต๊ะทำงานตัวเอง ก็ออกมานั่งทำงานเปลี่ยนบรรยากาศได้สบายๆ บรรยากาศดี เหมาะกับการคิดงานสุดๆ
​เรียกได้ว่าจ่ายราคาสบายกระเป๋า แต่ได้สิ่งอำนวยความสะดวกครบถ้วนเหมือนออฟฟิศใหญ่ ใครหาออฟฟิศย่านเพลินจิตอยู่ แนะนำเลยครับไม่ผิดหวังแน่นอน!
reviews.textTranslated:
We rented an office at Workstories, and let me tell you, it was more than worth the price!
If you're looking for office space or workspace in the heart of the city, I highly recommend Workstories. It's truly excellent!
We were impressed from the start by the location. It's very convenient, close to the BTS Phloen Chit station, and they even have a golf cart shuttle service – super convenient, no need to walk in the sun or rain.
The main reasons we chose to rent here were the affordable price and the comprehensive free services:
Free use of meeting rooms – no extra charge for meetings with the team or clients.
Free printing – saving a lot on office expenses.
A shared co-working space – perfect for a change of scenery when you're tired of your own desk. The atmosphere is great for brainstorming.
In short, you pay a budget-friendly price but get all the amenities of a larger office. If you're looking for an office in the Phloen Chit area, I highly recommend Workstories – you won't be disappointed!

reviews.name: Kwanchai Quinzy Yokto
reviews.text:
It is my first time for the Hairs spa therapy.

Package 120 minutes:

Service: Excellent since first step into the shop. They were explained to me really good and clearly enough with all details that I would like to do ans looking forward of results.

Treatment: 120 minutes for Hairs and Neck massage with Vietnamese style. It was outstanding and miracle slept 😴 over the Treatment without knowing. I was really impressed and really like the skills of the therapist who expertise of this event. It was making me felt refreshing after complete the treatment today. During the treatment really in detail while am awake period and felt so nice.

I went there without booking as per just would like to explore new experiences. They recommend me to make booking in advance for timing is better.

Overall compared with prices. Excellent and will be going back.

reviewContext.Specialties: The heads massage and hairs treatment

reviews.name: Alexis Castro
reviews.text:
Love the ladies at this salon. Im from the US and I'm mixed race. So my hair texture is thick and curly with a range from 3b-4c. Firstly, the shampoo and massage was very relaxing. However, the best part for me was the blow dry at the end. All the ladies came to help blow dry my hair. In the process, they were very curious and I gave them tips on how to comb it correctly. They quickly adapted to my tips and gave me a nice blow out. I felt very loved as a customer.

I'll be back! Amazing ladies here

reviews.text:
I have been here for several times already and they’ve never disappointed me even once. I even suggested to my own friends and family to visit here. Amazing service and their massage is totally wow, just wow.

Recommend for those who are looking for relaxing day.

reviews.name: SKTP 99
reviews.text:
บริการดี สุภาพ นวดสบาย 1ชม.กำลังดี มีที่จอด เดินทางสะดวก มีคิว 3คนวันธรรมดา เสาร์อาทิต4-5คนต่อการนวดหนึ่งรอบ

ราคาดีค่ะ ได้ผ่อนคลายดี เหมือนมีคนสระผมแล้วนวดให้

ขอติงเรื่องนึง:อุปกรณ์ที่ใช้ควรล้าง/เช็ดแอลกอฮอล์ทุกครั้ง พอดีทำกับแฟนแล้วเสร็จช้ากว่า เห็นพนักงานเก็บมาเรียงแต่ไม่ได้ทำความสะอาด(มีบางช่วงหลับตาอาจเห็นไม่ครบ แต่เท่าที่สัมผัสเตียงแฟนด้างข้างได้คือแค่เรียงอย่างเดียวเพราะไวมาก จัดเตียงเสร็จแล้ว)
ของที่นำมาใช้หากใช้ต่อๆๆๆกันจริง รบกวนรีบแก้ไขทำความสะอาดค่ะเพราะทำให้ภาพลักษณ์ร้านเรื่องความสะอาดลดลงไปเลยค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated:
Good service, polite staff, comfortable massage, 1 hour was just right. Parking available, easy to get to. There are usually 3 clients per session on weekdays and 4-5 clients on weekends.

Good price. Very relaxing, like having your hair washed and then getting a massage.

One criticism: The equipment used should be washed/wiped with alcohol after each use. My boyfriend and I had a massage that took longer than expected. I saw the staff arranging the items but not cleaning them (I might not have seen everything with my eyes closed, but from what I could feel on the side of my boyfriend's bed, they only arranged the items because it was very quick).
If the items are being reused, please address this issue of inadequate cleaning as it negatively impacts the salon's image regarding cleanliness.

reviews.name: Ra Wee
reviews.text:
เปิดประสบการณ์สำหรับเปิดประสบการณ์สำหรับคนที่ไม่เคยสระผมสไตล์เวียดนาม

reviews.text:
นวดคลายดีมากเลยค่ะราคาไม่แพง
พนักงานไดคุ้มให้เราแห้งเรียบร้อย
สบายมากเลยค่ะ

It was so relaxing.
The massage lasted about 45 minutes, plus another 15 minutes for drying my hair.
Definitely worth the price!

reviews.name: MaEzZiiZ Khunlaja
reviews.text: เป็นประสบการณ์สระผมที่ดีมากกกก ประทับใจทุกอย่าง ร้านหอมอโรม่าทั้งร้าน ร้านเล็กๆแต่พนักงานดูแลเทคแคร์ดีมากแบบ luxury สุดๆ ขั้นตอนเยอะมากราคาดีคุ้มค่าสุดๆ อยากให้มาลองค่ะ ให้ 10 ดาวไปเลยค่า 🥰😘
reviews.textTranslated: It was an amazing hair washing experience! I was impressed with everything. The salon smelled wonderful with aromatherapy. It's a small salon, but the staff provided excellent, luxurious service. The process was extensive, but the price was great and well worth it. I highly recommend trying it. 10 stars! 🥰😘

reviews.name: Pichsaran Ves
reviews.text:
Sleep salon ใกล้ซีคอนบางแค อยู่ในเวิ้งเดียวกับย่างเนยและ hotpotman เลย

เข้าไปบอกเลยว่า นี่คือตอบโจทย์คนต้องการการผ่อนคลายอย่างแท้จริง
มีโปรแกรมนวดหน้านวดศีรษะให้เลือก 3 แบบ โดยเพิ่ม option เพิ่มเวลา เพิ่มราคาไปตามลำดับให้เลือกได้อย่างชอบใจ เริ่มต้น 590 บาท/1ชม
สะสมแต้มแลกส่วนลดได้ด้วย

วันนี้ลองตัวพื้นฐาน 1 ชั่วโมงก่อน
เป็นนวดหน้า นวดศีรษะ สระผม ไดร์แห้ง
คือดีงามสุดๆ บรรยากาศผ่อนคลายมาก มาครบทั้งกลิ่น เสียง สัมผัส
แอร์เย็นกำลังดี มีกลิ่นอโรมาหอมๆ ผ่อนคลายด้วยการนวดและสระผม
พนักงานบริการดีมากๆ นวดดี ใส่ใจ
สถานที่อุปกรณ์ต่างๆดูสะอาดสะอ้าน มาตรฐานสุด

ใครอยากผ่อนคลายขอแนะนำเลยค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated:
Sleep Salon is near Seacon Bangkae, located in the same area as Yang Nuey and Hotpotman.

Upon entering, you'll immediately recognize it as a true haven for relaxation.
They offer three types of facial and head massages, with options to increase the duration and price accordingly, starting at 590 baht/1 hour.
You can also accumulate points for discounts.

Today, I tried the basic 1-hour package.
It included a facial massage, head massage, hair wash, and blow-drying.
It was absolutely amazing! The atmosphere was incredibly relaxing, with a perfect blend of scent, sound, and touch.
The air conditioning was just right, and the aromatherapy scents added to the relaxation during the massage and hair wash.
The staff were incredibly attentive and provided excellent massage techniques.
The place and equipment were spotlessly clean and of the highest standard.

I highly recommend it to anyone seeking relaxation.

reviews.name: Thanaporn Prabsatttoo
reviews.text: ใช้บริการที่ราคาแพงที่สุดไม่ได้รู้สึกถึงความสบายเท่าไหร่ สระผมได้ยินเสียงน้ำเตียงข้างๆ เตียงก็ติดกันเกินไม่รู้สึกผ่อนคลาย ต่างจากที่ไปทำที่ประเทศเวียดนามมากๆ
reviews.textTranslated: Even the most expensive service didn't feel as comfortable. I could hear the water while getting my hair washed, and the beds were too close together, making it not relaxing at all. It was very different from the experience I had in Vietnam.

reviews.name: Mayrisa Suriya
reviews.text:
โลเคชั่น : หาง่าย ปักหมุดตรงจุด มีที่จอดรถให้ หรือจะมาทางรถไฟฟ้าก็ง่ายมาก

บรรยากาศภายในร้าน : ร้านหอม แอร์เย็น สะอาด จัดส่วนแยกได้ดี ห้องนวดมีความไพรเวท ไม่มีเสียงจากข้างนอกมารบกวนได้ ห้องน้ำสะอาด

แพคเกจ : มี3แพคเกจ ราคาตามขั้นตอน แนะนำแพคเกจ3 เต็มเวลา2ชั่วโมง

การเข้ารับบริการ : บริการดีมาก ความฟินให้เต็ม10 ผ่อนคลายมาก มีขั้นตอนอะไรทำมาครบทุกอย่างจบที่นี่ นวดหัว นวดหลัง นวดมือ คือดีทุกจุด ฝีมือดีมากค่ะ

พนักงาน : ชอบที่ใส่ชุดเวียดนาม สุภาพอ่อนน้อมทุกคน บริการดี มือนิ่มมาก เวลาสัมผัสหน้าเราตัวเราแล้วไม่รู้สึกเจ็บหรือสาก ระหว่างบริการจะคอยถามตลอดเบาไปหนักไปแจ้งได้หมด

สรุปชอบมากค่ะ ผมยังนิ่มอยู่ทรงมา3วันแล้ว ประทับใจมากค่ะ มีโอกาสจะไปซ้ำอีกค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated:
Location: Easy to find, pinned location, parking available, or easily accessible by BTS Skytrain.

Atmosphere: The shop smells nice, is air-conditioned, clean, and well-organized. The massage rooms are private, with no outside noise disturbance. The restrooms are clean.

Packages: There are 3 packages available, priced according to the service. I recommend package 3, the full 2-hour session.

Service: Excellent service. The experience was incredibly relaxing (10/10). Everything was included – head massage, back massage, hand massage – all excellent. The therapist's skills are superb.

Staff: I liked that they wore Vietnamese traditional clothing. They were all polite and courteous, providing excellent service. Their hands were incredibly soft; the massage on my face and body felt smooth and not rough. During the service, they constantly asked if I wanted the pressure too light or too strong, and I could adjust as needed.

In summary, I loved it! My hair is still soft and styled for three days now. I was very impressed and will definitely go back again.

reviews.name: ttap vnutcha
reviews.text: พนักงานนวดดีมากค่ะ รู้สึกผ่อนคลาย คุ้มมากกกกกกับเงินที่จ่ายไป แนะนำเลยค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: The massage therapist was excellent. I felt so relaxed. It was totally worth the money. I highly recommend it!

reviews.text: พนักงานแอดมินไม่ตรวจเช็คคิว  ทำให้ลูกค้าเสียเวลาทั้งที่จองแล้วแต่บอกว่าคิวเต็ม อ้างแต่ว่าลูกค้าเยอะ ไม่ได้จ่ายค่ามัดจำลูกค้า ตอนจองคิวก็ไม่ได้บอกด้วยว่าต้องจ่ายค่ามัดจำ เซ็งค่ะครั้งเดียวพอ

They kept claiming there were too many customers and hadn't received a deposit. They weren't even mentioned during the booking process. Very frustrating, one time is enough.

reviews.text: พนักงานบริการได้ค่อนข้างเเย่มาก จองคิวไว้แล้วแต่พอไปถึงร้าน พนักงานใช้คำพูดว่าลูกค้ายังไม่ได้โอนมัดจำจองคิวเลยไม่ได้คิวในวันนั้น ทั้งๆที่ในเเชทที่จองคิวพนักงานไม่ได้พูดถึงเรื่องการโอนมัดจำเเม้เเต่น้อย และยังบอกให้ไปวันอื่นเเทน แต่คือตั้งใจหยุดงานเพื่อมาทำโดยเฉพาะ เสียความรู้สึกมากๆ ครั้งเดียวพอค่ะ ไม่ซ้ำแน่นอนและตลอดไป👎🏻

This was despite the fact that the reservation chat didn't mention a deposit at all. They also suggested I come another day. I specifically took time off work to come here. I'm extremely disappointed. One time is enough. I will never go back here again. 👎🏻

reviews.text: พนักงานแอดมินไม่ตรวจเช็คคิวลูกค้า พอไปถึงบอกคิวเต็มแต่นัดไว้16:00 โมง ลูกค้าที่นัดไว้มี3ท่าน คุยกับแอดมินไว้วันที่15/01/2569 นัดกันไว้วัน18/01/2569 แอดมินอ้างว่ายังไม่ได้จ่ายค่ามัดจำ แต่ข้อความที่คุยกันแอดมินไม่ได้พิมพ์ถึงค่ามัดจำเลย ถ้าแอดมินแจ้งค่ามัดจำแน่นอนค่ะเราโอนได้อยู่แล้วตั้งใจที่จะไปสระผมร้านนี้ หยุดงานที่จะไป แต่เจอแบบนี้ครั้งเดียวค่ะ 🙂
reviews.textTranslated: The admin staff didn't check the customer queue. Upon arrival, they said the queue was full, even though I had an appointment at 4:00 PM. There were three customers scheduled. I spoke with the admin on January 15th, 2026, for an appointment on January 18th, 2026. The admin claimed that a deposit hadn't been paid, but the messages we exchanged didn't mention a deposit at all. If the admin had mentioned a deposit, we would have definitely transferred it. I was planning to go to this salon to get my hair done, even though I took time off work. This will be my only visit after this experience. 🙂

reviews.text:
มาครั้งที่ 2 แล้ว พนักงานบริการดี

reviews.textTranslated:
This is my second visit, and the service is excellent.
Upon entering, the staff let me choose a scent; I chose jasmine, which smelled wonderful.
They started with a neck, shoulder, and back massage, followed by a facial.
It was amazing and so relaxing. They washed my hair twice, massaged my head, and did a lot of pressure point massages.

reviews.name: Martin Feng
reviews.text: Exceptional Muay Thai gym. Legit trainers/ coaches. I stayed there for a couple of days after my camp in Chiang Mai 🇹🇭.basic accomodations . Room had 2 mattress with AC. Communal showers and bathroom on the 1st floor. I started off a beginner and they took care of me. Teaching techniques and pad work. Learned good Thai clinch training with the coach and fighters there. Thank you for the great experience and memories 🙏🇹🇭💪 shout out to the international fighters from Morocco Ahmed, Uzbekistan Aslinov, Portugal Miguel 💪💪💪

reviews.name: Daniel Thaiger
reviews.text: Nice and clean facility!! Staff are professional trainers with many years of experience and super friendly. Offer best price around the area and a great program for all ages with education visa and certification.

reviews.name: Bogdan Shelkovnikov
reviews.text:
good trainers, good training, good, comfortable, clean gym

Excellent gym! The trainers are incredibly friendly and attentive, paying close attention to each individual and helping you improve. I'm very pleased with their concern for the safety and health of their trainees. For sparring, the trainers provide separate 16-ounce Top King gloves (Top King gloves are the softest and safest gloves I've ever used). The equipment is well-maintained and dry, so I didn't experience any odor or irritation from using their sparring gloves. Overall, if you're looking for a training gym and came here after reading reviews, definitely check this one out. They employ professionals who treat their trainees with respect and understanding!

The only thing is, I couldn't find the class schedule. There was no response on WhatsApp or Instagram. So, write to Line for details.

Thanks for the training, I was glad to attend the training, I will definitely come again!

only pay for 200 with really deep massage.

reviews.name: Camilla Leitner
reviews.text: I have been travelling for a month and this was one of the best massages I have had.  It is a very simple location. If you are looking for a great massage, this is the place. If you want a spa experience, maybe not.

reviews.name: Charlene Su
reviews.text:
We chanced upon this shop while looking for a massage, saw the very reasonable prices and went in. We were a bit confused at first because there was no seperate room or foot washing services - we changed in the back room where the toilet / staff’s belongings and the washing machine was. We worried a little about hygiene but little did we know we were about to get one of the best massages we’ve ever had in Thailand (and we come quite often). The masseurs were clearly experienced and their strength stayed consistent throughout - we left feeling relaxed and very happy we stumbled onto this gem. We intend to head back tomorrow :)

If you don’t mind more local, less fanciful or aesthetic facilities and just want a fantastic massage for a very affordable price, this is the place to be.

reviews.name: Suwatana Kamutchat
reviews.text: A very good place for a real massage in Thai style, look different from a fancy place in between $5/ hr and $70/ hr. This place is very local and served all equally Thai-foreigner. You might see the  objects around the place or in familiar style in the house but this is a culture of set up. There is a massage school in the temple, couple buildings on  Charoen Krung Road, that tells a lot why this road has several massage place.

reviews.name: Wealthstyles LP
reviews.text:
I had the most AMAZING massage at Analisa last night. Actually to say it was "amazing" is an understatement!

reviews.name: Thitapa Chueinta
reviews.text:
อยู่คอนโดนี้มานาน ไม่เคยนวดร้านนี้มาก่อน วันนี้ตัดสินใจลองใช้บริการ และบอกตรง ๆ ว่าเป็น การนวดที่แย่ที่สุดในชีวิต เสียเวลาไป 2 ชั่วโมงเต็ม และเสียดายเงินมาก
1.	แจ้งตั้งแต่ต้นว่าขอ เน้นข้างขวา แต่พนักงานไม่มีท่าทีสนใจ ทำหน้าไม่พอใจ ตอบอะไรบางอย่างเร็ว ๆ แล้วเดินหนีไป ระหว่างการนวดก็พิสูจน์แล้วว่า ไม่ได้เน้นตามที่ขอจริง ๆ
2.	นวดไปประมาณ 15 นาที ขอให้นวดแรงขึ้น แต่แรงเท่าเดิม จะแรงแค่ตอนใช้ศอกกด พอสอบถามกลับถูกเถียงว่า “ใช้นิ้วนวดจะแรงได้ยังไง ต้องแรงตอนใช้ศอกเท่านั้น” น้ำเสียงกวนและปากดีมาก เหมือนลูกค้าไม่มีสิทธิ์แสดงความรู้สึก
3.	พยายามพูดอ้อม ๆ ขอเปลี่ยนหมอ แต่ถูกปัดทันทีว่าไม่มีทางเลือก
4.	ผ่านไปประมาณ 30 นาที ขอให้นวดแรงขึ้นอีกครั้ง เพราะ ไม่รู้สึกอะไรเลยทั้งที่เมื่อยมาก คำตอบที่ได้คือ “นวดข้างเดียวจะไปรู้สึกได้ยังไง” ตรรกะเพี้ยนมาก สรุปคือลูกค้าต้องนวดครบ 2 ชั่วโมงก่อน ถึงจะมีสิทธิ์บอกว่าเบาหรือไม่ตรงจุดงั้นเหรอ?
5.	สิ่งที่แย่ที่สุดไม่ใช่ทัศนคติของหมอนวดแค่นั้น แต่คือ เทคนิคการนวดที่ห่วยแตกมากกก รู้ได้ทันทีว่าไม่เป็นงาน ไม่เคยเรียนนวดมาเลย คนที่นวดเป็นจริง ๆ ไม่จำเป็นต้องออกแรงเยอะ แต่ทำให้รู้สึกได้ตรงจุด แต่นี่คือเน้นบี้มั่วๆ กดมั่วๆ ให้ร่างกายช้ำอย่างเดียว ไม่ช่วยคลายเมื่อยเลยแม้แต่นิดเดียว

ใครจะบอกว่า “ก็แค่ 650 บาทจะเอาอะไรมาก” ขอบอกเลยว่า เคยนวดมาหลายที่มาก ทั้งถูกและแพง และมีร้านที่ถูกกว่านี้แต่ดีกว่านี้อีกเยอะ
นี่คือ ร้านแรกและร้านเดียวที่แย่ขนาดนี้ ตั้งแต่เคยนวดมา

⚠️ ใครกำลังคิดจะมา ขอบอกตรงนี้เลยว่า ไม่แนะนำอย่างแรง เสียเงิน เสียเวลา และเสียอารมณ์กับพนักงานสุด ๆ 👎👎👎
reviews.textTranslated:
I've lived in this condo for a long time and never been to this massage parlor before. Today, I decided to try their service, and honestly, it was the worst massage of my life. I wasted two full hours and regretted spending the money.
1. I told them from the start that I wanted them to focus on the right side, but the staff member showed no interest, made a displeased face, quickly replied something, and walked away. During the massage, it was proven that they didn't focus on the area as requested.
2. About 15 minutes into the massage, I asked for stronger pressure, but the pressure remained the same, only increasing when they used their elbow. When I questioned this, they argued, "How can you use your fingers to massage harder? You have to use your elbow." Their tone was sarcastic and disrespectful, as if the customer had no right to express their feelings.
3. I tried to subtly ask to change masseurs, but they immediately dismissed me, saying there were no other options.
4. After about 30 minutes, I asked for stronger pressure again because I couldn't feel anything despite being very sore. The response I received was, "How can you feel anything when massaging only one side?" Their logic is completely flawed. Does this mean that customers have to complete a two-hour massage before they have the right to say that it's too light or not hitting the right spots?
5. The worst part wasn't just the masseur's attitude, but also their incredibly terrible massage technique. It was obvious they were inexperienced and had never received any massage training. A truly skilled masseur doesn't need to use excessive force; they just need to target the right spots. This place, however, focused on randomly pressing and rubbing, causing bruising and providing absolutely no relief from soreness.

Anyone who says, "It's only 650 baht, what more can you expect?", let me tell you, I've been to many massage parlors, both cheap and expensive, and there are many cheaper but better places.
This is the first and only massage parlor I've ever been to that terrible.

⚠️ If you're thinking of coming here, let me say this: I strongly do not recommend it. You'll waste your money, time, and your temper with the staff. 👎👎👎

reviews.textTranslated:
It was the massage of a lifetime.
I was lucky enough to receive it from a therapist who specializes in teaching therapists, and it was truly amazing.

The Thai massage was 150 baht for an hour.
I got a two-hour back massage for 400 baht, but if I had time, I would have liked to get another two hours... I tipped 100 baht.
I've had massages at nearby Spa Land, Yin Yang, Saphan Taksin, and Khao San, but this was the best for me!

I've been wanting to visit this massage shop so much that I'm thinking about booking a hotel near here next time. I'm planning to come back to Bangkok sometime in the middle of this month, and I'll definitely be back at this massage shop.

reviews.name: J H
reviews.text: Baan Sabai Massage - The only reason I went there was because we stayed close in the hotel next to it. Two different people I had massage with - both massages were not done hard enough, not finding the technique, knots, seems like they do not know where exactly to press harder etc. I have had so many Thai massages in my life, this place is not as great as others, unfortunately. In addition to this, they just gave me a male person without even asking if I agree! Not enough skilled or maybe a bit lazy staff members. Overall, the place is clean. But I do not recommend if you are after a real Thai massage. Paid for nothing, especially second time, felt like the guy was a student, not a professional. Also, the receptionist is not friendly welcoming in my case - she  jumped up to get my my husband in when he walked in just to ask the price for me, but when I came - not so enthusiastic to welcome me, even rolling her eyes as if being annoyed by another female coming. Awful
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for sharing your feedback. We are deeply sorry to hear that your experience at Baan Sabai Massage was disappointing. Please accept our sincere apologies for the issues with the massage quality, the therapist assignment, and the service at our front desk. This is certainly not the level of service we aim to provide, and we truly appreciate your input as it helps us improve.

This was so bad because we just wanted a proper massage and this is not red light district in BKK. The masseurs even shamelessly asked for tips at the end. I visited Bangkok many times, and I love Bangkok so much. But this time, this massage store ruined my whole trip!!!!!!!!!!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Jim
We are truly sorry to hear about your unpleasant experience. Please accept our sincere apologies.
This is absolutely not the standard or service we provide or tolerate at our massage store.We value every customer’s comfort and safety above all else and we assure you that appropriate measures will be taken to prevent such issues from happening again. We take this matter very seriously.

She knows exactly where the tension is and how to relieve it. The massage was incredibly relaxing and effective from the first minute. Her technique, pressure, and attention to detail are amazing. Highly recommended!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks.

reviews.name: Faten AlRadini
reviews.text:
What a wonderful massage 🤩
I had a one hour foot massage
Thank you Tin for helping me to fully relax tonight ❤️
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks you

reviews.name: L Nguyen
reviews.text: Usually I’m a bit skeptical about places that charge low prices (200 THB) but the women here are AMAZINGGGG! I’ve had two different girls and they’re both equally good. It wasn’t too soft or too rough and I think they were able tell that I’m a bit more athletic so they dug deep in my muscles. When I asked her if she had tiger balm, she rubbed that all on my neck and shoulders and hit every pressure point to relieve the tension. The environment isn’t like 5 stars but it’s also not like one of those sketchy places. It’s also super close to so many good restaurants, bars and coffee shop. I highly recommend this place. The only complaint is that you can hear the traffic and conversations in the next room.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: I'm waiting for you to come back again. Thanks.

reviews.name: Irene
reviews.text:
Read this before you choose this shop. One star is the minimum requirement, if not I rather give 0 star with only review.

This is the worst massage I’ve ever had in my life. Randomly went to this massage shop with my boyfriend.

Two of the masseuse were using Thai language to mock us when we asked them harder for the foot massage!! How ridiculous of them thinking that we don’t understand but my boyfriend can actually understand and speak well Thai.

We paid for one hour massage .They started the massage at 8.10pm and one of the male masseuse was actually well aware of the time but when it comes to 8.55pm, he stand up and leaving. The female masseuse asked him that isn’t it until 9.10pm, but he refuse to continue and said it’s only until 9pm! Then, the female masseuse follow him and leave.

Fifteen minutes were shorten intentionally by them and I have to paid full 300 baht for this kind of unprofessional service and bad attitude! Worst experience in Phuket.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you. Welcome

reviews.name: Jyoti Kunwar
reviews.text: Incredible massage. Got the Thai massage after an evening of shopping at Chivilla market and then had to come back the next morning for an oil and foot massage. The prices are so affordable! Wish we had more time for more massages. Thank you so much again ladies x
