reviews.name: Xarniia
reviews.text:
Bevor was good shop and we liked to come often.Now the price nearly doubled and is therefore very expensive. The location is convenient and so a lot of tourist and one time customers arrond.
The massage was very oily and even soft.
We asked the staff to make it stronger, but the staff didn't follow. One therapist said she can't make strong massage anymore.
For around 500 Baht that's overpriced and just inadequate.

reviews.name: Елена Мягких
reviews.text: I was not satisfied with the foot massage.  They did a good job for my husband, my massage therapist kept getting distracted and talking to other employees.  The actual foot massage was for 10 minutes, and very superficial, the rest of the time the massage therapist rubbed the lower leg.  They didn’t crush the points on my feet, they forgot to pull the toes on one foot, they didn’t press on the muscles above the knees.  What a waste of an hour.  If you come across my massage therapist, you will be out of luck.  Perhaps others will be better, since my husband was lucky, he had another master and he did everything more carefully and well, and he was almost not distracted by conversations

reviews.name: Nancy
reviews.text: I am always on the lookout for a great massage place. This place is not fancy but it's comfortable.  What I wanted was someone to unkink my body after a long plane trip on top of a tough spin class.  The lady did it for me.  I have massages twice a month for the last 30 years. So, I know what my body needs.  My only regret is that I did not try the oil massage.  I followed my gold rule: always try the local way first; that means a Thai massage which is not exactly luxurious. Maybe next time.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: I'm waiting for you to come back again. Thanks.

reviews.name: yukyung hwang
reviews.text: I paid 350 baht for an hour and went to get a massage. I didn't go to waste my time. However, she kept talking with the staff and kept looking outside without focusing on the massage. I think even a star is a waste. Whether it's a festival outside or not, I'm here for a massage and I don't have to look at it, but she tells me to look outside. What do you want me to do? I put on a lot of oil for an hour. If you're going to do this, stop the massage shop.

reviews.name: udbhava sirsi
reviews.text: Oh this lace! The staff is so sweet and the massage was probably the best in Phuket. We went there 5 times in a span of 4 days - leg massage, face scrub, full body massage. They provide tea and fruits once done. Totally worth the money!!!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks so much

reviews.name: Weronika Jarowa
reviews.text: Do not recommend. I had lots of massages in Thailand and that was the worse because almost none.  1. It was cold. 2. It was only applying the cream in haotic moves. 3. Paid for 1 hour but it lasted 50 min and the masseuse was going out a lot of times. 4. First was working with feeds and right after without washing the hands passed to the face.

reviews.name: Anisha G
reviews.text: My masseuse was very distracted the whole time and applied no pressure at all. It was very lackluster. It didnt feel relaxing at all. There was no baskets to put my personal items. The beds didnt have a massage hole to put our head in. My head was sideways and hurting. I paid for head/shoulder/back. She touched my head for litterally 2 mins. They provided others with tea but didnt give us anything. Waste of money and time. Worst massage in thailand

reviews.name: K
reviews.text: They made time for me even late in the evening, and I had an amazing, relaxing massage which was very needed after a long travel day. I’m very happy with the service!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you.

reviews.name: K Motshele
reviews.text:
Oh my word! What an experience. It's my first time writing a review though I've had great experiences before, but this time I just had to.

I had a oil full body massage (literally head to toe) for 2 hours at Lai Thai Massage parlour

Thiwaphon was truly amazing and left no part of my body abandoned. All my knots in places masseuses often forget about are gone. I was surprised at how much tension I had in my hands and wrists! Enjoyed a good stretch of all my limbs too.

There is a lot of love & patience in every touch... You can tell she's deliberate in wanting to make you feel good. If I had more money I'd have asked to stay longer.

Enjoying my second cup of complimentary tea while I soak this feeling in.

Happy to say I have a new friend I'll visit everytime I come to Phuket ♥️

reviews.name: Danny Hamm
reviews.text: A much different vibe than Patong Beach.  The ladies are very friendly and take their time with your massage.  I got the 90 minutes coconut oil massage and it felt like 3 hours.  They were busy but I never felt rushed.  There was care and patience in her work and I drifted in and out of sleep.  It is in a nice location in the heart of Phuket Old Town.  You have many places to shop and eat.  It is a very walkable place.  There are other massage places but this one seemed the cleanest and had the best prices.  If you want to rest those tiredegs then go no further than Lai Thai massage.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: I Just Wait for Come Back Again

reviews.name: Allyson Neo
reviews.text: My masseuse kept stopping to talk on the phone and text. She even walked away mid-massage to chat with other customers, which was pretty annoying. My husband said his masseuse was pretty good though so I guess it depends on which masseuse you get.

reviews.name: sd khalsa
reviews.text: Just finished a 60 minute massage with Noi; it was awesome. My wife and daughter both had similar experiences with their therapists as well. I am a massage therapist and can tell you they do goid work. Can't wait to go back this week.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: I'm waiting for you to come back again. Thank.

title: หัตถ์ทิพย์นวดแผนไทย
address: 1383 Charoen Nakhon Rd, Bang Lamphu Lang, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand
plusCode: PG84+4C Bangkok, Thailand

reviews.name: Bowornlak Teerawattana
reviews.text:
I didn’t expect much when I first came here – I just saw the good reviews and it was close to my condo. But this place completely exceeded my expectations. I’ve been to many massage places in Thailand, and no one has ever been able to relieve my pain like here, especially the young male therapist, who is also visually impaired and the owner. He’s the only one who could truly fix my office syndrome and even adjust my back and neck.

I’ve had shoulder, neck, and upper back pain for years, and nothing ever worked – until now. He has a strong technique, works deeply on the right points, and even did a proper spinal adjustment. After a 3-hour session, my pain was gone completely. Honestly, this is the best massage experience I’ve ever had in my life. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Joshua Ashford
reviews.text: Came in for the one hour foot massage, and was welcomed by a senior woman. She carried out the session and certainly showed her experience through technique. She calculated certain pressure points and through her movements could hit the exact spots, certainly helped move some energy. My first foot massage experience in Thailand but compared to other countries of the world I’ve visited this was a very relaxing massage. Would recommend

reviews.name: Heeyoon Park
reviews.text: Highly recommended. Kind massage therapist and his crew. Massage has more focus on pressure points and muscle reflexology than manual stretching. Good tummy rub too!

reviews.name: L HM
reviews.text: A very nice massage, small business, with happy and friendly people working together. I felt much better afterward and happy to recommend.

reviews.name: Jen Cannon
reviews.text: Best place for authentic Thai massage in Bangkok. And only 200 baht an hour. Cant beat it

reviews.name: Joseph
reviews.text:
easily the best 'blind' massage shop I've ever been to and will travel for an hour to get massaged here.

the therapists are highly skilled; they may not be able to see with their eyes but they can certainly see with their hands.

it's a no frills shop, nothing fancy or glamourous however if you're wanting to untie your inner knots, it's the place to go do it.

I ask my local thai friends to make a booking on my behalf although I'm sure walk-ins are accepted as the place isn't busy.

English is very minimal but you could make it work.

the price is lower than most shops however the value is sky high.

the therapists are friendly (all males) and warm.

all in all, a place worth coming too!

reviews.name: And Andy
reviews.text: This was the best massage I have ever had,  A true thai massage. Don't be afraid of the basic shop and the fact the 3 guys are blind!!!!! 🦯🦮.   That is WHY they are so good. They will find sore  spots and work on them and stretch you out . Amazing skills. Please be generous too...... Try use Google Translate to help you ask for anything in particular... 🙏

reviews.name: Hafiz Zainudeen
reviews.text: Excellent. Prepare for pain. Most precise massage I’ve had in bkk so far

reviews.name: Sechmet
reviews.text: Ήρθα γιατί το είδα στο ινσταγκραμ, ένας ξένος το πρότεινε γιατί είχε ένα πολύ καλό θεραπευτή. Όταν πήγα εκεί με έβαλαν να κάνω μασάζ με έναν μαθητευόμενο( φαντάζομαι) που δούλεψε της γραμμές Σεν και μου έκανε και κάποια τεντώματα. Το μασάζ δεν μπόρεσα να το απολαύσω, πρόσφατα έκανα εκπαίδευση σε Ταϊλανδέζικο μασάζ και μπόρεσα να καταλάβω όλα τα λάθη. Αρκετές φορές πίεζε στα κόκκαλα (πράγμα που δεν επιτρέπεται στο μασάζ) , έκανε λάθος στα σημεία πίεσης, δεν καταλάβαινε ότι πίεζε παραπάνω, κάποιες κινήσεις τις επανέλαβε περισσότερες φορές μάλλον γτ είχε ξεχάσει ότι τις είχε ηδη κάνει, κάποιες κινήσεις ξέχασε να τις κάνει από την άλλη πλευρά. Στο τέλος ενώ είχα ζητήσει 2 ώρες το μείωσα στη 1 και έφυγα τρέχοντας. Όποτε όσοι είδατε το μέρος στο ινσταγκραμ,μόνο με τον κύριο που δείχνει το βίντεο(που δεν ξέρω αν είναι πραγματικά καλός), μην τρέχετε μέχρι εκεί άδικα.
reviews.textTranslated: I came because I saw it on Instagram, a stranger recommended it because it had a very good therapist. When I went there, they made me get a massage with an apprentice (I think) who worked on the Shen lines and also did some stretching. I couldn't enjoy the massage, I recently did some Thai massage training and I was able to understand all the mistakes. Several times he pressed on the bones (something that is not allowed in massage), he made mistakes on the pressure points, he didn't understand that he was pressing too much, he repeated some movements more times probably because he had forgotten that he had already done them, he forgot to do some movements on the other side. In the end, while I had asked for 2 hours, I reduced it to 1 and ran away. So, those of you who saw the place on Instagram, only with the gentleman showing the video (who I don't know if he is really good), don't run there unnecessarily.

reviews.name: sebastian kozar
reviews.text: Jeden z najlepszych masaży, jakie miałem podczas pobytu w Tajlandii. Masaż był mocny i konkretny, wykonany z precyzją oraz wyczuciem. Nigdy nie czułem się tak lekko po masażu. A ból lewej nogi z którym chodziłem od kilku dni, po godzinie w tym salonie znikł. Serdecznie polecam wszystkim którzy tutaj chcą przyjść, naprawdę warto 😊❤️
reviews.textTranslated: One of the best massages I had during my stay in Thailand. The massage was strong and specific, performed with precision and sensitivity. I've never felt so light after a massage. And the pain in my left leg, which I'd been struggling with for several days, disappeared after an hour at this salon. I highly recommend it to anyone who wants to come here; it's truly worth it 😊❤️

reviews.text: อาจจะพักก่อนค่ะ บอกนวดแรง แรงจิงแต่ไม่โดนจุดค่ะ เน้นใช้ซอกกดอย่างเดียว ไม่ได้รู้สึกดีขึ้นค่ะ โดนกระดูก เจ็บ คนที่เรานวดเป็นยายค่ะ คนอื่นอาจจะนวดดี แต่เราอาจจะยังไม่ปลื้ม แต่ลุงผชที่ใส่แว่นดีเลยค่ะ

They were visually impaired, but their massage effectively cured my ailments. I recommend that if you are a beginner or prefer a gentle massage, you should inform the masseur beforehand.

reviews.name: Sujin Lee
reviews.text:
3박5일 태국여행동안 3일 마사지 받았습니다.
숙소는 크룽톤부리 바로 앞이였고 도보로 15분이었습니다.
다른 메인상권가에 비해 많이 저렴하였고 시각장애인분들이 마사지사로 계십니다. 앞이 안보이는대신 촉각이 극도로 발달되신분들이라 제가 조금만 긴장해도 바로 알아차리시고 힘조절을 해주셨어요.

로컬의 힘을믿고 방문하였는데 너무너무 만족스럽습니다. 저렴한만큼 팁을 좀 후하게 드렸지만 전혀 아깝지 않습니다. 그래도 다른곳보다 싸니까요.

선하고 성실하신 분들이라 많이버셨으면 좋겠습니다.

‘그리고 이곳을 방문하실분들에게 부탁을 드립니다.’
부디 이 직원분들에게 친절하게 대해주세요. 불편한게 있다면  먼저 이야기 해주세요.
저희는 여성 둘이 방문해 남자직원분들께 마사지 받았는데 전혀 불편하지 않았습니다. 혹시 남자마사지가 불편하거나 예민한 분들은 다른곳을 가세요.

모두 정말 좋은분들입니다. 3일동안 2시간씩 마사지 받으며 정들정도로 좋은기억에 남았습니다.

아 영어로 소통이 어렵습니다. 저희언니가 간단한 태국어가 가능해 어려움이 없었지만 그래도 요즘은 핸드폰 기술이 좋으니 잘 활용해보세요
몸집이 작은 mr.너이 아저씨만 기초적인 영어소통이 가능하였습니다.

태국을 네다섯번 와봤는데요, 다음에 태국을 방문한다면 이곳근처로 숙소를 잡을까 합니다. 태국여행은 마사지만 제대로 받아도
만족스러우니까요

그때까지 모두 건강하세요
reviews.textTranslated:
I received massages three days during my three-night, five-day trip to Thailand.
My accommodation was right in front of Krung Thonburi, a 15-minute walk.
It was much cheaper than other major shopping areas, and the masseuses were visually impaired. Although they're blind, their sense of touch is extremely heightened, so they sensed even the slightest bit of tension and adjusted their pressure accordingly.

I trusted the power of local massage, and I was so, so satisfied. I tipped a little generously, but it was worth it. It's still cheaper than other places.

I hope they'll make a lot of money because they're kind and honest.

"And a request to anyone visiting this place."

Please be kind to the staff. If you have any concerns, please let them know first.
We were two women and received massages from male staff members, and we had no problems at all. If you're uncomfortable with male massages or are sensitive to them, please go elsewhere.

They're all truly wonderful. We had two-hour massages over three days, and it was such a memorable experience that we became close.

Oh, communicating in English is difficult. My sister speaks basic Thai, so it wasn't a problem, but these days, cell phone technology is so good, so try to make good use of it.
Only Mr. Nui, a small man, was able to communicate in basic English.

I've been to Thailand four or five times, and next time I visit, I'll consider staying near here. A trip to Thailand is satisfying even if you just get a good massage.

Until then, stay healthy.

reviews.text: หมอสุภาพ นวดโดนเส้นมาก วันนี้เน้นคอบ่าไหล่ เบาขึ้นเยอะเลย นวดดีกว่าร้านแถวนี้มากๆ ราคาก็ถูกกว่า อยากให้ทุกคนสนับสนุนและให้กำลังใยหมอนวดตาบอดฝีมือดีกันเยอะๆนะคะ

title: Nusara Massage
address: 207 Phangnga Rd, Talat Yai, Mueang Phuket District, Phuket 83000, Thailand
plusCode: V9MV+96 Phuket, Mueang Phuket District, Phuket, Thailand

reviews.name: Victor Arnolds
reviews.text:
Today I had a 2 hour traditional Thai massage at Nusara Massage which was very good.
Pu (pronounced Poo) was my masseuse.

It’s normal that in the first few minutes, one might tune in to each other and ask to adjust the pressure given, maybe a bit softer or stronger. But right from the start it felt just good and although I was still aware, I could fully surrender to the pace of pressure and release, my eyes covered with a little towel, floating on the background music, the muffled sounds from the street and the occasional soft Thai voices from the masseuses.
Not for one moment did she take me out of this zone, not one moment of pain or caution, just enjoying the eb and flow of her movements.
I felt great for the rest of the day.

When I was in my twenties I had fantasies of marrying a stewardess so I could travel for little money. Later that changed to an Opera singer, so I could enjoy her singing every day.
But after the last two hours….
I asked Pu but she did not immediately accept, which I can understand.

If you are new to traditional Thai massage, or already knowledgeable to it, I can highly recommend her. It would be silly to state that her massage is the best in Phuket, I do not have that knowledge, but I can say that in the 10 years of my travels in Thailand, this was honestly the best massage experience I had. A great combination of shop atmosphere and her expertise.
So enjoy it while you are in Phuket.
And if you do marry her, don’t let me know 😡

reviews.name: wandy mulia
reviews.text: Very friendly and professional team. The Thai massage was great and the place is clean. We were given fresh clean outfit to change before the treatment and clean towel to cover the pillow. The team speak English quite well.

reviews.name: ליהי עמית
reviews.text: I usually don't like to write bad reviews, but my experience here was terrible. The Thai massage was unprofessional and painful, very strong pressure in sensitive areas and barely any touch in other areas. I've had over 30 massages in Thailand and I've never encountered strange methods like the ones used here. There was pressure in places that made me leave the place in pain. They turned on the light all the time and at a certain point I felt like she was doing it badly on purpose. reviews.text:
Masseur did a fast-paced massage on me 😂  Guess may be that's because I'm the last appointment before the shop closes?

A few parts can be done better, but overall I think she did a fine job.

One thing that could really improve was the order that she worked on my head & face.

I remembered that she gave me a head massage (including massaging through my hair roots area) first, before using her fingers to massaging the areas between my eye brows & then other parts of my face.  I remembered being alert about that part, because she did not wash her hands in-between massaging my head & my face!

Unfortunately, this did result in new pimples the next morning, at one of the eye brow areas where she massaged.  I never had pimples there for the past 10+ years, so I'm sure they are directly caused by the massage.

reviews.name: Mish Chen
reviews.text:
I recently visited Moonleaf Spa here in Bangkok. While the massage therapist had excellent pressure point technique, the overall experience felt rushed. Her movements were very fast and forceful, which ended up hurting my muscles rather than relaxing them. She repeated the same motions several times, which made it even more uncomfortable. (I’m sharing this as an honest review of my experience.)

She did pause once or twice when she noticed I was in pain, but her overall pace remained fast—as if she was rushing to finish before time ran out.

If you enjoy strong, fast-paced massages, this place might be a good fit for you. But if, like me, you have a low pain tolerance and prefer a slower, more relaxing experience, it might not be the right choice.

On a positive note, Moonleaf Spa offers a wide range of massage packages. You can check out more details and promotions on GoWabi.

I first thought maybe I was calling on a weekend so it's understandable they would be fully booked, but the same thing on weekdays as well. And 8 calls, same response. Really unbelievable. Today when I finally asked the lady at the reception who answers the call always as to when is the appropriate time to call you since I never seem to get an appointment or is it because I have a voucher from GoWabi you are behaving like this, she got a little loud saying I told you we are fully booked so please call tomorrow if you like an appointment and hung up. Really really rude. There are many better options out there than to get such treatment.

Hope you improve the appointment making process and before that teach the lady at the reception some manners.

I'm thinking that this is very strange, so I grab his wrist and place his hand on my leg and said "It's good right there." Then he starts working on my left leg and does the same thing. Just rested his whole palm directly on top of my private parts and was kinda cupping it. Again, I grab his wrist and move his hand to my leg and say "It's good here". I should have cancelled the appointment because I thought the worst was over. He starts talking about how he has a friend in New York who always comes here and loves getting massages from Mong. I'm like "Ok, why are you telling me this?". We get near the end of the hour and I'm sitting up, cross legged, and he's working on my right arm and then he goes in for the nipple rub. I lift my other arm up to block it, thinking that this guy is super creepy. Then he switches sides and goes to the other arm and tries to go in again for the rub. I adjust to block it, the hour is up, I change and then when we're walking downstairs, he asks for my contact information. I told him I'm not interested in giving it to him, but then he pats my pocket where my phone is and says we can exchange information. I said "No, I'm good". I pay for the hour, and then go back the next day to get a website or phone number to contact the owner about this, but Mong is sitting outside. I ask him for any sort of information and he says they don't have that. So, if you want to be inappropriately touched, go to Lucky Massage on Chang Khlan Rd

reviews.textTranslated: We went to the head spa, but unfortunately, for me it was anything but a spa experience… A rather thin woman with long, straight hair, in her late 40s, just pulled my hair the entire time. The water was freezing cold and ran everywhere besides my head. When I said I wanted to stop after 30 minutes because it hurt so much and I only wanted to pay half price, the arguments suddenly started. Other employees were called over, and they all started talking against me as a customer, speaking their own language all around me. In the end, I paid the full price and left really disappointed! I wouldn't recommend it to ANYONE! And if you do go, don't go with the thin woman with long, straight hair; it's pure pain, and they don't react to feedback. Instead, you just get disgusted looks, and they don't address your problem at all.

reviews.name: yuehong
reviews.text: I went for a massage twice, and it felt great! Then I went for a massage at 10pm this time. There were not enough masseurs. I didn't know where to call a masseur for me. The process is called a whole torment. The masseur rushed over from home and didn't change her professional clothes. At first，she didn't realise that I was doing the shoulder and neck project. As soon as she came, she pressed feet fiercely. I reminded her that I needed shoulder and neck. Come and press my back for a long time, because I have done this kind of massage at his house before, and I intuitively feel that something is wrong. I have been pressing my back. So I said press the head, and the head was pressed for me as if I was working. I pressed it very urgently, which was not enjoyable at all. I also reminded me to slow down, slow down, and the effect was not very good. Press the head for a long time. The normal process will relax the acupoint on the face a little, and the acupoint is not right. I have reminded the acupoint, but I still press the wrong place. Finally, it was almost time, and he slipped away immediately. There is a good technician in the massage family. but you must meet right people，if you think it's wrong, just change it.

also it’s very hygienic, they wash your feet before, give you flip flops, a single-use underwear
You can choose your oil between 5 of them (we chose coconut it was smelling amazingly) and they give you a cup of tea at the end

Expérience exceptionnelle à Chiang Mai !

Nous sommes venus deux fois dans cet institut : une première fois pour un massage des pieds, puis une seconde pour un massage à l’huile de tout le corps. À chaque visite, tout a été absolument parfait. Les masseuses sont d’une gentillesse incroyable, très attentionnées et professionnelles. Les massages étaient d’une grande qualité, relaxants et profondément réconfortants. Mention spéciale pour le petit thé servi à la fin, une délicate attention qui prolonge le moment de bien-être. Je recommande très fortement !🤩
reviews.textTranslated:
An exceptional experience in Chiang Mai!

We visited this spa twice: once for a foot massage, and then a second time for a full-body oil massage. Each visit was absolutely perfect. The masseuses are incredibly kind, attentive, and professional. The massages were of high quality, relaxing, and deeply comforting. A special mention goes to the small cup of tea served at the end—a thoughtful touch that extended the feeling of well-being. I highly recommend it! 🤩

I had a travel blog where I wrote about her and her wonderful services back in 2020. she told me a lot of expats found her through my post and that I helped her business a lot. reviews.text:
I have mixed experience with this place.
The first time was good (That’s why I went back)
3 months later I visited again. This time I got a different masseuse (you cannot choose)

While waiting the staff told me “It’s good for you if you soak your feet in hot water for a long time”
In fact, there were not enough masseuses in the shop. I had to wait for the masseuse. What they lied about was just so cringe. The staff also tried to persuade me to get a full package.
Furthermore, Korean customers were talking nonstop and the staff did nothing about it.

I didn’t feel relaxed at all and my shoulder was still in pain like nothing was fixed (I chose neck and shoulders) It felt no different to regular Thai massage when you balance every part of the body.

560 Baht per hour is way too expensive for such a service. Last time it was 300ish which is still more expensive than average places in Chiangmai yet, acceptable. But when I pay more I expect a better service.

reviews.name: Carlos G
reviews.text:
VERY DISAPPOINTING MASSAGE.  NOT RECOMMENDED. GO ELSEWHERE. - In the last week (since the last review) the price increased to 560 Baht, vs. 300 Baht for other 4.9 star massage places in Chiang Mai and Bangkok. Of the places in Chiang Mai for a traditional Thai Massage (I've tried 6) this was the worst so far.

On arrival, the sales person pointed us to the 90 minute oil massage (1190 Baht) when I specifically asked for a traditional Thai massage, no oil.  She pointed us to the "head, neck, and shoulders" massage as the Thai massage.  60 minutes, 560 Baht, nearly twice the price of the other good places. We weren't given the menu to quietly decide - she held the menu, asked what we wanted, then suggested the upsell until we insisted "just traditional Thai massage, no oil please."

Immediately when the massage starts, the therapist puts oil on my feet (when I specifically said I didn't want it) and massages them for 15 to 20 minutes...during a head, neck, and shoulders massage with no oil.

The rest of the massage felt rushed, and jerky, just very quick pinching and pulling like **pinch** **pinch** **pinch** **pull** **pull** **pull** that simultaneously wouldn't let me relax and made me feel even more tense and tight.  Every other Thai massage I've had was steady, deep pressure and contortionist positions that got deep in the muscle.  This felt like being poked the entire time.

To end the massage, a few customers showed up and our therapists started leaning out to converse with the customers.  Mine ended my massage a few minutes early (before my partner when we started at the same time) and immediately went to talk to the other customers.

If this massage experience had been 250 to 300 Baht, I might let it slide.  However, this was a bad experience for 560 Baht - the price of 2 massages at all of the places I liked.

I'm actually feeling more tense now, so I'll pay the extra money to go back to one of the reliable massage spots in Chiang Mai.

If you're looking for a therapeutic thai massage, with deep steady pressure or a relaxing experience at a fair price - don't go here.  Go in the neighborhood on the west side of Nimman One plaza.  There are plenty of good massage spots there that give consistently good massages for 250 to 350 Baht.

I had been looking for a good and firm massage, which for some reason is seemingly difficult to find in Thailand nowadays, and was very happy to have tried out this place.

My masseuse give a serious and firm massage. She managed to locate all my problem spots and patiently kneaded out all the knots. She was also very observant and reduced her strength appropriately at sensitive spots.

Their price point is higher than the usual shops, but given the quality of service, I would say it’s worth the money. Highly recommended!

reviews.text:

My partner's masseuse didn't adjust even after multiple requests (4 times) to cover her legs, or the other leg that is not getting massaged with the blanket as she was feeling really cold. Nor when the hot towel was scorching hot at the beginning. She wasn't feeling so well afterwards and wanted to leave as soon as possible. Quite a disappointing experience, especially at this price.

reviews.name: Maria Eretnova
reviews.text:
Overpriced. Choose any other place in CM and it will be better.  560 baht vs 300 or even 250 baths pretty much everywhere in Chiang Mai in better locations, with much better massage and service.
Heavy sales will wait you, you will be offered the most expensive treatment, and you will have to ask for just regular thai massage.
The while massage was rough and rushed, when it was about to end, new customers walked in, but my curtains were closed and novody cared to close them so I was just exposed to 4 people staring at me while therapist is finishing my massage, it's very unpleasant.
Side note, it's not very important but in all other places that are located on Nimman or city center (and not on parking lot like this one), massage therapists are wearing simple but nice and professional uniforms. Here you will get charged twice the price, will have to get your way through upsales,  but at the end of it, the therapists are wearing just what they wear at home, t shirts and leggins.  I would let it ride, but well, the whole experience was terrible, so I will point that out as well.
I was in pain for 2 days after this "massage" and retreated to my go-to place on Nimman to get myself fixed.

It also looks like their buying reviews, sadly. My partner left a real review with 1 star, but it's not here, so they deleted it. But right after that, a few 5 star reviews from accounts with pretty much no activity appeared. Considering heavy sales, I wouldn't be surprised if they are buying reviews.

reviews.name: Namfon TL
reviews.text:
I’m a local and I love to go for massage 2-3 times a month. It was my first time here and it could be more relaxing experience if I’m being honest.

My partner and I got 1 hour Thai massage in private room because the regular rooms were full. For more than 1/3 of the session, the ladies were gossiping about their colleagues’ approach to customer selection and complaining about how busy they were, mentioning that she had to start another session immediately after finishing mine.

At first, I received a very light massage, so I had to politely request a firmer pressure.

The lady responded by stepping on my back with significant force. Normally, I enjoy firm massages and do not mind being stepped on, provided it is done safely. However, this was not merely firm—it felt aggressive. So I had to interrupt her again and politely said that was too heavy. Another lady who was massaging my partner then said to her ‘then don’t step’. After that it was ok.

When we completed our session, we saw another foreign customer at the front lodging a complaint about the light massage. Because I can understand Thai language, I feel like they could handle it better with the situation. Not professional.

reviews.text:
We had the most wonderful and relaxing massage here. From the moment we arrived, we felt so welcome. The people are incredibly kind and you can truly feel the love and care they have for their guests.
The massage itself was amazing — done with so much attention, patience, and genuine love for people. Every movement felt thoughtful and professional, and it left us completely relaxed and happy.
At the end, they even offered us tea and a banana, which was such a sweet and caring gesture. It made the whole experience feel even more special.
This is not just a massage, this is a place where people work with heart and love. We highly recommend everyone to come here if you want to relax and feel truly cared for. reviews.text: Three of us.    I had the best massage of 7 (so far) across Thailand and Cambodia.   I had the person in charge and she was super skilled at finding then digging into all of my knots.     She pretzeled her legs around min to bend my body while using forearms to apply pressure.   It was so great.   My wife's was justvok.   No complaints, no highlights..   My daughter's started late because there were only two people in the shop when we got there.    The person came in and literally watched a video on what to do, while trying to do it.     She pushed on bones, irregular pressure, total mess and unenjoyable.     So we give this 5 stars, 3 stars and 1 star from the same visit.

reviews.name: Johan
reviews.text:
Had aroma massage with two of the therapists; Pooh and Dan.

Pooh: First time great even if he cut short of 10 min. He is a bit inexperience and still seems to be learning the techniques.
Second time was not good, he worked sick and repeated the same movement over and over again as well as making me freeze even if repeatedly said it was cold. He also finished 15 min early. Second time was really disappointing as good the first time. In the end the front staff was fair about it and reduced to 90 min cost.

With Dan I was unable to communicate and he did not check at any point if I was ok. The pressure was a bit too strong and I was freezing throughout the massage. Tried to explain, but was difficult to communicate. He did not put any ankle support and I tried to adjust myself. He put them back in an uncomfortable position until I stopped the massage and explained the pain from the missing support. Furthermore, he poured very hot oil directly to the skin shocking the skin. Guess the massage would have been better if he checks the receiver during the massage and adjust to make it comfortable.

Don’t doubt the score of others, had one great massage and two bad. I think Dan could be good if we were able to communicate.

reviews.text: An amazing experience with Scuba Project! My wife and I are visiting Southeast Asia for the first time and wanted to fit a scuba day into our Bangkok trip. We knew that it was off-season and that a drive would be required. Luckily for us Scuba Project worked out all the details. They helped us pick the right day according to conditions (they were right, the viz and sea life was amazing), and provided ground transport, boat, and guide. Our guide, Sukunya Sittipornchai, is a very impressive diver with an incredible eye for spotting wildlife large and small. From the smallest of creatures to sea turtles and rays she found it all! Very happy with our experience and will certainly dive with Sea Project again if we are fortunate enough to return to Thailand.

title: My Thai Cooking

Hands-on Authentic Thai Cooking Class

Fun, easy and hands on Thai cooking class and dinning experience for small groups. (Private or shared join in group classes)

Classes are available 7 days a week.

We offer a large selection of Authentic Thai dishes that also including Vegan/Vegetarian options and Thai desserts/sweets.

Our class can optionally be combined with a visit to an authentic Thai fresh food market to lean how to select the best ingredients.

We also offer custom schedules and menus as well as dinner parties and cooking workshops.

Complimentary pickup/drop-off at Bearing BTS Sky Train Station.

reviews.name: Adelaide Calbry-Muzyka
reviews.text: We did a private online cooking class with Mam as a family pandemic event. We had some people in Canada & US (cooking for lunch), some people in Europe (cooking for an early dinner), and Mam in Thailand of course — pretty late for her! We did one main dish (crispy fish with Thai herbs) and one dessert (mango and sticky rice). We loved our dishes; everything was delicious and it was especially interesting, as non-Thai people, to learn new techniques and about new ingredients (& to go exploring Asian grocery stores ahead of time to do the ingredient prep). Mam was patient, fun, and adaptable to different levels of preparation of our group. Be aware that the time duration listed on the website when you book is just a guess — we went significantly over with our two dishes, which was great for us but hopefully also okay for Mam…!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you :-)

reviews.text:
I booked a class for 5 people last week, and the entire process from the initial process to the actual class was fuss-free and replies were very prompt. The host Mam reached out to confirm the meeting details and also checked if there were any specific dishes that we wanted to cook.

For the actual class, Mam was very adaptable to our various needs, and was very patient in teaching us the finer details of the process. The results turned out much better than expected, especially for people who don't cook much. It turned out to be a very homely meal which warmed our hearts, especially so as we were using a residential property for the class (as compared to commercial kitchens in other schools).
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you :-)

reviews.name: John Wiese
reviews.text:
End to end great service and even better food. My partner and I enjoyed a private session. We made three amazing and authentic Thai dishes. I am en experienced chef and I walked away with an all new skillet and some new recipes under my belt.

Mam picked us up at the train station and we got to see a part of Bangkok that most tourists will miss. As soon as we got in the car Mam asked us what we wanted to make. We weren’t stuck with the obvious choice like Pad Thai (though that was an option) and we were able to venture out a bit.

Lots of laughs, we learned so much, and we feasted! 10 out of 10!

We received a booking confirmation from the Website of my thai booking for a Group cooking class, begin at 3 pm. After we were waiting at the BTS Bearing station, there was no one until 15:00 to pick is up, which was the origin start for the cooking class. After calling the given number as well as sending Text messages via WhatsApp before and after 15:00, Unfortunately and incomprehensibly no one responded. We decided to book a taxi to the second specified location on the website besides BTS Bearing, but the adress leads us to a place under a bridge, there were no Restaurant, Shop or any life around (300 meters on tje other roadside there were some shops). We were so lucky, that we did not pay in advance via creditcard, so at least we only had a massive waste in our time and for transport costs. We hadnt received any information or an apology about what has happened today.

Edit: only a few Minutes after publishing this  recension, I received an WhatsApp from My thai cooking, saying they thought today there were no bookings and that they did not see my calls, messages and my booking until now. This is Hard to believe, because right before my booking I wrote with the owner via another providers Website Chat, saying that I will book on my thai bookings own Website (the Chat includes the specific Date). Also I received a booking confirmation from their own official email adress. I do not know if they did not want to give us a private class for the price of a Group class due to no other bookings (and maybe forgot to cancel our class or didnt thought this would be necessary).

reviews.text: The best Muay Thai coach I have ever worked with. I recommend anyone who wants intense focus from a coach to see master thong. Definitely the best Muay Thai gym in Bangkok

reviews.name: A
reviews.text:
Master Thong is the best.
Not only he was the striking coach of Team Alpha Male, but he is humble and the best at what he does.

His name is very well respected across Thailand and has not only trained but fought the best. His style is called Freestyle, as he has out of the box shots blended in with traditional techniques.

There is probably why some of the best fighters of RWS train there.

reviews.name: Steven Mike
reviews.text:
Be careful. His reputation clearly does not match his talent; otherwise, he would not be teaching in such a small and mediocre gym! I trained with him for several months, and based on what I observed he is not skilled at all for muay thai (maybe better for mma as he was the coach of a UFC fighter) plus he does not care about all students. He selectively gives advice to only a few, of his own choosing.

By the way, he is not a Master at all. He awarded himself that title, yet you can ask anyone in Thailand—no one recognizes him, and people laugh when his name is mentioned. Ask yourself why.

For the record, I am a 12th Khan with the Kru Muay Thai Association and i trained with the best coachs/masters in Thailand over the last 18years and near 40 differents muay thai camps so i know what i'm talking about. Just find a better place for learn or train to real muay thai.
This guy is not what he pretends to be.

reviews.text: Honestly after training at few places master thong is the best. He has best style and also best personality doesn't treat u like just a paycheck. You can tell he really loves martial arts and loves sharing his knowledge with who ever is training with him.

reviews.name: Michael Ebbage
reviews.text:
Good, friendly Muay Thai (and MMA) gym. Master Thong is very welcoming. I made the most of my time in Bangkok by popping in for lessons every couple of days.
They cater for everyone from beginner to expert level (having literally trained UFC champions). Fortunately, if you're like me and are not quite at that level... they know how to work you hard within your ability and current state of fitness, so you can develop at your own pace.
It gets busier during the weekends and evenings - on weekdays it's quieter, so ideal if you lack confidence or want some one on one training.
It's not the biggest gym, but there's enough space and equipment to do what you need. Everything is provided (wraps, gloves etc.) So no excuses.
I will definitely come back when I'm next in Thailand - highly recommended.

reviews.textTranslated:
This was my first time using this spa. I booked through an app with a discount coupon, and the price wasn't much different from other places. I booked for a body scrub and oil massage. First impressions: there was no spa manager to provide advice or recommend spa therapists; they lacked experience. The room and massage bed were acceptable, but the towels smelled musty. There was only one bathroom for showering, which was insufficient for the number of customers.
Next, regarding the spa and oil massage service, the staff performing the body scrub and massage did not do a good job.
In summary, it was a very unimpressive spa experience.

reviews.name: Heather
reviews.text:
마사지 받고 목에 상처남

최악의 남자 마사지사가 있는 곳 .....

우선 목에 상처가 난거 마사지사가 손톱을 길러서 긴 손톱으로 피부를 찌르고 눌러서 생긴거임 오늘 가기 전까지 아무렇지도 안았다.

난 이 마사지 샾을 비난 할려는게 아님 하지만 한 개인 마사지사는 비난 받아 마땅하다.

오너가 없었던 만큼  오너에게 곧 바로 있었던 일을 알리고 이런 글을 쓰지 않고 싶었다 .

다행이도 같이 갔던 일행은 아주 아주 좋았다고한다. 아주 인자하신 아주머니가 정성것 마사지를 해주심 !!!
다시 간다면 꼭 그분에게 받고싶다.

그리고 이곳의 시설은 아주 청결하고 잘 정리되어있다.  하지만 직원들은 아니다.
고객이 앉아서 서비스 받아야할 마사지 의자를 자신들이 차지하고 늘어진 자세로 손님을 받고있어서 들어가다가 흠짓하고 돌아갈까  생각도 했다.

시설도 안 좋은 옆가게엔 손님이 넘치는데 왜 이 좋은시설에 손님이 없을까 고민해보자!!!

우선 마사지가 들어 가기전 안내하는 직원이 아무런 질문이 없다 기본적으로 원하는 강도와 특별히 원하는 부분 마사지 스타일을 물어보지  않는 샾은 여기가 처음이었다. ..
충격 기본 중에 기본 아닌가???

그래서 아무런 대화없이 마사지실로 입장 !

오오 마사지실은 깨끗하고 조용하고 아주 좋았다 옷도 좋았다 .

하지만 마사지사는 아무런 질문없이 무성의 하게 마사지 시작 그리고 정말 정말 손의 힘을 빼고 장난치듯이 마사지 시작 지압률 제로 손에힘 0%로 지압한후 몸으로 누르는(힘이들지 않는 마사지)건 아주 세게함
그래도 참은 건 옆에 아주머니는 아주 정성것 열심히 하는것 같아보이고 일행도 만족하고 있어서 참음 근데 이제 둘사이의 커튼을 걷어 부치고는 대화하기 시작 계속해서 대화를 3분이상 지속 하자  아주머니가 무시 하고 마사지만 집중하심 이 남자는 계속 말함
그리고 몇분후에도 또 계속 대화를 시도하자 아주머니 대 놓고 무시 !!!!
자신의 일에 집중 하심

남자 마사지사 이제 포기하고 내 목과 머리를 손톱을 세워서 찌르기시작 아파 죽는줄 알았다. 남자한태 손톱으로 찔려보긴 살아생전 처음 ㅡㅡ

그렇게 지옥 같은 시간이 지나고 마지막까지
이 남자 팁을 바라고 노리고 있길래 ㅎㅎ

열심히 하신 아주머니만 100바트 드릴려다가
남자가 너무 짜증나서 50바트 아주머니만 드리자 남자가 아주머니한태 뭐라뭐라 짜증냄 ㅡㅡ

네  아니에요  너님이 일안하고 놀아서 못받은거고 몸에 상처도 생겼고 몸이 더 아파 ㅡㅡ 그리고 마사지중에 대화하는건 사장님이 가르쳤나요 ????

제발 손톱은 깍자 ㅡㅡ 그리고 대화하지 말자
힘은 제대로 넣어서 정성껏 마사지 해주시고요

ps. 가까워서 다시 걸어서 아줌마한태는 받으러 가고싶은데 남자분 또 걸릴까봐 무서워서 못가겠다는 ㅡㅜ

새로생기고 잘한다는 소문듣고가서 잘 하면 진짜 좋은 찐 리뷰 쓰려고 갔는데 너무 아쉽네요 사장님 디콘도 쪽 고객들 다 잃으신겁니다 ㅡㅜ
reviews.textTranslated:
I got a cut on my neck after a massage.

This place has the worst male masseuse.....

First of all, the cut on my neck was caused by the masseuse's long nails, which he used to poke and press on my skin. I didn't notice anything wrong until I left today.

I'm not criticizing this massage shop, but any individual masseuse deserves to be criticized.

Since the owner wasn't there, I wanted to tell him right away what happened and avoid writing this.

Luckily, the people I went with said they had a great time. The kind lady gave me such a thorough massage!!!
If I go back, I definitely want to get a massage from her.

The facilities here are very clean and well-organized. However, the staff are not.
They were occupying the massage chairs where customers should be sitting and receiving service, slouching in their positions. I even considered leaving after giving a nod.

The poorly-equipped next door shop is overflowing with customers, so let's consider why this nice place has no customers!!!

First of all, the staff member who guided me through the massage didn't ask any questions. This was my first time at a massage parlor that didn't even ask about my preferred intensity or specific massage style. ...

Isn't that the most basic of shocks???

So, I entered the massage room without any conversation!

Wow, the massage room was clean, quiet, and very nice. The clothes were nice, too.

But the masseuse started the massage without any questions, just casually. She really, really relaxed her hands and started the massage playfully. She applied zero pressure, then applied pressure with her body (a gentle massage) with very firm pressure. I held back, though, because the woman next to me seemed to be working very hard and seemed to be satisfied with the massage. But then she pulled back the curtain between them and started talking. After three minutes of conversation, the woman ignored me and focused solely on the massage. The man kept talking. A few minutes later, when I tried to continue talking, the woman blatantly ignored me!!!! Focus on your work.

The male masseuse gave up and started poking my neck and head with his nails. It hurt so much I thought I was going to die. It was the first time in my life I'd ever been poked with a man's nails. ㅡㅡ

After all that hellish time, until the very end,
this man was still waiting for a tip, haha.

I was going to give the hard-working lady 100 baht,
but the man was so annoyed that I gave her only 50 baht. He kept yelling at her, ㅡㅡ

No, it's not. You didn't get paid because you weren't working and playing around. I got a cut and it hurt even more. ㅡㅡ And did the boss teach you how to talk during a massage? ???

Please clip your nails. ㅡㅡ And don't talk.
Please apply proper pressure and give the massage with care.

ps. It's close, so I want to walk back and get a massage from the lady, but I'm afraid I'll get caught by another man, so I can't go. ㅡㅜ

I heard it was newly opened and good, so I went there with the intention of writing a really good review if it was good, but it's such a shame. The owner lost all the customers from Deacon. ㅡㅜ
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: The shop has received customer feedback and is aware of it. Error occurred The shop accepts every fault that the customer has said. The shop accepts every mistake that customers have said. We will use it to improve and warn all employees.

reviews.name: 기기
reviews.text: 구글 리뷰 안보고 촉타위 가려다가 그냥 좋아보여서 들어온 곳인데 안좋은 리뷰들이 제법 보이네요. 마사지사를 타나 본데 저는 오일마사지 남자마사지사분께 받았고 너무 아프지 않고 적당히 시원하고 좋았습니다. 시설도 깔끔하고 좋은데 무엇보다도 조용해서 좋았어요. 처음에는 완전 조용했는데 중간에 다른 마사지사님들끼리 대화하는 소리가 들리긴 했지만 커튼이 쳐저있고 거리가 있어서 크게 거슬리지 않았어요. 촉타위는 세네분이 크게 대화하셔서 좀 힘들었거든요. 그리고 머리망이 있다거나, 누워있으면 수건으로 눈을 가려주시는 등의 섬세함이 맘에 들었습니다. 또 오려고요.
reviews.textTranslated: I was going to Choktawi without looking at Google reviews, but I came here because it looked good, but I see quite a few bad reviews. I tried getting a masseuse, and I got an oil massage from a male masseuse. It wasn't too painful, and it was refreshing and nice. The facilities were clean and nice, but most of all, it was quiet. It was completely quiet at first, but I could hear other masseuses talking, but there was a curtain drawn and there was some distance, so it wasn't too bothersome. Choktawi was a bit difficult because three or four people were talking loudly. I also liked the thoughtful touches like having a hair net and covering your eyes with a towel when you lay down. I plan to come again.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: 우리를 믿어주셔서 감사합니다. 다린 마사지가 당신을 섬깁니다. 다음번에도 다시 케어 받을 수 있는 기회가 있기를 바라겠습니다.

reviews.text:
My boyfriend and I went for an oil massage. It was horrible. The masseuses were talking non stop for an hour and didn’t really focus on the task. Made it very hard to relax, I couldn’t. The massage was unsatisfying and sloppy. I felt like they didn’t really care and I’m not sure if they really did 60mins or less.
The music was so quiet and I couldn’t hear it anyways because of their constant chatter. Overall bad experience, wouldn’t recommend this place
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: I'm sorry for the bad experience caused by employees' communication habits. We warned two new employees about this. This is a sense of relaxation from Thai people, but I will correct this problem. Besides, regarding the time, I'm quite sure that all the time is enough. We have records at the front desk and every room has a clock. thank you

reviews.name: 誠實豆沙包
reviews.text:
一進來還沒按就收費
還是第一次遇見

從來沒有按摩這麼生氣
按摩愛聊天就算了
跟他說大力一點馬上用腳亂踩

整整一個小時都在用摸的
還一直刷手機很糟糕

我來曼谷10天
這家真的跳過很多步驟隨便亂按

另一個稍微好一點
跟他說大力一點～他說他沒力氣！？
滿頭問號

總兒言之按的很爛
一直搓我的頭皮叫他不要搓
按兩下脖子意思意思
繼續搓頭皮

整個按摩很不專業
讓人很生氣

最後還是給20小費
真的覺得連小費都不值得給

雷到你真的會叫他不要按了！
想直接走人

跟店員換兩個50還給我破掉的50
真糟糕

——————————

我們是台灣人不是大陸人
也跟他說了

他們確定是用最大力氣嗎？
請他們大力一點
他說晚上了沒有力氣！！
（你可以問他們有沒有說這一句）
如果沒有力氣就別接客人了

一個好的按摩師傅專不專業
有沒有心客人可以感受的到
請她用力一點
按的心不甘情不願！
那個踩法讓我很不舒服
想說語言不好溝通就算了

我朋友看到他滑手機很多次
也拍到一張！ 手機還在旁邊亮著呢

你覺得這樣的按摩會好到哪裡去？
一點都不尊重客人！

不會再回覆
只會讓我們感受更糟！
reviews.textTranslated:
I was charged before the massage even started!

This is the first time I've ever experienced this.

I've never been so angry about a massage. The masseur chatted, which is one thing, but when I asked him to press harder, he immediately started stomping on me.

He spent a whole hour just touching me, and he was constantly on his phone – it was awful.

I've been in Bangkok for 10 days, and this place has skipped so many steps and just randomly massaged me.

Another massage was slightly better, but when I asked him to press harder, he said he didn't have the strength!?

I was completely baffled.

In short, the massage was terrible. He kept rubbing my scalp, and when I told him to stop, he only massaged my neck a couple of times, then continued rubbing my scalp.

The whole massage was very unprofessional and infuriating.

I still gave him a 20 baht tip, but I honestly felt it wasn't even worth it.

It's so bad you'd tell him to stop!

I wanted to just leave.

I asked the staff for two 50 baht notes, but they gave me a torn 50 baht note. It was awful.

——————————

We're Taiwanese, not mainland Chinese, and we told them that.

Are they sure they were using maximum pressure?

We asked them to press harder, and he said it was too late and he didn't have the strength!! (You can ask them if they said this.) If you don't have the strength, don't take on customers.

A good massage therapist's professionalism and attentiveness are evident to the customer. Asking her to apply more pressure, she was doing it reluctantly!

That footwork technique made me very uncomfortable. I thought I'd just let it go because of the language barrier.

My friend saw him using his phone multiple times and even took a picture! The phone was still lit up nearby.

How can a massage like that be good?

It shows absolutely no respect for the customer!

They won't reply anymore; it will only make our experience worse!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: 你好！很抱歉給您造成了不好的體驗。因為之前有中國台灣省以及其他國家的人在收銀台點了ThaiMassage結果又和員工更換了了精油Massage，後面他們又不認賬和我們說他們只是點了Thai Massage，所以我們不得不在收銀台貼上了paid fist的提醒牌子，以避免錯誤的信息。所以所有客人進來都是paid fist。第二我不知道您所謂的跳過很多步驟是什麼意思？因為我們所以按摩師都是持有泰國職業證書的人。有時候按摩師會根據客人的生理期等情況刪減掉一些動作，但是如果您經歷了很多按摩有那些動作沒有的你又特別想要做是可以和按摩師溝通的。至於您提及的刷手機的問題我會進行核查如果是真實的情況我會把她開除。另外您選擇的是傳統泰式按摩而不是deep Thai Massage，與中式按摩和緬甸按摩不同，因為泰式按摩講究柔和技巧，而不是單純用蠻力按壓。我已經和員工溝通確定力度都用了100%，並且員工說她們知道你們兩個是中國人後特意使了最大的力氣。最後一個問題，我很鬱悶？因為現金是銀行找給我們的現金，它破了一個角但是並不影響使用並且我們也在第一時間和您更換了。（也就是我們更換了，我不知道🤷🏻‍♀️你在生氣什麼？）如果您有任何不滿或者中途需要換人都是可以說的，可是您在離開之前都沒有和我們溝通。因為您有任何問題都沒有和店主溝通，讓我感覺很困惑。謝謝。

reviews.name: 邹诗蕊
reviews.text: 非常非常非常非常非常差劲的体验，按脚完全就是在给我擦身体乳，毫无力道和专业度可言，在泰国呆了一个月，从来没有遇见过按摩如此之差的一家店。按完一个小时也依旧没有任何放松之感，感觉自己就是在浪费时间。
reviews.textTranslated: This was an absolutely terrible experience. The foot massage was nothing more than applying body lotion; there was no pressure or professionalism whatsoever. I spent a month in Thailand and never encountered such a bad massage parlor. Even after an hour, I still didn't feel any relaxation; I felt like I was wasting my time.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
感谢您的反馈，我们对未能达到您的期望深表歉意 🙏

本店主要提供以放松和舒缓疲劳为主的按摩服务，力度可根据每位客人的需求进行调整。在服务过程中，按摩师会定期询问力度是否合适，客人也可以随时提出调整或更换按摩师。

本店所有按摩师均经过专业培训，我们也会持续提升服务质量。
在某些情况下，尤其是在不同语言沟通时，可能会产生一定的理解偏差。对此我们深表理解，并会持续改进相关服务。

如果您方便，欢迎您直接联系店铺，我们很乐意进一步为您提供协助。

title: F45 Training Asok
ownerDescription: Functional HIIT Group Training
address: 48 Sukhumvit 16 (10th Flr Parking Building of Foodland, Khlong Tan, Klongtoey, Bangkok 10110, Thailand
street: 48 Sukhumvit 16 (10th Flr Parking Building of Foodland
plusCode: PHM6+68 Bangkok, Thailand

reviews.name: BangkokBoy2001
reviews.text: The place is hard to find. Go into Foodland. Turn right twice. Take the elevators to the 8th floor. Then walk through the parking lot to the other side and ascend two flights of stairs. I liked it — but not a huge fan of needing to watch a TV screen for guidance.

reviews.name: Ming Hui
reviews.text:
Visited this place for 3 days during a short vacation in Bangkok. Their online booking system makes it really easy. I think there are about 6 classes per weekday for booking. I took the 10am ones, but I starts as early as 7am.

The equipment were pretty new. In fact they look almost new. Good spacious gym with more than sufficient space to do our workout.

The trainers were pretty good too. Helped to correct my movement along the way.

Its about 700 baht per class. Good to buy some package credits if u intend to do more.

reviews.name: Andrea DiCastro
reviews.text:
I was introduced to F45 when I arrived in Bangkok over 2 1/2 years ago and have been going to F45 Asok since then.

Location has change from Exchange Tower to a much bigger space on Soi 16.

I love the variety of workouts and sessions and the coaches are all excellent. It’s been rough having the gyms closed for the last 5 months and so glad to be back.

The space is open with good ventilation. You do not share equipment during class and it is cleaned after each class.

Highly recommend for a good cardio / strength HIIT option style classes!

reviews.name: Chachrist Bond Akkarasawart
reviews.text: Great community! Got 3 free trial passes for a week and despite the pain I thoroughly enjoyed myself. And now they’ve converted me into a regular. It’s a good change for me from my usual weightlifting at the gym. These functional exercises are a different beast. My favorite is Hollywood - a weights and cardio good time. Also I can testify the Asok branch’s got the best people.

reviews.name: Kumar Bikram Regmi
reviews.text: Very nice special place for functional training, coach is excellent, …fluent in English…Located very near to Benchakitti park, sufficient parking

reviews.name: Orasa Horachaikul
reviews.text:
F45 has been more than just a gym for me – it’s a true community.
I’ve been training here for over a year, and it’s one of the best decisions I’ve made for my health and lifestyle. The coaches are knowledgeable, motivating, and genuinely care about your progress. The workouts are always varied, challenging, and fun – you never get bored. But what really sets F45 apart is the sense of camaraderie. You walk in and feel like you belong. If you’re looking for a place where fitness meets friendship and support, F45 is it.

reviews.name: Mace K
reviews.text: The coaches Meysam, Shannon & Kenny are experienced and pay attention to form during sessions. Meysam has given me advice on how to improve and on how to achieve fitness goals. It’s a great gym and the 45min sessions are efficient.

reviews.name: Jo Tap
reviews.text:
Coach Pani is lazy and does not care. Half the class is doing the wrong sequence and she’s on the side chatting with a friend at the table. She just randomly spurts out instructions that are not comprehensive and ambiguous - whether someone gets it or not, seems to be none of her business.  Everyone was
effectively working out by themselves which defeats the purpose of paying so much. Last time I will be coming here

reviews.name: Benjamin Hies
reviews.text: Love this place. Great coaches and great workouts. One of my highlights of each week!

reviews.name: Nathan Agnew
reviews.text:
F45 is a fantastic style of training no matter what your existing level of experience.

For beginners, it introduces a lot of different exercises and movements in a safe way while being guided by  instructors who can correct form/technique.
For experienced gym-goers, it is a great way to continue to push your fitness goals and move outside your comfort zone.
For everyone, it provides a fun atmosphere with a real ’community’ feel.

The Asok branch is huge, was recently renovated with new equipment and has many classes scheduled throughout the day (which is convenient). Sometimes the music is good.

reviews.name: Mia Nguyen
reviews.text:
+Good work out. There are screens to follow steps and many equipment
-dirty toilet. Not suitable if you are looking for a place to work out early morning , take a shower and then  head to work. Very uncomfortable with the bathroom. Only 4 rooms and occupied with loud Thais.
-quite hectic to get there. Have to go up 8th floor , cross the building, go up 10th floor.
-i think they should be involved more with members. Seems they are good athletes but not so good in group class that needs to motivate others and make everyone excited , have fun in the class

reviews.name: Ann Annika
reviews.text: Definitely tiring and worth waking up for. However, it was quite hard to find as you have to walk across the car park for it.

reviews.name: D
reviews.text:
Only place in Bangkok that wouldn't pause or give extension to a membership when I was out of the country visiting a terminally ill family member prior to their death. Ignored my request for consideration twice. Considering they promote their fitness "community" so much, probably a community I don't want to be a part of.

It's an F45, a good space, poor facilities if going to work after. Repetitive exercises, but that's F45.

I won't be back.

reviews.name: katie holroyd
reviews.text: I love this gym! The trainers are all friendly, inclusive, and great at their jobs. Workouts are really fun and I actually look forward to going to classes. The gym also has a great community with regular events, challenges, and get togethers. All the classes are done in English. It’s a great way to meet people’s me get a workout in, I went home after going to F45 for four months and multiple people spontaneously commented on how I looked stronger. Definitely sign up and try the FS8 pilates studio package too!

reviews.name: Pareena Seamthong
reviews.text: Such a great fitness community and amazing coaches! You should definitely come and check it out yourself.

reviews.name: birgitta car
reviews.text:
Been a member at Asok for over 2 years now and it’s honestly the best gym I’ve ever used here in Bkk! The facilities are amazing, easy to get to with the BTS just a 10min walk away and motocy ranks all around.
The trainers are professional and help to modify activities for new comers and when you are dealing with injury, so no need to feel like you are not fit enough to train! Every class is different which means never getting bored - for me very important because it means I always look forward to training. The community is super friendly and encouraging and everyone just wants to have fun and work hard while achieving personal goals! Fun socials are scheduled throughout the year and there’s a fitness Challenge every few months which makes it easy to set goals and reach your fitness potential while maintaining it consistently! I’d recommend to anyone who enjoys a solid sweat and a good laugh while you’re at it!!

reviews.name: Natasha Ferreira
reviews.text:
When I first joined F45 Asok I just wanted to workout in a different environment than condo gym, which for me was always a struggle to keep myself motivated.
It turned out that I found this great place, with great people, fun workouts for all levels and not boring at all.
I discovered that YES, I can enjoy going to the gym.
It changed my life and the way I see workouts now.

reviews.name: Saloni Sethia
reviews.text: F45 was recommended by a friend. If you are visiting bangkok you can drop by for a call for 700 Bhat. Their schedule is on the website and make sure you contact them ahead and get a booking as you might not get a space otherwise. Arrive 10 mins before the class starts. If you are a resident you can get a free trial class. It was my first time doing f45 and it was a good experience. The gym was clean and the trainers super friendly and helpful.

reviews.name: kelsey purdon
reviews.text: I joined F45 Asok about 7 months ago, and it’s been life changing! The atmosphere is always so vibey with loud music, and pumped up coaches. I’ve joined many gyms before this, and this sits at the top of my list!

reviews.name: Adam Reich
reviews.text: Absolutely horrible customer service and complete waste of time. I messaged ahead via Facebook for a free trial. The gym confirmed they offered one class free trial and booked me into a class, no questions asked. When I arrived, they asked how long I was staying in Bangkok and if I had a work visa. In their Facebook messages they hadn’t mentioned this was required (and unclear why this was relevant). Because I didn’t, they insisted it would be 700 bhat to attend the class. If you’re thinking of giving this gym a go, don’t waste your time.

It's not crowded, so you don't have to compete for equipment. The trainers are friendly; even if you don't train with them, you can always ask questions and receive good advice.

reviews.text:
🎖🏆Gym ที่ประทับใจ จากที่เคยเป็นสมาชิกและฝึกเทรนนิ่งกับ PT ที่นี่ราวๆ 2 ปีกว่า ถึงจะเป็น gym ที่ไม่ใหญ่มาก แต่มีอุปกรณ์ออกกะลังกายครบตามมาตรฐาน gym

reviews.textTranslated:
🎖🏆 A gym that impressed me, having been a member and training with a personal trainer here for about 2 years. Although it's not a very large gym, it has all the standard exercise equipment.
Both the workout area and the restrooms are clean.
🤼‍♀️🧸 The environment is warm and inviting, making it a great place to go to the gym every day, like a small family gathering.
🩵💙 I can only say that Gym 02 Rama 3 will always be one of my fondest memories.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
ขอบพระคุณคุณ Boong Pramual เป็นอย่างยิ่งสำหรับรีวิว 5 ดาว และสำหรับการแบ่งปันประสบการณ์ดี ๆ กับ O2 Fitness Rama 3 ค่ะ 💙

พวกเรารู้สึกยินดีและซาบซึ้งมากที่ตลอดระยะเวลากว่า 2 ปีที่ได้เป็นส่วนหนึ่งของเส้นทางการออกกำลังกายของคุณ ความประทับใจที่มีต่อบรรยากาศ ความสะอาด อุปกรณ์ รวมถึงการดูแลจากทีมเทรนเนอร์ ถือเป็นกำลังใจสำคัญสำหรับทีมงานทุกคนค่ะ

สิ่งที่เราภูมิใจที่สุดคือการได้สร้างสังคมการออกกำลังกายที่อบอุ่นและเป็นกันเอง ให้สมาชิกทุกคนรู้สึกเหมือนได้มาออกกำลังกายกับครอบครัวเล็ก ๆ ตามที่คุณได้กล่าวไว้

ขอบคุณที่ให้ O2 Fitness Rama 3 เป็นส่วนหนึ่งในความทรงจำดี ๆ ของคุณนะคะ ขอให้คุณมีสุขภาพแข็งแรงและประสบความสำเร็จในทุกเป้าหมายที่ตั้งใจไว้เสมอค่ะ 💪✨

reviews.name: Supavadee Hongsunirundon
reviews.text: สถานที่รูปแบบไม่แออัด ดูโปร่งสบาย สถานที่สะอาดมาก พนักงานให้การต้อนรับดี เทรนเนอร์เอาใจใส่ฝึกสอนดี ห้องน้ำห้องอาบน้ำมีสบู่แชมพูครบถ้วน ถูกใจค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: The venue wasn't crowded, felt spacious and comfortable. It was very clean, the staff were welcoming, and the trainers were attentive and provided good instruction. The restrooms and showers were fully equipped with soap and shampoo. I was very satisfied.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ขอบคุณมากครับคุณสุภาวดีทีมงานดีใจและยินดีมากครับที่มีโอกาสได้ต้อนรับแล้วแวะมาออกกำลังกายกับพวกเราอีกนะครับ

reviews.name: Sani P
reviews.text:
เครื่องเล่นใหม่เอี่ยม มาตรฐานโรงพยาบาลกายภาพ คนไม่เยอะ ห้องน้ำดีมาก เทรนเนอร์อัธยาศัยดี สอนดี ที่จอดรถเยอะมาก ราคาแพงกว่าฟิตเนสสีแดงหน่อย แต่ได้ความสะดวกสบาย ไม่ต้องต่อแถวเล่นเครื่องแย่งกับใคร เพราะคนไม่เยอะ แนะนำค่ะ

แต่ราคาแพงกว่าที่อื่นนิดหน่อย ต้องรอโปรโมชั่น และเทรนเนอร์มีน้อย
reviews.textTranslated:
The equipment is brand new and meets hospital-level physiotherapy standards. It's not crowded, the restrooms are excellent, the trainers are friendly and provide great instruction, and there's plenty of parking. It's a bit more expensive than the red-branded gym, but you get the convenience of not having to queue for equipment because it's not crowded. Highly recommended.

However, the price is slightly higher than other places, so you'll need to wait for promotions, and there aren't many trainers available.

reviews.name: Sarawut Rachasrimuang
reviews.text:
อุปกรณ์ถือว่าเยอะ ครบครัน สะอาด และ มีโปรแกรมหลากหลาย PA มีอัธยาศัยดี เป็นกันเอง น่ารักทุกคนครับ สนนราคาอาจจะดูแพงสำหรับบางคน แต่เมื่อเทียบกับสุขภาพที่จะได้มาก็ถือว่าคุ้มครับ

วันธรรมดาอาจจะดูแน่น โดยเฉพาะเวลาทองหลังเลิกงานก่อนกลับบ้าน แต่หากบริหารเวลาดีๆ มาตอนเช้าหรือบ่ายๆ ไม่ค่ำมากจะชิวๆๆ มาก

ไวไฟก็แรงดีครับ ที่จอดรถสะดวกสบาย

โดยรวมดีครับ หากใครมีบ้านแถว ๆ พระรามสาม เจริญกรุง แถว ถ. เจริญราษฎร์ ถ. จันท์ ถือว่าเป็น Gym ที่น่าสนใจทีเดียว
reviews.textTranslated:
The gym has a large and complete range of equipment, it's clean, and offers a variety of programs. The gym staff are friendly, welcoming, and lovely. The price might seem high to some, but considering the health benefits, it's worth it.

Weekdays can be crowded, especially during peak hours after work, but if you manage your time well and come in the morning or early afternoon, it's much more relaxed.

The Wi-Fi is strong, and parking is convenient.

Overall, it's a good gym. If you live near Rama III, Charoen Krung, Charoen Rat Road, or Chan Road, this is a very interesting option.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ขอขอบคุณสำหรับการรีวิว ทุกคำชมและคำแนะนำ คือพลังขับเคลื่อนของพวกเราโอทูทีม ให้มีการพัฒนา อย่างไม่หยุดยั้ง ขอบคุณมากๆครับ

reviews.text: Clean and professional!  Super comfortable leather Lazy boy recliners for foot massages.  Cool aircon and pleasant surroundings make this my favorite massage parlour.

reviews.name: Benny Begin
reviews.text: I was disappointed.  Saw the menu at the entrance,  it said hot stone massage 450 baht. I made sure that was the price and came inside. The manager said this was the price for hot stone massage with oil. After i got undressed the masseuse came in and said it was 700 baht and showed me a different menu. Long story short i got a dry massage with a stupid electric heated appliance for 450 baht. Did not enjoy the experience and especially the bad service regarding the price

reviews.name: 김태영
reviews.text: It was so bad. I tried very hard to write the review accurately. Please read carefully. I requested a shoulder and neck massage. But the massage was so weak that it just felt like oil was being applied. I kept asking for a stronger massage. The masseuse had someone else do the massage for her. I asked for a neck and shoulder massage, but the masseuse suddenly started massaging my arms as hard as she could. I pressed extremely hard and it was very painful. I screamed. She continued to massage extremely hard. I kept yelling and even getting irritated with her. Even though I kept screaming, she only verbally apologized and continued to massage me extremely hard. I was patient but I realized that this masseuse was just trying to make me feel bad, so I couldn't hold back my anger. I am a foreigner and I know that I should never be angry with Thai people. Because I knew that is Thai culture, I always smiled no matter how bad I felt. But when I realized that the goal of this masseuse was to make me feel bad, I just couldn't stand it. I left in the middle of my massage and started yelling at the staff. And I threw in 1000 baht and left. This massage parlor is the first place in Thailand that made me scream and protest. I hope you get 1000 baht and make a lot of money.

reviews.name: Jason Padman
reviews.text: Best massage in Udon Thani! The ladies are super friendly and really know how to give a strong, relaxing massage that always leaves me feeling amazing afterwards.

reviews.name: Marc Joris
reviews.text: This is the 6th Thai massage i've had in Thailand and it's the best. Neither too strong nor too soft. I came out very relaxed and really satisfied. 300 baht for 1 hour is really cheap.

reviews.text: The sweetest staff and the best massage. We had so much fun talking with the ladies here. They did a great job and the place was beautiful! We had walked for a long time and desperately needed a foot massage. They took great care of us and gave us yummy ginger tea afterwards. We had a long chat and a good laugh together! Highly recommend going here if you’re in Udon Thani.

reviews.text: My husband and I came here after 4 days if trekking. I had the 90 minute foot massage and he did the oil massage.  Both were really good, but i realized i should have asked for the foot massage that included the shoulders and neck. I came back the next morning for the back, shoulder, and head massage and it was lovely and staff were very friendly and accommodating.

reviews.name: 黃銘輝
reviews.text:
I stayed at a nearby hotel and saw that this massage place had decent reviews, so I decided to give it a try for convenience. However, this turned out to be my worst massage experience in Thailand. I have no idea how it got such good reviews before.

I originally planned to get a 60-minute foot massage, but upon the owner’s recommendation, I added an extra 30 minutes for a shoulder and neck massage. Unfortunately, the therapist had poor skills—the whole session lacked strength and didn’t target any sore points. I lost 90 valuable minutes of my time in Chiang Mai.

reviews.name: Jeremy Ivy
reviews.text:
Most disappointing massage experience of my life here. I went in asking for 1 hour thai massage, and 1 hour oil. 5 minutes into my thai massage the lady swaps out for a male masseuse. He finishes about half the thai massage and asks me about oil. I decline, and say just thai in this case. Turns out he just slowed down ands stretched what should have been done in one hour into two, so they could charge me for two hours massage regardless. Totally uncomfortable situation all around.

Two stars because he did work on stretching me and on my sore muscles, but not as deeply as I've had other older ladies do with just an hour.

I won't be back.

On the evening of February 2nd, the owner said he was off on Sundays, and that a female masseur would have been fine, but I still prefer Loki's strength. I'll continue my massages tomorrow night, and then go for another one before heading to the airport the day after tomorrow. Otherwise, I'll have to wait until the October long weekend to come back.

reviews.name: S W
reviews.text:
I trained at this small Muay Thai gym in Bangkok and had an excellent experience. The gym was very clean and well-maintained, which immediately gave me a good impression. I booked private lessons, and the trainer took the time to understand exactly what I wanted to work on. He pushed me in a positive way, corrected my mistakes, and focused on improving my technique.

I’ve trained in many Muay Thai gyms across Thailand, and this one truly stands out as one of the best. Highly recommended for anyone looking for quality, personalised training in a friendly and professional environment.

Update after my second visit: I’ve now returned for another two weeks of private training, and the experience was just as outstanding as the first time — if not even better. The consistency in quality, attention to detail, and professionalism is impressive.

The trainer continues to refine my technique with patience and precision, while also pushing me to a higher level each session. He really listens to my goals and adjusts the training accordingly, which makes every lesson feel purposeful and challenging in the best way.

Coming back confirmed that this gym wasn’t just a one-time great experience. I’ll definitely return again on my next trip to Bangkok.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: I am very relieved to see that you have learned what you really want at Felix Muaythai,and I wish you and your family good health and look forward to your next study🙏🙏

reviews.name: Dionne Mallens
reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
I booked an outcall aromatherapy oil massage at Top One Massage Sukhumvit, and it couldn’t have been easier to arrange. I was assigned therapist Candy, and she was absolutely fantastic!

As a tall, older woman, with a few sporting injuries, I often struggle to find someone who can give a proper massage - but Candy did not disappoint.

She combined relaxation techniques with focused neck and back work, plus some traditional Thai stretching, and it was hands-down the best massage I’ve had out of dozens over the years.

Extremely professional, knowledgeable, and clearly experienced. I was left feeling both relaxed and restored. I’ll definitely be booking again.

Thank you, Candy and Top One!🙌
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much my dear

reviews.name: Radheshyam Tiwari
reviews.text:
Terrible experience. The female masseuses here have no real massage skills — they simply pour oil and rub your body without technique or professionalism. From the moment they enter the room, their only focus is to push you into paying extra for “special services” rather than providing an actual massage.

I called for a masseuse named Jina. She talked endlessly about herself, claimed she was beautiful, and then demanded an outrageous 5,000–6,000 baht for extra services — far above normal rates in the market. The massage quality itself was the worst I’ve experienced, with zero therapeutic value.

Avoid this place completely. Do not waste your money or time calling any masseuse from here.

reviews.name: Tak Sasaki
reviews.text:
What brought us into the space was the free herbal compact to the massage.

Both my partner and I were curious to try. They had offered different specials with their services once we were inside.

It was a fair deal.

I couldn’t offer a higher rating due to a couple factors.

My masseuse did a satisfactory job, for my partner, they stopped short 7-10mins from her start time. Hers started later due to changing into a different attire. The other factor, the effort put into the masseuse on her end was not satisfactory.

For myself I would never go back due to all the different shops around the city, I would rather try another place.

Overall a neutral rating on my end.

Hopefully for others they will have a better experience.

reviews.text: Had foot massage which was done on a lazy couch chair. Massage can use more strength. Staff were kind to let me stay in because of the heavy rain outside while waiting for the rain to subside.

reviews.text: They made us feel welcome, relaxed and well taken care of. The patrons spoke a little bit of English, enough to communicate and joke with us. Yes, I would go back and recommend this establishment any day.

reviews.name: Haya
reviews.text: They clearly aim to give the impression of wealth to attract foreigners. Despite having two people outside and three inside, they insisted they were full. I called the number to book immediately and asked if I could simply walk in, and they confirmed that I could.

reviews.name: Robert Cole
reviews.text: 2 visits, 2 very different experiences.  First visit everything was quite good.  Reception was polite, and 1 hour oil massage, without a booking, was very good. Got the shop's card as I planned to come again the following week. Tried to call this morning to make a reservation with the same masseuse but the landline number was busy for over an hour.  Maybe that number doesn't work but they still gave me their card?  Anyways, walked in today and asked for my first masseuse but she was not working.  I really wanted a massage and there were 4 girls sitting around in the shop, on their phones.  Not one of them asked to help me, not one of them said "I'm sorry, would you like to book another masseuse?"  "Can I help you with anything?"  I stood there for a few minutes, just meters away from 4 employees who are supposed to help the shop make money.  Nothing.  Possibly the worst, the rudest customer service ever.  Unbelievable. Avoid this place.

ร้านนวดเล็กๆ​ ราคาเริ่มต้น​140บาท​ ถูกสุดในย่านนี้​ ระยะทางจากร้านออกไปอีกไม่เกิน3กิโลเมตร​มีร้านนวด​11ร้าน  ร้านอื่นเริ่มต้นที่​ 180~300   สถานที่เป็นตึกแถวชั้นล่างนวดทั่วไป​ และชั้นสาม​เป็นห้องส่วนตัวสำหรับบริการนวดน้ำมัน
หมอนวดเอาใจใส่บริการดี​ นวดเต็มเวลาไม่มีการดึงเวลาหรือเลิกก่อนครบเวลา​ ถ้ามาใช้บริการควรโทรมาสอบถามก่อน​ หมอนวดมี​สามถึงสี่คน​ อาจไม่ว่าง
reviews.textTranslated:
This is a small massage shop with prices starting at 140 baht, the cheapest in the area. Within 3 kilometers of the shop, there are 11 other massage shops, with prices starting at 180-300 baht. The shop is located in a shophouse; the ground floor offers general massages, and the third floor has private rooms for oil massages.
The masseuses are attentive and provide good service. They give full-time massages without dragging out the time or ending early. It's best to call ahead to inquire about availability, as there are three to four masseuses, and some may not be available.

reviews.name: Natnicha Satitjindawong
reviews.text:
เจ้าหน้าที่ที่นี่ ใส่ใจมาก Therapist ที่ดูแลหน้าจำรายละเอียดหน้าลูกค้าแม่นยำ เหลือเชื่อ  พี่ยังจำไม่ได้เลยว่าหน้ามีสิวเม็ดไหน ตรงไหนขึ้น ลด ^_^  ไปทำหน้าทีไร สัมผัสนิดเดียว น้องเห็นความแตกต่าง เจ้าตัวยังจำไม่ได้ขนาดนั้นเลยค่ะ

น้องที่ดูแลตัวก็ ปสก จริงๆ นวดตัวแป๊บเดียว ทักได้ว่า ช่วงนี้พี่ไปออกกำลังกายมาใช่มั้ยคะ เนื้อไม่แน่น ตัวตึง ตัวอ่อน แนะนำได้หมด สุดยอดมากค่ะ …

ปกติ จะไม่ยอมขับรถไกลๆเพื่อไปนวด แต่ที่นี่ ยอมให้จริงๆ ตามตั้งแต่สาขาทองหล่อ ย้ายมาสุขุมวิท จนตอนนี้ นราเพลส ^_^ ขอบคุณที่ดูแลกันนะคะ
reviews.textTranslated:
The staff here is incredibly attentive. The therapists who do facials have unbelievable memory for each client's face. I can't even remember which pimples I have or where I've had breakouts! ^_^ Every time I go for a facial, with just a slight touch, they see the difference. I don't even remember the exact difference myself!

The therapists who do body massages are also very experienced. After a short body massage, they immediately noticed I'd been exercising because my skin felt loose and relaxed. They gave great advice. Simply amazing!

Normally, I wouldn't drive far for a massage, but I'd make an exception here. I've been a customer since their Thonglor branch, then they moved to Sukhumvit, and now to Naraplace. ^_^ Thank you for taking such good care of me!
