#กายทิพย์อยู่สปา
reviews.textTranslated:
The place is quite luxurious, isn't it? This time I tried the Ta-Ke Relief Massage. It's an aromatherapy massage followed by a warm, golden bamboo tube (or maybe a warm bamboo tube, haha) 🤣🤣 The therapist massaged my body and pressed on various pressure points.

The therapist said it helps reduce muscle tension, balance the body, stimulate blood circulation, and release stress effectively.

That seems true; I felt so light after the massage, like I'd had a hot volcanic stone massage! 👍👍

The snacks were much better than elsewhere, especially when comparing just 5-star hotel spas.

#Myphysicalbodyisattheoffice
#Myspiritisatthespa

reviews.name: Marla Cousins
reviews.text: I would like to give one star but I don’t want to hurt the business because of one terrible therapist. The older woman with the short hair was terrible, and I have never left a bad review for a massage. It was a complete waste of my time and money. I asked for a 60 min massage on my back and arms and she was literally just using her elbow on my back which felt terrible, and she had no technique of what she was actually doing. I said enough on my back and just do my arms and she was just rubbing tiger balm on it and not even massaging it. I asked her to cut the time short and finish at 30 min. Also she never smiled at me once, it felt like she was annoyed or resentful that she “ had “ to massage me or something. Now, I don’t know if that part is true but that is how it felt on my end. The other lady working was very sweet and apologized when I told her that was the worst Massage I ever had and a complete waste of my time. I went across the street and got a phenomenal 30 min massage on my forearms which is what I had requested from this place initially. I really don’t like leaving poor star reviews as I am a business owner myself but this lady was BRUTAL on so many levels.

reviews.text: This place does phenomenal Authentic Thai massages. I have been twice in the few days we stayed nearby, the first was one hour and amazing, two days later went back for a two hour. reviews.text: November 24, 2024. I used the aroma massage service, and while I usually relax and even fall asleep at other places, this time it was different. The masseuse seemed to assume that I wouldn't tip her, which resulted in her showing a negative attitude toward me from the very beginning. Her service was neither good nor attentive, and she even caused me pain. At the end of the session, she directly asked me for a tip. If her service had been good, there would have been no need to ask—I would have tipped her as a matter of courtesy. Despite her poor service, I still tipped her out of politeness. Overall, this was a bad experience in Thailand.

reviews.text: My husband and I had two massages here over a couple days.  The spa is gorgeous and the staff are all friendly.   As for the massages themselves, the Thai massage was great! My husband and I both agree.  Price is around $15 ($500- $800baht) for each massage.  All things considered, this place is great!  Highly recommend the Thai massages.

サバーイ(心地よい)とコップンカー(ありがとう)だけで乗り切りました。

的確なツボ押しや丁寧さは日本の方が優れている(個人的見解です)と思うので、ハーブマッサージを受けてみました。
２階に上がってクーラーのガンガン効いた個室で、アツアツのハーバルボールでマッサージを受けるのですが、お風呂に浸かれないタイではすごく癒されました。
お勧めです。

個室もパーテーションとかでないので着替えや盗難も心配なく、お値段も繁華街や日本より段違いに安くてとても満足な時間でした。
女性1人でもタイ語が話せなくても安心して訪れられるお店だと思います。
reviews.textTranslated:
Once inside, it looked much cleaner and more hygienic than it looked from the outside.
The clothes I was given and the bed had no strange smell or sandy texture.
The menu was in Japanese, but most of the staff spoke neither English nor Japanese.
I got by with just sabai (comfortable) and kopkunka (thank you).

I think that Japanese massages are better in terms of accurate acupressure and attention to detail (this is just my personal opinion), so I decided to try an herbal massage.
I went up to the second floor and received a massage with piping hot herbal balls in a private room with the air conditioning blasting. Since you can't soak in a bath in Thailand, it was very relaxing.
I recommend it.

The private rooms don't have partitions, so I didn't have to worry about changing clothes or theft, and the prices were significantly cheaper than in busy areas or Japan, so I had a very satisfying time.
I think this is a place that even women who don't speak Thai can visit with confidence.

reviews.name: 春菊天
reviews.text:
トンタラリバービューホテルの隣にあり便利。
いくつかのコースを選べる仕組み。
（フットマッサージ、オイルマッサージ、全身、部分）
私は90分全身コースをお願いした。
とても丁寧で上手な施術だった。

翌日もホテルチェックアウト（12:00）前にもう一度90分コースを受けて来た。
（2日とも同じ方が担当してくださった）
スタッフは複数名在籍。

写真は入り口すぐのフットマッサージチェア。
全身コースは足浴（セラピストさんが洗ってくれる）後、階段を上がって各部屋へ。
料金は90分で400バーツ（2024.4.3）
reviews.textTranslated:
Conveniently located next to the Tongtara Riverview Hotel.

There are several treatments to choose from.

(Foot massage, oil massage, full body, partial massage)

I ordered the 90-minute full body treatment.

The treatment was very thorough and skillful.

The next day, I received another 90-minute treatment before checking out of the hotel (12:00 PM).

(The same person treated me both days.)

There are multiple staff members on staff.

The photo shows the foot massage chairs just inside the entrance.

For the full body treatment, after a foot bath (where the therapist will wash your feet), you go up the stairs to your room.

The price is 400 baht for 90 minutes (April 3, 2024)

reviews.name: U CHAN
reviews.text:
2回目です。
1回目が良かったので来ましたが、あたりまえですが人によって違います。
お疲れのようで眠たそうです。
そして、自分の脇が臭うんでしょうか…
あくびしながらマッサージしながら自分の脇の臭いを何度も確認しています。
reviews.textTranslated:
This is my second visit.

I came back because the first time was good, but of course, it varies from person to person.

She seemed tired and sleepy.

And, I wonder if she's worried about the smell of her armpits...
She keeps checking the smell of her armpits while yawning and getting a massage.

reviews.name: เกิดมาใช้ชีวิต Aiw's life
reviews.text: เป็นการนวดที่แย่มาก นวดเหมือนไม่ได้นวด เหมือนแค่เอาน้ำมันมาลูบๆขา ไม่ได้ช่วยให้รู้สึกผ่อนคลายหรือหายจากอาการเมื่อยล้าเลย พนักงานนวดแย่มาก พูดจาไม่ดี บริการไม่ดี พนักงานนวดที่อายุมากแล้วผมสั้นๆสูบบุหรี่ด้วย พูดจาด่าทอลูกค้าและโอ้อวดว่าตัวเองเคยมีแฟนเป็นคนเกาหลี และพนักงานนวดบอกว่า คนเกาหลีให้เงินค่าบริการ3000-10000บาทกับพนักงานนวด ซึ่งดูเหมือนพนักงานนวดทำในสิ่งที่ไม่ดี และพนักงานนวดที่เป็นผู้หญิงอีกคนที่อายุกลางๆคนบอกว่า มีลูกสาว2คนทำงานที่เกาหลี ไม่รู้ว่าทำงานอะไรที่นั่น ฉันไปนวดแล้วฉันต้องมานั่งฟังเรื่องเหล่านี้ที่ไม่ได้อยากรับฟัง และไม่ได้ทำให้ฉันรู้สึกดีขึ้นเลย ฉันอยากบอกเจ้าของร้านว่า ควรปรับปรุงนิสัยและพฤติกรรมของพนักงานนวดทั้งร้านหรือควรเปลี่ยนพนักงานทั้งร้านไปดีกว่า พอตกเย็น กลางคืนก็มีการมาตั้งโต๊ะดื่มเหล้าสุราเบียร์ เปิดเพลงเสียงดังทุกคืนจนถึงเที่ยงคืน สร้างความเดือดร้อนกับคนแถวนั้นมาก
reviews.textTranslated: It was a terrible massage. It felt like they just rubbed oil on my legs; it didn't help me relax or relieve my fatigue at all. The massage therapists were awful. They were rude and provided poor service. One older therapist with short hair smoked and cursed at customers, boasting about having a Korean boyfriend. She also said that Koreans pay her 3,000-10,000 baht for her services, implying she was involved in something unethical. Another middle-aged female therapist said she had two daughters working in Korea, but she didn't know what they did. I had to listen to all this nonsense, and it didn't make me feel any better. I want to tell the owner that they should improve the behavior and attitude of all their massage therapists, or even replace everyone. In the evenings, they set up tables and drink alcohol, playing loud music until midnight every night, causing a big disturbance to the neighbors.

reviews.name: すえふじともや
reviews.text:
フットマッサージを受けて、旅の疲れがスッキリとれました。
丁寧に対応してもらい、力加減がちょうど良く最後は肩のマッサージも気持ちよかったです。
また利用したいです。
reviews.textTranslated:
The foot massage really helped me to relieve the fatigue of my trip. 
The service was thorough, the pressure was just right, and the shoulder massage at the end was also very pleasant. 
I'd like to use this service again.

reviews.name: ら
reviews.text:
最初に足を洗って2階に上がりました
施術者が女性だけなので、女性1人で行っても安心なのでは？強く押してと頼めば強く押してくれました。観光名所や高級マッサージも行ったけど
ここが1番良かった
reviews.textTranslated: First, I washed my feet and went up to the second floor. Since the therapists are all women, I feel safe going alone. They pressed hard when I asked. I've been to tourist spots and high-end massage parlors, but this was the best.

reviews.name: 윤미영
reviews.text:
1시간에 250바트
완전 로컬 마사지샵이예요.
주인 여자분이 친절하고 영어를 조금 할줄 아세요. 가성비 좋고 시원하게 잘 해주십니다.
아시아티크에서 걸어서 10분정도 걸리고 복잡한 아시아티크 앞에서 택시 잡기 힘들때 잠시 걸어와서 마사지 한시간 받고 가기 좋을듯 해요.
reviews.textTranslated:
250 baht for an hour

It is a completely local massage shop.

The female owner is friendly and speaks a little English. It is great value for money, and she gives a really refreshing massage.

It takes about a 10-minute walk from Asiatique, so if you are having trouble catching a taxi in front of the crowded Asiatique, it would be a good idea to take a short walk here for an hour-long massage before heading back.

title: RarinJinda Spa
ownerDescription: Rarinjinda's first branch in Bangkok with metropolitan spa concept. Gratified in Bangkok's private paradise that offers the perfect blend of tranquility and metropolitan lifestyle, yet conveniently accessible from Bangkok's downtown.
address: 8th Floor, Grande Centre Point Hotel, 153/2 Soi Mahatlek Luang 1, Lumphini, Pathumwan, Bangkok 10300, Thailand
street: 8th Floor, Grande Centre Point Hotel, 153/2 Soi Mahatlek Luang 1
plusCode: PGRR+Q9 Bangkok, Thailand

reviews.name: Tongsen Yang
reviews.text: Best hospitality and services I ever have. I bought vitality of life which included body exfoliation/body mask, aroma oil therapy massage, herbal hot compress, and facial relaxation. It was so soothing, comfortable that I fell asleep and woke up feeling so relaxed. I would say it was so relax that I turned into  a jello..😂

reviews.name: SR design
reviews.text:
The best experience with the best therapist “Ratchanee” foot massage 1000 pat
- First they wash the feet gently
- And the foot massage
- back massage
- relax room with a cup of tea and mango slices

Recommended with the same therapist

reviews.name: Sunil
reviews.text: I would rate this as one of the Best Day Spa facilities in Bangkok with an exceptional value for money. Outstandingly clean and beautiful and elegant interiors, super choices of different types of treatments and therapeutic massages. Awesome welcome drink and mist tasty mango sticky rice after the treatment. The masseurs are highly trained and give you an amazing relaxing experience. Advance booking us a must to avoid disappointment. Very courteous. You will become a repeat customer.

reviews.name: Camille Dewaratanawanich
reviews.text: My husband and I walked in and were immediately taken care of. We are guests at the hotel, so we also got a discount. We did the 2 hour full body massage, and it was incredible. At one point, I actually fell asleep! They didn't make me feel embarrassed and, in fact, made me feel very comfortable and welcomed. The mango sticky rice at the end was a nice surprise! My husband and I will absolutely be back!

reviews.name: cow cow
reviews.text:
A very elegant high-end spa in Bangkok. Excellent service. I had tried a few other spas during this trip and this one is the best. The place is very hygienic, relaxing and comfortable.
The Masseuse was skilful and professional. Also like their exclusive resting area after massage, very chill! Recommended this spa!

reviews.name: Sally
reviews.text:
Had a 120min traditional Thai massage there. The overall massage itself was ok but I’m not happy about the attitude.

The staffs who served us gave us no greetings when getting into the room. I was having problems with tying the pants they provided, and asked for help. The staff literally just grabbed my shoulder and turned me around to tie from the back in a very rude way. I was too shocked and embarrassed, but remained polite and said thank you, without receiving any response, not even a smile.

The first 5min of massage was too light and it was basically like touching, and they never tried to ask how we feel. Then I decided to change a way of communicating and said in a cold tone: you’re making it too gentle. Do it harder. And that’s when things finally get right and the first time I heard *Mam* in the place.

The 120min message ends 5min earlier than it’s supposed to be.

I would not recommend this place if the service is not improved, and Let’s Relax at Grande centre point prestige in 2min walk might be a better option.

reviews.name: Jaktat J.
reviews.text: Good and quiet atmosphere, well trained staffs. They provide a very good massage with set of fruits and mango sticky rice at the end of service.

reviews.name: Becca Marsh
reviews.text: This spa is the perfect place to visit for a relaxing and sophisticated atmosphere. Their treatments are high end with professional staff and a welcoming spa area.

reviews.name: Ward T
reviews.text: Absolutely terrible service. Highly not recommended, I understand why people don’t like it. Guests at the hotel told us to avoid and we should have listened.

reviews.name: Kendrick Khoe
reviews.text: The whole experience was excellent. 2000thb for 2 hours massage. Final bill was $68 usd with all things added.

reviews.name: Pattanan Sritaweesap
reviews.text: Everything was so impressive. Relaxing atmosphere, well-trained staff and yummy after-therapy snack!

reviews.name: SIEW LIAN LIM
reviews.text: Their aromatherapists are professional. Hotel guest gets 20% discount. I am suprised that they serve us dessert after the massage.

reviews.name: TaranjotSGulati
reviews.text:
Pathetic. Disappointing. And a sham.
Please do not go to this spa at all. An absolute waste of money. They are just making a fool out of the customers. There are way better other spa’s who give great service and great body oil massage than this place and are half the price.

I paid a heavy price for a 1.5hr (90mins) oil massage, and very smartly the lady finished and wrapped up everything in 60mins and then 15mins of cleaning with hot towel and said .. its done. I checked the clock when i changed and it was just 80mins were over. And then when i got out, they asked how was it for 90mins. Seriously. Made a fool of me. Massage excluding changing and any other things should be full 90mins. Not 60mins ++. Their calculation of 90mins is when therapist went inside the room and when came out.

Even the massage was so bad that the lady gave me more back pain than what i had before. All she did was to do oil on my shoulders and hands and back and thats it. Pathetic. The quality of massage was literally sad and pathetic.

Never ever go to this place. I wasted an hour in traffic to reach them and after that was made a fool and they charged a high price. My humble request to all that dont go to this Spa. There are other much better spa’s then them.

My preference use Dream House at Sukhumvit Road. Hands down the best.

reviews.name: 邵幼雲（Yu-Yun Shao）
reviews.text: This is a high-end spa place. The atmosphere is quiet and relaxing (I really don't like the massage or spa place that you can hear other customers' sounds.). I tried the Royal Touch package, which included foot wash and polisher, facial relaxation, foot reflexology, herbal hot compress, and most importantly a four-hand aromatherapy warm oil massage. I highly recommended this! Although it is surely a bit pricey, the four-hand massage saved so much time. I enjoyed all the above within 2 hours! The snacks after the spa is luxurious, including assorted fruits and mango and sticky rice. Surely a place I will visit again next time I am in Bangkok.

reviews.name: Alyssa Ricabo
reviews.text: Clean, well-maintained facilities! Good Thai massage with free mango sticky rice for guests after. The receptionist and staff are all very pleasant and welcoming!

reviews.name: Taj Y
reviews.text:
Went for a foot massage late into the night. Staff is very polite and professional. One of the best massage places I've visited so far. They varied the pressure based on gender, I received a much stronger massage as compared to my partner who's female and I really appreciate that.

They finish the foot massage with a good back and shoulder rub. Will consider going for a full body massage before I leave.

reviews.name: Kim
reviews.text:
Relaxed massage 💆‍♀️ 💆‍♂️
Combination of foot + back 👍
Serve with dessert 🥭

reviews.name: Phaneesh Prahlad
reviews.text:
Spa service was really good. Staff is very humble and provide good service. Yes compared to other sites cost is on higher side but service is up to the mark.
Mango sticky rice post spa service was very good to refuel. Post spa if sona service was available it would be good as cost is also on the higher side without all such services spa feels just normal.

reviews.name: MA Z
reviews.text: Staff are very rude and un respectful, not professional, everyone is not talking politely and they don’t want to do service to us 👎🏻👎🏻👎🏻

reviews.name: Melissa Lee
reviews.text:
Very badly maintained and run. We were assigned to a room with a stagnant pond of water and smelled like a blocked drain. We told the staff and requested to move next door but still smells bad.
Paid 6000 thb for a couples’ massage as well, so expected top notch spa but it was far from it.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for choosing RarinJinda Wellness Spa and for taking the time to leave us a review. We're sorry to hear that you had an unsatisfactory experience with our spa. We will coordinate with the branch manager to provide this feedback for us to improve the services that we provide to customers. Please accept our apology.

title: 24 Massage by.Fera @สุขุมวิท 22,24
ownerDescription: ร้านนวดเพื่อความผ่อนคลาย
address: 605/14 Soi 22,24 Sukhumvit khlong Tan Nuea khlong Toey Khlong Toei, คลองตัน Bangkok 10110, Thailand
street: 605/14 Soi 22,24 Sukhumvit khlong Tan Nuea khlong Toey
plusCode: PHC7+JW Bangkok, Thailand

reviews.name: Abd Arabi
reviews.text:
I choosed this place because it is clean.
Unfortunately the one Uhr massage was only 50 minutes.
The masseuse was thinking about anything else than doing correct massage.
The price was higher compared to others in the same area.

reviews.name: Ting Ting Lim
reviews.text: worst massage here ever. we came at 1am, masseurs were woken up from their sleep, begrudgingly prepared us for the body massage. paid for 60mins but massage ended in 45mins.

reviews.name: Meuni D
reviews.text: The place was clean and relaxing. Today I had a 1 hour aroma oil massage which was great! I am 8 months pregnant and the massage therapist was able to tailor the massage accordingly and ensured I was comfortable throughout. Highly recommend.

reviews.name: Klauss Goularte
reviews.text: This new massage parlor is quite different than most massage shops on Soi 22. It is clean, and the massage rooms are not cramped. It also seems safe, and not a firetrap. The masseuse did a fantastic aroma oil massage and she earned her tip. It is not cheap, but it is worth the money for the massage in a good new facility.

reviews.name: The Angry Stringinstrument
reviews.text: The parlor is clean and very private. Nice atmosphere with a classy massage parlor feels. The staffs are very helpful. The massage itself is phenomenal.

reviews.name: Laila Lampe
reviews.text: The massage was lovely but unfortunately it was only 45 minutes instead of 1 hour. Comparably pricy.

reviews.name: Stefan Shilgalis
reviews.text: Had a great oil massage with Linda (aka Lin). She is very fun to talk with and her massage is amazing. Highly recommend.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you

reviews.name: Lucas Z
reviews.text: 45min instead of 60min, and they tried to argue that it was an hour

reviews.name: NL.
reviews.text: สถานที่สะอาด ใหม่ นวดไทย 60 นาที = 400 บาท/ 90 นาที = 550 พนักงานนวดดูนวดยังไม่ค่อยถนัด แต่งตัวไม่เหมือนกัน ใส่กางเกงขาสั้นนวด
reviews.textTranslated: The place is clean and new. Thai massage: 60 minutes = 400 baht / 90 minutes = 550 baht. The massage therapists seemed inexperienced and their attire varied; some wore shorts while massaging.

reviews.name: Marlon Verstappen
reviews.text: Slechte massage die ik ooit gehad heb. Masseur zit gewoon op haar telefoon tijdens de massage en kan er niks van. Ga hier niet naar toe.
reviews.textTranslated: The worst massage I have ever had. The masseur was just on her phone during the massage and was useless. Don't go here.

reviews.name: Aulai Aulai
reviews.text: ร้านสวยมาก  กว้าง  หรูหรา  ดีกว่าหลายร้านแถวไหล่กัน  สะอาด เป็นส่วนตัว  เงียบสงบ  มีลิฟด้วย  ประทับใจ
reviews.textTranslated: The restaurant is beautiful, spacious, luxurious, and much better than many other restaurants nearby. It's clean, private, quiet, and even has an elevator. I was very impressed.

reviews.name: A Yim
reviews.text: นวดออยดีมาก  ร้านสะอาดจริงๆ  กว้างขวาง  มีห้องส่วนตัว  บิการดี  น้องๆมารยาทดี
reviews.textTranslated: The oil massage was excellent. The shop was really clean, spacious, and had private rooms. The service was good, and the staff were very polite.

reviews.name: apisit somboon
reviews.text: ได้รับบริการที่ยอดเยี่ยม การนวดออยอโรมาทำได้ดีเยี่ยม สามารถบอกจุดที่ต้องการให้ผ่อนคลายทำได้เป็นอย่างดี พนักงานนวดมีความเป็นมืออาชีพ ไม่รบกวนการพักผ่อนครั้งนี้เลย ห้องมีความสะอาด สงบเหมาะกับการผ่อนคลายมาก
reviews.textTranslated: I received excellent service. The aromatherapy oil massage was superb. The masseuse was able to clearly point out the areas I wanted to relax and did a great job. The massage therapist was very professional and didn't disturb my rest at all. The room was clean and quiet, perfect for relaxation.

reviews.name: sohot
reviews.text: ร้านอยุ่่ในซอยสุขุมวิท 22,24 เข้าซอยไหนก็ได้ ชอบมานวดร้านนี้เพราะนวดดี นวดถึงกดจุดดีมากๆๆๆ พนง.ก็ต้อนรับดี บริการดีค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: The shop is located in Sukhumvit Soi 22 or 24; you can enter from either soi. I like coming to this massage shop because the massage is excellent; they really hit the right pressure points. The staff are also welcoming and provide great service.

reviews.name: 24Massage
reviews.text: มีการเปลี่ยนแปลงมาแบบใหม่. มีอัไรดีๆน่าค้นหาที่นี้
reviews.textTranslated: There have been some changes. There are many interesting things to discover here.

reviews.name: Hajar Alrasheed
reviews.text: سويت مساج اقدام مكان نظيف وخدمه رائعه والموظفين محترمين الموظفه محترفه بالمساج
reviews.textTranslated: I had a foot massage; the place was clean, the service was excellent, and the staff were respectful. The masseuse was a professional.

reviews.name: 허수희
reviews.text:
덥다니까 밖이 더워서 더운거라고

사장이 안계셔서 그런지 관리사들이
뭘 주섬주섬 들고와서 들락날락 거리면서

태국말로 1시간동안 수다 떨면서

한쪽발은 10분만에 끝내더니
나머지 발만 계속 문질렀어요 ㅡㅡ

타임 10분 안채우고 끝내길래 아무말 안하고 나왔네요

다른데는 300바트인데 590바트나 받고

뭐가 다를줄알았는데 구멍가게 로드샵보다 못해요
별 하나도 아깝
reviews.textTranslated:
I said it was hot, but they said it was hot because it was hot outside.

Maybe because the owner wasn't there, the therapists kept rummaging through their bags, going in and out,

and chatting away in Thai for an hour.

They finished one foot in 10 minutes,

but just kept rubbing the other foot. ㅡㅡ

Since they finished before the full 10 minutes were up, I left without saying a word.

Other places charge 300 baht, but they charged 590 baht.

I expected it to be different, but it's worse than a small corner shop on the street.

Even one star is too much.

reviews.name: siriparn kanyok
reviews.text: นวดสบายมากๆค่ะ วันนี้มานวดออฟฟิศซินโดรม 2 ชั่วโมง ที่ตึงๆ ปวดๆ ตรงคอ บ่า หลัง รู้สึกคลายทั้งตัวเลยค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated: The massage was incredibly relaxing. Today I had a 2-hour office syndrome massage, and all the tension and pain in my neck, shoulders, and back felt so much better. My whole body feels relaxed now.

reviews.name: Kanthida Nur
reviews.text: พนักงานต้อนรับข้างหน้าน่ารักดีค่ะ มานวดครั้งแรกชอบเลย หมอนวดดูเชี่ยวชาญในการนวดอย่างดี
reviews.textTranslated: The receptionist at the front desk was lovely. This was my first time getting a massage and I loved it. The masseuse seemed very skilled and experienced.

reviews.name: Frequent Traveller

reviews.name: Michael Ziebarth
reviews.text: Ich hatte den Charissa Thai Massage ausgesucht, weil es Kabinen gibt. Ich möchte bei einer Massage entspannen und nicht durch hin und herlaufen oder andere Störungen dabei unterbrochen werden. Meine erste Massage war bei Mimi, nach dieser Massage bin ich jeden Tag zur Massage in den Laden gegangen. Ich hatte jedes Mal eine Öl Massage. Ich habe jedes Mal Mimi ausgesucht, die Massagen waren so entspannend und einfühlsam, dass ich mich danach immer sehr locker und entspannt gefühlt habe. Ich war schon häufiger in Thailand und hatte überall Massagen. Die Massagen von Mimi waren bisher die besten in meinem Leben. Sobald ich in Bangkok bin werde ich Charissa Thai Massage wieder aufsuchen und auf alle Fälle wieder Mimi verlangen.
reviews.textTranslated: I chose Charissa Thai Massage because they have private rooms. I want to relax during a massage and not be interrupted by people walking around or other disturbances. My first massage was with Mimi, and after that, I went to the shop every day. I always had an oil massage. I always chose Mimi; the massages were so relaxing and gentle that I always felt very loose and relaxed afterward. I've been to Thailand many times and had massages everywhere. Mimi's massages were by far the best I've ever had. As soon as I'm in Bangkok, I'll go back to Charissa Thai Massage and definitely ask for Mimi again.

reviews.name: Kacper Garcarz
reviews.text: Wspaniały masaż tajski. Najlepszy na jakimkolwiek byłem. Dobra cena 300 bath. Jeśli będę jeszcze w Bangoku na pewno wrócę
reviews.textTranslated: Great Thai massage. Best I've ever had. Good price at 300 THB. If I'm ever in Bangkok again, I'll definitely be back.

reviews.name: Won Cho
reviews.text: 태국에서 받은 마사지샾의 앱쁜 마사지사님. 태국 마사지는 흡사 추나나 물리치료 같은 형태 입니다. 다른 동남아는 피부를 마사지 하지만 태국 전통 마사지는 근과 골격을 푸는 방식입니다. 저는 태국은 2번 째 방문이고 20년전 첫 해외 여행이 태국 였습니다. 태국 마사지를 받은 이후 다른 국가에서는 항상 만족감이 없었는데 방콕에 와서 인생 최고의 마사지를 받네요. 가격은 한화기준 15000원 정도 입니다. 가게 이름이 태국어라 알려드릴 수는 없고 간판 보세요. 라마다 플라자 호텔 앞에 있습니다. 다음에도 아내랑 같이 찾을게요. 앱쁜님 잘 지내시길.
reviews.textTranslated: I received a massage from a masseuse in Thailand, and I was impressed by the massage therapist. Thai massage is similar to tuina or physical therapy. While other Southeast Asian massages focus on the skin, traditional Thai massage focuses on muscle and bone relaxation. This is my second visit to Thailand, my first trip abroad being 20 years ago. Since receiving a Thai massage, I've never been satisfied with other countries, but in Bangkok, I received the best massage of my life. The price is about 15,000 won. The name of the shop is in Thai, so I can't tell you, but look at the sign. It's in front of the Ramada Plaza Hotel. I'll be back with my wife next time. Take care, App.

reviews.textTranslated:
Left - Mimi, Right - Lucky. Both are highly experienced, so they are skilled at massage and very kind. I was delighted to meet excellent massage therapists at a place I stumbled into by chance after making eye contact with the manager.

I paid 500 baht for a 30-minute foot massage and a 1-hour Thai massage, and I am 200% willing to revisit.

It is a small but clean, friendly, and professional shop.

If you are nearby, come here!

Since the shop is small and there are only a few massage therapists, I recommend making a reservation in advance.

쌩돈 내면서 깨달은 몇가지를 알려줌.

2. 4박5일짜리 단기 여행으로 오는 한국인들 후기좀 경계하자. 비유하자면 한국 명동 길에서 떡볶이 한접시 만원에 먹고 최고라고 후기적는 미국사람 생각남. 맛이 없다는게 아니라 한국인은 만원주고 떡볶이 안먹다. 관광객용 가게.
3. 뭔가 슬로우비디오처럼 느리게 마사지 하면서 손으로는 살짝 피부만 간지럽힌다. 이러면 쎄게해달라 요구할 필요도 없음. 그냥 망한거니까 시간을 버릴지 돈을 버릴지 생각하고 일어나야함.

여기를 찾느라 다른데 다니며 돈버린 생각하니 시간과 노력이 너무 아깝..

동남아에서 받은 100개 이상 마사지중 시원함이 최고인지는 모르나 가격대비로 하면 최고다.
reviews.textTranslated:
This is a review I'm writing for myself to look back on later.

Here are a few things I learned while paying my own money.

1. If the reviews are only from Thai people, you should be suspicious. It could be a prestigious local establishment, but it could also be a business promotion by their acquaintances.

2. Be wary of reviews from Koreans on short 4-night, 5-day trips. To use an analogy, it reminds me of an American who eats a plate of tteokbokki for 10,000 won on Myeongdong Street in Korea and writes a review saying it's the best. It's not that it tastes bad, but Koreans wouldn't pay 10,000 won for tteokbokki. It's a shop catering to tourists.

3. The massage is done in slow motion, and their hands only lightly tickle your skin. If this happens, there is no need to ask them to massage harder. It's just a failure, so you have to decide whether to waste your time or your money before leaving.

Thinking about the time and effort I wasted going to other places just to find this place makes me feel so regretful...

I don't know if it's the most refreshing of the over 100 massages I've received in Southeast Asia, but considering the price, it is the best.

reviews.name: Jovana Jovanovic
reviews.text:
A Huge Disappointment and an Extremely Unprofessional Experience – Avoid This Place!

Unfortunately, this was by far the worst experience we had during our stay in Thailand, where people are generally incredibly kind and welcoming. From the very first moment, we felt as though we were an inconvenience.

Here’s a detailed account of our experience:

Communication and Arrival: Booking through WhatsApp took an unusually long time, and we often had to wait hours for a reply. We arrived exactly 10 minutes before our appointment (6:50 PM for a 7:00 PM booking), but the staff member looked visibly surprised and confused that we had arrived and simply asked us to wait.

Waiting Time and Atmosphere: We waited inside the salon for over 30 mins where customers are required to remove their shoes, while the floor was covered with other customers’ hair from previous blow-dries. No one apologized for the delay or explained why our treatment was starting late. The atmosphere throughout our visit was extremely uncomfortable, and the staff appeared visibly irritated and angry—likely due to poor organization or one of their employees being late. Unfortunately, that frustration was taken out on us, despite the fact that we arrived on time.

Lack of Professionalism and Empathy: As this was our first head spa experience, we had no idea that we were expected to change clothes or that the treatment also included a shoulder and neck massage. Instead of politely explaining the procedure, we were met with a sarcastic attitude, as if to say, “Don’t you know you’re supposed to change?”. All of this while we’re looking at the shampoo basins that are filled with someone else’s hair.

Comfort and Hygiene: Throughout the entire treatment, the air conditioning was blowing directly onto me while my hair was being washed and while my shoulders and neck were being massaged. Since my hair and upper body were wet the entire time, I was freezing and had to wrap my hands in a towel just to stay warm. However, the atmosphere in the salon was so tense and unwelcoming that we didn’t even feel comfortable asking them to turn down the air conditioning.

Hidden Charges: In the begining of the treatment, I was offered a conditioner for my hair, only to be told that it would cost an additional 200 THB. This extra charge was never mentioned beforehand and was not included in the advertised treatment price. After already waiting for over 30 minutes and enduring such an unpleasant experience, this felt completely unreasonable, so we declined.

Hair Treatment and Rough Handling: During the blow-dry, my friend, who has long hair, was treated so roughly that the stylist repeatedly pulled and tugged at her hair. They kept making faces and laughing while dealing with her hair, making her feel self-conscious about the length of her hair. At some point it became so painful that she had to say, “Please stop,” deciding she’d rather leave with her hair half-wet then enduring more pain and unpleasant situations. Unfortunately, soon after came another predicament.

Payment and the Most Unpleasant Part: The total bill came to approximately 1,380 THB. Nowhere in the salon was there any notice that card payments were not accepted. Since my friend didn’t have enough cash with her (she had 1,070 THB), she offered to leave that money there, walk to her hotel hotel to withdraw the remaining approximately 310 THB from an ATM, and return immediately to pay the balance. The staff’s reaction was shocking since they treated her as though she were a thief and insisted that one of them accompany her to the hotel and ATM to supervise the entire process. This crossed every line of basic courtesy and professionalism.

The salon itself may look decent at first glance, but because of the freezing air conditioning (which genuinely made us worry about getting an ear or chest infection) and, more importantly, the extremely rude, arrogant, and hostile treatment we received, we cannot recommend this place to anyone.

We traveled throughout Thailand and nowhere else did we feel this unwelcome.

reviews.name: Nora Vale
reviews.text:
I’ve been coming to this salon regularly for over two years, and I always return — which says everything.

The owner runs two salons next to each other:
•	one for manicure, pedicure, and hair services
•	the other for SPA treatments and massages

The team is very professional, friendly, and consistent.
Manicure with gel polish costs around 500 THB, which is excellent value for the quality.

They can do manicure and pedicure at the same time (four hands), which saves a lot of time.
The work is always neat and careful — they never cut or damage my skin, and the gel lasts very well.

The owner is welcoming, bookings are easy online, and the overall experience is relaxed and trustworthy.

Highly recommended if you’re looking for a reliable, affordable, and professional nail & spa salon in Bangkok.

reviews.name: Jayne Irvin
reviews.text: First time in Bangkok, (while looking for different salon and getting lost) I came upon Angel Salon & Spa.  I was in urgent need of a gel mani pedi before Christmas.  The mani pedi was great, thorough and meticulous. On Impulse i asked the stylist if she could fix the disastrous color that a hair stylist had given me 2 days prior.  (That colorist was recommended by a local friend of a friend). Maya very gently advised that there was no way to correct the damage and wrong color that was applied without ruining my hair.  She suggested a Paul Mitchell keratin conditioning instead.  She was absolutely right. My hair is still an awful color but It is looking and feeling better already!

reviews.textTranslated: Terrible. My body ached even more after the massage. An hour was excruciating. The masseuse hadn't washed her hands; they were sticky with other customers' sweat. I've never had such a terrible massage in Thailand. Definitely avoid this place! The place and the slippers were also extremely dirty. Don't come here!

reviews.name: Suzanne Olsen
reviews.text:
Enten er de så gode at jeg ikke ved det eller også er det den dårligste massage jeg har fået i chiang mai. Hvis man får en tok sen massage er den meget anderledes end andre steder. Jeg elsker tok sen men har først opdaget det for nyligt. Så jeg aner ikke nok til at gennemskue hvorfor den her massage var så anderledes end de andre massager jeg har modtaget.

Han holdte ikke pinden tæt nok på min krop og i vævet men nogle gange så løst at den ikke berørte min hud når han slog så det blev meget uden på huden og det yderste væv frem for dybe vibrationer. Jeg spurgte om det kunne gøres hårdere det kunne det ikke for det var farligt. (Har andre så sat mig i fare?)

Alt i alt selve tok sen massagen er jeg ikke kvalificeret at bedømme jeg er dog mest til de andre jeg har fået. Men jeg aner ikke hvem der er teknisk mest korrekt.

Stedet var meget autentisk. Alene af den grund er stedet et besøg værd.
reviews.textTranslated:
Either they are so good that I don't know or it is the worst massage I have had in Chiang Mai. If you get a tok sen massage it is very different from other places. I love tok sen but have only recently discovered it. So I have no idea why this massage was so different from the other massages I have received.

He did not hold the stick close enough to my body and in the tissue but sometimes so loose that it did not touch my skin when he hit so it was very much on the skin and the outermost tissue rather than deep vibrations. I asked if it could be made harder it could not because it was dangerous. (Have others put me in danger?)

Overall I am not qualified to judge the tok sen massage itself, I am more into the others I have had. But I have no idea who is technically most correct.

The place was very authentic. For that reason alone the place is worth a visit.

If you can tolerate her elbows pressing down, I highly recommend it. I followed up with a Thai massage, which was also very relaxing.

title: New Chiang Mai Massage
ownerDescription: Authentic Thai massage in the heart of Chiang Mai's Night Bazaar. Walk in after exploring the market and let our experienced therapists melt your tension away. We offer Traditional Thai Massage, Oil Massage, Deep Tissue, Foot Reflexology, Neck & Shoulders, and unique 4-Hands massage with two therapists working in sync. Try our popular combo packages — the Healing Package (Thai + Oil + Foot, 2 hours) or the Luxury Package featuring Thai Herbal Hot Compress. Clean, air-conditioned rooms. Affordable prices starting from 300 THB (9 USD). No appointment needed - just walk in!

title: Relaxense Aroma Thai Massage
ownerDescription:
Relaxense Aroma Thai Massage offers authentic Thai massage in a friendly, local atmosphere, just a 3-minute walk from Nana Station. Our therapists are highly trained and certified, with continuous learning and developing to ensure providing the best possible wellness services. We are always striving to improve the experience for our customers.

Whether you seek traditional Thai massage, aroma therapy, or targeted relief, our services are designed to leave you truly rejuvenated. You can select or change therapists within the first 15 minutes for your comfort. With local pricing and a focus on real wellness, Relaxense Aroma Thai Massage offers genuine, down-to-earth relaxation at great value.
address: 4/1 Sukhumvit Rd, Khwaeng Khlong Toei, Khet Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, Thailand
plusCode: PHQ4+VC Bangkok, Thailand

reviews.name: Follow Fauzia
reviews.text:
My grab bike dropped me off at a wrong location and because I was in a bit of a time constraint I went into this massage place I mean it seemed OK and sometimes you could be surprised where there’s a good masseuse but this was Terrible!

😞 I asked her to do a deep tissue she said cannot and I said why not because she said oil massages are not deep tissue I don’t think she fully understood me!

I don’t know if it was plastic on top of the bed where you lie down and then she massages and typically massages are done in a massage table but this was done on the mat!

Knew what she was doing she was basically just rubbing you as if for you to know that she may know how to massage I will never come back here!

I don’t mind paying a tip there is a reason, And I could Not find a reason!

This place to go for massage are all for the wrong reasons

The original place that I picked but the grab bike did not drop me off at is the one I will go next time it’s in the same street here!

In my opinion I would not recommend Anybody to go here!

Follow fauzia for 👍🏼🦋🦋more massage places in around Bangkok and beyond and of course you can follow us here as well as our YouTube channel, Facebook and of course Instagram 🦋🦋🦋
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Fauzia,

Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We sincerely apologize for the experience you had at our massage shop and understand how frustrating it must have been, especially when things didn’t meet your expectations.

We always strive to provide the highest level of service, and we’re sorry that the deep tissue massage you requested wasn’t delivered as you had hoped. We actually offer a specific deep tissue massage option on our menu that may be better suited to your preferences, and we would be happy to recommend it for your next visit.

Additionally, we want to make sure every guest feels comfortable, which is we are offering the option to change therapists within the first 15 minutes if the current therapist isn’t the right fit. We will take your comments into account to ensure better communication and understanding in the future.

Regarding your comment about the massage mat, we use traditional Thai-style mats for certain types of massages, which are a common practice. However, we appreciate your feedback, and we’ll continue improving to meet a broader range of customer expectations.

We truly hope you’ll consider giving us another try in the future, as we’re committed to ensuring a better experience for all our guests. Please feel free to contact us directly if there’s anything else we can do to assist you.

Thank you again for your feedback, and we wish you all the best on your next massage experience.

Warm regards,
Relaxense Aroma Thai Massage Team

reviews.text: I come here very often for the past few months but they always ask me to pay before message. Even tho a white old guy before me just paid after the massage. So I will stop coming here because I feel disrespectful that they ask me a loyal client to pay before massage.

reviews.text: Very skilled and pleasant masseuses here, serenely peaceful environment. I have gotten excellent massages from a number of the ladies here. Ms. Yok gave me my most recent massage, very healing and pleasant. I highly recommend this place

reviews.text:
From the moment I walked in, it was clear that no one wanted to be there or welcome customers.
The oil massage was a complete disaster — no technique, no care, and absolutely no professionalism.
There wasn’t even basic hygiene, as no proper hand washing was done before touching my face.
The service was unacceptable, and my masseuse’s attitude was cold and unpleasant.
Overall, a very disappointing and frustrating experience. I would not recommend this place.

Highly recommended for consistent, exceptional service. Book now and revive your energy! #ThaiMassage #Aromatherapy #RelaxationGoals #ReaxenseWellness #TopLocalChoice

reviews.name: Martin Geifman
reviews.text: Went in on a rainy evening and ordered a foot massage.  The massage was nice, but nothing more than that.  What was distressing was the atmosphere in the room.  There were about 7-8 comfy chairs and other people were talking, including one annoying child.  From my experience, massage stores discourage any talk above a whisper.  But here, the staff seemed to be happy with all the chatter.  Thus, overall it was not really a relaxing experience.

reviews.text: Got a foot scrub by laa. Staff was friendly. Peaceful and quiet environment. I get very ticklish when i get foot treatment, but the staff here made me feel very comfortable.

reviews.text: The massage on its own was alright. However, I would not come back as the atmosphere was far from relaxing. The lady has been laughing, giggling and couldn't stop talking to another masseuse for almost all the time. Moreover the massage was 50 mins instead of 60.

reviews.text: Been here 2 times. Amu is very good and has been very consistent. Massage strength and service definitely worths more than what you pay for. I’ll come back again if I pass by Nana.

reviews.name: Moiz Khan
reviews.text: Nice Thai massage at this place. They were very accommodating even though we showed up somewhat late at 10.45 PM (closing time is 12AM) and asked for a 1 hour Thai massage. Very relaxing and soothing experience.

reviews.name: Tiffany Chen
reviews.text: Worst massage I’ve had in Thailand. I got a body scrub and massage and the masseuse just rubbed oil on me extremely fast. No thoughtful pressure or relaxation. I asked her to focus on my neck and shoulders and she did not. This was the first time I ended a massage early because it was so bad.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Tiffany Chen,

Thank you for sharing your feedback with us, and we deeply apologize for the experience you had. It’s very disappointing to hear that the service didn’t meet your expectations, especially in terms of the body scrub and massage. We understand how important thoughtful pressure and relaxation are, and we’re truly sorry that your specific request to focus on your neck and shoulders wasn’t addressed.

We strive to offer high-quality, personalized service, and it’s clear we fell short in this instance. We will be reviewing this with our team to ensure this doesn’t happen again. If you’re open to giving us another chance, we would love the opportunity to make things right and provide a much better experience.

Thank you again for your feedback, and we hope to welcome you back in the future.

Warm regards,
Relaxense Aroma Thai Massage Team

title: Akasha Wellness Bangkok
subTitle: อาคาชา เวลเนส
ownerDescription: Akasha Wellness Bangkok offers a diverse range of classes and services designed to help you achieve balance. Classes include yoga, meditation, Pilates, sound healing, and mindfulness practices intended to soothe the mind, body, and soul.
address: 550, 1 Charoen Nakhon Rd, Bang Lamphu Lang, Khlong San, Bangkok 10600, Thailand
plusCode: PG95+94 Bangkok, Thailand

reviews.name: Coconut
reviews.text: Adrienne is a very friendly, energetic, and attentive instructor. She observed the student level and adjusted the class accordingly. She would go around and adjust the posture to make sure we’re in the correct form. The place is a real hidden gem, with clean facilities. Highly recommended!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for this lovely review, we really appreciate it.
We’re so glad you enjoyed the class and felt supported by the instructor throughout. It means a lot to know the guidance and attention to detail came through in your experience.
And thank you for your kind words about the space, it truly means a lot to us.
We hope to see you again soon.

reviews.name: TMT
reviews.text:
A true sanctuary and urban oasis in the city! Highly professional yet warm teachers; all have well-done sessions. The place is beautiful and relaxing and has a cute cafe attached to it. The place is also impeccably clean! The owner is very welcoming and made me feel comfortable and at home. The instructors have incredible rapport with the students, structured sessions, all very patient and would explain movements properly and what to expect in the sessions. Love that the teachers all have very calm, friendly demeanours who are all about the students having a wonderful time and effective sessions vs being intimidating. All lovely folks!

Special shout out to Adrienne and her fun effective classes on Radiance Fit (pure energy on the bounce balls!) and Mat Pilates that had me working out muscle groups I didn’t know existed. Her infectious energy is what makes the class worth going to over and over again!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much! Can’t wait to have you back in our space 🤍

reviews.name: Netta Ilany
reviews.text:
It was my first time attending a sound bath, and I can honestly say it felt life-altering. The instructor was amazing — I felt like she guided both my body and soul through a truly meaningful journey.

The space itself is like a hidden haven in the middle of Bangkok — serene, beautiful, and calming. From the moment I arrived, I was warmly greeted and shown to the locker area, which includes clean, well-maintained showers and bathrooms.

The sound bath session was powerful, and it was followed by a tarot reading that added another layer of reflection and depth to the experience. I appreciated how thoughtfully everything was arranged.

They also offer yoga, pilates, and mobility classes, and the pricing is very reasonable. Every member of the staff was so kind and accommodating.

Absolutely 10/10 — I’d recommend this place to anyone looking for something healing, grounding, and a little magical.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for sharing such kind words. We’re delighted your first sound bath felt transformative and that you enjoyed the space. We look forward to welcoming you back for more grounding and healing experiences.

reviews.name: Pha P.
reviews.text: The studio has such a great vibe—peaceful, clean, and very private. They offer a variety of classes to choose from. Parking is available, though limited; I’d recommend parking at Sena Fest nearby.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for your visit! We look forward to welcoming you again. 
With love, 
Team Akasha

reviews.name: Micòl Cont
reviews.text: Wonderful atmosphere, peaceful oasis near the river. As a guest of the Hotel Ibis Riverside I attended 3 wonderful classes and enjoyed every single step of this escape (clean, good welcome tee, flowers, scent). absolutely perfect experience
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We appreciate the kind words and are thrilled that you enjoyed your visit! Welcome back anytime 🤍

reviews.name: Maddy Yeack
reviews.text:
This is truly a luxury fitness & wellness experience, it’s right off a main road but right when you walk through the gate you’ll be transported to another world. The service here is amazing, the women that work here are so sweet and attentive. It feels like you’re at a spa when you’re just going for a workout!

This studio is definitely at a higher price point but the value for money ratio is really good. The classes are small so you get hands on time with your instructor - something that is quite rare these days.

Two of my classes ended up being private 1:1s with the instructor and the other was just two people in the class. There are only four reformer machines so it’s guaranteed your instructor will pay attention to you.

Reformer was great, I have a bit of a hard time adjusting to new machines and I was pretty tired both classes but the instructor was really friendly and adjusted the class to my abilities.

I also did a yoga class, when I booked it said it would be taught in Thai but it was my last day and I thought I could just follow along by sight. The teacher was so kind and we went from yoga to a bit of a fusion Pilates burn then she did like a full on massage for the shavasana. It was great.

Finally, the aesthetics of this place are STUNNING. No notes just fabulous and I feel like they’ll just keep getting better and better.

I was a bit worried about the price but if you can swing it I promise you won’t be disappointed. I can’t wait to return and try out the sound healing, meditation and more yoga and reformer!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi Maddy, 
Thank you very much for the lovely review and for sharing your time with us! 
We're delighted to hear that you enjoyed your experience, and of course,  you are welcome back anytime.  
Much love and light, 
Team Akasha Wellness Bangkok

reviews.text: Had the best time at Hatha Yoga! The instructor was extremely kind and professional and always gave options for both beginners and intermediate students. Highly recommend - I will be back 😊
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: So happy you enjoyed your time with us—We look forward to having you again!

reviews.text: I did the Yin Yoga class with Ms. Pina and it was truly amazing. The deep stretching and breathing exercises were relaxing yet challenging, suitable for all levels. The interior and design is absolutely stunning and peaceful. I high recommend this wellness studio to everyone!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your lovely feedback! We're so glad that you had an amazing experience in Ms. Pina's Yin Yoga class and that you found the session both relaxing and challenging. It's also great to hear that you enjoyed the peaceful atmosphere of our studio. We look forward to welcoming you back soon!

reviews.text: coming into Akasha wellness, my friends and I were amazed at the peaceful atmosphere and the details that were put into this studio. reviews.name: T.W.A. Mueller
reviews.text:
Due the law in Thailand (section 326 of the Penal Code) only this as review:
Booked online on 28.3.2024 one hour Gong Sound Healing Session for two person at 3.4.2024.
Payed online in full at same day and got confirmation.

At 3.4.2024  we drove through the rush hour in Bangkok and arrived about 15 minutes before appointment.

Door closed, no reaction about ringing at the door and the provided (confirmation email) phone number was not reachable.
Tried to contact the business owner via different social media channels.
After half an hour: we are sorry, had technical problems and forgot to inform you.

Refund in full received after that chat via Line.

Ultimately no financial loss but a lot of hassle and wasted time.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Thomas,
We hope this message finds you well. We would like to extend our deepest apologies for the recent circumstances you experienced. Your time is invaluable to us, and we sincerely regret any inconvenience or frustration caused. Our team has been briefed on the situation, and we understand the experience you've encountered. While we refrain from directly referencing the specific comments and expletives in your call, we acknowledge the significance of your feedback and the emotions expressed during our previous communication. We remain committed to ensuring your satisfaction with our service. Our offer on LINE message still stands!

Thank you for your understanding and patience. We would love regain your trust and demonstrate the high standards we strive to uphold here.
Love and light, Team Akasha.

reviews.text: Me and my husband booked in for a reformer Pilates class and a sound bath session on our stay in Bangkok. This studio is so beautiful, it has definitely been the highlight of my trip. I loved the kindness of the staff and appreciated the carefully curated aesthetics - it really felt like a retreat. I felt relaxed and rejuvenated at the end of the day. Would love to attend more sessions when we are back next - Thank you!!

Lovely to hear that you enjoyed the experience~ 
Thanks so much for coming by and look forward to having you in our space again. Happy travels!

I recommend getting the class pass and trying out the different classes.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your kind words!  We’re delighted you enjoyed the intimate class experience and felt supported by our team. Our goal is to create a space where every session feels special, no matter the class size. ✨🌿

title: SVG Thai Massage School
ownerDescription:
We are a small Thai massage school of highly trained and highly accomplished massage therapists. All of our teachers have real experience in the professional world of massage therapy, several at the highest level of spa service. After extensive careers abroad, our lead teachers returned to their native Thailand and, while still maintaining their healing work on clients, started to devote their passion for massage into teaching others. SVG Thai massage school Chiangmai as a private Thai massage study class.
Here we have the freedom to cap class sizes to a maximum of 6 students, ensuring quality instruction and promoting the intimate, tight-knit, family experience that is fundamental to the learning environment that we work hard to create

reviews.name: Jessica Witherow
reviews.text:
I have studied here 2 times.  First in 2018 for 2 weeks, taking Thai massage 1&2.  The second time was in 2022 for a much longer stay.  I was in need of recovery from a debilitating autoimmune disease and I knew I would find my healing here as well as updating my training to help give me the confidence to get back to work with my clients.  I traveled solo and spent weeks simply healing and meditating.  Once I was feeling healthy and stronger, I took every single massage class the SVG has to offer with the amazing Master Aire and sat in meditation with Master Parawat Poungpiam 3 times a day.  The two of them make an excellent and well rounded team because their skills and massage styles vary from each other, offering an authentic and very advanced perspective to their students.
The SVG isn’t just a training center, it’s a family.  And this Global SVG Family nurtured me Soul, Mind, Body and career.  I returned home healthier, calmer and ready to work with clients again.  I’ll be forever grateful and look forward to my next trip back.

reviews.name: zaldy miranda
reviews.text: Without bias, but just with the level of skills, competencies, and professionalism of the instructors, I would highly recommend SVG.  I have just completed two courses under the wings of Master Aire: deep tissue Thai massage (for 5 days) and feet reflexology for 2 days (Sat and Sun).  Master Aire is a top-notch.  She's well-spoken, understandable, keen to details, and her level of expertise is 10/10, her teaching method is strict but loving.  Her techniques and way of explaining what seems to be complicated made it easier for me to understand, absorb and apply everything she taught me.  I got lucky to have been the only student in those classes at that time, so I had a private one-on-one with the master.  Right after the class, I was already able to apply everything I learned to my friends.  I made sure to note down everything, even the littlest and slightest techniques, cos they're all essential knowledge for me.  Master PP reignited my interest in meditation.  Without fail, everyday during the course, our day will start with prayers and meditation.  He would even add on healing for me and the other students.  His prayers and intentions for his students is genuine and apparent.  They are both welcoming, warm and always with best interests for their students.  The class, all throughout, felt more like a personalised experience, a knowledge transfer than a money-making school.  It is, without a doubt, that these things be considered when choosing a school.  I'm sure to come back for my Thai Massage classes!

reviews.name: roni2908
reviews.text:
Today I completed five days of a basic Thai massage course (Level 1) at SVG School in Chiang Mai, and I wholeheartedly recommend it!

The school is an absolute gem. Classes are small and intimate—we were just two students in the group, and there’s also an option for one-on-one lessons. This is a huge advantage compared to other schools with large classes. Despite the same price, the personalized attention here makes the learning experience far superior. For me, the cost was incredibly reasonable considering the quality.

The instructor was amazing—not only highly skilled but also a true teacher for life. He shared deep knowledge, taught meditation techniques, and spoke about the philosophy of life behind Thai massage. This experience was much more than technical training; it was something meaningful I’ll carry with me.

If you're considering learning Thai massage in Chiang Mai, I highly recommend SVG!

reviews.name: HDFM IKB
reviews.text:
2024年4月滞在記録

タイ古式マッサージ初めての学びだった僕の経験としては、良くも悪くもアットホームな家庭的な学校だと感じました。

主人であるPP先生も奥さんであるエー先生もとても親切ですし丁寧です。とても熱心に教えてくれますが、それとは反対に家族である犬の世話とスマートフォンの中毒性があることは否めません。

日本人が日本のクオリティーで学びを求めてしまうと少し無理があります。テキストも分かりづらく細かく説明を書かなければならないので授業についていくのに必死でした。

少しお金はかかってしまうかもしれませんが、個人的にはITMやCTMに行き日本人の居る所で学ぶのが無難かと思います。

タイ人訛りの英語でも全く問題なくスムーズにコミュニケーションが取れて、タイ古式の基礎が分かっている方はここに通うのに適していると思います。

カラダの使い方を基礎から教えてもらえるので、基礎が分かっている方でも更なる基礎を学ぶ事が可能です。

ongスクールなどのbasicとprofessionalがここでのLevel1&2なので、まずは基礎をという方はongの安価で活気のあるところで触りを習ってから、その後にここで深めるというのも手かと思います。

あくまで個人の意見・通ってみた感想なので、参考までに書き留めておきます。
reviews.textTranslated:
April 2024 Stay Record

This was my first experience learning Thai traditional massage, and for better or worse, I found it to be a very homey and friendly school.

Both the master teacher, PP, and his wife, Ae, are very kind and attentive. They teach with great enthusiasm, but I can't deny that they're addicted to caring for their family dog ​​and their smartphones.

It's a bit of a stretch for Japanese people to expect a Japanese-quality education. The textbooks were difficult to understand, and detailed explanations had to be written, so I struggled to keep up with the lessons.

It may cost a little more, but personally, I think it's safer to go to ITM or CTM and study in a place with Japanese people.

I was able to communicate smoothly with my Thai-accented English, and I think this is a good place for people who already have a basic understanding of Thai traditional massage.

They teach you how to use your body from the very basics, so even those who already know the basics can learn even more.

Basic and Professional courses at ong schools and the like are Level 1 & 2 here, so if you want to start with the basics, it might be a good idea to get a feel for it at an affordable and lively place like ong, and then deepen your understanding here.

These are just my personal opinions and impressions from having attended the school, so I'm writing them down for reference.

Although my job is completely unrelated to massage, I came to learn massage during my time off! The instructors are very kind, and sometimes strict, in their teaching. 😊💓 We go to delicious and inexpensive restaurants for lunch every day.🍴
Chiang Mai has a very laid-back atmosphere, so I recommend visiting not only for sightseeing, but also to improve your skills and broaden your horizons. 🙂✨


My job isn't related to Thai massage, though. I decided to learn Thai massage at SVG.
They taught me very kindly (sometimes strictly lol). We go to restaurants together which are very delicious and cheap.
I recommend going to Chiang Mai not only for sightseeing, but also to learn Thai massage, meditation, and real Thai culture at SVG. ❤️

reviews.name: Rihoko Kakizaki
reviews.text: 少人数でしっかりと、体をどう動かすか基礎から教えてもらえます。教え方は厳しいこともありますが、その分しっかり身につきます。とてもアットホームな雰囲気で、練習期間中は先生やクラスメイトたちと家族のように過ごしました。朝は瞑想のクラスもありますよ。
reviews.textTranslated: In small classes, you can learn how to move your body from the basics. The teaching methods can be strict, but you will learn a lot. The atmosphere is very homey, and during the training period, I felt like family with the teachers and classmates. There are also meditation classes in the mornings.

reviews.text:
想給3.5🌟

第一次來時：
我朋友很滿意他的男按摩師，很用心會觀察哪裡需要被按。
我的按摩師是按的還行普普通通。

要離開清邁前再來按一次！！
我朋友是一位年紀稍大的阿嬤，可以感覺她很努力有用心，但還是第一次男按摩師力道比較足夠。
我自己的按摩師則是滿會偷懶的，會邊滑手機邊按（力道明顯變超小），或直接滑手機不按（大約3-4次7-10秒）

後來發現之前的按摩師大概是5：30才來上班，可惜第二次來早了沒遇到第一次的按摩師。

不過這價格還是很便宜拉，一小時200泰銖。
reviews.textTranslated:
I'd give it 3.5 stars 🌟

First time: My friend was very satisfied with her male masseur; he was attentive and observed where the massage needed to be done.

My masseur was just okay, nothing special.

I came back for one more massage before leaving Chiang Mai!!

My friend is an older woman, and you could tell she was very hardworking and attentive, but the first male masseur's massage was still much stronger.

My own masseur was quite lazy; he would use his phone while massaging (the pressure noticeably decreased), or he would simply use his phone and not massage at all (about 3-4 times for 7-10 seconds).

Later I found out that the previous masseur only started work around 5:30 pm, but unfortunately, I came too early the second time and didn't get to see him.

However, the price was still very cheap, 200 baht per hour.

reviews.name: Mariko
reviews.text:
I’m so relaxed.

I'm so relaxed.

reviews.name: Nadege DESPREZ
reviews.text:
Je ne peux juger le salon mais la masseuse que j'ai eu ne devait pas souvent faire de oil body massage ! Elle m'a badigeonné d'huile et caressait. Je n'appelle pas cela un massage. J'ai dû lui demander plus fort mais pas de changement. Sans experience, j'aurai été capable de faire la même chose.
Accueil un peu froid... la fin... débrouillez vous. La musique d'ambiance : le tic tac de l'horloge. Pas une bouteille d'eau ou un the offert. Je n'y remettrai pas les pieds.
reviews.textTranslated: I can't judge the salon itself, but the masseuse I had clearly didn't do oil body massages very often! She just slathered me in oil and stroked me. I wouldn't call that a massage. I had to ask her to apply more pressure, but it made no difference. Without any experience, I could have done the same thing. The welcome was a bit cold... and at the end... you're on your own. The background music was just the ticking of a clock. Not a single bottle of water or tea was offered. I won't be going back.

reviews.name: Alex F
reviews.text: Gute Massage für wenig Geld. Für eine Stunde Thai Massage muss man 200 Baht + Trinkgeld zahlen. Ich wurde von einer älteren Dame massiert. Die Massage war wirklich gut.
reviews.textTranslated: Good massage for little money. An hour of Thai massage costs 200 baht plus tip. I was massaged by an older lady. The massage was really good.

reviews.text: 按摩師傅按的非常好，並不會因為價格便宜就行事潦草。值得逛街時有在附近可以過來一按，贊。
reviews.textTranslated: The massage therapist was excellent; they didn't skimp on the service just because the price was cheap. Definitely worth stopping by if you're shopping nearby. Thumbs up!

reviews.text: 부모님께서좋아하심 타이마사지+호랑이연고(밤) 코스를좋아하심. 마사지해주시는분들 노련하세요^^여행,쇼핑하다 지치면 잠시들려 받으시길.일부러 찾아갈 필요는 없고, 나이트바자왔다가 가성비(?)타이마사지 짱^^
reviews.textTranslated: My parents love the Thai massage + tiger balm (night) course. The masseuses are experienced. ^^ If you get tired of traveling or shopping, stop by for a quick massage. You don't have to go out of your way to visit, but if you come to the night bazaar, the value (?) Thai massage is the best. ^^

title: Jaroen Nund Thai Massage
subTitle: พรทิพย์ นวดแผนไทย

reviews.name: Ruby
reviews.text:
Friendly people but the massage was not great. I asked for Aroma massage but just got a normal oil massage. The room was very cold, no music so you couldn’t really relax with the loud noises from the street. Massage was very soft, more stroking, so I asked for stronger, it got a bit better than. It was a weird massage where she did some parts very long and some parts barely. Also she did different things on different sides. She giggled a lot during the massage (when my bones cracked or something) or talked to me. She was friendly but that’s just not very relaxing obviously.

Only good thing was that she washed her hand before she massaged my face/head so it wouldn’t get oily.

reviews.name: Sonny Sacks
reviews.text: If you like a strong massage, ask for Patty. It’s 350 baht for a full hour. I’m that hour she spent most of it on my back and my legs, which is perfect. Most places spend too much time on the chest and arms. She’s amazing. I underestimated her strength. And after she stretches you out. By the time she was done, I felt like jello and couldn’t move for 5 minutes. Then she gave me tea. My new go-to spot for a massage for sure. I tipped her 100 baht.

reviews.name: Rekha Müller
reviews.text:
We wanted to get a Massage at Thai Thai Thai Massage Salon but they were closed and the message below (photo) was attached to the salons door. So we went to the Jaroen Nuad Thai Massage Salon and booked 1 hour Thai oil massage (450 Baht) each of us, my husband and me. The Staff told us that these two Salons are the same, so that's why we decided to get a massage there.
As I'm myself a massage therapist, I must say this was the most painful and worst massage I ever got. The masseuse had no plan what she was doing. It was some rubbing on my back with too little oil/cream, so it felt uncomfortable. On the backside of my leg she didn't use any oil/cream and only one leg was treated as if she forgot her own sequence of the massage.
On the frontside she was just putting so much pressure and again left and right arm were different. Also it seems, they don't know much about anatomy as they were putting pressure on points which are not meant to be pressed with such strong power.

If you never had a thai massage or massage before, I'd not recommend this place, you will be traumatized. The staff is nice overall but definitely not professional or at least these two ladies we had.

The toilet is not clean, the sink was open, without a pipe. So as I washed my hands my feet got wet.

reviews.name: Ali Law
reviews.text: I came in because I saw the diagram of the pressure points on the door. I assumed that that they did foot reflexology. I got more of a basic massage with rubbing and pounding in no particular order and it was clear there wasn't any advanced anatomy knowledge. Great for basic foot rub at going rates in the area but definitely not reflexology.

reviews.name: Aris Karamessinis
reviews.text: Tried 1/2 hr foot massage, was great and shown good knowledge of reflexology. Tried also 1/2 hour thai massage which gave a good stretch and overall feel good.

reviews.text:
Wat meine zweite Massage in Thailand.
War sehr schmerzhaft.
Unter den Axeln wurde so massiv Druck ausgeübt, dass die Lymphknoten danach entzündet waren und ich jetzt seit zwei Wochen erkältet bin/ war.
Waren alle sehr nett, aber ich würde nicht mehr hingehen weil auch noch die von dem anderen negativen genannten Punkten von den anderen Bewertungen ebenfalls stimmen.

@Team Feedback: Bitte mal bei anderen Massagestudios schauen wir die das machen.
reviews.textTranslated:
This was my second massage in Thailand.
It was very painful.
The pressure was so intense under my armpits that my lymph nodes became inflamed, and I've had a cold for two weeks now.
Everyone was very nice, but I wouldn't go again because the negative points mentioned in the other reviews are also true.

@Team Feedback: Please check with other massage studios to see if they do this.

reviews.textTranslated: Excellent massages (for the back and shoulders with Tiger Balm). The room is large and clean. The masseuses are very professional. They allowed us to wait there until they were available, to protect us from the heat outside.

reviews.name: Momomo
reviews.text: 타이타이타이통이라고 위에있는 마사지샵과 같은 곳이라고 하네요. 원래는 거기 가려고 했는데 문을 닫아서 이 지점으로 오게 되었어요. 한국인도 종종 오시나봐요? 시설은 솔직히 좋지 못하지만 마사지 실력은 괜찮은 것 같습니다. 개인적으로 푸켓과 치앙마이에서 받은 마사지가 어른어른 떠오르지만 이정도면 나쁘지 않다 생각합니다. 우선 제가 아픈 곳을 잘 아는건 확실하더라구요. 오피스 신드롬을 겪고 계신 ㅠㅠ 분들께는 타이 허벌 마사지를 추천합니다...
reviews.textTranslated: I heard that this place, called Thai Thai Thai Tong, is the same as the massage shop mentioned above. I originally planned to go there, but it was closed, so I ended up coming to this branch. It looks like Koreans visit often, too. Honestly, the facilities aren't great, but the massage skills seem decent. Personally, the massages I received in Phuket and Chiang Mai keep coming to mind, but I think this isn't bad. First off, they definitely knew exactly where my sore spots were. I recommend Thai Herbal Massage to anyone suffering from office syndrome...

최고에요!!!  엄청 정성들여서 해주시는게 느껴져서 방콕에 머무는 사일동안 매일갔어요~!!

It's the best!!! I could really feel the care they put into their service, so I went every day for the four days I stayed in Bangkok~!!

It was the worst Thai massage I’ve ever had. The therapist clearly didn’t know what she was doing - she skipped parts of my body, kept repeating the same areas, applied no pressure where it was needed, and too much pressure in sensitive areas. I ended up stopping the session halfway as I realized it was a waste of time. Massage was made by girl with a short hair.
Additionally, the massage bed felt dirty, as if it hadn’t been changed after previous clients. I do not recommend this place

reviews.text: Overall, the restaurant was unclean, the chairs were broken, and the service was terrible. I went there yesterday and there was a lot of drinking and noise. She's always smiling and welcoming to customers, and she handles everything well even when her boss isn't around. I never thought the boss would treat her like this. I will never be returning here again.
