reviews.text: Last week i arrived in Bangkok and visited the shop. I choos a girl named Poppy. The rooms were good, quiet and clean. To be honest, i got more as i expected, from everything. She was cute, charming, very beautyful and i never had such a good experience her ein Bangkok before. I was very relaxed after and will come again for sure :-).

reviews.name: 泰風太郎
reviews.text:
ママさんに聞いたら、スクンビット24で
このエリアで一番最初に始めた
スペシャルマッサージ店らしく
一番長い歴史を持つお店とは驚きました！

女の子も新しい子が随時入ってきてるみたいで、
値段もサービスも良い！

支払いもクレカが使えるので、ありがたいです。
reviews.textTranslated:
I asked the owner and she told me that this is the first special massage parlor in the Sukhumvit 24 area, and I was surprised to find out it's the longest-running one!

It seems like new girls are constantly joining, and the prices and service are great!

I also appreciate that they accept credit cards for payment.

reviews.name: futsal Tulio
reviews.text:
日本の方向けに書きます。おすすめしません。
Iceちゃんという子を指名し90分Null Bath Room 3000Bahtで入りました。
しかし実際にはマットを使うことなく、オイルマッサージと何が違うのかわかりませんでした。
Iceちゃん曰く、小さいので使わないとのこと。確かにBath Roomには想像するマットプレイ用の半分くらいのサイズが立て掛けてありました。
また、60分経ったほどで2発目を発射するとそそくさと準備を始めシャワーを一瞬で浴びて終了となりました。浴びた後も急かされながら準備をさせられ退転させられました。ママさんに文句を言おうとも思いましたが、そんな暇すらなく追い出された気分です。店に"入って"から"出る"まで65分ほどでした。他店なら残った時間はマッサージするなり責めてお話しなりとなるのでは？
マットプレイもなく、60分終了とは話が違いすぎます。返金して欲しいと思ったの初めてです。本当におすすめしません。
reviews.textTranslated:
I'm writing this for Japanese customers. I do not recommend this place.
I requested a girl named Ice and booked a 90-minute session in a Null Bath Room for 3000 Baht.
However, she didn't actually use a mat, and I couldn't tell the difference between this and an oil massage.
Ice said she didn't use one because it was too small. Indeed, there was a mat propped up in the bathroom, about half the size you'd expect for mat play.
Also, after about 60 minutes, she quickly started getting ready after my second round, took a quick shower, and it was over. Even after showering, she rushed me to get ready and made me leave. I wanted to complain to the madam, but I didn't even have time; I felt like I was being kicked out. From "entering" the shop to "leaving," it was about 65 minutes. At other places, wouldn't the remaining time be used for a massage or some kind of teasing/conversation?

With no mat play and the session ending after 60 minutes, it was completely different from what was promised. This is the first time I've ever wanted a refund. I really do not recommend this place.

reviews.name: 對馬正貢
reviews.text:
ホテルの近くであったので、行って見ました。何人か女の子が並んでいたのですが、声を掛けて来た多岐川裕美似の娘と個室へ。彼女との接触は良かったのですが、部屋が寒い。ガンガンにクーラーが効いていて体が冷えてしまった。
彼女のサービスは充分でした。満足
reviews.textTranslated: It was near my hotel, so I went there. There were a few girls lined up, but a girl who looked like Takigawa Yumi called out to me, so I went to a private room. I had a good time with her, but the room was cold. The air conditioner was on full blast, so I got cold. Her service was sufficient. I was satisfied.

reviews.name: クレインクレイン
reviews.text:
日本の男性向けに書きます。
タイの風俗といえばゴーゴーバー、テーメーカフェ、エロマッサージ等が検索上位に入り、プロンポンのスペシャルマッサージは中々出てこないと思います。

オリエントマッサージは店の前に嬢が居て、顔を見て指名できます。(周囲も同じ形態の模様)
日本人好みの子も居ますし、異国情緒溢れる子も居ました。(来店時は4人居て、2:2ぐらいの割合)
英語やタイ語か堪能なら60分でサクッとマッサージからスペシャルまで。
連戦希望なら2時間で挑みましょう。

2時間+VIPルームで2,500Bでしっかり堪能出来ました。チップ200込でも3,000越えません。コスパ抜群です。
※連戦できず、英語やタイ語が話せないなら60分にしないと間が大変だと思われます。
reviews.textTranslated:
This is written for Japanese men.
When searching for Thai adult entertainment, go-go bars, themeka cafes, and erotic massage parlors tend to rank highly, and special massage parlors in Phrom Phong don't often come up in search results.

At Orient Massage, the girls are waiting outside the shop, and you can choose your girl after seeing her face. (The surrounding area seems to operate in the same way.)
There were girls who appealed to Japanese tastes, as well as girls with an exotic charm. (There were four girls when I visited, roughly a 2:2 ratio.)
If you're fluent in English or Thai, you can get a quick 60-minute session, from massage to special treatments.

If you want multiple sessions, go for 2 hours.

I was able to fully enjoy myself for 2,500 baht for 2 hours + VIP room. Even with a 200 baht tip, it didn't exceed 3,000 baht. Excellent value for money.

*If you can't do multiple sessions and don't speak English or Thai, you'll probably find the 60-minute session too long.

reviews.name: mik 726
reviews.text:
開業してから16年らしいのでこの業界では老舗の分類に入るのかな❗値段もそれほど高くなくぼったくるという雰囲気がないのが気に入っています。(人によるかも)VIPルームは必ず勧められますが…
初めて行っても安心なお店と言えると思う❗
reviews.textTranslated:
It seems they've been open for 16 years, so I guess that makes them a long-established business in this industry! I like that the prices aren't too high and there's no feeling of being ripped off. (Though this might depend on the person.) They always recommend the VIP room, though...
I think it's a safe place to go even for the first time!

reviews.name: Ting-Hong Chen
reviews.text: 小姐沒在官網上，雖然稍微豐腴了一點，但全場笑容很甜，給人女友感很足夠
reviews.textTranslated: The lady wasn't on the official website. Although she was a little plump, her smile was sweet throughout, giving off a strong girlfriend vibe.

reviews.text: Gel Massage で90分2400バーツは他店と比べると安い。お相手の名前はAriiちゃん。望むことは全てやってくれました。
reviews.textTranslated: The 90-minute Gel Massage was 2,400 baht, which is cheaper than other salons. My partner's name was Arii. She did everything I wanted.

reviews.text: Very professional massage skill 👍

reviews.text: Very Good!

reviews.text: Good good

reviews.name: 黃束貞
reviews.text: 整團臨時安排來按摩，沒想到店面超大，27人一起進來也完全沒問題。兩個小時全身指壓只要1000元，小費100元，CP值很高。我的師傅手藝相當不錯，按完整個人徹底放鬆，回到飯店直接躺平，連妝都沒卸就睡著了，真的舒服到不行。
reviews.textTranslated: The whole group was arranged to come for a massage at the last minute, and I didn't expect the shop to be so big; even 27 people could come in without any problem. Two hours of full-body acupressure only cost 1000 yuan, plus a 100 yuan tip, which was great value for money. My masseuse was very skilled; I felt completely relaxed after the massage. I went straight back to the hotel, lay down, and fell asleep without even removing my makeup. It was incredibly comfortable.

reviews.name: Chen Owen
reviews.text:
來這裡做指壓兩次，第一次實在太舒壓了，師傅的力道很夠，讓背部肌肉得到舒展開來。於是第二天再去按摩，結果這次的師傅力量真的不足，我講了好幾次加重力道，結果都沒有像第一次那樣，實在太可惜了。
一次五星，一次三星，平均就是四星了。
按摩完可以吃個米餅，還蠻好吃的，有販賣，喜歡可以買。
reviews.textTranslated:
I came here for acupressure twice. The first time was incredibly relaxing; the masseur's pressure was just right, really relaxing my back muscles. So I went back for a massage the next day, but this time the masseur's pressure was really insufficient. I asked for more pressure several times, but it wasn't as good as the first time, which was a real shame.

One massage was five stars, the other three stars, so the average is four stars.

After the massage, you can have a rice cake, which is quite delicious. They sell them; you can buy some if you like.

reviews.name: DEAN
reviews.text: 真的是我這輩子體驗過最舒服的一次按摩。師傅們彷彿對人體構造瞭若指掌，總能精準地在穴位周圍找到最需要放鬆的位置，尤其對骨頭的深層按壓特別講究。泰式按摩獨有的伸展與踩踏手法更是一絕，師傅運用全身重量穩定地踩壓在身體各處，力道深沉卻恰到不好處。每一次按壓都像是在打開緊繃已久的筋膜，讓身體逐漸舒展開來。按摩結束後，不只是肌肉放鬆，也是精神上的折磨，真正感受到身心靈合而為一的療癒感。
reviews.textTranslated: This was truly the most comfortable massage I've ever experienced. The masseuses seemed to have an unparalleled understanding of human anatomy, always able to pinpoint the most vulnerable spots around acupoints, with particular attention to deep pressure on the bones. The unique stretching and foot-pressing techniques of Thai massage were exceptional; the masseuse used their full weight to steadily press on various parts of the body, applying deep yet perfectly balanced pressure. Each press felt like opening up long-tightened fascia, allowing the body to gradually relax. After the massage, it wasn't just muscle relaxation, but also a mental and emotional release, a truly healing experience that brought body, mind, and spirit together.

reviews.name: Rui
reviews.text: 謝謝為我按摩的姐姐 您辛苦了
reviews.textTranslated: Thank you to the masseuse who gave me the massage. You worked so hard.

reviews.name: 林小梅
reviews.text: 初次跟團來按摩，我們團體是兩個小時$1000，推薦這位短髮阿姨按摩師，我剛好躺在風口冷氣很強，她發現我會冷還拿枕頭去調整風扇，穴道筋絡各個精準到位、力道剛剛好👍初體驗很棒！（看評論說自己來會有差異，這部分應該很吃運氣）
reviews.textTranslated: This was my first time getting a massage in a group. Our group paid $1000 for two hours. I highly recommend this short-haired lady masseuse. I happened to be lying in a drafty spot where the air conditioning was very cold, and she noticed I was cold and even brought a pillow to adjust the fan. She accurately targeted all the acupoints and meridians, and the pressure was just right 👍 ​​A fantastic first experience! (I read in the reviews that things might be different if you come on your own; this part probably depends a lot on luck.)

reviews.name: HANS CHIHHAN CHANG (張致瀚)
reviews.text: 跟著旅遊團來的，本來很擔心會不會因為團體就被混水摸魚，但我2026/05/02 16:00-19:00在二樓房間門口的床位，接受一位戴眼鏡的女性師傅按摩，非常的認真、舒服、時時關心力道是否ok，非常值得推薦
reviews.textTranslated: I came with a tour group, and I was initially worried that being part of a group might lead to me being taken advantage of. However, on May 2nd, 2026, from 4:00 PM to 7:00 PM, I received a massage from a bespectacled female masseuse on the bed near my room on the second floor. She was very attentive, the massage was comfortable, and she constantly checked whether the pressure was okay. I highly recommend her.

reviews.name: Yiing Teng
reviews.text: 🥸🙏很謝謝各位的姐姐阿姨晚上為我們加班🙏🤓🥹
reviews.textTranslated: 🥸🙏Thank you so much to all the ladies and aunties who worked overtime for us tonight!🙏🤓🥹

reviews.name: Bonnie Hsu
reviews.text: 師傅按摩手法差不多，很看個人運氣，總共來兩次，第一次很舒服，快睡覺，第二次那個師傅愛講話，不專心，雖然兩個師傅都有中途跑去上廁所，但第二次的一直跟別人講話，很不OK
reviews.textTranslated: The massage therapists' techniques were similar, and it really depends on luck. I came twice in total. The first time was very comfortable, and I almost fell asleep. The second therapist was talkative and inattentive. Although both therapists went to the restroom at times, the second one kept talking to others, which was very unpleasant.

reviews.name: 周胡元
reviews.text: 泰式按摩基於源自印度的阿育吠陀醫術，透過按摩穴位並輔以一些瑜伽姿勢，來調節人體的能量線。按摩師通常會從足部開始按摩，逐漸向身體上部移動，有節奏地進行指壓按摩，並通過一系列流暢的伸展運動，來幫助你緩解身心壓力。按摩師也可以根據你的需求，為你量身定製按摩手法。不同按摩店和spa通常都會在傳統按摩手法的基礎之上做一些變化，所以每家按摩店的手法都是獨一無二的。
reviews.textTranslated: Thai massage, based on Ayurvedic medicine originating from India, uses acupressure and yoga postures to regulate the body's energy channels. The therapist typically begins with the feet, gradually moving upwards, rhythmically applying acupressure and incorporating a series of flowing stretches to help relieve stress. The therapist can also customize the massage to your individual needs. Different massage parlors and spas often make variations on traditional techniques, making each establishment's approach unique.

reviews.name: WEN
reviews.text: 20251231按的還算不錯
reviews.textTranslated: The press on 20251231 was pretty good.

reviews.name: Evan Chiang
reviews.text:
農曆年前和家人跟團來這家
團費有含兩小的泰式全身按摩（牌價費用1000） 第一次的師傅按超好 我小費給兩百
最後一晚我們又來了（這次自費
結果第二次幫我按的按摩師按超爛 很混 態度敷衍
我給五十 她拿到五十呆住也沒說謝謝
我就走了 然後跟導遊抱怨
七個人去 三個人 都是第二次遠不如第一次
同店 不同按摩師 真的很吃運氣
建議跟團來 第一次按摩師的名字要記住，第二次要來可以跟導遊指名預訂。
reviews.textTranslated: Before the Lunar New Year, my family and I went to this place on a tour. The tour fee included a full Thai massage for two children (list price 1000 baht). The first masseur was excellent, and I tipped him 200 baht. We went back for our last night (this time at our own expense). The second masseur was terrible, very indifferent, and had a perfunctory attitude. I gave him 50 baht, and he just stared at me without saying thank you. I left and complained to the tour guide. Out of seven people who went, three experienced a significantly worse massage the second time. It really depends on luck – different masseuses at the same place. I recommend going on a tour. Remember the masseur's name for the first massage; if you want to come back for the second time, you can ask the tour guide to reserve that masseur's name.

reviews.name: 王哲宜
reviews.text: 穴道按壓的很舒服，整體按摩技術不錯值得再來
reviews.textTranslated: The acupressure felt very comfortable, and the overall massage technique was excellent; I would definitely come again.

reviews.name: 洳憶樓茶業
reviews.text: 服務、態度、專業、真的很好！讓我們整團人都想再來！
reviews.textTranslated: The service, attitude, and professionalism were truly excellent! Our entire group wants to come back!

reviews.name: 林凱西
reviews.text: 團體旅遊首選，從腳按到頭，讚。1000泰銖。
reviews.textTranslated: Excellent for group tours, massage from head to toe, highly recommended. 1000 Thai Baht.

reviews.name: Roger Hong
reviews.text: 做了精油按摩，還不錯

reviews.name: Ken Clark
reviews.text:
We visited the “Yoga Rooftop” studio in Phuket, Thailand, eager to attend their “Beach Yoga” class scheduled for 5:30 pm. The website instructed us to arrive 15 minutes early at the address provided for “CC,” which we did—arriving 20 minutes early. After snapping a few photos outside the location, we walked in, only to be told that the group had already left for the beach. The staff on-site seemed confused about the beach location and eventually provided a Google Maps pin using my phone. We left immediately, drove to the location indicated on the map, parked, and searched the beach but found no one.

The website stated that advance payment wasn’t necessary, so we planned to pay in Thai Baht upon arrival, which seemed reasonable at the time. However, the lack of clear communication and incorrect or contradictory information completely derailed the experience. While we later discovered that once you click on the class details there’s a note to arrive at 5 pm, this information was buried and not clearly reflected in the primary instructions.

We drove from Patong Beach on our scooter and carefully planned our day around this class, only to be met with poor coordination and misinformation. The studio staff had no contingency in place for people arriving at the listed time or location, as instructed on their website.

It’s unfortunate because the studio itself looked beautiful, and this could have been an incredible experience. However, the failure to provide accurate and consistent details made the whole situation disappointing. I’ve also noticed other reviews highlighting the same issue, and it’s clear this feedback has not been addressed.

This review will remain as is—a one-star rating—as we expect the studio to acknowledge this issue, comments on this post, and updates their website to ensure accurate information for future visitors. Accountability matters, and this is an opportunity for improvement.

reviews.name: Olena Tsulun
reviews.text:
Had a quite disappointing experience with the school. Beach yoga class location does not correspond to the information on the booking confirmation, communication from the personal is very poor.
I’ve booked a beach yoga class online, booking confirmation stated that meeting point should be at the Club Med Phuket at Kata beach. I’ve arrived 15 min in advance and could not find the group, when I’ve called the number mentioned in the booking to check if the location has changed, lady has failed to explain anything and just dropped the phone, when I’ve tried to recall no one picked up the phone.
If you are planning to book yoga class online, do double check the location, not to waste money and time as in my case.

reviews.name: Phoebe Jayne
reviews.text:
Great location for a rooftop yoga session and resort seems lovely too. However the sunset yoga class we attended was lacking and my partner (he is a yoga instructor) in particular was quite unhappy with our class and felt we should leave a review. The instructor didn’t cue us or really seem to offer any efficient assistance or instruction to people who were clearly beginners. My partner felt it was unsafe and at the time wanted to speak with someone about it but didn’t end up doing so. Would be more helpful to do that but I didn’t wish to offend anyone at the time.

It wasn’t an easy class I believe as there was one sick girl and someone’s kid who interrupted us a few times (maybe instructor was thrown off by this), but either way that was the experience.

reviews.name: Lisa Plaickner
reviews.text: I normally don't write reviews for yoga classes but I felt the need to do so for this one. The teacher did not adapt the class tho the level of the students. Almost just beginners, but we did a lot of advanced poses like headstand, crow, etc. A student next to me was trying multiple times to do headstand, I was afraid that she would hurt herself so I assisted her. I think its quite dangerous to put such poses into an open class. You can, but then they really have to be explained properly but they weren't. Of course you could skip them, but then you would miss out on 80 percent class. Almost no variations were given. The vibe didn't feel supportive either, I feel like the teacher mainly applauded the ones that could do the hard poses. Wouldn't come again.

reviews.text: I just had a massage here and it was divine. I came about an hour before closing so I wasn't expecting much, but boy did they deliver. I asked for a 1 hour foot massage. It's a small massage parlor and a bit off from the main road, but the service you get can rival those more expensive and mainstream ones you see on major roads and streets. Go there! reviews.text:
I visited your establishment a year ago and had an amazing experience – the massage was highly professional, relaxing, and of excellent quality. Because of that wonderful experience, I returned this time with high expectations, but unfortunately, the service did not match the previous standard. This time, the massage felt much less professional, and the overall experience fell short of what it was before.

In addition to this, I paid 450 baht for an aromatic massage, gave 1,000 baht, and received only 500 baht in change. On my way home, I realized I had overpaid.

I’m sharing this feedback out of appreciation for your place, hoping you’ll take note of the improvements needed to restore the high level of service you once provided. I would love to return in the future and see positive changes.☺️

reviews.name: Eve L
reviews.text:
Worst massage I have had after traveling Thailand for 3 weeks.
After almost daily treating myself to a foot massage after long days of sight seeing, I believe I’m somewhat sufficient in telling what a good massage is. This was far from it.

As soon as I entered the salon, I woke up the masseuse that was sleeping on one of the beds, as well a an older guy in an armchair at the door. I guess they had a slow day (and now I see why).

During my massage, the masseuse kept walking away multiple times to her computer to answer every LOUD sound of an incoming message. The times she was back, she only put some lotion on my legs. No massaging at all.
The older guy at the door fell asleep again and was snoring loudly, while my face was 30cm away from him, separated by a curtain. It was amazing that the masseuse didn’t say anything about it. But it matched the unprofessional vibe of this parlor perfectly anyway.

After 20 minutes of “petting” one leg, 20 minutes the other (this includes walking away 5 times), and she was finished. She wanted me to pay for the full hour. When I mentioned there was still at least 20 minutes left, she pretended to be confused and only said “no you pay now, you pay now”.

Safe to say I did not pay full and I do not recommend this miserable place. Never again. Please be warned and don’t get scammed by them.

reviews.name: Desmond Cheung
reviews.text:
WORST MASSAGE OF THAILAND. DO NOT COME HERE.

Our first bad massage after 10+ massages during our trip. Very lazy masseuse who was sleeping when we came in the shop.  She is only using one hand during the massage while CALLING ON HER PHONE with the other. Constantly walking away. Also there was a man (non customer) in the store SNORING loudly.

She ended the massage after 45 mins, which I mentioned, and therefore I refused to pay the full 500.

If this masseuse was an employee, she deserves to be fired. If she's the owner: your business deserves to fail.

reviews.text: มาที่นี่ครั้งแรก นวดดีม๊ากก แนะนำเลย เปิดประสบการณ์สุดๆ ไปนวดมาหลายร้าน ประทับใจร้านนี้ที่สุด มีการประคบผ้าร้อนให้ ฟินม๊ากกก พึ่งเคยเจอครั้งแรกเลย ดีสุดๆๆ มากันเยอะๆนะครับ วันนี้ได้นวดกับพี่จ๋าครับ ก่อนที่จะเข้ามาเห็นรีวิวไม่ดีก็ลังเลว่าจะมาดีมั้ย แต่ก็ลองวัดใจดู ถ้าวันนี้ไม่ได้มาคงเสียดายน่าดู เท่าที่ทราบมา จากการสอบถามพี่จ๋า ได้มีการเปลี่ยนคนดูแลใหม่แล้ว มานวดกันเยอะๆนะครับ แล้วทุกคนจะไม่ผิดหวัง (รีวิวจากใจ ไม่อวย) ขอให้ปังๆนะค้าบบ🤍

reviews.text:
เราไปนวดออย2ชม. เชื่อมั้ยว่าไม่สบายเลย เเค่ลูบๆคลำ ไม่มีท่านวดไหนที่ทำไห้สบายตัวเลย คนนวดก้ใส่ถุงมือนวด คืออะไรงงมาก
นวดมาเยอะ ถึงคนนวดไม่เป็นก้ไม่เคยเห็นพนักงานรักเกียจ ลค.ถึงขนาดค้องใส่ถุงมือนวดเลยซักที มาเจอร้านนี้คือเฟวมาก เอาหลักการไหนมาคิดว่าใส่ถุงมือนวดไม่เคยเห็นไครทำมาก่อน นวดไม่สบายทีนึงละต้องมารพคาญกับถุงมืออีก โห....โครตเสียความรู้สึกเลย การนวดไม่ไช่ทำไห้ลค.สบายในการมานวดหรอ เค้ามานวดเพื่อต้องการรีเเลคร่างกาย เเต่นี่อะไรน่ารำคาญสุดๆ ดีนะที่เราไม่โวยวายเพราะเเฟนมาบอกหลังออกมาเเล้ว
ยังไห้ทิปด้วยซ้ำ พอเลยครั้งนี้ครั้งเดียวพอ 😡😡😡😡😡
ไครไปนวดร้านนี่คิดดีๆค่ะเราเสียเงินเพื่อไห้ร่างกายพักผ่อนสบาย ไม่ใช่หัวน่ารำคาญกว่าเดิม
reviews.textTranslated:
We went for a 2-hour oil massage. Believe it or not, it was so uncomfortable. They just stroked and caressed, but none of the massage techniques made me feel comfortable. The masseuse even wore gloves! What the heck? I'm so confused.
I've had massages at many places, and even if the masseuse wasn't skilled, I've never seen an employee so disrespectful to a client that they had to wear gloves. This place was a total disappointment. What logic did they have to think that wearing gloves during a massage was something they'd never seen before? One uncomfortable massage and then having to deal with the annoying gloves on top of that... Ugh... I was so disappointed. Isn't a massage supposed to make the client feel comfortable? People come for massages to relax their bodies, but this was so irritating. Luckily, I didn't make a fuss because my boyfriend told me after we left.
I even gave a tip. That's it, one time is enough. 😡😡😡😡😡
Anyone thinking of going to this massage shop, think carefully. We pay for relaxation, not to have our heads annoyed even more.

reviews.name: Eddie Yau
reviews.text:
Worst massage I’ve ever had in my life.
Went in for 2 hours Thai massage, the lady was incredibly rude and unprofessional.

First of all, the lady just stood in the massage room with me whilst I was changing clothes. I tried to use a polite tone to ask her out as I needed to change my pants but she just acted rude and urged me to finish the changing. I didn’t become angry as I could understand she might be very tired from all the massages.

However, for the whole hour, she just kept massaging (or stepping?) my glutes and hamstrings. I politely asked her to stop massaging my legs as I needed more on my shoulders, then she just gave me a rude reply, ”you want Thai massage right?” while WITH A HEADPHONE ON HER RIGHT EAR?
I was like,”yes, but I need more on my shoulders”, despite she was being very impolite and impatient.

Then she just went out and asked the manager to talk to me. Unfortunately, the manager seems to side with her and said she has her own massage protocol, and I cannot change it. I was very confused, as I saw the massager on the other bed was doing another “protocol” so it’s all her own excuse.

I insisted and the lady massager kept massaging me and kept speaking in Thai with anger. I couldn’t take it no more and said, “what did you just say?”. Then She just left and ran to her manager. It didn’t end well.

Finally the manager changed the new massager for me.

Honestly, if you don’t want to do the massage, just straight up tell me and I don’t mind waiting. No one forces her to massage.

I 100% do not recommend this massage store. Period.

reviews.text:
เป็นลูกค้ามาปีกว่าๆ แล้ว Glow Fitness เป็นฟิตเนสที่ไปแล้วอบอุ่นมาก ไปแล้วอยากไปอีก
ตอนที่ไปออกกำลังคือ เวลาผ่านไปไว ไม่ทรมานกับการออกกำลังเลยค่ะ 😆 เพลินและสนุกกับการออกกำลังสุดๆ
เดิมเป็นคนที่ไม่ชอบออกกำลังกายเลย แถมไม่มีความรู้ในการเวทและสร้างกล้ามเนื้อเลย
แต่ที่นี่ทำให้เรารักการออกกำลังกายขึ้นมาได้ (รวมทั้งการยืดเหยียด) ทำให้เราสุขภาพแข็งแรง แทบไม่ป่วยเลย มีความภูมิใจในตัวเองในเรื่องสุขภาพ บุคลิกภาพดีขึ้น มีกล้ามเนื้อเยอะขึ้นแบบชิวๆ ไม่เครียดด้วย

คือเทรนเนอร์น่ารัก เทรนด์ดี ตั้งใจมาก มีการวางแผนมาเป็นอย่างดี เก็บข้อมูล ดูพัฒนาการของลูกค้า ออกแบบแผนมาได้พอดีกับเราสุดๆ ทั้งสนุก หลากหลายรูปแบบ แต่ได้ผลลัพธ์เน้นๆ เทรนเนอร์เป็นกันเอง ดูแลกันเหมือนคนในครอบครัว สามารถทักไปขอคำแนะนำได้เสมอ
แถมยังมีคาเฟ่ในฟิตเนส จิบกาแฟไปเทรนด์ไป บางครั้งก็มัทฉะ คือดี อร่อยมาก กาแฟดี มัทฉะดี ฮีลใจหลังเทรนด์เสร็จสุดๆ

ดีไปหมดดด ใครสนใจอยู่ ไม่ต้องลังเลเลยค่ะ มาลองดูก่อน ไม่ผิดหวังแน่นอน เค้ามีโปรโมชั่น กิจกรรมเรื่อยๆ ด้วยนะคะ :)))
reviews.textTranslated:
I've been a customer at Glow Fitness for over a year now. It's a really warm and welcoming gym, and I always want to go back again.
When I work out, time flies by; it's not at all grueling! 😆 It's so enjoyable and fun.
Before, I hated exercising and had no knowledge of weight training or muscle building.
But this gym has made me love exercising (including stretching!). It's made me healthier, I rarely get sick, I feel proud of my health, my physique has improved, and I've gained muscle effortlessly without stress.

The trainers are lovely, great, and very dedicated. They have excellent plans, collect data, monitor client progress, and design plans that fit me perfectly. They're fun, varied, and deliver great results. The trainers are friendly and treat you like family; you can always ask for advice.
Plus, there's a cafe in the gym where you can enjoy coffee while training, sometimes matcha – it's delicious! The coffee and matcha are great, perfect for healing after a workout.

Everything's great! If you're interested, don't hesitate. Try it out; you won't be disappointed. They also have promotions and events regularly. :)))

reviews.name: Genta
reviews.text:
My experience at the AWAY Spa at W Bangkok was nothing short of extraordinary! The spa features stunning neon-lit rooms that resemble spaceship-like pods, creating an otherworldly ambiance that instantly puts you in a relaxed state of mind. It’s a beautifully designed space that feels both luxurious and innovative.

One of the highlights was the great hammam option, which offered a truly rejuvenating experience. The attention to detail in the design and services is impressive, making every moment feel special.

I also loved the chill area, complete with a hot tub whirlpool that’s perfect for unwinding after treatments. It’s the ideal spot to relax and soak in the beautiful surroundings.

Overall, AWAY Spa is a must-visit for anyone looking to indulge in a luxurious spa day. The combination of beautiful design, exceptional amenities, and top-notch treatments makes it a memorable experience!

 Tip เปลี่ยนมุมองศาการวางเท้าเฉียงเล็กน้อย จะช่วยเน้นกล้ามเนื้อก้นด้านข้าง (Gluteus Medius) ได้ดียิ่งขึ้น!
